11614218.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11614218.value: Contaminated urban land in China is the result of the relocation of state-owned enterprises, engaging in manufacturing activities from urban areas, to less-developed urban peripheries beginning in the 1990s. Primarily driven by a booming real estate market in the 2000s, such a de-industrialization process became more widespread, evidenced by a significant amount of former industrial land being redeveloped for more productive uses. However, the redevelopment of industrial sites, commonly known as brownfields in the Western context, does not appear to be treated differently from non-contaminated sites until very recently. Over the past ten plus years, two major changes related to China’s industrial sites have occurred. The first is the result of the launching of a market-based land transaction system, which replaced the past free-allocation or negotiation-based land-use right transfer. The second change, related to the increasing awareness of land contamination, has resulted in policy initiatives and media exposure of contamination-induced health problems in newly built communities, which has caught local and national attention. A debate prevailing in the Western literature is whether it is necessary to spend public money cleaning up private properties. Using empirical data of cities in the United States, scholars find statistically significant positive linkage between remediated brownfields and the surrounding properties. Also, they find that for industrial properties in prime locations, sales price displays a discounted rate that appears to take into consideration remediation cost. Such an empirical analysis with Chinese land data is clearly missing. This study fills a gap in the literature by investigating all land sales in three top tier cities in China over a thirteen-year period. With over ten years of land sales under the market mechanism, this study examines whether land remediation cost in industrial site redevelopment has been capitalized in land prices. I expect to find out that, due to the increasing societal awareness of environmental problems related to land contamination and the adoption of the market mechanism in land transaction, real estate developers have learned over time to take into consideration remediation cost when they bid on former industrial sites. In addition, cities with different policy initiatives show different price response to potential contamination. 20世纪90年代开始，中国国有企业陆续将生产制造基地从城区内搬迁到郊外或欠发达地区，遗留下了大量受污染的城市用地。2000年后房地产业的迅猛发展，带动了大量老旧工业基地土地再开发，去工业化的范围遍及全国大中城市。废旧工业用地在西方国家通常被理解为“棕地”（即污染用地），其再开发过程需要区别于非污染用地。然而，中国社会直到近几年才开始意识到区别对待开发棕地的必要性。 在过去十多年间，中国有两件影响工业用地的重要事件。一件就是替代以往的土地使用权无偿划拨和协议转让，实施基于市场的土地拍卖制度。另一件就是中国社会对土地污染问题的认知度提高，一系列棕地治理政策措施出台，媒体曝光新建社区内土地污染导致的健康问题也引起国内外的关注。 是否有必要投入政府资金去清理私有土地是西方研究学者广泛争议的问题。美国的实证数据研究表明，清理过的棕地与其周边房地产价值呈现显著正相关性。同时，此类研究还发现，对于区位较好的工业地产买卖，成交价通常会以折扣的方式反映出土地清理费用。迄今为止，基于中国数据的此类研究严重缺失。 本课题深入研究中国三个一线城市历年土地拍卖交易，弥补学术空白。通过分析十三年的土地拍卖交易信息和相关数据，本课题拟验证工业用地再开发过程中产生的土地清理费用是否反映在土地价格中。预期结论包含，随着时间的推移，房地产开发商在竞拍土地时受两方面因素的影响，即社会对土地污染问题认知度的提高以及土地市场交易制度的实施，开发商逐渐学会了在竞拍报价中考虑后期清理费用。另一个预期结论是，不同城市棕地政策措施的差异导致了土地价格对土地污染因素的灵敏度不同。

11614218.label: Realisation of objectives
11614218.value: Studies have shown that brownfields are often sold at a discounted price to compensate for anticipated clean-up costs and potential liability risk. However, such a hypothesis has not been tested in the Chinese context, largely due to a lack of information about land contamination and the absence of regulations regarding brownfields. Over the past decade, Chinese cities’ gradual introduction of redevelopment policies for former industrial sites has increased public awareness regarding land contamination. In major cities like Beijing and Shanghai, the land market has responded to regulations on mandatory environmental information disclosure at land auctions. Under this institutional context, the overall objective of this project is to examine (1) whether there is a learning curve for real estate developers who bid on former industrial sites, and (2) whether the land market has responded differently to brownfield policies in terms of policy initiatives, learning curve of developers, and price discount due to contamination. This overall objective was then broken down into several sub-objectives. We first review the timelines of brownfields policies at both the national and city levels. After gaining a comprehensive understanding of brownfield regulations and information disclosure requirements during land transactions, we identified critical time points of policy implementation. The critical time point thus becomes the reference for evaluating before-and-after policy impact. Then, we collected and manipulated land sales data for our case-study cities. To build econometric models, we also collected other data, including socio-economic data, land use maps, geo-spatial data, etc. For each case study city, we conducted separate regression analyses. All of the objectives have been achieved, with a slight deviation from original plan. In the original project proposal, the empirical data are about three cities—Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou. We have completed analysis with data of Beijing and Shanghai. However, we were unable to gather the complete set of data for Guangzhou due to the interruption of Covid-19. To overcome the problem, we shifted our case study city from Guangzhou to Hong Kong. This change of case subject does not compromise our research objectives. Instead, studying Hong Kong’s brownfields actually better supplement the research contribution to existing knowledge.

11614218.label: Major findings and research outcome
11614218.value: This study is the first of its kind to statistically examine the impact of environmental policy on brownfield pricing in the Chinese context. Unlike advanced countries where contamination is a deterrent to land sales, brownfield redevelopment in Chinese cities used not to differ from greenfields in any significant way, partly because of insufficient brownfield regulations and weak public awareness regarding land contamination. In this project, we statistically prove that, over time, real estate developers do display a learning curve while bidding for former industrial sites, as reflected by the significance level and magnitude of price discounts offered for brownfields. Policies requiring contamination information be disclosed in auction invitation documents thus ensure developers to have better knowledge about site conditions and their potential environmental liabilities. (Objectives 1&2) To explore the extent of the impact of brownfield policies on land leasing prices, we empirically analyze land transaction data for the period from 2007 to 2019 (Objectives 4&5). Our analyses produce three major findings. First, the results of the DID baseline models indicate that environmental policies have a negative effect on the sales prices of brownfields, reducing them by about 18% after three years of policy implementation. Second, we find that local district governments, the initial auction asking price setters, display a similar temporal response to the brownfield regulations to that of the private developers. Asking prices for the brownfield parcels are, on average, 14–16% lower than that for greenfield parcels after four years. Third, with regard to the urban versus suburban areas, the regression results of the sales prices reveal no significant differences between urban and suburban areas. In contrast, the regression results for the asking prices reveal a negative impact on suburban brownfields, implying the existence of a different pricing mechanism between urban and suburban district governments. For Hong Kong, we took alternative approaches. Through investigating the impact of cleaning up landfill sites on housing prices, we find that housing prices near landfill sites increase about 2.2% within two years after landfill restoration; but housing prices show no further change after the restored landfill sites are redeveloped into urban. Additionally, we applied remote sensing method to identify the spatio-temporal land use change patterns of brownfields. We find that, despite regulatory control over rural land and strengthened enforcement measures, brownfields in Hong Kong continue to grow in a decentralized and fragmented fashion.

11614218.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11614218.value: There are two directions for future studies. First, for this project, we identified brownfields by assuming that parcels previously engaging in industrial activities are brownfields because few organizations or agencies in China have a complete understanding of redeveloped industrial sites. As brownfields have been one of the major concerns of the Chinese government, we hope that one day the environmental agencies will build a database of brownfield parcels that discloses the degree of contamination. With such information, we can improve our models with much refined information. Second direction is to examine heterogeneous effects on parcels for commercial versus residential uses. Although some empirical studies have shown that brownfields cause greater price discounts for residential than commercial properties, we cannot test this hypothesis with existing land transaction data. Our study examines the impact of information disclosures on land markets, where developers are the major players, rather than the housing market, where homebuyers are the main players. Because the information disclosure policy applies to land transactions, not housing transactions, information asymmetry exists between homebuyers and developers, meaning that homebuyers unlikely have full knowledge about the site history. This potential research area would be possible once China has a more mature brownfield market.

11614218.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11614218.value: There is a dearth of brownfield studies in the Chinese context, even rarer is statistical examination linking land contamination to land prices. This project enriches existing literature and provides significant policy implications. First, with rigorous method, this study highlights the importance of information disclosure for environment issues. We demonstrate that policies requiring disclosure of contamination information in auction invitation documents can ensure developers having better knowledge about site conditions when they bid for parcels. We tested the causal relationship between environmental policy that requires information disclosure and contamination-induced price discount in an open land market. Second, this study enriches literature on the capitalization of land pollution into property prices. We proved that industrial sites, which, in the past, sold at the same rate as greenfields, are now sold at discounted prices because of environmental information disclosure. Third, this research sheds light on how governments can use market mechanisms to intervene in brownfield development. The majority of midsized and large cities in China have been facing the closure of heavy manufacturing plants, leading to a significant volume of vacated land. Our research methods can be easily applied to other cities where land transaction data are publicly available.

11615518.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11615518.value: 在過往二十年間，香港藝術家創作了不少作品來探討生態議題。此研究項目旨在記錄他們的藝術實踐，分析在香港的社會、政治、生態情境下藝術和生態的關係，探討生態審美的理論問題。研究者將試圖回答以下問題：香港藝術家使用了哪些策略來推動生態議題？他們如何思考香港的生態和香港的殖民歷史、資本主義意識形態、日趨降低的自主性之間的關係？他們如何將行動主義和形式實驗相結合？哪些機構和話語力量幫助生態藝術實踐在近年得以繁榮？哪些領域需要年青一代藝術家更多的關注和實驗？

The artists used a wide range of media, including photography, film, installation, sound, performance, and social practice. 11615518.label: Major findings and research outcome
11615518.value: Major findings: The ecological art projects documented in this research project happened within the two decades after Hong Kong’s handover. They mainly occurred in rural Hong Kong, and addressed land-related issues, ranging from land for garbage dump, to land for farming, to land for development. Many projects took an collective approach: artists gathered together and often collaborated with villagers. Several also were pedagogical, for students and wider communities. The forms of these projects are diverse, from painting to photography, from documentary to dance. Together they constitute an important field in Hong Kong’s post-1997 art and social landscape. Compared to an earlier project conducted by the PI on ecological art practices in Mainland China, this project clearly reveals the land and ocean consciousness that motivates ecological art practices in Hong Kong. Research outcome: Fourteen in-depth case studies have been written and added to the open online database http://ecoartasia.net/. The database allows rich visual and audio materials to be accessible to students and researchers. A book-length manuscript based on these fourteen narrative essays has been prepared and will be submitted to an academic publisher for review.

11615518.value: Ecological art practices continue to develop in Hong Kong. I will continue to follow this field and conduct further research in a few years.

12100018.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12100018.value: The 5’ end of a eukaryotic mRNA generally contains a methyl guanosine cap (m7G cap). In addition to protecting the mRNA from degradation, the cap mediates almost all other aspects of gene expression, including transcription, RNA processing/modification, transport, translation, and gene silencing. A distinctive feature of prokaryotic RNAs is the absence of the 5’-cap. However, in recent years, some bacterial RNAs, particularly a subset of regulatory RNAs and mRNAs, were found to contain a NAD+ moiety at their 5’ ends. Earlier this year, it was reported that yeast and mammalian RNAs also contain the NAD cap. These findings raise intriguing questions about physiological significance and regulatory implications of this nonconventional RNA cap, adding another piece to the complex puzzle of RNA-based regulation of gene expression. Regulated removal of the RNA cap structure requires de-capping enzymes. Dcp2, a nudix family protein, is the best-known enzyme in eukaryotes that removes the m7G cap from RNA. Very recently, an E. coli nudix protein (NudC) and the yeast and mammalian Rai1/DXO proteins were reported to function as NAD-RNA decapping enzymes. We have found that Arabidopsis DXO (AtDXO) also hydrolyzes NAD from NAD-capped RNAs. We have obtained homozygous atdxo knockout mutants. While the atdxo mutant embryos can develop into viable seeds, the mutant seedlings display multiple developmental defects. The atdxo mutant phenotypes can be fully complemented by transgenic expression of the fission yeast Rai1 gene, indicating functional similarity between the yeast Rai1 and AtDXO. This proposed study focuses on understanding of molecular and biological functions of the DXO protein and NAD-capped RNAs in Arabidopsis. We will capture NAD-capped RNAs from Arabidopsis using a click chemistry-based method, and the captured RNAs will be sequenced to identify NAD-capped RNAs from both Arabidopsis wildtype and atdxo mutant plants. Profiles of NAD-RNAs and global transcriptomes from wildtype and atdxo will be compared to provide important clues on RNA targets of AtDXO and possible biological pathways mediated by AtDXO. Together with functional analysis of the AtDXO loss-of-function mutations and gain-of-function forms, this study will make a significant contribution to the emerging field of non-conventional RNA capping and decapping. 在真核生物中，mRNA的5’末端通常會有一個m7G作為它的端帽。該帽子結構除了保護mRNA免被降解，還通過參與核糖核酸的修飾、轉運和翻譯的過程，調控基因表達。原核生物並沒有一個m7G端帽。然而，在最近的研究中發現，一些細菌的RNA分子的5’末端具有一個NAD分子。這些被報導的NAD-RNA分子，一部分被認為是具有調控功能，另一部分則是mRNA。 在2017年，酵母和動物細胞中也發現了帶有NAD帽子結構的NAD-RNA。NAD端帽的發現表明基因調控存在一個新的機理。那麼這種不同於一般帽子結構的NAD端帽，在生物體中又發揮著怎樣的作用，又具有怎樣的生物學意義？ mRNA去端帽是與去端帽的酶來調控。 在真核生物中，隷屬於nudix蛋白家族的DCP2蛋白，是廣為人知的m7G端帽的脫端帽酶。在最近的報導中，大腸桿菌的NudC蛋白以及真核生物酵母和哺乳動物細胞中的Rai1/DXO家族蛋白被發現具有去除NAD帽子結構的功能。在我們的研究中，擬南芥的DXO蛋白可以水解NAD-RNA的端帽結構，將NAD從核糖核酸的5’端去除掉。缺失DXO蛋白的擬南芥突變體雖然可以完成胚胎發育至產生種子，但植物本身出現多樣的生長發育缺陷。在dxo突變體中表達裂殖酵母Rai1基因，可完全回補這些嚴重的生長缺陷。以上結果，證明了擬南芥DXO蛋白與裂殖酵母Rai1蛋白具有相似的功能。 本研究將專注於闡明擬南芥DXO蛋白和NAD-RNA的作用機制和生物學意義。我們將採用基於點擊化學來標記、富集和鑒定NAD-RNA的方法來找出擬南芥中的NAD-RNA, 對dxo突變體和野生型中的NAD-RNA的含量及序列與其轉錄組數據進行比較，瞭解擬南芥DXO蛋白在體內的底物。結合我們對擬南芥DXO功能缺失突變體及功能獲得性突變體的分析，此研究將對這一RNA新型端帽和去端帽的研究領域做出貢獻。

12100018.label: Realisation of objectives
12100018.value: Development of new methods for identification and analysis of NAD-capped RNAs In the submitted proposal, we planned to use the previously reported NAD captureSeq method to identify NAD-RNAs in Arabidopsis. However, while carrying out the NAD captureSeq analysis, we realized some shortcomings associated with the method. We decided to develop a new method for transcriptome-wide analysis of NAD-RNAs. The new method we developed is termed NAD tagSeq (Zhang et al, 2019, PNAS; Shao et al, Nature Protocols). NAD tagSeq uses the same enzymatic and click chemistry reactions as in NAD captureSeq for tagging NAD-RNAs. However, instead of tagging NAD-RNAs with biotin, the NAD tagSeq method labels NAD-RNAs with a synthetic RNA tag. After tagging, tagged RNAs can be enriched by hybridization to a DNA probe complementary to the RNA tag. The RNA samples are then directly sequenced by using Oxford nanopore sequencing. RNA reads containing the tag are considered as NAD-RNAs. The NAD tagSeq method was used to profile NAD-RNAs in Arabidopsis (Zhang et al, 2019). We found that the click chemistry reaction (CuAAC) used in tagging NAD-RNAs causes severe RNA degradation. We developed a new tagging approach using a different click chemistry reaction (SPAAC) which increases sensitivity by approximately 10 folds and the SPAAC-based methods were used to profile NAD-RNAs in E. coli and Arabidopsis (Zhang et al, PNAS, 2021; Hu et al, PNAS, 2021). We have developed a reliable method (using a m7G decapping enzyme) to remove the m7G cap in RNA samples before subjecting samples to tagging to reduce noise from m7G-RNAs. Previously reported methods for NAD-RNA profiling still have some major shortcomings, including insufficient sensitivity and inability to identify exact 5’ ends of NAD-RNAs. To overcome these shortcomings, we recently developed two new methods named precision NAD-sequencing (pNAD-seq) and NAD linkSeq (unpublished). These methods are based on our finding that biotin-tagged NAD-RNA can still be decapped by a NAD-RNA decapping enzyme (nudC). The decapped RNAs can then be ligated with a 5’ linker and specifically amplified by RT-PCR, and the resulting cDNA library can be sequenced by a 2nd-generation sequencing platform. In addition to enrichment of NAD-RNAs by biotin tagging and purification via streptavidin resin like in the other methods, pNAD-seq and NAD-linkSeq introduce the second step of enrichment by selective amplification of NAD-RNAs through PCR. As a result, it offers a much higher sensitivity. In addition, the 5’ end of a NAD-RNA can be identified as it is flanked with the 5’ linker. We have used the pNAD-seq and NAD-linkSeq methods to profile NAD-RNAs in various organisms, including Arabidopsis. We found that NAD-RNAs have features that have not been found previously. First, NAD-RNAs are typically small RNAs with a size of 20-160 nucleotides, making it unlikely that they are protein-coding. Second, NAD-RNAs in Arabidopsis are mostly produced from the mitochondrial genomes. A small number (several dozens) of nuclear genes in Arabidopsis also produce NAD-RNAs, but generally at a much lower levels compared to these produced in mitochondria. Third, some NAD-RNAs are produced from alternative promoters, often localized in intragenic regions. Our findings indicate that NAD-RNAs more likely function as regulatory RNAs. Identification of AtDXO’s putative RNA targets/substrates We initially used the NAD tagSeq II method to compare NAD-RNA profiles between wt and dxo1 mutant. However, we only detected a low level of NAD-RNAs from a small number of genes. The NAD-RNA profiles were not obviously different between wt and the mutant. We realized that the sensitivity of the method was not high enough. In addition, the NAD tagSeq method is based on Nanopore sequencing and small RNAs (<120 nucleotides) could not be sequenced by this method. We later found that NAD-RNAs are mostly small RNAs (see above). We are now using the recently developed pNAD-seq method to generate and compare NAD-RNA profiles in wt and dxo1. Our preliminary data also indicate that NAD-capped transcripts from the nuclear genome in Arabidopsis (likely also in other eukaryotic organisms) are nascent transcripts that are transcriptionally paused. They don’t accumulate in cells as each cell likely has no more than two NAD-capped transcripts from each locus. Therefore, their abundance is very low. To enhance the sensitivity in identifying and quantifying NAD-RNAs from nuclear genes, we are developing a method to isolate nascent transcripts from nuclei which will then be used to profile NAD-capped transcripts. We proposed to identify NAD-RNAs that could be DXO1’s targets by identifying DXO1-binding RNAs. We have found that DXO1 is likely a general RNA-binding protein (Pan et al, JIPB, 2019) and its RNA-binding domain is likely located in the C-terminus which binds to RNA bodies non-specifically. Therefore, identifying RNAs associated with DXO1 is not a good approach in identifying NAD-RNAs that are targeted for decapping by DXO1. Understanding biological functions of AtDXO We obtained two T-DNA insertion lines and one knockout line generated by using the CRISPR-cas9 genome editing technique. All three lines displayed similar pleotropic phenotypes. The mutants showed severe growth defects with small sizes and narrow and yellowish leaves. Their reproductive organs are often deformed with severe reduction in fertility (both male and female fertility). Transcriptome profiles of WT and the dxo1 mutants revealed that the mutants showed elevated expression of defense-related genes but reduction in photosynthesis-related genes. The above findings were included in the published paper (Pan et al, JIPB, 2019). We previously found that almost all phenotypes associated with the dxo1 mutant could be complemented by a catalytically inactive form of DXO1, suggesting that it is not the defect in NAD-RNA decapping that resulted in the phenotype (Pan et al, JIPB, 2019). The result indicates that DXO1 has another important function unrelated to its enzymatic activity. One of the DXO1-interacting proteins identified by our Y2H screen shares a significant sequence similarity to RNA cap methyl transferases (RNMTs) in eukaryotic organisms that convert the guanosine cap of mRNAs to the methylguanosine (m7G) cap. Our study further showed that this protein (named RNMT1) is indeed the sole enzyme in Arabidopsis that catalyze methylation of the guanosine cap. Interestingly, RNMT1 possesses a basal activity and is activated by physical association with DXO1 (a manuscript under the second round of review by Nature Communications). The catalytically inactive DXO1 can similarly activate RNMT1. Our study reveals a novel mechanism in m7G capping in plants in which a NAD-RNA decapping enzyme is a critical component of m7G capping, raising an intriguing possibility that NAD-RNA decapping might be interconnected with m7G capping in plants.

12100018.label: Major findings and research outcome
12100018.value: 1. NAD-RNA biology is a newly emerging field. Availability of a reliable and sensitive method to profile cellular NAD-RNAs is essential for studying their biological and molecular functions. Therefore, we have devoted a significant amount of resources and effort toward the method development (NAD tagSeq, NAD tagSeq II, pNAD-seq, and NAD-linkSeq). We believe that pNAD-seq, in particular, offers a much higher sensitivity and accuracy for identification of NAD-RNAs and could be a ‘gold standard’ in this field for profiling cellular NAD-RNAs. This effort has led to multiple publications (Zhang et al, PNAS, 2019; Shao et al, Nature Protocols, 2020; Zhang et al, PNAS, 2021; Hu et al, PNAS, 2021; and a manuscript in preparation on pNAD-seq and NAD-linkSeq). 2. We found the Arabidopsis DXO1 possesses the NAD-RNA decapping (deNADding) activity. Its loss-of-function mutation causes pleiotropic phenotypes, including severe developmental defects, increased expression of defense genes and reduced expression photosynthetic genes. However, the dxo1 phenotypes could be complemented by the catalytically inactive DXO1, indicating that in addition to its deNADding activity, it has another important function unrelated to its enzymatic activity. These findings have been published (Pan et al, JIPB, 2019). 3. We identified a DXO1-interacting protein (RNMT1). We found that RNMT1 is the enzyme in Arabidopsis that catalyzes conversion of the guanosine cap of mRNA into the methylguonosine (m7G) cap. However, RNTM1 alone only possesses a basal methyltransferase activity and it is activated by its association with DXO1. DXO1 is likely an RNA-binding protein that recruits nascent transcripts to facilitate cap methylation by RNMT1. The dxo1 and rnmt1 mutations reduce m7G-capped mRNAs while increasing G-capped mRNAs. This unexpected and exciting finding also raises an intriguing possibility that NAD-RNA decapping is coupled with m7G capping in plants. A manuscript based on these findings are under review by Nature Communications.

12100018.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12100018.value: Using the more sensitive and reliable methods we developed for profiling NAD-RNAs, we have obtained more accurate information on the features of NAD-RNAs in Arabidopsis and other organisms. This is an important step stone which allows us to design and carry out future experiments for detailed mechanistic understanding of biological and molecular functions of NAD-RNAs. We are going to study the mechanism that controls biogenesis of NAD-RNAs, how NAD capping affects transcriptional regulation, and mechanistic details of the role of DXO1 in m7G capping, and whether and how decapping of NAD-RNAs are interconnected with m7G capping through DXO1. We have submitted a CRF proposal to answer these questions to significantly advance the field of NAD-RNA biology.

12100018.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12100018.value: RNAs use DNA master blueprints to make proteins. This process is termed gene expression. Proteins do most of work in cells. RNAs can be modified in different ways to mediate gene expression. One of the best-known RNA modifications is adding of a cap to an RNA molecule. A messenger RNA (mRNA) that codes for a protein in eukaryotic organisms typically contains a methyl-guanosine cap (the m7G cap). In recent years, some RNAs were found to contain a non-canonical NAD cap. We have developed more sensitive and reliable methods to identify and analyze NAD-capped RNAs (NAD-RNAs). Our study has led to novel findings on the features of NAD-RNAs and their possible functions. Our findings indicate that NAD-RNAs are a unique type of regulatory RNAs that are generated to control gene expression. The availability of the methods and the knowledge will allow us to further study mechanistic details of the NAD capping process and its function.

12100118.label: Realisation of objectives
12100118.value: For the objective 1, we have not only achieved full realization of it, but also isolated loci that are responsible for hybrid embryonic lethality with or without parental effect (see details in Genetics. 2019 May 7). We systematically dissect the genetic mechanism of asymmetric sterility and inviability in both hybrid male and female progeny between the two species. Specifically, we performed reciprocal crosses between C. briggsae and different C. nigoni strains that each carry a GFP-labeled C. briggsae genomic fragment referred to as introgression, and scored the HI phenotypes in the F1 progeny. The aggregated introgressions cover 94.6% of the C. briggsae genome, including 100% of the X chromosome. Surprisingly, we observed that two C. briggsaeX fragments that produce C. nigoni male sterility as an introgression rescued hybrid F1 sterility in males fathered by C. briggsae Subsequent backcrossing analyses indicated that a specific interaction between the X-linked interaction and one autosome introgression is required to rescue the hybrid male sterility. In addition, we identified another two C. briggsae genomic intervals on chromosomes II and IV that can rescue the inviability, but not the sterility, of hybrid F1 males fathered by C. nigoni, suggesting the involvement of differential epistatic interactions in the asymmetric hybrid male fertility and inviability. Importantly, backcrossing of the rescued sterile males with C. nigoni led to the isolation of a 1.1-Mb genomic interval that specifically interacts with an X-linked introgression, which is essential for hybrid male fertility. We further identified three C. briggsae genomic intervals on chromosome I, II, and III that produced inviability in all F1 progeny, dependent on or independent of the parent-of-origin. For the objective 2, we have achieved the full realization of our goal by contracting the RNA-seq results of synchronized embryos for mRNAs and small RNAs between wild-type embryos and hybrid F1 and F2 embryos between C. briggsase and C. nigoni (see details in Genome Research. 2022 Nov 9:gr.277205.122.). We examined gene regulation in the hybrid F2 embryos resulting from reciprocal backcrosses between F1 hybrid progeny and C. nigoni or C. briggsae F2 hybrid embryos with ∼75% of their genome derived from C. briggsae (termed as bB2) were inviable, whereas those with ∼75% of their genome derived from C. nigoni (termed as nB2) were viable. Misregulation of transposable elements, coding genes, and small regulatory RNAs was more widespread in the bB2 compared with the nB2 hybrids, which is a plausible explanation for the differential phenotypes between the two hybrids. Our results show that regulation of the C. briggsae genome is strongly affected by genetic exchanges with its outcrossing sister species, C. nigoni, whereas regulation of the C. nigoni genome is more robust on genetic exchange with C. briggsae. For the objective 3, we have achieved the full realization of our goal by the development of a transgenesis method with miniMos and used it generate over 50 chromosomally integrated single-copy transgene consisting of myo-2:GFP or myo-2:mCherry over the genome of various locations. We then examined the inactivation of chromosome by examining the reporter expression (see details in G3 (Bethesda). 2022 Sep 28:jkac254. doi: 10.1093/g3journal/jkac254).

12100118.label: Major findings and research outcome
12100118.value: After genome-wide screening of Loci, we identified multiple loci that rescue hybrid male fertility and male inviability between the two closely related species, C. briggsae and C. nigoni in addition to numerous loci of hybrid embryonic lethality. This laid a framework for further cloning of the loci with defined molecular identity. The proposed work has built a solid framework to facilitate realization of such goals, including but not limited a high-quality of genomes and its annotation of both species, highly effective methods of transgenesis methods, the methods for mapping of hybrid incompatibility loci independent of homology-based recombination, and the methods for establishment of full-length transcript for genome annotation.

12100118.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12100118.value: The proposed work has laid a foundation for systematic cloning of hybrid male sterility and inviability loci using two nematodes as a model for the first time.

12100118.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12100118.value: The recent discovery of the nematode, C. nigoni, as a sister species of C. briggsae, had opened the possibility of genetic and molecular characterization of speciation gene using nematode species. Our genomic studies of hybrid sterile males suggest a long-range functional interaction between the sex chromosome X and autosome, which is essential for hybrid male fertility. However, the solid evidence of such an interaction is still lacking. If such an interaction is indeed present, how many are there and how do they regulate hybrid male sterility? The identification of such interacting loci and determination of their molecular identities is crucial for answering these questions. We have recently found that in contrast to the hybrid male sterility between wild-type C. briggsae male and C. nigoni female, the hybrid males are fertile when their X chromosomes are partially derived from a combination of C. briggsae and C. nigoni X chromosomes. This provides a good opportunity for identifying the interacting loci between the X and autosome. Through systematic backcrossing, we identified multiple X-autosome interaction loci/genes that are responsible for the hybrid male fertility. The results provide important insights into the role of interaction between X and autosome interaction for the male’s fertility.

12100218.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12100218.value: The prevalence of metabolic diseases is on an uprising trend. Although susceptible genetic background, over-nutrition and physical inactivity are identified as major risk factors contributing to the development of the diseases, they alone are not sufficient to account for the high prevalence. Over the last 20 years, converging epidemiological and experimental data have pointed out that the risk of developing metabolic syndrome is associated with early exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs) in life. Seemingly, EDC-elicited suboptimal maternal-intrauterine environment which perturbs early metabolic programming, thereby increasing the susceptibility to the development of metabolic diseases (i.e. obesity, type-2 diabetes) in adulthood. Although the risk of EDC exposure during fetal development is highest, the underlying effects are not clearly documented. Previous studies confirmed that placenta and pancreatic islets both plays critical roles in fetal metabolic programming, therefore any perturbations in placental function and malprogramming of islets would seemingly predispose the offspring to a greater risk of developing obesity and diabetes later in life. Perfluorinated compounds (PFCs) are EDCs that could alter fetal metabolic programming by targeting on nuclear receptors (the metabolic sensors in energy homeostasis) using its fatty-acid-like chemical structure. There is considerable amount of human data that correlates PFC exposure to the risk of metabolic diseases. Unfortunately, prospective evidence on both causality and mechanisms is lacking. Although laboratory studies provided mechanistic insight to underline the effects of PFC exposure on insulin secretion, dysglycemia and dyslipidemia, major informational gap still exists between the observed functional disorders and the mechanistic effects upon exposure in utero. In this proposal, we hypothesized that early PFC exposure perturbs maternal metabolic status which alters placental function and fetal nutrient supply. The nutritional disturbances in turn affects the growth and function of pancreatic islets in the fetuses. Using maternal-fetal mouse model, we will analyze the changes in hormones and metabolites in the maternal environment during gestational PFOS (perfluorooctane sulfonate) exposure. Molecular and biochemical approaches will be adopted to measure the responses in (i) nutrient-transport function of placenta, (ii) growth and maturation of islets and (iii) nutrient sensing pathways (mTOR signaling) with respect to the changes in maternal-intrauterine environment and early neonatal growth. This will be an integrated approach to decipher the mechanisms underlying the metabolic perturbations in pregnant dams and adult offspring, thus providing valuable insights to aid in the disease management in humans. 代謝疾病的流行正處於增多趨勢之中。雖然遺傳背景，過度營養和缺乏身體活動已被確定為導致疾病發展的主要風險因素，但僅靠它們並不足以解釋疾病的高流行率。在過去的二十年中，流行病學和實驗數據指出，發生代謝綜合徵的風險與生命早期暴露於內分泌干擾化學物質有關。看起來，在內分泌干擾化學物影響的母體宮內環境，擾亂了早期發育的代謝編程，從而增加了成年期代謝疾病（即肥胖，二型糖尿病）發展的可能性。雖然胎兒發育過程中，內分泌干擾化學物質暴露的風險最高，但其潛在影響尚未明確記錄。以往的研究證實，胎盤和胰島在胎兒代謝編程中都起著關鍵作用，因此胎盤功能和胰島編程的任何擾動似乎都會使後代更容易在以後的生活中發生肥胖和糖尿病。 全氟化合物是內分泌干擾化學物質，它們可以通過使用其脂肪酸類化學結構核受體（能量穩態中的代謝傳感器）來改變胎兒代謝編程。 有相當數量的人類數據將全氟化合物的暴露與代謝疾病的風險聯繫起來。 不幸的是缺乏關於因果關係和機制的前瞻性證據。 儘管實驗室研究強調全氟化合物的暴露對胰島素的分泌，血糖和血脂異常的影響提供了機制洞察力，但在觀察到功能障礙與子宮內暴露的機制效應之間仍然存在主要的知識間隙。 在這個提議書中，我們假設早期全氟化合物的暴露擾亂了母體代謝狀態，這改變了胎盤功能和胎兒營養供應。 營養紊亂反過來影響胎兒胰島的生長和功能。 使用母胎小鼠模型，我們將分析妊娠期全氟辛烷磺酸的暴露期間，母體環境中激素和代謝物的變化。採用分子和生物化學方法來測量（一）胎盤的營養轉運功能，（二）胎兒胰島的生長和成熟和（三）營養傳感途徑（mTOR的信號傳導）相對於母體宮內環境變化反應及早期新生兒生長。 這將是破解懷孕期和成年後代代謝擾動潛在機制的綜合方法，從而提供有價值的見解，以幫助人類的疾病管理。

12100218.label: Major findings and research outcome
12100218.value: In this study, using the maternal−fetal model, we investigated the impact of gestational PFOS exposure on the placental structure and nutrient transport. There were no noticeable changes in placental weights and the relative areas of junctional and labyrinth zones among the control and exposed groups. However, our data showed a signiﬁcant reduction in fetal body weight at high-dose exposure. Our data showed a signiﬁcant reduction in maternal−fetal transport of the glucose and amino acid analogues. The perturbation in the placental transport function accounted for the PFOS-induced reduction of fetal body weights. Moreover, our data showed that PFOS exposure decreased fetal hepatic metabolic gene expressions but increased relative liver mass and lipid accumulation at gestational day 17.5. At PND21, high-dose PFOS- exposed offspring exhibited significantly greater body weight (catch-up-growth), associated with significant induction of hepatic metabolic gene expression. 16SrRNA-sequencing of the cecal samples revealed an increase in carbohydrate catabolism but a reduction in microbial polysaccharide synthesis and short-chain fatty acid (SCFA) metabolism. From PND21-80, a postnatal diet challenge with a high-fat diet, the body weight of the PFOS-exposed adult offspring was significantly reduced compared to the respective offspring with a normal diet. Metagenomic data showed a significant reduction in the biosynthesis of microbial polysaccharides, vitamin B, and SCFAs in the PFOS-exposed adult offspring with the high-fat diet. The data suggest that in-utero PFOS-exposed offspring had difficulty utilizing high-fat nutrients. Furthermore, our study characterized the negative effects of PFOS on pancreatic islets/β-cells, using in vivo, ex vivo, and in vitro models. Immunohistochemical staining of the pancreatic sections showed that PFOS downregulated the insulin-signaling pathways, evident by reducing the expression levels of the transcriptional factors, Pdx-1, islet-1, and insulin. Transcriptomic analysis of ex vivo PFOS-treated islets, revealed the inhibition of insulin and the PI3K-Akt-mTOR signaling pathway. Subsequent experimental studies using the pancreatic β-cell-line showed the inhibitory effects of PFOS on GSIS and the rate of ATP production. In conclusion, our data support the perturbing effects of PFOS on animal metabolism and demonstrate the underlying molecular targets and events in impairing placental, liver, and β-cell functions.

12100218.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12100218.value: In light of the evidence generated in this study, further development could focus on an in-depth analysis of molecular mechanisms, including epigenetic changes and target molecular pathways in the placenta and fetal development. In addition, remedial strategies should be investigated for reversing the toxic effects of chemical exposure in utero.

12100218.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12100218.value: Globally, non-communicable diseases (NCDs) are on the rise. Over 380 million people worldwide suffer from diabetes, which is a leading cause of retinopathy, hypertension, and kidney failure. In 2015, diabetes alone was estimated to cost the healthcare system USD 1.31 trillion globally. The development of a fetus can be affected by environmental factors. There is evidence that in-utero exposure to high-potency EDCs perturbs maternal-intrauterine metabolism. In particular, experimental studies have shown that exposure to PFCs (which are types of EDCs) in utero perturbs glucose/lipid metabolism and insulin secretion. This proposal aimed to examine how early exposure to chemical pollutants (i.e., PFOS) prompted the development of metabolic symptoms in the fetus. The chemical affected uteroplacental, liver, and pancreatic function, as well as gut microbe development. Our study examined the specific effects of PFOS on maternal intrauterine environments to modify early developmental plasticity in nutrient sensing. This directly links environmental stress and intrauterine adaptive mechanisms, thereby increasing disease susceptibility. This study will provide a significant advance in understanding how environmental pollution factors contribute to the development of NCDs.

12100318.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12100318.value: In eukaryotic organisms, post-transcriptional mechanisms such as alternative splicing (AS) generate multiple mRNA isoforms from single template DNA. Using this strategy, eukaryotes are able to make full use of a limited genome to generate a diversified proteome for carrying out a variety of functions. As a consequence, AS contributes to the flexibility of organisms under varied physiological conditions. However, which splicing isoforms will be generated or translated into proteins, and whether the resulted proteoforms can display distinct functions are largely unknown. We have identified global changes of both AS transcripts and proteins under normal conditions or in response to abscisic acid (ABA) treatment by using parallel approaches of short-read RNA sequencing, single molecule long-read RNA sequencing and proteomic identification in Arabidopsis. Approximately 83.4% of multi-exonic genes have been observed to contain splicing isoforms. ABA treatment increased the number of non-conventional splicing sites among these ABA-regulated AS isoforms. Thus splicing factors, as essential components in the spliceosome, play pivotal roles in response to developmental cues and environmental changes. In addition, we also found that the expression of five isoforms of a serine/arginine-rich splicing factor, SR184, was altered under ABA treatment. These five isoforms exhibited three different subcellular locations and the mutant of this gene was sensitive to ABA treatment. These findings raise the intriguing possibility that SR184 may participate in ABA-mediated stress responses. Isoforms potentially encode five proteins that might have distinct functions in response to ABA-regulated splicing changes. In this proposed study, we will further characterize the phenotypic differences under stress treatments using Arabidopsis genetic materials including knock-out mutants for all the five splicing isoforms, knock-out mutants, overexpression and complement lines for each SR184 splicing isoform. We will analyse the spatio-temporal expression pattern of these splicing isoforms at both the transcriptional and protein levels. The subcellular localization of each SR184 splicing isoform will be further investigated. Subsequently, the AS pattern and splicing site usage will be compared among the above mentioned Arabidopsis genetic materials under normal conditions and in response to stress treatments. To further reveal the underlying mechanism of AS regulation, crosstalk between alternative splicing and transcriptional control of ABA signalling will be further investigated using mutants of ABA-responsive transcription factors. In addition, we will continuously screen and validate the protein partners of SR184 and its splicing isoforms. Our study should provide new understanding into the diverse responsive mechanisms of plant splicing factors and AS regulation in ABA-mediated stress responses. 在真核生物中，可變剪切作為一種轉錄後調控模式，可以從同一個範本DNA產生不同的mRNA剪切體。真核細胞運用這種策略能夠充分利用基因組遺傳信息，以此來產生不同功能的蛋白異構體。因此，可變剪切在生物體的生命過程和抗逆境回應中扮演了重要角色。但是，很多分子生物學難題仍然有待解決。在先前的工作中，我們運用蛋白基因組聯合分析技術，解析了在正常情況下和脫落酸處理下擬南芥幼苗的組學剪切模式。其中，大約83.4%的擬南芥多外顯子基因存在mRNA剪切體。 我們發現脫落酸處理增加了非保守型剪切位元點的使用頻率，所以推測剪切因數在此過程中扮演了重要角色。隨後，我們發現一個SR剪切因數的五個剪切體在脫落酸處理下存在不同的表達模式。亞細胞定位表明，這五個剪切體所能編碼的蛋白在擬南芥原生質體中存在三種不同的定位模式。因此，我們假設這個SR剪切因數參與了脫落酸介導的剪切調控機制。在本研究中，我們將運用植物遺傳學、分子生物學和大資料組學的手段深入研究這個SR剪切因數及其每個剪切體的潛在功能。我們的研究成果可以為脫落酸剪切調控機制提供新的線索。

12100318.label: Realisation of objectives
12100318.value: Alternative splicing (AS) generates multiple mRNA isoforms from single template DNA and is an important post-transcriptional regulation in eukaryotes. We have identified global changes of both AS transcripts and proteins in response to external conditions such as abscisic acid (ABA) and stress treatments by using parallel approaches of short-read RNA sequencing, single molecule long-read RNA sequencing and proteomic identification in Arabidopsis and other plants. Several specific splicing factors and regulations of AS under different conditions have been detailly studied with the support of this funding. Splicing factor 30 (SPF30), also known as survival motor neuron domain containing protein 1 (SMNDC1) in animals, is a spliceosomal protein and homologue that plays an essential role in spliceosomal assembly in plants. We first did the genome-wide search and phylogenetic analysis of SPF30 genes in the plant kingdom. In total, 82 SPF30 genes were found in 64 plant species from algae to land plants. Alternative transcripts were found in many SPF30 genes and splicing profile analysis revealed that the second intron in SPF30 genome is frequently associated with AS events and contributed to the birth of novel exons in a few SPF30 members. In addition, different conserved sequences were observed at these putative splice sites among moss, monocots and dicots, respectively. From these results, we will focus further on functional characterization of some plant SPF30 genes as putative splicing factors. This work has been published in Planta (Zhang et al. 2019). Serine/arginine-rich (SR) proteins as splicing factors are widely found in higher eukaryotes including metazoans and plants. They form a major family of essential splicing factors and function in both constitutive and alternative splicing (AS). Some SR proteins can also shuttle between nucleus and cytoplasm and play roles beyond splicing. The activities of SR proteins are required for many living organisms to maintain normal growth and development. Although the SR genes have been identified in numerous plants, they are less studied compared to those found in animals. Results of existing research suggest that plant SR proteins share many similar properties as their animal counterparts. However, plants generally have a higher number of SR proteins which display largely redundant functions under normal conditions but participate in specific stress responses. Moreover, many animal and plant SR genes are alternatively spliced, which can be regulated by themselves or other SR proteins. These AS events enable a mechanism for protein amount control under different conditions but sometimes also lead to translated protein isoforms with different functions. We summarized these key findings of SR proteins in animals and plants and compared the essential characteristics of SR studies in these two different research areas. This work was published in Critical Reviews in Plant Sciences (Zhang et al. 2020). Spliceosome is a large ribonucleoprotein (RNP) complex for the process of splicing. In spliceosome components, the U2 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein (U2 snRNP) forms the pre-spliceosome by association with the branch site. An essential component that promotes U2 snRNP assembly, named U2A, has been extensively identified in humans, yeast and nematodes. We performed a comprehensive analysis and identified a total of 112 U2A genes from 80 plant species representing dicots, monocots, mosses and algae. Comparisons of the gene structures, protein domains, and expression patterns of 112 U2A genes indicated that the conserved functions were likely retained by plant U2A genes and important for responses to internal and external stimuli. This work provides a general understanding of this splicing factor family in terms of genes and proteins, and it will serve as a fundamental resource that will contribute to further mechanistic characterization in plants. This work was published in Planta (Liu et al. 2022). Over the years we have been studying how controlled soil drying regulates rice grain filling. Poor grain ﬁlling of inferior spikelets is common in some large-panicle rice varieties. In our previous studies, we proved that post-anthesis moderate soil drying (MD) is an effective way to promote starch synthesis and inferior grain ﬁlling. As one of the most important regulatory processes in response to environmental cues and at different developmental stages, the function of alternative splicing (AS) has not yet been revealed in regulating grain ﬁlling under MD conditions. Here AS events at the most active grain-ﬁlling stage were identiﬁed in inferior spikelets under well-watered control (CK) and MD treatments. Of 16,089 AS events, 1840 AS events involving 1392 genes occurred differentially between the CK and MD treatments, many of which function on spliceosome, ncRNA metabolic process, starch, and sucrose metabolism, and other functions. This study provides some new insights into the function of AS on the MD-promoted grain ﬁlling of inferior spikelets, and has been recently published (Teng et al. 2022). We also systematically characterized the branch point binding protein, splicing factor 1 gene family in plant development and stress responses. Splicing factor 1/branchpoint binding protein (SF1/BBP) is a single protein that can bind to the intronic branchpoint sequence (BPS), connecting the 5′ and 3′ splice site binding complexes during early spliceosome assembly. Here we conducted a systematic characterization of the SF1 gene family across plant lineages. In this work, a total of 92 sequences from 59 plant species were identified. Phylogenetic relationships of these sequences were constructed, and subsequent bioinformatic analysis suggested that this family likely originated from an ancient gene transposition duplication event. Most plant species were shown to maintain a single copy of this gene. Furthermore, an additional RNA binding motif (RRM) existed in most members of this gene family in comparison to their animal and yeast counterparts, indicating that their potential role was preserved in the plant lineage. This work was published in BMC Plant Biol (Zhang et al. 2020). Alternative splicing (AS) and its regulation is also examined in woody plants. Numerous reports have primarily focused on AS analysis in model plant species or herbaceous plants, leading to a notable lack of research on AS in woody plants. More importantly, emerging evidence indicates that many important traits, including wood formation and stress resistance, in woody plants are controlled by AS. We summarized the current progress of all kinds of AS studies in different tree species at various stages of development and in response to various stresses, revealing the significant role played by AS in woody plants, as well as the similar properties and differential regulation within their herbaceous counterparts. This work was published in Tree Physiology (Chen et al. 2020). We also studied how the circadian clock is regulated by AS under stress treatments. Circadian clock is an internal time-keeping mechanism that synchronizes the physiological adaptation of an organism to its surroundings based on day and night transition in a period of 24 h. The clock is driven by positive and negative elements that regulate transcriptionally and post-transcriptionally. Alternative splicing (AS) is a crucial transcriptional regulator capable of generating large numbers of mRNA transcripts from limited numbers of genes, leading to proteome diversity, which is involved in circadian to deal with abiotic stresses. Therefore, the rhythmically expressed splicing factors and core clock oscillators fill the role of temporal regulators participating in improving plant growth, development, and increasing plant tolerance against abiotic stresses. This work was published in Front. Plant Sci. (Fan et al. 2022).

12100318.label: Major findings and research outcome
12100318.value: We extensively studied alternative splicing and its components in many plants and under several stress conditions. For example, splicing factor 30 (SPF30) is a spliceosomal protein and homologue that plays an essential role in spliceosomal assembly in plants. We searched 82 SPF30 genes in 64 plant species from algae to land plants and found the second intron in SPF30 genome is frequently associated with AS events and contributed to the birth of novel exons in a few SPF30 members. Serine/arginine-rich (SR) proteins as splicing factors are widely found in higher eukaryotes including metazoans and plants. We summarized the key findings of SR proteins in animals and plants and compared the essential characteristics of SR studies in these two different research areas. Spliceosome components, the U2 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein (U2 snRNP), named U2A, forms the pre-spliceosome by association with the branch site. We performed a comprehensive analysis and identified a total of 112 U2A genes from 80 plant species representing dicots, monocots, mosses and algae. Comparisons of the genes indicated the conserved functions for responses to internal and external stimuli. We also found that post-anthesis moderate soil drying (MD) regulated alternative splicing (AS) that is related to many key proteins and their function during rice grain filling process, especially with inferior spikelets. The splicing factor 1/branchpoint binding protein (SF1/BBP) is a single protein that can bind to the intronic branchpoint sequence (BPS), connecting the 5′ and 3′ splice site binding complexes during early spliceosome assembly. We did a systematic characterization of the SF1 gene family across plant lineages and built up the phylogenetic relationships of these genes. Some interesting features were found in comparison to their animal and yeast counterparts. We also studied alternative splicing (AS) and its regulation in woody plants and how it regulates the circadian clock in the plants. Some intriguing details were revealed and further studies are warranted to follow up.

12100318.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12100318.value: When we first investigated the changes of both AS transcripts and proteins in response to external conditions, we focused on the Arabidopsis, the model plants. With the progress of our understanding and the improved approaches we have developed, we found AS exists in many abiotic stress responses with many plant species. In this study, we examined many species and under many different external conditions for treatments and have found many clues showing specific AS factors and their regulations. Certainly, we shall use these findings as preliminary studies and will go deep for more detailed genetic and molecular functions and regulations.

12100318.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12100318.value: Alternative splicing (AS) is an important post-transcriptional regulation in eukaryotes and responsible to generates multiple mRNA isoforms from single DNA template. We have investigated changes of both AS transcripts and proteins in response to external conditions and generated information about many AS factors, their functions, genetic origins and evolutions. Particularly we found AS exists in many abiotic stress responses with many plant species. Several hundred plant species were examined for specific AS factors and their functions. As a crop science study, for example, we found that post-anthesis moderate soil drying (MD) regulated alternative splicing (AS) that is related to many key proteins and their function during rice grain filling process, especially with inferior spikelets. In woody trees, we found AS is responsible for many growth and developmental responses to environmental stimuli. For plant time-keeping of the 24-hour rhythm, we found AS is responsible for producing many mRNA transcripts from limited numbers of genes that function to regulate the internal circadian clock, the 24-hour synchronizing the day/night changes.

12100618.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12100618.value: 摘要： 阿爾茲海默症（Alzheimer’s disease, AD）是最常見的神經性退行性疾病之一，影響著全球3560萬多人。然而，目前的治療藥物只能部分緩解症狀並存在著副作用，故我們需要進一步尋找有效安全的藥物。在阿茲海默症病人的腦中，常能發現一種叫做神經纖維纏結的神經內含物，其中包含了錯誤折疊的Tau蛋白聚集體，這些錯誤折疊的磷酸化的Tau蛋白聚集體被認為是引起AD病人神經缺失和認知障礙的原因。因此，若能找到可以抑制異常Tau的形成或促進它的清除，便能為AD病人提供一種潛在的治療方案。 組蛋白脫乙酰酶6（Histone deacetylase 6, HDAC6）的蛋白水平在AD病人腦中是上升的，這與神經存活下降相一致。有趣的是，在小鼠的AD模型中，敲除HDAC6或是抑制HDAC6的活性能夠減緩認知障礙，並促進Tau蛋白的降解。因此，靶向HDAC6有可能成為治療AD的潛在性的治療手段。然而，目前現存的HDAC6抑制劑大部分不能通過血腦屏障並存在著毒副作用，並不能用於治療AD。因此，新型的可以通過血腦屏障並無毒的HDAC6抑制劑有望成為治療AD的候選藥物。我們最近發現了一種新的HDAC6抑制劑protopine具有這樣特性，這是一種從中藥Corydalis yanhusuo中分離出來的生物堿。從我們的預實驗中發現（1）在神經細胞系和原代神經細胞中，protopine上調α-tubulin和Hsp90的乙酰化水平，但不影響histone 3的乙酰化水平，這提示了protopine能夠特定地抑制HDAC6；（2）體外實驗和分子模擬結果顯示了protopine能夠與HDAC6結合，並調節HDAC6-Hsp90分子伴侶功能，通過UPS來減少神經細胞中的Tau的聚集；（3）protopine可通過在P301S Tau的AD模型小鼠的血腦屏障，能夠顯著減少運動功能的紊亂，並減少Tau的聚積；（4）protopine可以減輕3XTg的AD模型小鼠的記憶障礙。通過以上的實驗結果，我們推測protopine能夠通過抑制HDAC6促進腦內積聚的Tau蛋白的降解，在AD模型中發揮了神經保護的作用。 在這個研究項目中，我們將通過以下三個具體目標來檢測我們的假設：（1）檢測protopine在AD模型動物中的體內神經保護作用；（2）尋找protopine促進清除異常Tau蛋白的具體分子機制；（3）評估protopine的藥物動力學和安全性。我們的初步研究已經提供了一個清晰的研究思路和策略來證明protopine在AD模型中的神經保護作用。本研究為新型的可透過血腦屏障的中藥小分子protopine在療效、作用機制、藥代動力學和安全性方面提供了具有前景的臨床前研究數據。這項研究的成功，將提供一種新型的可透過血腦屏障的HDAC6抑制劑，並可研發成治療AD的有效藥物。

12100618.label: Realisation of objectives
12100618.value: Objective 1: To characterize in vivo neuroprotective effects of protopine in AD animal models. Animals and treatment To assess the efficacy of PRO in vivo, we used triple transgenic (3xTg-AD) and P301S mutant tau over-expressing (P301S tau) AD mouse models. Female 3xTg-AD mice (7-month-old) were administered with PRO (1 and 2.5 mg/kg) every day for 8 months orally (N=8). Female P301S mice (1.5-month-old) were administered with PRO every day for 2.5 months orally (N=8). After treatment, mice were used for behavior tests and then sacrificed for biochemical analysis. Results PRO treated group significantly alleviated the learning and memory dysfunction compared to the Tg-Vehicle-treated group. A probe trial was conducted, which demonstrated that PRO enhanced the time spent by the mice in the target quadrant searching for the hidden platform. Hence, indicating that PRO can reduce memory and cognitive impairment in the 3xTg-AD mice model. The data from 3xTg-AD mice double-confirmed our findings in P301S mice. Furthermore, immunoblotting results show that PRO did not affect the protein expression of either FL-APP/CTFs. Additionally, in the hippocampus and cortex, Aβ load (%) also did not show any changes, suggesting that PRO does not affect the expression and processing of FL-APP. To determine the effect of PRO on tau aggregates, immunoblotting results showed that PRO significantly reduced phospho-tau (ALZ50, AT8, CP13, MC1, PHF1, and HT7) markers in sarkosyl-insoluble fractions, but not in sarkosyl-soluble fractions, indicating that PRO specifically targets the insoluble aggregated tau for degradation. Additionally, immunohistochemical analysis of brain sections showed that treatment with PRO dose-dependently decreased AT8-positive cells in the hippocampus, compared to the Tg-Vehicle group. To further verify the effects of PRO on tau pathology, in mutant tau overexpressing P301S AD mice model, PRO predominantly reduced phospho-tau markers in sarkosyl-insoluble fractions but not in the sarkosyl-soluble fractions. Additionally, our immunohistochemical analysis confirmed that PRO treatment significantly decreased the AT8- and PHF1-positive cells in the cortex compared to the Tg-Vehicle group. We also found that PRO can inhibit HDAC6 activity and promote the acetylation of HSP90, thereby recruiting HSP70/HSC70 for the degradation of pathological tau via UPS in AD models. Altogether, our results suggest that PRO selectively enhances tau degradation in AD animal models. Generally, we have achieved the proposed studies in Objective 1. Objective 2: To determine the mechanism by which protopine promotes the clearance of aberrant Tau. Methods To study the inhibition of HDAC6 deacetylase activity, PRO was prepared in HDAC Assay buffer. Trichostatin A (TSA) was used as a positive control for HDAC6 inhibition. HDAC6 recombinant protein was added to appropriate wells. Fluorometric reading was measured at a wavelength of 440 nm in a Wallac EnVision fluorometer. The binding of HSP90 to immobilized ATP was performed following the manufacturer’s protocol. Briefly, HT22 cells were treated with PRO at indicated concentrations for 24 h. Cells were then lysed using ice-cold lysis buffer (50 mM Tris, 2 mM EDTA, 100 mM NaCl, 1% Triton X-100, and protease inhibitor tablet, pH 7.5). Protein lysates were quantified by the BCA method, and to 1 mg of protein lysate (500 μL), 50 μL of ATP-Agarose beads were added to all the tubes and were incubated overnight at 4°C on an end-over-rocker. Beads were washed, and specifically bound proteins were eluted with 25 μL ATP (100 mM) and 25 μL of 2X LDS sample buffer. Boiled samples were analyzed for the effect of HSP90 binding to ATP-agarose beads by Western blotting. Results Fluorometric assay with pure HDAC6 protein showed that PRO dose-dependently reduced the activity of HDAC6 (IC50: 2.78 μM). Furthermore, immunoprecipitation results demonstrated that PRO dose-dependently impaired the interaction between HDAC6 and HSP90, which resulted in hyperacetylation of HSP90, suggesting that PRO promoted HSP90 co-chaperone complex formation that is adequate for pathological tau degradation in neurons. Since our earlier experimental findings showed that PRO promotes the degradation of tau and acetylates HSP90, thus it is necessary to confirm whether PRO modulates the chaperone function of HSP90. Specifically, we determined whether PRO decreases the binding of ATP to HSP90. We observed that PRO did not affect HSP90 binding to ATP, suggesting that PRO modulated only the acetylation status of HSP90, independent of ATP binding. To evaluate the role of HDAC6 in PRO-mediated degradation of tau/PHF1 levels, in SHSYP301L tau cells, we transiently over-expressed HDAC6F (full-length) and HDAC6DC (catalytically deficient), and treated them with PRO. Surprisingly, overexpression of HDAC6-F increased PHF1 protein expression. The ability of PRO-mediated decrease in PHF1 in the pcDNA group was abrogated upon overexpression of HDAC6F, whereas HDAC6DC overexpression did not abolish the PRO-mediated degradation of PHF1-tau. To understand the mechanism of PRO-mediated tau degradation, N2a cells were transiently transfected with P301L mutant tau in combination with HA-tagged ubiquitin (wild-type) and treated with PRO for 24 h. Our results demonstrate that PRO can dose-dependently increase the ubiquitination of tau (IP fraction), indicating that PRO can promote the ubiquitination of pathological tau. Furthermore, we also observed that PRO could significantly enhance the clearance of total ubiquitin conjugates dose-dependently, indicating that PRO activated UPS. The PRO-mediated decrease in ubiquitin conjugates was reversed upon co-treatment with proteasomal inhibitor MG132. Also, MG132 blocked the PRO-mediated degradation of phospho-tau (PHF1) and aggregated tau (TAU5). Thus, our results indicate that HDAC6 overexpression significantly blocked the PRO-mediated degradation of PHF1 in neuronal cells. Therefore, in this objective, we have addressed the role of HDAC6 in tau accumulation and the mechanism of PRO-mediated activation of UPS for the degradation of pathological tau. For Objective 2.4: “To determine if PRO acetylates Tau at KIGS motif to reduce Tau aggregation”, we have replaced it with another more important and relevant study, which addressed the neuroprotective effects of PRO. We found that PRO significantly promoted the clearance of hyperphosphorylated Tau aggregates in vitro, by promoting ubiquitination of tau and degradation via the UPS system. Objective 3: To evaluate the pharmacokinetics and safety of protopine. Pharmacokinetics: To determine the blood-brain barrier (BBB) permeability of PRO, we first investigated the pharmacokinetic profile of PRO in the plasma and brain of ICR wild-type mice. When PRO (10 mg/kg) was administered orally, it passed through the BBB and reached a maximum concentration (Cmax) of 289.47 ng/g in the brain at Tmax of 15 mins. In plasma, Cmax of PRO was found to be 79.8 ng/mL at Tmax of 5 mins. Safety: One of the essential prerequisites for drugs to demonstrate good efficacy in vivo is their safety profile and the potential to permeate the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and achieve optimum concentration in the brain. Hence, we first investigated the safety of PRO in C57BL/6 wild-type mice. An acute toxicity study was performed and the 50% lethal dose (LD50) of PRO was estimated to be 98.11 mg/kg. Importantly, parameters such as alanine transaminase (ALT), aspartate transaminase (AST), etc. in hematological tests were recorded, and found that PRO does not show any potential toxicity in multiple organs such as muscle and liver. Furthermore, H&E staining demonstrated that when PRO (1 and 2.5 mg/kg) was orally administered for 28 days, there was no significant change in the body weight and the weights of various organs (lungs, spleen, kidney, liver, and brain), indicating that PRO is a safe compound for its downstream evaluation. Generally, we have achieved the proposed studies in Objective 3.

12100618.label: Major findings and research outcome
12100618.value: Our current findings demonstrate that PRO can safely pass through the blood-brain barrier and significantly improved the spatial and learning memory functions in 3xTg-AD and P301S tau over-expressed AD mice model. Also, PRO promoted the clearance of abnormal, pathological aggregates of phospho-tau in these two AD models. PRO can significantly increase Ac-α-tubulin, indicating HDAC6 inhibition, and promoted the recruitment of molecular chaperones for tau degradation via ubiquitin-proteasomal system (UPS). Moreover, PRO decreased the ubiquitinated conjugates by activating the proteasomal degradative system for pathological tau clearance. The reduction of protein conjugates upon PRO treatment could be probably by activation of deubiquitinating enzymes. This reduction of protein conjugates was reversed upon co-treatment with proteasomal inhibitor, MG132, indicating that PRO promotes UPS-mediated degradation of tau. PRO bioavailability was enhanced in the brain of AD models, and it effectively promotes the clearance of insoluble pathological tau through the UPS pathway in AD mice models. PRO inhibits HDAC6 activity, thereby promoting the recruitment of molecular chaperones for the degradation of pathological tau. Also, PRO alleviates motor and cognitive dysfunction in AD models. Altogether, our experimental findings suggest that PRO can be considered a safe and effective anti-AD therapeutic strategy. Based on these findings, we have published two peer-reviewed papers (SG Sreenivasmurthy, et al. Phytomedicine. 2022 and SG Sreenivasamurthy, et al. Front Mol Biosci. 2022). Through this project, we have trained two research assistants, and one PhD student (Thesis title: Protopine and Its Derivatives Mitigate Tau Pathology Via Histone Deacetylase 6 Inhibition in Alzheimer's Disease Models). In continuation with this project, several PRO derivatives were synthesized, and their bioavailability and bioactivity were tested in AD models. The project was funded by Health and Medical Research Fund (HMRF), #15163481.

12100618.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12100618.value: The results from this project have confirmed the therapeutic effects of PRO on animal models of AD through directly binding to HDAC6 and activating the ubiquitin-proteasomal system (UPS) for the degradation of pathological hyperphosphorylated tau. Based on these findings, follow-up work can be adopted: 1) to facilitate translation of the findings to the clinical setting. 2) to promote the application of PRO as an HDAC6 inhibitor and a UPS inducer in the therapeutics of other neurodegenerative diseases involving UPS impairment.

12100618.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12100618.value: Alzheimer’s disease (AD), a major form of dementia, affects millions of people worldwide. A hallmark of the AD brain is the presence of neuronal inclusions called neurofibrillary tangles (NFTs). NFTs are formed from the accumulation of phosphorylated free Tau. Therefore, therapies targeted at degrading toxic or pathologic Tau species may be effective. Currently available medications for AD offer only moderate symptomatic relief and have side effects. Effective, safe drugs are needed. One of the latest, most promising strategies for drug discovery is using histone deacetylase inhibitors (HDACis) for epigenetic modulation for memory improvement and Tau degradation. Inhibiting HDAC6 leads to hyperacetylation of HSP90 which in turn modulates the chaperonic action of HSP90 and promotes the degradation of tau via the ubiquitin-proteasome system (UPS). According to the in vitro and in silico data, PRO binds with HDAC6 and modulates the HDAC6-HSP90 chaperone function to reduce Tau aggregates via UPS in neuronal cells. Also, PRO efficiently passes through the BBB and significantly alleviates memory dysfunctions as well as reduces aggregated tau in P301S and 3xTg-AD mice. Altogether, our results suggest that PRO is an excellent pharmacological agent that can enhance the modernization of Chinese medicine globally and improve the quality of life.

12100818.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12100818.value: 本項目旨在探索黃荎多糖RAP如何通過M細胞進入小腸pp結以激動免疫反應的機理。 黃荎是最常用的補氣類中藥，在中國廣泛應用于增強癌症病人的免疫力。已經證明，口服黃荎多糖RAP可以通過免疫系統抑制腫瘤，但是作用機理不明。 作爲腸道内主要的免疫器官，PP結可能是RAP口服后激活免疫反應的主要目標。已有的證據表明，RAP口服后快速到達小腸，停留三個小時后，進入大腸而被降解。早在第一個小時中，RAP已經誘導了PP結中的MAPK/NFkB信號通路，涉及到多種免疫細胞：殺傷性T細胞、巨噬細胞和樹突狀細胞。但是，尚未可知：RAP是如何進入PP結的。 在PP結表面，M細胞轉運是大分子和抗原進入體内的主要通道，可以在10秒内快速完成。初步的体外實驗數據表明，M細胞可以轉運RAP通過腸道上皮細胞層。由此我們推測，M細胞轉運是RAP進入PP結的主要途徑。由於已經證明TLR2/4均是RAP的受體，所以我們推測，這個轉運過程是TLR2/4界導的。 爲了證明上述設想，本項目計劃利用免疫熒光和電子共聚焦顯微鏡來確認M細胞對RAP的轉運；並利用TLR2/4基因敲除動物和抑制劑來進一步驗證。 本項目如果成功，將有助於解釋天然多糖是如何在口服的情況下激活免疫反應的。進而，有助於多糖佔主體的中藥湯劑的作用機理研究。

12100918.label: Realisation of objectives
12100918.value: All the following four objectives were achieved: 1) To examine the osteoblast-specific distribution of the (DSS)6-chalcone derivative conjugate. 6-month-old female rats were ovariectomized (OVX) and left untreated for 9 months to induce age-related osteoporosis. The subgroup of age-related osteoporotic rats (15-month-old) were chosen according to established serum osteocalcin-based classification criteria and divided into four groups: chalcone derivative (n =9) or (DSS)6-chalcone derivative (n = 9) or (NAA)6-chalcone derivative (n = 9) or (DSS)6 +chalcone derivative (n = 9). The rats in each group were administrated with the corresponding chalcone derivative formulations at a dose of 6 μmol/kg via tail vein injection. Eight hours after the administration, the rats in each group were sacrificed and cells were sorted from bone marrow by FACS using an antibody to ALP (a specific marker for osteoblasts) or an antibody to OSCAR. Amounts of chalcone derivative formulations in ALP-positive osteoblasts, OSCAR-positiveosteoclasts or ALP-negative non-osteoblasts were examined by LC-MS/MS. The results showed that (DSS)6 could facilitate the in vivo osteoblast-specific distribution of the conjugated chalcone derivative in age-related osteoporotic rats. The objective was completely achieved. 2) To test the dose-response pattern and persistence time of the (DSS)6-chalcone derivative conjugate. To test the in vivo dose-response pattern of the (DSS)6-chalcone derivative conjugate, 6-month-old female rats were OVX and left untreated for 9 months to induce age-related osteoporosis). The subgroup of osteoporotic rats (15-month-old) were chosen according to established serum osteocalcin-based classification criteria and divided into four groups: chalcone derivative (n =36) or (DSS)6-chalcone derivative (n = 36) or (NAA)6-chalcone derivative (n = 36) or (DSS)6+chalcone derivative (n = 36). The rats in each group were administrated with the corresponding chalcone derivative formulations with the dose of 0, 3, 6 and 9 μmol/kg (n = 9 for each dose) via tail vein injection, respectively. Two days after the administration, the rats in each group were sacrificed and primary osteoblasts were sorted from bone marrow by FACS using antibody to ALP (a specific marker for osteoblasts. Levels of Smurf1 activity (Smad1 bound to Smurf1 and ubiquitination of Smad1), p-Smad1, Runx2 activation and osteocalcin mRNA were examined by immunoprecipitation followed with ELISA, ELISA, Runx2 transcription factor assay and real-time PCR, respectively, to determine the optimal dose of different formulations. To determine the dosing interval of different chalcone derivative formulations, the BMP-2n/Smurf1e subgroup of age-related osteoporotic rats were divided into four groups: chalcone derivative (n = 36) or (DSS)6-chalcone derivative (n = 36) or (NAA)6-chalcone derivative (n = 36) or (DSS)6 + chalcone derivative (n = 36). The rats in each group were administrated with the corresponding chalcone derivative formulations with the optimal dose determined in above experiments via tail vein injection and sacrificed at 0, 24 h, 48 h and 72h (n = 9 for each time point), respectively. Primary osteoblasts were sorted from bone marrow by FACS using antibody to ALP (a specific marker for osteoblasts). Levels of Smurf1 activity (Smad1 bound to Smurf1 and ubiquitination of Smad1), p-Smad1, Runx2 activation and osteocalcin mRNA were examined by immunoprecipitation followed with ELISA, ELISA, Runx2 transcription factor assay and real-time PCR, respectively, to determine the optimal dosing interval. The results showed that (DSS)6-chalcone derivative, rather than other formulations, significantly inhibited Smurf1 activity and improved p-Smad1 expression, Runx2 activation and osteocalcin mRNA expression at 6 μmol/kg and 9μmol/kg in BMP-2n/Smurf1e subgroup of age-related osteoporotic rats. (DSS)6-chalcone derivative exhibited the maximal inhibition of Smurf1 activity and enhancement of p-Smad1 level, Runx2 activation, and osteocalcin mRNA in osteoblasts at 24 h and maintained the effective action for 72 h, whereas other formulations showed no satisfactory effects. All the above results suggested that the objective was completely achieved. 3) To determine the bone anabolic action of the (DSS)6-chalcone derivative conjugate. 6-month-old female rats were ovariectomized and left untreated for 9 months to induce age-related osteoporosis. The subgroup of age-related osteoporotic rats (15-month-old) were chosen according to established osteocalcin-based classification criteria and divided into five groups: chalcone derivative (n =9) or (DSS)6-chalcone derivative (n = 9) or (NAA)6-chalcone derivative (n = 9) or (DSS)6 +chalcone derivative (n = 9) and PTH group. The rats in each group were administrated with the corresponding chalcone derivative formulations via tail vein injection with the optimal dose (6 μmol/kg) and an interval determined by the above experiments, respectively, or PTH with a dose of 40.0 μg/kg. All the rats were sacrificed after treatment for 9 weeks. Before the sacrifice, all the rats were injected intraperitoneally with xylenol orange (30 mg/kg) and calcein green (10 mg/kg) in a time sequence of ten and two days. After sacrifice, the left femur were collected for examining bone formation using bone histomorphometric analysis and the right femur were collected for determining bone mass using microCT. The results showed that (DSS)6-chalcone derivative, rather than other chalcone derivative formulations, significantly promoted bone formation and enhanced bone mass in BMP-2n/Smurf1e subgroup of age-related osteoporotic rats, which was similar to those of PTH. The objective was completely achieved. 4) To examine the Toxicity of the (DSS)6-chalcone derivative conjugate. 6-month-old female rats were ovariectomized and left untreated for 9 months to induce age-related osteoporosis. The subgroup of age-related osteoporotic rats (15-month-old) were chosen according to established osteocalcin-based classification criteria and administrated with (DSS)6-chalcone derivative with the dose of 0, 3, 6 and 9 μmol/kg (n = 9 for each dose) via tail vein injection, respectively. After 72 h, all the rats were sacrificed and liver function indicators (alanine transaminase (ALT), aspartate transaminase (AST)), kidney function indicator (blood urea nitrogen (BUN)) and hematology parameters (red blood cell (RBC), haemoglobin (HGB), hematocrit (HCT), white blood cell (WBC) and platelets (PLT)) were examined. In addition, the BMP-2n/Smurf1e subgroup of age-related osteoporotic rats (n = 9) were administrated with (DSS)6-chalcone derivative with the optimal dose and an interval determined by the above experiments. Liver function indicators (ALT, AST), kidney function indicator (BUN) and hematology parameters (RBC, HGB, HCT, WBC and PLT) were examined. The results showed that the liver function indicators, kidney function indicator and hematology parameters stayed within the normal range in BMP-2n/Smurf1e subgroup of age-related osteoporotic rats after a single/multiple injection(s) of (DSS)6-chalcone derivative. The objective was completely achieved.
