12300318.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12300318.value: Photodynamic Therapy (PDT) emerging as a novel, efficacious cancer treatment modality with less side effects by locally converting “light” into reactive oxygen species, such as singlet oxygen (1O2) in vivo with photosensitizers to inhibit cancer growth is still failing to obtain its deserved popularity due to unsolved practical constraints: (i) photostability, (ii) cancer selectivity, and (ii) deep-tissue excitation failure of the currently existing molecular PDT agents. A prerequisite of further successful preclinical PDT translation as a “less-painful” anticancer treatment alternative to address the society’s demands is a fundamental breakthrough of designing new PDT agents. Recently, surface-functionalized upconversion nanomaterials (UCNMs) of remarkable photophysical properties (excitable by near-infrared light sources) and excellent biocompatibility (target recognition) have held tremendous promise as the sought-after blueprint of new PDT agents. However, the true efficiency of claimed good 1O2 generation in vivo of such UCNMs is still uncertain. With the renaissance of persistent luminescence nanomaterials (PLNMs) research, we hypothesize that one-stop X-ray induced and rechargeable (deep tissue-penetrating radiation) PLNMs (hour-based emission duration) surface-coated with photosensitizers (1O2 generation excited intrinsically by its own persistent luminescence) and target-specific peptides (cancer cell selectivity) can provide the ultimate ideal solution as next-generation PDT agents for deeper-tissue anticancer treatment. Prostate cancer, a deeper-tissue cancer, is the most common non-cutaneous cancer developed in men and remains the leading cause of cancer death in male mortality. The current prostate cancer treatments always involve invasive protocols that risk inevitable but indelible prostate damage. Hence, in this project, based on our experience in lanthanide spectroscopy and peptide chemical biology, we aim to launch an anti-prostate cancer PDT research program by proposing and developing a series of novel multifunctional X-ray-persistent luminescence-PDT bioprobes. This smart system is based on low-dosage X-ray excitable (ex/in vivo) emissive persistent luminescence lanthanide-doped nanoparticles (Sr2MgSi2O7:Eu2+) anchored with porphyrins (persistent luminescence-photosensitized hours-long 1O2 generation) and bio-conjugated with specific peptides to target ERG (an overexpressed prostate cancer receptor). Simultaneous real-time NIR monitoring is also available throughout the whole process. To substantiate our proposal, we have performed several proof-of-concept experiments: (i) 5% 1O2 was detected from porphyrins conjugated with persistent luminescence nanoparticles after 1 Gy single dose of X-ray radiation and (ii) the selectivity of binding of ERG with the proposed nanomaterials was confirmed by electrophoretic mobility shift assay. This project will be a practically translational cornerstone example of persistent luminescence-guided target-selective PDT treatment for prostate cancer imaging and therapy research. 光動力療法（PDT）作為一種新穎有效副作用小的癌症治療方式，能局部的將“光”轉化為活性氧物質如單線態氧（1O2），并與光敏劑在體內抑制癌症生長。但由於以下未解決的實際限制令其未能獲得普及：（i）光穩定性，（ii）癌症選擇性，（iii）當前的PDT分子藥劑無法有效地激發深層組織。因此，將臨床前PDT轉化為迎合社會需求的“無痛” 抗癌治療的先決條件是新型PDT藥物設計的突破創新。最近，具有顯著光物理性質（可通過近紅外光源激發）和優異生物相容性（目標識別）的表面官能化上轉換納米材料（UCNM）有希望作為一種新型的PDT藥劑。然而，這種具有良好的1O2轉化效率的UCNM，其在體內的轉化效率仍然不確定。另一方面，隨著長余輝發光納米材料（PLNMs）研究的複興，我們構想了一種由X射線激發和可再充電（深層組織穿透輻射）的PLNMs（可長達數小時的發射持續時間），其表面塗覆有光敏劑（受PLNMs激發后持續產生1O2）和特異性靶向肽（具有癌細胞選擇性），使其可成為理想的深層組織抗癌治療的新一代PDT藥劑。前列腺癌是男性最常見的非上皮性深層組織癌，是導致男性患癌症死亡的主要原因。目前的前列腺癌治療總是涉及侵入性的醫療方案，因此風險較高，而且容易造成前列腺的永久損傷。所以，根據我們在鑭系元素光譜和多肽化學生物學方面的經驗，我們的目標是提出和開發一系列新型多功能X射線激發長余輝-PDT抗前列腺癌生物探針。該智能係統基於用卟啉的低劑量X射線激發（注射前/體內）的持續發光的鑭系元素摻雜的納米顆粒（Sr2MgSi2O7:Eu2+）（長余輝發光引導光敏材料持續產生1O2），其與特異性靶向肽綴合標定ERG（過度表達的前列腺癌受體）。與此同時，實時的近紅外成像也可用於檢測整個過程。為了佐證我們的提案，我們已經進行了幾個實驗來驗證：（i）在1Gy單次劑量的X射線輻射之後，從與銪離子摻雜的長余輝發光納米顆粒結合的卟啉中檢測到5％的1O2;（ⅱ）通過電泳遷移率變動分析證實了ERG和所提出的納米材料的選擇結合性。該項目用長余輝發光引導靶向選擇性PDT治療，在前列腺癌成像和治療中具有廣闊的應用前景。

12300318.label: Realisation of objectives
12300318.value: Photodynamic therapy (PDT) is a treatment based on generation of cytotoxic reactive oxygen species (ROS) by a light-activated photosensitizer in a controlled manner to kill target cells. PDT is a non-invasive treatment method that is also highly efficient and reliable, although its efficacy is held back by several challenging problems. The PDT photosensitizers are vulnerable towards photobleaching, which reduces their ability to produce ROS. Furthermore, the ROS generated (e.g. singlet oxygen) does not differentiate between normal and cancer cells; thus leading to undesired cell damage. The penetration depth of the excitation light to induce PDT at the photosensitizer is also a problem due to absorption by tissues, and the problem is particularly pronounced for deep-tissue tumors. As a result, the scientific community yearns for a breakthrough in the research and development of next-generation PDT agents that could aid the advancement of this appealing treatment modality. On the other hand, persistent luminescence is a phenomenon in which the emission of light continues long after the cessation of excitation, with emission lifetimes ranging from seconds to hours. The development of functionalized persistent luminescence nanomaterials (PLNMs) has combined the long-lasting emission lifetimes with bio-functionality for applications as smart multifunctional theranostic platforms, with the luminescence aiding tracking and monitoring while the platform itself plays the role of a drug delivery system. In addition, when PDT is taken into consideration, the use of persistent luminescence as a constant source of excitation to induce PDT is appealing as it solves the light penetration problem mentioned above. Literature has reported the use of a single dose of X-ray as excitation to induce effective PDT towards radioresistant malignant cells, demonstrating the potential of synergistic therapy in which the use of X-ray alone would not have been effective. We believe the ideal solution to our aforementioned obstacles is to fabricate a target-specific PDT system that is activated through rechargeable persistent X-ray luminescence. In this project, we designed and prepared four series of PDT agent that could be initiated by low-dosage X-ray. The system comprises of an X-ray-excited PLNM for persistent NIR luminescence to induce PDT; target specificity is imparted by conjugation with a tumor-specific vector (i.e. peptide). The following are selected highlights of the project. (1) We developed a nanoparticle drug delivery system (NDDS), so called nanocapsule, based on ultra-small near-infrared-emissive persistent luminescence nanoparticles with a hollow mesoporous Mn-doped silica shell (Mn-ZGOCS-PEG) loaded with the anticancer drug doxorubicin (DOX). Controlled release of DOX is achieved by the biodegradation of the silica shell when it encounters the slightly acidic environment of the tumor microenvironment (TME), giving tumor selectivity. The presence of Mn ions allows for treatment monitoring and tracking by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and exclusion of excitation light as a result of persistent luminescence made interference from autofluorescence irrelevant. We performed in vitro and in vivo experiments to confirm the design rationale of the nanocapsule could be successfully translated into practical cytotoxicity against cancer cells and outstanding tumor inhibition. This work represents the immense potential for further development as clinical theranostic agents. (Theranostics, 2011, 8448) (2) The potential of including a radionuclide for an additional imaging modality, such as positron emission tomography (PET), for a mesoporous nanoparticle-based drug delivery system was explored. We designed and prepared persistent luminescence (PL) nanoparticles comprising of Cr3+ and Nd3+ for NIR PL optical imaging, magnetic Gd3+ nanoparticles for MR imaging and radioactive 68Ga for PET imaging. The drug delivery system, named hybrid mesoporous nanoparticles (HMNPs), were synthesized via a mesoporous nanoparticle (MSN) template with high monodispersity and a consistent spherical shape. The large pores of the MSN template was retained in the HMNPs, allowing a high loading capacity for anticancer drugs (e.g. DOX) and photosensitizer for PDT. Mice studies revealed that the anticancer HMNPs showed excellent tumor accumulation due to the intrinsic enhanced permeability and retention effect (EPR) of nanoparticles and impressive cancer cell ablation efficiency due to the combination of chemotherapy (DOX) and photodynamic therapy. The HMNP system is a successful demonstration of an “all-in-one” theranostic nanoplatform that blends multimodal imaging and synergistic therapy effectively, paving way for the design and application of next generation theranostic agents. The work also demonstrated the advantages of using the MSN-templated synthesis for preparation of high-loading nanoparticles to increase the treatment efficacy. (ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces, 2021, 9667) (3) We explored the possibility to achieve dual persistent luminescence in the visible and NIR regions on zinc gallogermanate (Zn3Ga2Ge2O10, ZGGO) nanoparticles by tuning the luminescence wavelength with varying concentrations of the dopant metal ions (Zn2+, Ga3+, Ge4+). The ZGGO nanoparticles were prepared by the sol-gel method followed by a sintering process. Upon studying the photoluminescence and electron spin resonance spectra of our ZGGO nanoparticles, zinc and oxygen vacancies in the rhombohedral lattice was found, with the latter found to be particularly crucial with regards to the luminescence properties. The ZGGO nanoparticles exhibited persistent luminescence in the visible region (with maximum intensity at around 520 nm) – as reported in similar nanoparticle compositions in literature –as convoluted Gaussian components. Interestingly, we found that the emission band could be tuned from the green region to the near-infrared region by modifying the chromium doping ratios of the ZGGO constitution. The fitting results of the decay curves of the persistent luminescence emission bands revealed that a relatively unimodal distribution of the distances and orientations between trap and acceptor in the lattice. The persistent luminescence spectrum could be reconstructed with the average rate constants of the persistent luminescence decays at different energies, determined from the respective fits. This work demonstrates the potential of chromium-doped ZGGO to be a tunable persistent luminescence emitter that could activate a photosensitizer for inducing PDT and perform high-penetration NIR optical imaging at the same time. (ACS Applied Nano Materials, 2020, 3, 1961-1971) The research of this proposal focuses on the design and fabrication of nanoplatforms that utilizes persistent luminescence for photodynamic therapy. By conjugation with target-specific peptide vectors, the nanoplatforms were rendered as biocompatible therapeutic agents towards prostate cancer. Comprehensive photophysical and biological studies revealed impressive luminescence, cell permeability and specificity, giving rise to a new generation of smart, multifunctional theranostic agents capable of real-time imaging/monitoring as well as targeted drug delivery for prostate cancer treatment. We also achieved a breakthrough in the development of X-ray-induced persistent luminescence for activating PDT agents, demonstrating practical potential for translation into clinical applications. The big picture of this proposal – and, macroscopically, our research – is to harness the advantages of our expertise in chemistry, biochemistry, nanoparticle synthesis and spectroscopy to produce a combinatorial and synergistic approach for cancer treatment. Thus far, decent progress has been made with the development of lanthanide-based persistent luminescence nanomaterials as multimodal imaging agents – optical imaging, MRI, PET – and target-specific therapeutic agents applicable in PDT which is beneficial towards treating deep-tissue tumors.

12300318.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12300318.value: There is much room for improvement for our developed systems, such as the tunable dual-persistent luminescence system which can be utilized in photosensitization and optical imaging at the same time. The MSN-templated strategy has proven to be bring great physical and pharmaceutical properties for further exploration and optimization of the reported system for translational clinical applications. In the long run, the study will optimize the persistent luminescence systems to achieve 1) continuous excitation light to induce photodynamic therapy via the PDT photosensitizer and 2) NIR excitation to generate persistent luminescence within the first biological window for the imaging of tumors. The chromium- and lanthanide-doped zinc gallogermanate in this project is a representative example to demonstrate that the persistent luminescence can be tuned by varying the dopant concentration. The green persistent luminescence at around 520 nm can be tuned towards a longer wavelength by controlling the chromium ion dopant concentration. This maneuver gives us the ability to manipulate the emission profile to cater for specific applications, i.e. using the highly-penetrative NIR to induce persistent luminescence and activate PDT photosensitizer. Work is currently in progress along this direction.

12301018.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12301018.value: 利用自適應流水綫的時間並行算法

12301018.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12301018.value: The parallel numerical solution of time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs) has long been the focus of the high performance computing community. In order to effectively utilize the large number of available processors in modern computing clusters, the classical approach is to apply a semi-discretization in time to the time-dependent PDE, and then apply domain decomposition (DD) in space. For highly refined models however, accuracy or stability constraints often limit the size of the time step; the time stepping process, because of its sequential nature, often becomes the bottleneck. Consequently, parallelization in the time direction has become an increasingly pressing issue. In this project, we will design new time-parallelization schemes based on waveform relaxation (WR), which are methods of the space-time domain decomposition type. Our new methods are competitive with sequential time-stepping in terms of total number of floating point operations required, and their convergence does not deteriorate with the length of the time horizon. The key idea is to eliminate computations that do not contribute to fast convergence of the overall solution. The resulting methods are mathematically different from standard WR methods, and a key part of this project is to analyze their convergence. Preliminary results show that our approach works well with advection-dominated problems and is able to multiply the overall speedup numbers by about an order of magnitude. In order to accommodate iterative solvers other than DD, we propose reformulating WR as an abstract fixed point iteration involving the unknown solution, the solution at the previous time step, and interface data coming from the previous WR iteration. The resulting framework is general enough to convert any iterative method for elliptic problems into an efficiently implemented WR-like method. Crucially, we will produce a customizable, easy-to-use code base in C++/MPI for time-parallel integration, which will be shared with the research community. This will allow engineers and researchers to add time parallelism into their codes easily, and to effectively utilize tera-scale computing resources to speed up or increase the resolution of their simulations. To ensure that our framework also works well for realistic applications, we will apply it to the simulation of unsaturated porous media flow modelled by the Richards equation. To solve this equation, we will design a WR version of the nonlinear Robin-Robin method. We will analyze its behaviour theoretically and perform a numerical comparison of its convergence rate and parallel efficiency against standard time-stepping and/or parareal approaches. 長久以來，時間相關偏微分方程的並行數值求解在高性能計算領域備受關注。為了有效地利用現代計算機集群的強大算力，傳統的處理方式是先對時間相關偏微分方程在時間方向進行半離散，然後在空間方向使用區域分解方法求解。然而，對於高度精細化模型，對算法的精度和穩定性要求常常限制了時間步長的選擇。時間步進過程，由於其本質串行性，往往成為了制約算法效率的瓶頸。因此，時間方向的並行化日益成為極待解決的問題。 在本項目中，我們將基於一種空間時間區域分解方法——波形鬆弛（WR）方法，設計新的時間並行算法。我們的新方法與傳統波形鬆弛方法相比在整體浮點數運算需求方面更有優勢，並且其收斂性不會隨著時間窗口變長而變差。算法的核心思想是去掉對算法整體快速收斂沒有貢獻的冗餘計算。由此得到的算法在數學上與標準的波形鬆弛（WR）算法是不同的，而且其收斂性分析是本項目的研究重點。初步的研究結果顯示，新的方法能有效地求解對流佔優問題並且能夠將整體加速數成倍地增加大概一個數量級。 為了兼容區域分解之外的其它迭代算法，我們將波形鬆弛方法重新寫成包含未知解、之前時間步的解以及由WR方法產生的界面數據的不動點迭代算法。由此得到的一般性框架可以將任何求解橢圓問題的迭代法轉化成可以有效實現的類WR方法。此外，我們將重點設計開發可自定義的、易用的時間並行計算C++/MPI庫，並將其與相關領域的研究者共享。這將使工程技術人員和研究者能夠很容易地把時間並行求解器整合到自己的代碼中，能夠有效地利用萬億級的計算資源來加速計算或者擴大計算問題的規模。 為了確保我們的計算框架能夠很好地應對實際應用問題，我們將把其應用於Richards方程描述的非飽和介質滲流的數值模擬中。為了求解該方程，我們將設計WR型非線性Robin-Robin算法。與此同時，我們將在理論上分析算法的收斂性，並且在數值上與標準的時間步進方法以及parareal方法在算法的收斂性態以及並行效率方面進行對比。

If the associated parameters are piecewise constants, then the unique recovery results shall be established for determining both the shape and the parameters. 12301218.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12301218.value: We consider three different but closely connected topics associated with the Maxwell system and the magnetic Schrodinger equation. They are the scattering from corner singularities, inverse shape determination of an inhomogeneity by a single far-field pattern, and the geometric structures of transmission eigenfunctions. This project is a natural continuation and extension of the PI's work on related studies for acoustic scattering governed by the Helmholtz system. We propose to conduct a systematic and comprehensive study on those fundamental issues to direct and inverse scattering theory. For the electromagnetic scattering, we consider a generic inhomogeneous medium which possesses a corner singularity on its support. In such a case, we establish the failure of the real-analytic extension across the corner, of certain electromagnetic fields satisfying the generalized transmission eigenvalue problem. This result has two important consequences. First, we can show that the corner medium scatters any incident electromagnetic waves nontrivially. Second, we can derive the unique recovery of the convex polyhedral support of a medium without knowing its contents by a single far-field pattern. Furthermore, if the medium parameters are assumed to be piecewise-constant supported in either polyhedral-cell or polyhedral-nest geometries, then the parameters can be uniquely recovered as well. Those recovery results are completely new and in sharp difference to the existing results in the literature where one basically makes use of infinitely many measurements. They also shed light and provide inspiration on a longstanding geometrical shape problem in inverse scattering theory. To push our study even further, we intend to quantify the corner scattering and the shape recovery results by establishing sharp stability estimates. The obtained quantitative results have important implications to invisibility cloaking. Moreover, they pave the way to study the geometric structures of transmission eigenfunctions. We consider both interior and exterior transmission eigenvalue problems and show that the eigenfunctions either vanish or localize near a corner point depending on the corner angle. The results are not only of significant theoretical interest, but can also be used to produce super-resolution reconstructions for inverse problems. Finally, we extend some of the proposed studies to the case with quasi-corner points. The proposed studies on exterior transmission eigenfunctions and quasi-corners are new to literature and were not ever considered even for the acoustic scattering. For the magnetic Schrodinger equation, we focus on the unique recovery of polyhedral-supported electric and magnetic potentials from a single far-field pattern, which is mainly of mathematical interest. 本項目主要針對由麥克斯維爾方程和磁性薛定諤方程描述的三個相互關聯的課題進行相應的數學研究。這其中包含有對稜角波散射，用一組遠場數據探測一個未知散射體形狀的反問題和傳輸特徵值的幾何結構的定性和定量分析。此項目所要進行的研究是課題負責人之前工作的自然延伸和推廣。這些數學研究對波的正反散射問題具有根本和基礎上的重要性。 對於由麥克斯維爾方程描述的電磁波散射問題，我們主要考慮散射體的邊界上有一些不光滑的稜角。針對此種情形，我們首先從理論上證明某一類相關的傳輸特徵值問題的特徵函數在上述稜角處無法進行解析延拓。這個結果為建立如下如下重要結論鋪平了道路：1.上述有稜角的散射體在一般的入射波探測下，總是產生出來非零的散射波場，即它在探測下總是不可能隱形的；2.如果散射體的形狀是一般的多面體，那麼我們可以證明其形狀可以被一組遠場數據探測得到； 3. 進一步，如果散射體的結構是某種特殊的多面體胞狀或多面體巢狀結構，而且其材料參數為相應的分片常數，那麼不僅其形狀，而且連帶它的材料參數也可由一組遠場數據探測得到。對上述結論，我們擬建立相應定量和定性的結果，其在理論上和實際應用中都有重大的價值。在得到上述結果的基礎上，我們會進一步研究其在傳輸特徵值幾何結構分析中的應用。我們擬從理論上證明傳輸特徵函數在稜角處的能量要麼為零要麼局部集中，而這種幾何行為量化地依賴稜角的角度大小。 我們同時也會利用上述建立起來的幾何結構來發展一套針對反散射問題的重構算法。 最後，我們擬把上述電磁波散射的相應結論由稜角的情形推廣到更一般的近稜角或類稜角的情形，同時也延伸到由磁性薛定諤方程描述的量子波散射問題中去。

12301218.value: The grant has been used to support my research on the mathematical analysis on scattering from corner singularities, inverse shape problems and geometric structures of transmission eigenfunctions. We have achieved all the objectives of this project and the results obtained are fruitful. The proposed studies in the 5 objectives are separate but intriguingly connected. In the following papers: 1. E. Blasten, H. Liu and J. Xiao, On an electromagnetic problem in a corner and its applications, Anal. PDE, 14 (2021), no. 7, 2207—2224. 2. H. Diao, X. Cao and H. Liu, On the geometric structures of transmission eigenfunctions with a conductive boundary condition and applications, Comm. Partial Differential Equations, 46 (2021), no. 4, 630-679. 3. H. Diao, H. Liu, X. Wang and K. Yang, On vanishing and localizing around corners of electromagnetic transmission resonances, Partial Differential Equations and Applications, (2021), 2:78. 4. H. Diao, X. Fei, H. Liu and K. Yang, Visibility, invisibility and unique recovery of inverse electromagnetic scattering problems with conic singularities, preprint, 2022. We established comprehensive results in qualitatively and quantitatively characterizing the vanishing and localizing properties of transmission eigenfunctions associated with electromagnetic waves in different physical scenarios. The results readily imply that corners scatter electromagnetic waves nontrivially. That means, Objectives 1 and 4 have been achieved. On the other hand, those results can be applied to establish novel unique identifiability results for the associated inverses shape problems, which are the Objective 2. Moreover, if the physical parameters are piecewise constant, we can further determine those parameters in addition to the shape of the anomalous scatterer. 12301218.label: Major findings and research outcome
12301218.value: The project is mainly concerned with qualitatively and quantitatively understanding the relation between the electromagnetic wave scattering pattern and the local geometries of the scattering object, as well as its applications to invisibility and inverse scattering problems. One of the major findings in this project is that if there is a corner singularity (locally) on the shape of the scatterer, then it scatters any incident wave nontrivially; that is, there must be radiating wave generated and the scattering object must not be invisible. The relevant findings are contained in the following papers: 1. E. Blasten, H. Liu and J. Xiao, On an electromagnetic problem in a corner and its applications, Anal. PDE, 14 (2021), no. 7, 2207—2224. 2. H. Diao, X. Cao and H. Liu, On the geometric structures of transmission eigenfunctions with a conductive boundary condition and applications, Comm. Partial Differential Equations, 46 (2021), no. 4, 630-679. 3. H. Diao, H. Liu, X. Wang and K. Yang, On vanishing and localizing around corners of electromagnetic transmission resonances, Partial Differential Equations and Applications, (2021), 2:78. 4. H. Diao, X. Fei, H. Liu and K. Yang, Visibility, invisibility and unique recovery of inverse electromagnetic scattering problems with conic singularities, preprint, 2022. We further quantify those results by showing that a corner not only scatters nontrivially, but also stably: 5. E. Blasten and H. Liu, Indiana Univ. Math. J. 70 (2021), no. 3, 907–947. 6. C.-H. Tsou and H. Liu, Calc. Var. Partial Differential Equations 61 (2022), no. 3, Paper No. 91, 24 pp. The results above are a direct consequence of certain spectral geometric results for the so-called transmission eigenvalue problems. We established qualitative and quantitative results concerning the (local) geometric properties of the transmission eigenfunctions. Furthermore, we show that if a scatterer is non-invisible, it can be uniquely determined by the associated observation of the wave pattern (with a single measurement). These are unique identifiability results for the inverse scattering problems, and the results obtained are contained in the papers 1,2,4,5,6 above as well as the following two papers: 7. E. Blasten and H. Liu, Inverse Problems, 36 (2020), 085005. 8. X. Cao, H. Diao and H. Liu, CSIAM Trans. Appl. Math., 1 (2020), 740-765. Finally, we extend the relevant results by relaxing the corner singularity to be a certain high-curvature condition: 9. E. Blasten and H. Liu, SIAM J. Math. Anal. 53 (2021), no. 4, 3801–3837.

12301218.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12301218.value: It would be interesting to consider the qualitative and quantitative relations between more general local geometries of an scattering objects and the corresponding wave scattering pattern, as well as their applications to invisibility, inverse scattering problems and spectral geometry of transmission resonances. We shall consider those extensions in our future study.

12301218.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12301218.value: The project is mainly concerned with qualitatively and quantitatively understanding the relation between the electromagnetic wave scattering pattern and the local geometries of the scattering object, as well as its applications to invisibility and inverse scattering problems. Our major finding is that if the underlying object (locally) possesses a corner or a highly-curved part, then by sending a probing wave, it will always radiate a nontrivial wave pattern; that is, the object cannot be invisible under the wave probing. Moreover, we further show that those local geometric features can help us to identify the object, which will be of practical interest to radar/sonar, nondestructive testing and medical imaging. Mathematically, the study is boiled down to analysing the so-called transmission eigenvalue problems and we derived novel spectral geometric results for the transmission eigenfunctions, showing that they must (nearly) vanish locally around a corner point or a high-curvature point.

12301418.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12301418.value: 波動方程中的特征值問題及其在隱形和反散射中的應用

12301418.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12301418.value: This project is concerned with some eigenvalue problems arising from wave equations and their applications in areas such as invisibility and inverse scattering problems. We shall consider the conventional eigenvalue problems such as the Dirichlet and Neumann eigenvalue problem, the interior transmission eigenvalue problem for medium and medium containing obstacles as well as the exterior transmission eigenvalue problems. We shall also propose new model of transmission eigenvalue problems for geometric structure such as local rough surfaces and periodic structures, which are essentially different from the interior or exterior of a single bounded domains. Starting from the Helmholtz equation for acoustic wave , we shall move on to the Maxwell’s equations for electromagnetic wave and the Navier equation for elastic wave. Through theoretical analysis and numerical computation, we shall first establish the properties for some of the eigenvalue problems, such as the existence and discreteness of the eigenvalues. More importantly, we shall investigate the geometric structure of the eigenfunctions for certain domains, which is a new contribution to the field. The connections among the eigenvalue problems, their associated scattering/diffraction problems and the Herglotz wave approximation theory will then be utilized to give rise to new notions of invisibility, which differ from the conventional ones in a few major aspects such as the requirement of the cloaking layer and the material properties. For the Dirichlet and Neumann eigenvalue problems, those connections will also lead us to a novel computational method for the inverse obstacle scattering problems. In view of the PI’s recent findings on the geometric structure for interior transmission eigenfunctions, we shall see the method can be modified for solving the inverse medium scattering problems. This method are fundamentally different from conventional ones with salient features such as the ability to resolve corners, edges and narrow regions, which are difficult for conventional methods. 本研究計劃主要關心的是和波動方程相關的特征值問題以及它們在諸如隱形和反散射問題中的應用。我們將考慮傳統特征值問題，如狄里克萊和諾依曼特征值問題、介質和含有障礙物的介質所對應的內部傳輸特征值問題、以及外部傳輸特征值問題。我們還計劃針對其他幾何結構建立新的傳輸特征值問題模型，包括局部粗糙界面和週期界面。這些結構和一個有界區域的內部或外部有本質不同。我們將從以聲波的亥姆霍茲方程作為出發點，并逐步擴展到電磁波的麥克斯韋方程和彈性波的Navier方程。 我們將首先通過理論分析和數值模擬探究其中一些特征值問題的性質，如特征值的存在性和離散型。更為重要的是研究某些區域中特征函數的幾何結構，這將是對本領域新的貢獻。之後我們將利用特征值問題、它們所對應的散射或衍射問題以及Herglotz波函數逼近理論之間的聯繫提出新的隱形概念。這些隱形概念和傳統概念有一些主要區別，包括對隱形層的要求和材料性質等。 針對狄里克萊和諾依曼特征值問題，這些聯繫還將引出障礙物反散射問題的新型計算方法。另外，鑒於PI最近在內部傳輸特征函數幾何結構中的發現，我們將看到該方法還可以推廣至介質反散射問題。此方法和傳統方法有著本質差別。它的突出特點是可以重構邊角和狹窄區域，而這正是傳統方法的一個困難所在。

12301518.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12301518.value: Triclosan (TCS) is a synthetic chemical that is extensively used as an anti-bacterial agent in clinical and personal care products. The chemical has been detected in the environment ubiquitously. Environmental exposure to TCS may significantly increase the risk of various diseases. Recent studies have shown that TCS considerably accelerates the development of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Exposure to TCS has been found to enhance liver fibrogenesis and tumorigenesis in mice. TCS exposure-related tumors were detected in mice liver. However, the detailed mechanism of liver toxicity is not well elucidated. Liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) is a powerful technique for qualitative and quantitative analysis and has been widely employed for metabolomics research. This project will utilize our strong experience in mass spectrometry (MS) and metabolomics research to develop MS-based non-targeted and targeted metabolomics methods and apply for the investigation of the possible influence of triclosan exposure associated with liver disease. TCS exposures at various levels will be investigated in normal human liver cells (LO2) for understanding the toxicological effects, and in liver cancer cell lines (HepG2 and QGY-7703) for evaluating the promoting proliferative effects. The normal C57BL/6 mouse and diethylnitrosamine-induced mouse of HCC model will also be used for investigating the influence of TCS exposures. The difference among groups with or without TCS exposure will be investigated and compared. The change of endogenous metabolites will be analyzed by using LC-Orbitrap high resolution MS and triple quadrupole MS. Multivariate statistics will be used for data analysis. The altered endogenous metabolites induced by TCS will be identified. The metabolic pathways and network will be clarified at metabolism levels. Depending on the identification results of differential metabolites, selected metabolic flux analysis focusing on the interested metabolites in critical pathways (e.g., glycolysis, PPP and derived amino acids or polyamines) will be conducted by using isotope tracer with and without TCS exposure for confirming the identified biomarkers and metabolic pathways and for investigating biochemical mechanism of TCS toxicity. The results from this study may provide insight for the correlation between TCS exposure and the development of liver diseases, and benefit the better understanding of the influences induced by TCS exposure. The successful project completion may also provide valuable information for interpreting the biological effect and toxicological mechanism of TCS. 三氯生是一种人工合成化学品，在临床和个人护理产品中广泛用作抗菌剂。三氯生在环境中的大量暴露可能与一些疾病的风险增加有关，尤其是肝脏相关的疾病。最近的动物实验研究表明暴露于三氯生可加速肝细胞癌的发展，以及增加小鼠肝脏的肝纤维化和肿瘤的发生。但是，三氯生促进肝细胞癌的机制尚未明确。液相色谱-质谱联用法已广泛用于代谢组学研究中, 本项目将综合采用基于质谱的非靶向和靶向代谢组学策略，研究三氯生暴露与肝病相关的影响；研究和比较正常人肝细胞（LO2）在各种水平的三氯生暴露后所引起的代谢物的变化，以了解三氯生的毒理作用；研究三氯生在癌细胞系（HepG2和QGY-7703）中促进增殖的作用。正常C57BL/6小鼠和二乙基亚硝胺诱导的肝细胞癌小鼠模型也将用于研究三氯生暴露的影响。本课题将采用超高效液相色谱-静电场轨道阱Orbitrap高分辨质谱技术以及三重四极杆质谱分析内源代谢物的变化，比较三氯生暴露组及对照组之间的代谢谱差异。采用多元统计方法进行数据分析，利用多级质谱技术鉴定由三氯生引起改变的内源代谢物，在代谢水平上阐明由三氯生引起的代谢通路和代谢网络的变化；根据差异代谢物的鉴定结果，选择代谢通路进行靶向分析，重点关注关键途径中的相关代谢物，例如糖酵解、磷酸戊糖途径中的代谢物和氨基酸等。本项目还将使用同位素示踪剂技术对所鉴定的生物标志物和代谢途径进行验证，进行三氯生毒性作用机制的研究。本研究的结果可以提升关于三氯生暴露与肝脏疾病的发展之间的相关性的认知，并有助于更好地理解三氯生暴露引起的影响。项目的成功完成也可以为更好地理解三氯生的生物学效应和毒理学机制提供有价值的信息。

12301518.label: Realisation of objectives
12301518.value: We have accomplished the four objectives proposed in the project. Firstly, we developed ultra-high performance liquid chromatography (UHPLC) coupled to high resolution mass spectrometry (MS)-based metabolomics profiling methods for investigating changed metabolites in liver cells and liver of mice after exposed to TCS. Chromatographic separation conditions (e.g., columns, mobile phases and gradient program) and mass analyzer parameters (e.g., collision energy, sheath gas, aux flow, ion transfer tube temperature and vaporizer temperature) were optimized in order to detect more metabolites in organisms. Human normal hepatic cell line L02 and human hepatocarcinoma cell line HepG2 were exposed to different concentrations of TCS to develop cell models. At the same time, C57BL/6 mice were exposed to TCS (10 and 100 mg/kg body weight per day) for 13 weeks by oral administration to develop the mice model. After exposure, cells and mouse liver were collected for metabolomic profiling analysis. Secondly, we successfully identified and quantified the TCS-induced differential endogenous metabolites. The Xcalibur Software was used for data acquisition and pretreatment. Chromatography peak alignment and metabolite extraction were achieved using the software R. Metabolic features with disturbed signals in blank samples and coefficient of variation > 30% in QC samples were excluded to eliminate the potential contamination. The differentiating metabolites between the control and exposure groups were selected based on the variable importance in projection (VIP > 1), as well as P value (P < 0.05) and fold change (FC, FC > 1.2 or <0.8). Metabolites were structurally identified by matching MS/MS fragments with data in the databases of METLIN and Human Metabolome. Metabolite biomarkers were further confirmed through the comparison of authentic standards. Thirdly, the relevant metabolic pathways in cells and mouse livers after exposed to TCS were identified. After differential metabolites identification, pathway was carried out using MetaboAnalyst according to the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway database, and oxidative stress and energy metabolism disorder related pathways were impacted by TCS in both cell and mice models. Lastly, the toxicological effects of TCS on liver were investigated in both cell and animal models. The differential metabolites and relative pathways were closely associated to toxicological effects. Therefore, biological assays, like qPCR, western blots, ELISA and some biological kits were used to verify the results from metabolomic analysis. MTS was applied to evaluate cell viabilities induced by TCS in both L02 and HepG2 cells. The molecular probe 2,7′-dichlorodihydrofluorescein diacetate (H2DCF-DA) was used to detect the ROS release. For other oxidative stress markers, the specific assay kits, like levels of malondialdehyde (MDA), and the activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT) as well as activities of xanthine oxidase and succinate dehydrogenase were applied. To verify the effects of TCS on energy metabolism, qPCR and western blots were conducted in liver tissues. Related mRNA levels (eg., Cd36, Fatp2 and Acs1) and enzyme levels (eg., RRARα, Cpt1 and Srebp-1c) were detected. In this project, we totally published ten SCI papers one journals, such as Environmental Science & Technology, Journal of Hazardous materials, Science of the Total Environment and Environmental Pollution. One Chinese patent was successfully applied and obtained. The project also provided resources for one PhD student training.

12301518.label: Major findings and research outcome
12301518.value: This proposed project aims to investigate the adverse effects of TCS on livers by using metabolomics analysis. Our established UPLC-MS profiling method detected the differential metabolites induced by TCS in both cell and animal models. The result found that in L02 normal cells, TCS exposure induced the up-regulation of purine metabolism and amino acid metabolism, caused lipid accumulation, and disturbed energy metabolism. These metabolic disorders in turn enhanced the overproduction of reactive oxygen species (ROS), leading to the alteration of antioxidant enzyme activities, down-regulation of endogenous antioxidants, and peroxidation of lipids. TCS-induced oxidative stress is considered to be one crucial factor for hepatotoxicity. However, in HepG2 cancer cells, TCS underwent fast detoxification through phase II metabolism, accompanied by the enhancement of energy metabolism and elevation of antioxidant defense system, which contributed to the potential effects of TCS on human hepatocellular carcinoma development. In the mouse liver tissues, we found that TCS induced significant changes in hepatic free fatty acid pool by upregulation of fatty acid uptake and de novo fatty acid synthesis, together with up-regulation of genes associated to TG synthesis, fatty acid oxidation and inflammation in TCS exposure group. These changes in lipid homeostasis could contribute to membrane instability, lipid accumulation, oxidative stress and inflammation. These different responses of metabolism in both liver cells and mouse liver tissues provide novel and robust perspectives for revealing the mechanisms of TCS-triggered hepatotoxicity.

12301518.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12301518.value: The protocols and methods developed for TCS can be extended to the analysis of other antimicrobial ingredients and other diseases-associated toxicities. The outcome of this research may be helpful for investigations of antimicrobial ingredients-induced diseases and study on the toxicological mechanisms. As an important application for further development of the research, we have revealed the adverse effects of triclocarbon in both cell and animal models and evaluate the potential health risks of triclocarbon in relation to liver diseases. In addition, the developed metabolomic profiling method could also be applied to investigate TCS-induced other diseases, like dermal toxicity and neurotoxicity.

12301518.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12301518.value: Triclosan (TCS) is an antimicrobial agent extensively employed in consumer and personal care products. However, TCS has been increasingly linked to adverse health effects, rather than the antimicrobial effectiveness. Particularly, TCS is a liver tumor promoter, its exposure can cause liver cell proliferation and fibrotic responses, and accelerate the development of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). In this study, we developed liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry methods for measurement of differential metabolites induced by TCS in both liver cells and mouse liver tissues and investigate the potential adverse effects of TCS in livers. Our results found TCS could cause oxidative stress, inflammation and energy metabolism disorder in both cell and animal models. These findings suggested that government intervention should be taken to limit application and production of TCS and its similar chemicals.

12302318.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302318.value: 求解大數據集的一階算法的數學研究

12302318.label: Project Objectives
12302318.value: To design a series of new algorithms, based on some benchmark first-order methods, for big datasets of some important optimization models. To rigorously prove the convergence and estimate the sublinear convergence rates for the new algorithms. To introduce some novel theoretical and analytical frameworks for studying the linear convergence rates of the new algorithms. To apply the new algorithms to some important and popular big datasets and to tackle crucial implementation issues.

12302318.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302318.value: The dimensionality of datasets under investigation increases very rapidly. This feature immediately poses mathematical challenges to designing implementable and efficient numerical algorithms for big datasets. Indeed, even for the application of a classic algorithm to big datasets of a simple optimization model, some important mathematical issues, including how to customize a known algorithm, how to design new algorithms tailored for a big-dataset scenario and how to rigorously prove the convergence, should be conducted from scratch. In this project, we plan to systematically study the mathematics in designing first-order algorithms for big datasets. Our emphasis are designing a series of implementable and efficient first-order numerical algorithms; introducing some new theoretical and analytical frameworks for convergence analysis, and automating the implementation of some first-order algorithms to real datasets with millions or more variables, for some important optimization models. 我們需要處理的數據集的維數正在急速增長。這一特點也使得設計適用於大數據集的高效且易實現的數值算法面對一些數學挑戰。事實上，即使應用一個經典的算法去求解一個帶有大數據集的簡單優化模型，也有很多重要的數學問題需要重新進行研究。這些數學問題包括如何對一個已有的算法進行度身定製的改動、如何設計適合大數據集的新算法、以及如何嚴格地證明算法的收斂性等。本項目將系統地研究一階算法求解大數據集優化問題帶來的數學問題。我們將針對一些重要的優化模型，設計一系列適用於大數據集的有效且易實現的一階算法、介紹一些新的理論和分析框架去研究收斂性、并將一些用於求解帶有百萬數量級變量的真實數據集的一階算法的實現自動化。

12302318.label: Major findings and research outcome
12302318.value: The major finding of this project is a systematic and comprehensive mathematical study of some numerical algorithms that can be used for solving big-data optimization models. Some novel methodologies and theoretical tools have also be developed in this project to understand these algorithms deeply. The outcome of this project is a completely new mathematical understanding of some big-data problems, from the algorithmic design, theoretical analysis, and application perspectives. The outcome of this project has lead to a number of papers published on flagship journals in the areas of Optimization, Machine Learning, Optimal Control, Inverse Problems, and Scientific Computing.

12302318.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12302318.value: The methodologies used in our algorithmic design and the new analytic frameworks used in our convergence analysis may potentially inspire some new follow-up works in academia soon. Our findings in this project may also encourage concrete collaborations with industry. In particular, the PI is working with a leading enterprise on applying some algorithms developed in this project to solve some challenging live streaming delivery problems arising in cloud computing.

12302318.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12302318.value: In this project, we had invented some new algorithms which can be used to solve some classic mathematical models but under the big-data scenarios, and established some completely new frameworks for theoretical analysis (e.g., convergence rate estimates) for these new algorithms. We had also intensively studied some important application problems, and investigated how to apply these algorithms to these applications. A number of papers have been published on top journals in several areas, and some research findings of the projects are being used in industry for solving real-life problems.

12302518.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302518.value: 全球暖化下氣候變得更加極端，世界各地的城市將同時面臨水資源供給及水災害防治的挑戰。以往很多研究已經評估了氣候變化在較長時間尺度上對水資源的影響，例如月、季和年尺度。但是，更極端的氣候（例如更強的暴雨和更長的乾旱時期）通常以氣候因子短時間尺度上的波動增加為特徵，從而改變短時間尺度的水文-大氣過程（例如土壤-植被-大氣交互及產流過程），進而對長時間尺度的水資源量及水庫調度產生影響，然而相關研究卻十分有限。東江流域受亞熱帶季風氣候影響，是一個濕潤地區，但該流域的水資源已經被高度開發及分配以滿足珠江三角洲約四千萬人和高速經濟增長對水資源的需求，使得該區域對長期水資源量變化特別脆弱。因此，嚴格地評估更極端氣候對日尺度水文-大氣過程、水資源量和水庫調度的影響，對於東江流域在氣候變化下的可持續水資源管理非常重要。本研究將把耦合水文-大氣的模型系統WRF/WRF-Hydro應用到東江流域和考慮土壤-植被-大氣連續體的動態交互，利用歷史觀測數據率定及驗證該模型系統，構建具有不同極端程度的、具有相同氣候因子總量\均值的假設氣候情景，並驅動WRF/WRF-Hydro來模擬估計氣候變化下短時間尺度水文-大氣進程，長期水資源量改變和水庫蓄水的有效性。本課題的研究目的包括（1）揭示更極端氣候下東江流域日尺度水文-大氣過程的變化特徵，例如產流以及土壤-植被-大氣交互反饋作用；（2）估算長期水資源量對更極端氣候的響應及其與日尺度水文-大氣過程的聯繫；（3）評估水資源量時間再分配對水庫蓄水的影響。該研究將有助於提升在不同時間尺度上氣候變化對水文過程影響的科學解釋，並對香港及相鄰城市的水安全具有實際意義。

12302518.label: Realisation of objectives
12302518.value: The project aims to investigate the impacts of more extreme climate on daily hydrological processes and water availability in the East River basin. The research team has generated research findings to address three scientific questions: (1) how does more extreme climate affect hydrological-atmospheric processes, especially soil-vegetation-atmosphere interactions? (2) how does water availability respond to more extreme climate through the changes in daily hydrological-atmospheric processes? (3) what are the implications of the redistribution of water availability? To realize the objectives, we have configured and validated a hydrological-atmospheric model, evaluated the changes in hydrological-atmospheric processes under more extreme climate, and assessed the changes in water availability and implications to reservoirs under extreme climate. First, we evaluated the responses of hydrological-atmospheric processes, especially the dynamic interactions in the soil-vegetation-atmosphere continuum. Two major approaches, i.e., numerical simulations and statistical analyses, were employed to realize this objective. The Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model coupled with Noah-MP, as well as the WRF-Hydro model have been configured, optimized, and validated in the East River basin. Different physical schemes of WRF have been used, and the one with the highest agreement with daily observations was selected. We compared the effects on the model performance of different numbers of domains (i.e., 2 nested and 4 nested domains) and physical scheme options (e.g., WSM-6 class and Lin for mp_physics). After comparing various options, 4 nested domains and optimal schemes with the best model performance were identified. In the model, dynamic vegetation was set to enable the model dynamically simulate the vegetation and hydrometeorological conditions based on their interactions. The simulations of drought events with dynamic and static vegetation (i.e., vegetation was fixed in the model) were compared to evaluate how soil-vegetation-atmosphere interactions affect hydrological processes and factors (e.g., vegetation, soil moisture, evapotranspiration, runoff, precipitation, and temperature) under droughts. To further study vegetation responses to climate extremes, the research team collected observed and remote sensing vegetation data such as above-ground biomass, below-ground biomass, biodiversity, and normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) in different regions. The NDVI dynamics and above-ground and below-ground biomass of different periods (e.g., growing season and annual) under climate extremes of various levels (e.g., extreme dry, moderate dry, slight dry, …, extreme wet) were analyzed using various statistical methods such as mixed-effects models and post-hoc test. Based on the results of the statistical analyses, the responses of vegetation (e.g., resistance and resilience) with various biological characteristics (e.g., biodiversity and functional group) to climate extremes of different levels were assessed. Second, the impacts of more extreme climate on hydrological processes and water availability were assessed. The WRF model was driven by scenarios of extreme cases with perturbed temperature. The temperature of all the vertical layers was raised or reduced by 1 oC, 2 oC, 3 oC, 4 oC, and 5 oC. All other boundaries and initial conditions were controlled as in the control run. The model outputs of land-atmospheric components (e.g., soil moisture, runoff, humidity, evaporation, precipitation) of the scenarios were compared with the control run to analyze the impacts of different temperatures on the hydrological processes. Since the resolutions of outputs from Global Climate Models (GCMs) are coarse for regional and local studies. Downscaling is often used to downscale GCM outputs to finer spatial resolutions. We examined the impacts of different strategies (e.g., interpolation and statistical downscaling) on handling the resolution issues of models for the estimation of precipitation extremes. A multiscalar drought index based on the GRACE terrestrial water storage was proposed by the research team to characterize the deficit/surplus of all terrestrial water components (e.g., streamflow, soil moisture, and groundwater). The research team also proposed a trend-based time-varying assessment method to assess the impacts of climate change and human activities on streamflow and floods. The proposed method does not require the existence of change point and stationarity assumption which are the prerequisites of the conventional abrupt change-based methods. In reality, hydrological conditions may change gradually over a period (e.g., affected by climate change), instead of altering abruptly at a particular time. Therefore, the proposed method based on trend detection better fits the hydrological changes in this case. Combined with the Variable Infiltration Capacity (a widely used macroscale semi-distributed hydrological model), the proposed method was used to attribute the temporal evolution of mean streamflow and floods. Third, we assessed the impacts of temperature on precipitation (extremes and non-extremes) and the implications to reservoirs. For each meteorology station in the East River basin, the daily precipitation and the corresponding daily mean temperatures were extracted. Only the wet days with daily precipitation larger than 0.1 mm per day were considered. Precipitation on wet days was placed in 12 temperature bins with approximately the same number of wet days in each bin. The 50th, 75th, and 99th percentiles of daily precipitation were used to represent precipitation at different levels (e.g., non-extremes for water availability and extremes for floods). This process was employed in observations and model simulations with perturbed temperature. Statistical relationships (e.g., point-to-point relationship) between the 50th, 75th, and 99th percentiles of daily precipitation (ordered from lowest to highest) and the average daily temperature in the East River basin. Based on this, the implications of water availability and flood risks to reservoirs in different temperatures and in different seasons were discussed.

12302518.label: Major findings and research outcome
12302518.value: Results about the impacts of more extreme climate on hydrological processes and water availability have been produced in this project. First, our numerical experiments under extreme drought events in the East River basin show that model simulations with vegetation dynamics perform better than simulations with statistic vegetation. Simulations considering vegetation dynamics in drought conditions in the East River basin lead to wetter conditions (i.e., higher runoff and soil moisture, and lower air temperature). Based on observed and remote sensing data, soil-vegetation-atmosphere interactions have also been evaluated for terrestrial ecosystems’ response to climate extremes of different intensities (e.g., moderate and extreme) and directions (e.g., dry and wet). Vegetation in different ecoregions shows that their resistance (ability to absorb shocks) and resilience (capacity to recover to its original state after a disturbance) are highly dependent on climate extreme intensity (Hossain and Li 2021a). That is, vegetation shows lower resistance but higher resilience to dry climatic conditions and higher resistance but lower resilience to wet climatic conditions (Hossain and Li 2021a). Our assessment of the resistance and resilience of vegetation based on 24-year observations exhibits that vegetation resistance increases with species richness (number of species) irrespective of wet and dry climatic conditions but vegetation resilience decreases with species richness after dry climatic conditions (Hossain et al. 2022). Our studies also reveal that the response of vegetation to climatic variability and extremes varies across ecoregions (Hossain and Li 2020), across plant functional types (Hossain and Li 2021b), between above- and below-ground biomass (Hossain and Li 2020c), and across grassland types (Hossain et al. 2023). Second, a multiscaler standardized terrestrial water storage index (STI) has been proposed by Cui et al. (2021) to characterize the deficit of terrestrial water storage. Short-term time scales (e.g., 3 and 6 months) of STI showed higher correlations with long-term time scales (e.g., 18 and 24 months) of other meteorological indices (e.g., standardized precipitation index [SPI], and evapotranspiration index [SPEI]). STI is considered a robust indicator of hydrological droughts and changes in vegetation, as this index better represents vegetation growth compared to uniscalar drought indices. Third, in more extreme climate with increased temperature, extreme precipitation in the dry seasons would pose a threat to the flood control capacity of reservoirs, while the decrease in non-extreme precipitation is also expected to pose a great challenge to water storage of the reservoirs.

12302518.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12302518.value: This project creates knowledge of hydrological-atmospheric processes under more extreme climate, which can be developed to further in-depth and interdisciplinary topics covering hydrology, ecology, and atmospheric science. For example, although standardized terrestrial water storage index (STI) has been found more reliable in assessing vegetation growth compared to other drought indices (e.g., SPI and DSI), investigation of vegetation responses to several co-occurring extreme events (e.g., drought × heatwaves) and land management in the future research will provide important evidence of vegetation dynamics, functioning and stability in the face of climate change. In this project, a trend-based time-varying approach has been proposed for assessing climate- and human-induced impacts on streamflow in the East River basin. The effectiveness of this trend-based time-varying approach can be extended for other major river systems in order to assess the robustness of this approach through exploring temporal evolution of seasonal streamflow attributed to climate change and human activities across the world. This project also concludes differential resistance and resilience of vegetation under varying degrees and directions of climate extremes, which provided an important future research direction for understanding ecological memory under increasing magnitude and frequency of climate extremes.

12302518.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12302518.value: This study aims to understand (i) the interactions of soil-vegetation-atmosphere under more extreme climate, (ii) the impacts of more extreme climate on hydrological-atmospheric processes and water availability, and (iii) the implications to the management of water resources and floods. According to observations and model simulations, a warming climate speeds up regional hydrologic cycle and weather patterns, changing not only the mean condition of weather patterns but also the temporal variability of temperature and precipitation over short- to long-term time scales. This project provides important findings on the complex interactions of soil-vegetation-atmosphere. The numerical simulations highlight the importance of modeling the dynamics of vegetation with consideration of soil-vegetation-atmosphere interactions. Ecosystem responses to climate extremes vary across vegetation types, plant functional groups, number of species and root and shoot production. Greater number of species increases vegetation ability to absorb extreme drought and decreases vegetation capacity to recover after droughts. A standardized terrestrial water storage index is proposed to measure the shortage of all terrestrial water components (e.g., streamflow, soil moisture, and groundwater), which is shown to be good at representing vegetation growth. The more extreme precipitation regimes caused by increased temperature lead to more challenges in balancing flood and water resource management.

12302818.value: 回归的模型检验：带有全局光滑特征的局部光滑检验方法

12302818.label: Project Objectives
12302818.value: To benefit the advantages of local and global smoothing-based tests, we try to bridge these two schools to construct a test that is based on local smoothing method when projections at all directions are used, and takes a particular average such that it inherits the merits of global smoothing-based tests. As limiting null distributions of global smoothing-based tests are either intractable or impractical when the sample size is not large, we will propose a hybrid test that is combination of a simple global smoothing test and a commonly used local smoothing test. we propose a model-adaptation approach. To this end, we first propose a new thresholding ridge ratio criterion to identify the number of predictors that involve in the test statistic construction. The tests can be a simple weighted sum of residuals without any nonparametric estimation under the null hypothesis such that the limiting null distributions are tractable and practically usable. This construction could make the tests easier to maintain the significance level. Further, they automatically adapt to the alternatives such that the tests are omnibus against general alternatives. These methods are readily applied to handle the scenarios where the number of predictors diverges to infinity. To achieve this goal, we try to construct them in the form of distance-correlation-based tests and then investigate their performances in finite sample and large sample scenarios.

12302818.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302818.value: For regressions with high-dimensional predictors, how to deal with data sparseness problem is an important issue. Existing local smoothing and global smoothing tests respectively shape into two very different classes of tests in this area, which have their own pros and cons in high-dimensional scenarios. In this project, we propose two novel approaches to bridge these two different methodologies. The first is to transfer a projection-based local smoothing test to be a global smoothing test such that the constructed test can benefit the advantages of two methods. The second is to use a model-adaptation method and a hybrid strategy to construct test statistic. Under the null hypothesis, the test is simply a sum of weighted residuals such that the critical values can be easily determined by normal distribution. While, under the alternative hypothesis the test automatically adapts to the underlying models so that general alternative hypothesis can be detected as any omnibus test does. The constructed tests by these two approaches can detect the alternatives distinct from the null at parametric rate that is fastest possible rate in hypothesis testing no matter the tests are constructed basing on local smoothing tests or not. 对于具有高维预测因子的回归问题，如何处理数据稀疏是一个重要的问题。现有局部平滑与全局化平滑的检验方法分别形成两个非常不同的检验方法论。在高维情况下，它们都有各自的优缺点。在这项目，我们提出了两种新的方法来有机结合这两种不同的方法论。第一种方法是将基于投影数据的局部平滑方法转变成一个全局平滑检验，使得所构造的检验能够具有两类方法论的优点。第二种方法是使用一个模型自适应方法和混合策略去构造检验统计量。在零假设下，检验统计量只是一个加权残差的总和，使得临界值可以很容易地由正态分布确定。而在备择假设下，检验统计量测试自动适应数据服从的模型，以便，如同任何一个通用的检验一样，一般的备择假设可以被检测。不论所构造的检验统计量是否基于局部光滑技术，这两种方法都可以检验出以最快速度收敛到零假设下的备择模型。

12303218.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12303218.value: 移動中大量點源的分解與分析

12303218.label: Project Objectives
12303218.value: The objective of this task is to develop a general theory along with effective methods to construct point-source recovery operators based on convolution transform of the point-sources with kernels different from the Gaussian, replacing the orthonormal Hermite basis of $L_2(mathbb{R}^q)$ in [11,12] by other orthonormal or bi-orthogonal bases, that depend on the convolution kernels. In particular, spline functions, basis functions of bi-orthogonal wavelets, with synthesis-wavelet spline functions and analysis-wavelet distributions will be used to significantly reduce computational complexity and random-access memory. We will also investigate the feasibility of this consideration to data-dependent manifolds based on our previous work [9], so as to apply the representation of the basis functions on graphs and trees [13,14] to handle massive point-sources in the Big Data paradigm. After applying one of the most efficient algorithms developed in the above task to extract the positions of the point-sources $mathbf{x}_{ell}(t)$ and their corresponding coefficients $a_{ell}(t)$ at any time instant $t$, we introduce a function $u(mathbf{x}, t)$ that satisfies $u(mathbf{x}_{ell}(t), t) = a_{ell}(t)$, for $ell = 1, cdots, L$. The objective is to design an iterative prediction-correction motion algorithm for $t = t_1, t_2, cdots$, based on mean-curvature flow of the point-masses for such applications as autonomous identification of abnormal point-masses in motion. The output of the prediction-correction computations described in task (2) is extended to some open connected sets $Omega_{ell}subset mathbb{R}^q$, such that $(mathbf{x}_{ell}( t_j) in Omega_{ell}$, for $j=1, 2, cdots$ and $ell = 1, cdots, L$, by applying various methods from Approximation Theory that are meaningful to certain selected physical models of interest. The objective is to develop constraint interpolating curve subdivision algorithms, for $2-D$ and $3-D$, to extend the point-mass positions to smooth curves that lie in $Omega_{ell}$. The objective of this task is to design a user-friendly software tool-box by modifying and improving the computer graphics algorithms in [16,17,18,19] for visualization of point-masses in motion, while high-lighting abnormal point-mass movements, based on the algorithms developed in the above tasks (2) and (3). This task will be carried out by our students, under the direction of the PI and guidance of a post-doctoral assistant supported by the proposed project. 12303218.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303218.value: Although the term ``Big Data" is often used as hype for advertisement, the rapidly increasing amount and complexity of data to be analyzed and understood in any scientific endeavor is a big challenge to the communities of mathematicians and other scientists. This proposal is motivated by the need of innovative mathematical theory along with effective computational schemes, to extract data information for super-resolved fluorescence microscopy in cell biology, and to facilitate the understanding of the birth of the first stars in cosmology, with focus on decomposition and analysis of living cells and stars while in motion. Indeed, motion of cell migration is key to the identification of tumor cells, particularly cancer cells that move by using different internal mechanism, movement of RNA molecules in cell nuclei enables eukaryotic gene readouts, and irregular movement of young galaxies facilitates identification of the first-generation stars for the discovery of chemical elements of life. This proposed research is concerned with decomposition of unknown point-sources in motion. The main objective is to develop a mathematical theory along with effective computational schemes and visualization tools, for predicting, analyzing and displaying motion activities. To accomplish this goal, a one-pass solution of the super-resolution inverse problem, based on our recent work [11,12] and the PDE model of mean-curvature flow, will be developed. Visualization algorithms will be extension of our previous papers [16,17] in computer graphics. The long-term impact of the proposed research is not limited to analysis of point-sources in motion, but also to providing a powerful mathematical tool for big data decomposition and understanding. Furthermore, in view of the current exciting development of super-resolved light microscopy with sub-cellular nano-scale capability for viewing molecular activities within a living cell, and the forthcoming launch of the James Webb space telescope in 2018, with the capability of seeing the earliest stars and galaxies and to looking deep into nearby dust clouds to study the formation of stars and planets, the timing and research findings of this proposed project should have significant great impact to the research advancement of cell biology and cosmology, as well as the advancement of science and technology in general. 雖然“大數據”這個術語經常被用作廣告的宣傳，但是在任何科學努力中要分析和理解的數據的數量和復雜性的快速增加對數學家和其他科學家的社區來說是一個巨大的挑戰。這項擬議的研究動機是需要創新的數學理論和有效的計算方案, 為細胞生物學中的超分辨熒光顯微鏡提取數據信息, 並促進對宇宙學中第一顆恆星誕生的理解: 重點是分解在運動中分析活細胞和恆星。實際上, 細胞遷移的運動是識別腫瘤細胞的關鍵, 特別是通過使用不同內部機制移動的癌細胞, 細胞核中RNA分子的移動使得真核基因讀數成為可能。並且年輕星系的不規則運動有助於識別第一代星為發現生命的化學元素。 這項擬議的研究涉及移動中未知點源的分解。主要目標是開發數學理論以及有效的計算方案和可視化工具，用於預測，分析和顯示移動的活動。為了實現這一目標，將開發基於我們最近的工作[11,12]和平均曲率流的PDE模型的超分辨率反問題的一過通(不用迭代的)解決方案。可視化算法將是我們之前在計算機圖形學中的論文[16,17]的擴展。 我們擬議研究的長期影響不僅限於分析移動中的點源，而且還為大數據分解和理解提供強大的數學工具。此外,鑑於目前令人興奮的超分辨光學顯微鏡的發展，具有亞細胞納米級能力，用於觀察活細胞內的分子活動，以及推出的詹姆斯韋伯太空望遠鏡，具有觀察能力最早的恆星和星係以及深入到附近的塵埃雲中研究恆星和行星的形成，這個項目的時間和研究結果應該對細胞生物學和宇宙學的研究進展產生重大影響以及科學技術的進步。

12303218.label: Realisation of objectives
12303218.value: (1) In the process of developing a general theory and methods to construct point-source recovery operators, we introduced the extended Haar wavelet with arbitrarily n-th order of vanishing moments, for arbitrarily large n as the scaled continuous convolution kernel, with scale “a” to search for each unknown point-source. This new approach is also extended to separation of multi-component signals and non-stationary time series. Two research papers on this innovation are published in the 2021 ``Applied and Computational harmonic Analysis” journal, and the 2021`` IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems”. Other follow-up papers have also been published in 2021, as reported in the Part C research output. (2) The number L of point-masses, their positions and coefficients are determined in the objective realization (1). Since this new method is more powerful than the proposed objective, there is no need to apply the proposed prediction-correction approach. We simply use frame-by-frame digital video for mean-curvature flow of the point-masses for identification of abnormal point-masses in motion. (3) Again, since our new method does not require post processing of prediction-correction outputs, realization of this objective is trivial and has been accomplished. (4) While the the post-doctoral assistant supported by this project was not capable in carrying out this proposed task of designing a user-friendly software tool for visualization of point-masses in motion, we are fortunate to have hired a research assistant to take over the task. While the progress in the software design is on-going with successful results, we predict completion of this task in six months. (5) In the original proposal, we have intended to carry out the application to Cell Biology, in collaboration with Professors Ming-Jer Tsai and Sophia Tsai, of the Department of Molecular and Cell Biology of Baylor College of medicine, on autonomous identification of cancer cells from tracking the movement of cell migration and investigation of cancer cell invasion. Unfortunately, Professors Ming-Jer and Sophia Tsai had decided to retire, this task was not accomplished.

12303218.label: Major findings and research outcome
12303218.value: In one publication, the Haar function is extended to a family of minimum-supported cardinal spline-wavelets with any desired polynomial order and arbitrarily high order of vanishing moments, for the purpose of carrying out our strategy of continuous wavelet transform thresholding to recover all “active” sub-signals and time series, along with their instantaneous frequencies from a blind-source composite signal they constitute. The commonly used adaptive harmonic model for governing the composite signals is extended to the realistic adaptive harmonic model to allow the time-varying continuous phase functions of the sub-signals to be non-differentiable or to have negative derivatives in arbitrary sub-intervals of the time-domain. In a follow-up paper, we propose a direct method of signal separation based on the adaptive continuous wavelet-like transform by introducing two models for signal separation: the sinusoidal signal-based model and the linear chirp-based model, which are derived respectively from sinusoidal signal approximation and the linear chirp approximation at any time instant. In another follow-up paper, we introduce an innovative approach for the recovery of non-stationary signal components with possibly crossover instantaneous frequency curves from a multi-component blind-source signal. The main idea is to incorporate a chirp rate parameter with the time-scale continuous wavelet-like transformation, by considering the quadratic phase representation of the signal components. Hence-forth, even if two IF curves cross, the two corresponding signal components can still be and recovered, provided that their chirp rates are different. In the third follow-up paper, we carry out the analysis of "signal separation operators” based on the adaptive short-time Fourier transform (STFT), by studying both the sinusoidal signal-based model and the linear chirp-based model, and obtain the error bounds for the instantaneous frequency estimation and component recovery. The fourth follow-up paper, we consider the mode retrieval of a multi-component signal which has crossing instantaneous frequencies, meaning that some of the components of the signal overlap in the time-frequency domain. The fifth follow-up paper, a novel theory-inspired implementation as a deep neural network (DNN) is developed with the capability of realization of sub-signal time on-sets and departures, along with short-time prediction of their instantaneous frequencies. We also prove that a major advantage of DNN over shallow networks is that DNN can take advantage of any inherent compositional structure in the target function, while shallow networks are necessarily blind to such structure. Therefore, DNN can avoid the so-called curse of dimensionality using what we have called the blessing of compositionality.

12303218.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12303218.value: As in the state-of-arts, our research for this project is based on point-masses that are well separated sparse data. The potential for further research is to remove any separation assumption, by allowing the unknown point-masses to be arbitrarily close or arbitrarily far apart. In this regard, we propose to introduce the notion of ``super-resolution wavelets” and their corresponding ``search functions”, defined by the ``continuous super-resolution wavelet transform”, with the scale parameter used as the search variable. Besides theoretical development, three methods are also proposed: One is on “bottom-up thresholding” for dividing the search domain into much smaller and manageable sub-domains, and second is “top-down thresholding” for computing the local maxima of the search functions which give rise to the exact locations of the unknown point-masses, while yielding the exact valued of the coefficients, which are the light intensities. This ``divide and conquer” strategy is very powerful. The third method is for off-line computations of the ``data-independent basis” functions for the formulation of the search functions. While the task is very challenging, the success should be a tremendous break-through in the mathematics of big data and super-resolution, with many potential applications to the advancement of sciences and technology.

12303218.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12303218.value: Microscopes are essential for research and development in Bio-sciences. In the 1860´s, Ernst Abby developed an optical theory that led to significant improvement in microscope design and understanding of magnification limit, called Abby’s super-resolution barrier. In 2008, Osamu Shimomura, Martin Chalfie and Roger Tsien were awarded the 2008 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, for their development of green fluorescent protein for marking and visualization. Based on this invention, the 2014 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to Eric Betzig, Stefan Hell, and William Moerner, for the development of super-resolved fluorescence microscopy, to getting around the Abbe’s super-resolution barrier. In 2013, David Donoho was awarded the Shaw Prize in Mathematical Sciences for his introduction of “compressed sensing” to solving the super-resolution mathematical problem in the one-dimensional setting. While the research in this area is very popular, most results are still for 1-D, and even the rare extension to higher dimensions can only be applied to still imageries. Our work on this project is the only attempt to point-mass images in motion.

12303318.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12303318.value: （随机块坐标）近端梯度法的线性收敛率研究

12303318.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303318.value: In recent years there has been an ever-increasing interest in the optimization community for algorithms suitable for solving optimization problems with separable structures. These optimization problems have arisen from various fields such as machine learning, signal processing, and statistics. With the advent of big data era, the problem instances are typically of large- and even huge-scale. Numerous experiments have demonstrated that first-order methods such as the proximal gradient method (PGM) and the randomized block coordinates proximal gradient method (R-BCPGM) are very powerful for solving them. The numerical efficiency and some theoretical progress on PGM and R-BCPGM have long been witnessed in diversified areas, but research on their convergence rates is still in its infancy. In this project, we will focus on introducing the well-established error bound/calmness/metric subregularity theories in variational analysis to the convergence rate analysis. In particular, the convergence rates of PGM and R-BCPGM will be intensively investigated under error bound/calmness/metric subregularity. Firstly, a new framework for establishing suitable algorithm-tailored subregularity conditions which suffice to ensure the desired linear convergence will be initiated. Moreover, the calmness conditions tailored to linearly convergent PGM will be verified to hold automatically for a wide class of structured convex models. In addition, the subregularity conditions required for the expected value-type linear convergence of R-BCPGM will be proved to hold automatically for some widely-used statistical learning models such as LASSO, fused LASSO, grouped LASSO and etc. For general problems without any underlying structures, by using some recent developments in variational analysis, sufficient conditions for the calmness tailored to the linear convergence of PGM will also be developed. 近年来，优化邻域对用于求解可分离结构优化问题算法的兴趣日益增加。这类优化问题常常出现在机器学习，信号处理和统计等各种领域。随着大数据时代的到来，对这些问题数据规模通常较大甚至十分庞大。大量数值实验已经表明了一阶方法如近端梯度法（PGM）和随机块坐标近端梯度法（R-BCPGM）在求解这类问题时十分有效。虽然关于PGM和R-BCPGM的数值效率和其他一些理论进展长期以来在各个邻域都有所研究，但关于它们收敛率的研究仍处于起步阶段。 在这个项目中，我们重点将在变分分析中已建立的误差界条件/平稳性条件/度量次正则理论引入到收敛速度分析中。特别地，我们将应用误差界条件/平稳性条件/度量次正则理论深入研究PGM和R-BCPGM的收敛率。首先，我们将提出用于建立基于算法的度量次正则条件的新框架，其足以确保线性收敛性。其次，我们将证明PGM的平稳性条件对一系列广泛的结构凸模型自动成立。此外, 对于一些广泛使用的统计学习模型，如LASSO变量选择模型，grouped LASSO分组最小角回归模型等，我们将证明R-BCPGM方法线性收敛所需的度量次正则条件自动成立。对于缺乏基础结构的一般问题，通过使用变分分析的一些最新理论结果，我们将同时给出PGM线性收敛所需平稳性条件的充分条件。

12303618.value: For ultra-high dimensional data, we will discretize continuous response and predicting variables, and apply 0-1 Boolean bit operation to make sure independence screening procedure to detect not only the significant main effects, but also all of pure interaction effects among the predicting variables. We will discretize the response variable and combine regularization methods with the use of Boolean operations for categorical data modeling problems. We will build a publicly available R package that interface between R and C++ that implements the proposed discretization method and 0-1 Boolean operation to general statistical modeling. Consider partial linear varying coefficient model, we apply the step function to approximate the varying coefficient function, and therefore change the model as a high dimensional linear model. The estimation of this model can be done using simple least squares to obtain the initial linear component estimate, and obtain the varying coefficient function estimates using two-step estimation procedure, and investigate the trade-off between the complexity of computation and the efficiency of the estimate. We will investigate the statistical properties of the statistical inference methods based on those estimates of parameters in the linear component, and varying coefficient functions in the partial linear varying coefficient models Under more generalized semiparametric or nonparametric setting, we will investigate statistical properties and complexity of computation based on the proposed approach, and develop a framework to balance between the efficiency of statistical estimate and inference methods and their complexity of computation when the size and dimension of data is relatively large.
