15213318.label: Major findings and research outcome
15213318.value: Our major findings include four main aspects. First, we have developed a set of algorithms for joint task scheduling and network flow scheduling in collaborative edge computing environments considering different application models [J2019] [J2020c]. The research is novel in considering complex computing and network resource dependency. Previous works have considered task scheduling and network flow scheduling problems separately that can lead to inefficient solutions in mesh network environments due to congestion among network flows. Our problem was more challenging and leveraged a joint approach for scheduling dependent resources. We designed a joint heuristic algorithm for the application model with dependent tasks, with each task requiring input data from multiple sources. We also designed another heuristic algorithm for multi-hop offloading of multiple directed acyclic graph tasks. Performance evaluations show significant improvement over benchmarks. Second, we have developed bandwidth allocation solutions during concurrent live VM migrations in edge clouds [J2020a]. We have designed a mathematical model to optimize the bandwidth to maximize the average QoS while considering the migration time constraint for each VM migration task. Previous works have considered single live migration and ignored the QoS requirement. We have proposed a set of evolutionary algorithms to select an initial solution for the relaxed mathematical formulation. We have also proposed a heuristic that adjusts the solution to improve performance further. The performance evaluation shows that our proposed approach can achieve good QoS while maintaining fast convergence speed under various simulation settings. Third, we have developed a hybrid data dissemination approach in automated driving scenarios that leverages potential vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) dissemination with a higher priority than vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) dissemination [J2020b]. We proposed an offline algorithm for data dissemination for the whole period. Based on offline solution, we have also proposed two online solutions, snapshot online data dissemination (SODD) and online data dissemination algorithm with ∆t-step (∆t-ONDD), that can be applied in practical environments. Extensive simulations using real-world data show significant performance improvement over benchmark solutions. Fourth, we have developed a reinforcement learning (RL) based solution for reliability-aware dynamic service chain scheduling in 5G networks [C2021] [J2022c]. Previous works have considered static deployment strategy and assumed that all SFC requests are known in advance, which is impractical and inefficient. We have proposed an efficient approach by separating the redundancy-determining problem from SFC scheduling. The proposed RL-based online solution can increase the success rate of service function chain requests by 18.7% over the benchmark solutions.

15213318.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15213318.value: For the data-aware task allocation problem, we will study distributed solutions to jointly schedule tasks and network bandwidth in a collaborative edge computing environment. Existing solutions for joint task and network scheduling are often centralized that are not scalable in large city-scale edge computing environments. While some studies have focused on distributed solutions for task scheduling, they have yet to focus on the joint task and network scheduling for mesh network edge devices. We will also consider integrating intra-task and cross-task scheduling, where intra-task focuses on offloading tasks from end devices to a single edge device while cross-task scheduling focuses on scheduling tasks across multiple edge devices. The study of this topic would advance the state-of-the-art of scheduling for edge computing environments. Additionally, in the future, we will investigate joint scheduling of computing and network resources while considering AI training and inference tasks. We will study the compression and partition of deep neural network models to reduce the model inference delay in a collaborative edge computing environment with a mesh network of edge devices. We will also study model training and aggregation scheduling to achieve high model accuracy and convergence speed by considering the underlying computation and network resources.

15213318.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15213318.value: The research makes a significant contribution towards achieving efficient scheduling of tasks that is fundamental to empowering the next generation of edge computing applications. This research specifically addresses the problem of joint task and network flow scheduling in a collaborative edge computing environment with a mesh network of edge devices sharing computing and data resources. The proposed system models, algorithms, and prototypes can benefit application developers and end users by improving application performance. The proposed research can be applied to different application domains as illustrated by simulations using real-world data for the case of autonomous vehicles and 5G network environments. We have also illustrated the efficacy of proposed solutions for real application scenarios by developing prototypes for distributed machine learning and multi-robot systems application. In summary, this project not only improves the task scheduling performance for collaborative edge computing environments but also greatly impacts several application domains leveraging edge computing technology such as Industry IoT, autonomous vehicles, 5G/6G, multi-robot systems, etc.

15213818.value: 多核處理器正在成為實時系統的主流硬件平臺，以滿足其不斷增長的高性能與低功耗需求。軟件需要被並行化才能充分發揮多核系统的計算能力。OpenMP是共享內存體系結構上事實標準的並行編程框架。其被廣泛使用於通用和高性能計算領域，近年來也被嵌入式計算機領域廣泛關註。例如，OpenMP已經在MPPA和Keystone II等嵌入式處理器的開發工具中得到支持。本項目的主旨在於研究如何用OpenMP來構建實時並行軟件。實時系統的建模和分析傳統方法分為兩步：（1）最壞執行時間分析和（2）可調度性分析。最壞執行時間值被作為低層程序語義分析和高層調度行為分析的邊界。然而OpenMP帶來了傳統分析方法無法解決的新挑戰。OpenMP是編程模型，而非高層任務模型。因此，OpenMP程序所產生的負載與低層的程序語義緊密藕合，所以無法簡單地用最壞執行時間值來在程序分析和可調度性分析直接劃出清晰的界限。現有關於OpenMP任務模型時間分析方面的工作都是采用傳統方法，因此或者只適用於OpenMP中的某些特性，或者因為過度簡化的建模而承受很大的悲觀性。為解決上述問題，本項目將研究壹種新的分析框架，利用全面的負載抽象而非簡單的最壞執行時間值作為程序級與系統級分析的邊界。在此基礎上，本項目將研究如何對基於OpenMP的實時系統設計進行優化以提高其時間可預測性。盡管本項目著眼於解決OpenMP規範中各種限制對時間分析所帶來的挑戰，我們的目的並非倡導在實時系統中使用OpenMP的所有特性。相反的，我們相信需要對OpenMP進行定制和擴展來支持實時計算。本項目的終極目標是理解OpenMP中有哪些現有的和缺失的目標可以使其適用於實時系統，由此在不損失OpenMP性能和可編程性的前提下來保證其實時性。長期來看，本項目的研究成果將對推動OpenMP在未來版本中包括正式的實時計算支持起到推動作用。

15213818.label: Realisation of objectives
15213818.value: The project has achieved the objectives. Specifically, we have meet the following goals. * We developed a benchmark suite of real-time OpenMP tasks. Previous studies conduct evaluations with randomly generated task graphs, which cannot well capture the structure features of realistic OpenMP programs. To fill the gap between theoretical real-time scheduling research and the OpenMP software reality, we develop an ompTG tool for transforming OpenMP programs into parallel task graphs. ompTG prepares a way to exhibit OpenMP such that the researchers in real-time community can easily understand: An OpenMP system consists of a set of tasks. There are interdependencies among tasks, and each task has an intra structure of the control-flow graph. Besides the topology of OpenMP tasks, we also provide a safe WCET for each vertex of OpenMP task graphs by using static WCET analysis techniques. Moreover, we derive the flow facts, e.g, infeasible path and loop bounds for the task graph, which is necessary information for real-time scheduling and analysis. As a case study, we collect 12 OpenMP programs from the BOTS benchmark, and transform them into task graphs, demonstrating the usage of ompTG. * We have established theories to analyze realistic OpenMP task systems, which in general have more flexible structures that do not comply with those assumptions in existing work. In this project, we model the behavior of general OpenMP task systems with non-well-nested structures. The worst-case response time analysis problem for such systems is more difficult due to the flexible graph structure. As the major technical contribution, we develop two efficient algorithms to compute the worst-case response time bounds, with different trade-offs between efficiency and precision. Evaluation with both randomly generated task graphs and realistic OpenMP programs shows good performance of our approaches in terms of both precision and efficiency. We formulate the workload of OpenMP task systems with loop structures as the cyclic graph model and study how to compute safe upper bounds for the worst-case response time (WCRT). The loop structures combined with the creation of tasks and conditional branches result in a large state space of the possible execution flows, i.e., the actual paths taken in the program to generate workload at runtime. Simply unrolling the loop and/or enumerating all the possible execution flows would be computationally intractable. As the major technical contribution, we develop a linear-time dynamic programming algorithm to compute the WCRT bound without unrolling loops or explicitly enumerating the execution flows. We study the real-time scheduling and analysis of OpenMP task systems supporting nested parallelism. First, we show that under existing scheduling algorithms in OpenMP implementations, nested parallelism indeed may lead to extremely bad timing behaviors where the parallel workload is sequentially executed completely. To solve this problem, we propose a new scheduling algorithm and develop two sound response time bounds by considering the trade-off between simplicity and analysis precision. * We developed new scheduling techniques to significantly improve the timing predictability of OpenMP tasks. An important feature in OpenMP is tied tasks, which must execute on the same thread during the whole life cycle. Although tied tasks enjoy benefits in simplicity and efficiency, it was considered to be not suitable to real-time systems due to its complex behavior. In this paper, we study the realtime scheduling and analysis of OpenMP task systems with tied tasks. First, we show that under the existing scheduling algorithms in OpenMP, tied tasks indeed may lead to extremely bad timing behaviors where the parallel workload is sequentially executed completely. To solve this problem, we proposed a new scheduling algorithm and developed two response time bounds for it, with different trade-off between simplicity and analysis precision. We also study the real-time scheduling of OpenMP task systems with tied tasks but without changing the original TSCs. In particular, we propose a partitioning-based algorithm, P-EDF-omp, by which the tied constraint can be automatically guaranteed as long as an OpenMP task system can be successfully partitioned to a multiprocessor platform. * We developed techniques to predict the cache behavior in OpenMP tasks for timing predictability. Choosing the appropriate assignment of loop iterations to threads is one of the most critical decisions when parallelizing loops, especially considering the large impact by caches behaviors to the program execution time. In this paper, we study data cache analysis for OpenMP programs with parallel loops. We first present a method considering the impact of the schedule clause in OpenMP programs on cache behavior. We capture the dynamic behavior of memory access by computing its temporal scope (the loop iterations where a given memory block is accessed for a given data reference) during address analysis. Based on the ACS representation, we present a temporal scope aware data cache miss calculation technique.

15213818.label: Major findings and research outcome
15213818.value: The project aimed to address the gap between theoretical real-time scheduling research and the OpenMP software reality by developing a benchmark suite of real-time OpenMP tasks and establishing theories to analyze realistic OpenMP task systems. The project developed an ompTG tool for transforming OpenMP programs into parallel task graphs to exhibit OpenMP's structure and provide safe WCET for each vertex of OpenMP task graphs using static WCET analysis techniques. They also derived flow facts, such as infeasible path and loop bounds for the task graph to assist real-time scheduling and analysis. As a case study, they transformed 12 OpenMP programs from the BOTS benchmark into task graphs and demonstrated ompTG's usage. The project also developed two efficient algorithms to compute the worst-case response time bounds for OpenMP task systems with non-well-nested structures, and a linear-time dynamic programming algorithm to compute worst-case response time bounds for the workload of OpenMP task systems with loop structures. They also proposed a new scheduling algorithm and developed two sound response time bounds by considering the trade-off between simplicity and analysis precision to handle nested parallelism. Additionally, the project studied the real-time scheduling and analysis of OpenMP task systems with tied tasks and proposed a new scheduling algorithm to handle it. They also proposed a partitioning-based algorithm to automatically guarantee the tied constraint as long as an OpenMP task system can be successfully partitioned to a multiprocessor platform. Finally, the project developed a method for data cache analysis for OpenMP programs with parallel loops, which considers the impact of the schedule clause on cache behavior and captures the dynamic behavior of memory access by computing its temporal scope. Based on the ACS representation, they proposed a temporal scope aware data cache miss calculation technique. Overall, the project's research findings contribute to improving the timing predictability of OpenMP tasks in real-time systems.

Further development could involve integrating ompTG with real-time scheduling and analysis tools to enable better decision-making in real-time systems. Expanding the study to other parallel programming models: While this research focuses on OpenMP programming, there are several other parallel programming models like MPI, CUDA, and OpenCL. Therefore, further development can involve exploring how the techniques developed in this research can be adapted to support other parallel programming models. Exploration of advanced cache analysis techniques: The research developed techniques to predict cache behavior in OpenMP tasks. Further development could involve exploring advanced cache analysis techniques to enhance cache performance in real-time systems. Continued development of new scheduling algorithms: This research developed new scheduling algorithms to improve the timing predictability of OpenMP tasks. Further development can involve continued development of new scheduling algorithms to increase the effectiveness and performance of real-time systems.

15213818.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15213818.value: This project aimed to make sure that programs written in OpenMP, a software for parallel computing, work correctly and predictably in real-time systems. We made a tool called ompTG that turns OpenMP programs into graphs, which can be analyzed to see how long each task will take to complete. We also created new algorithms to analyze OpenMP programs with complex structures, and improved the way data is stored in computer memory to make OpenMP programs run better. Overall, the outcomes of this project help make sure that OpenMP programs run smoothly in real-time systems.

15214318.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15214318.value: 此項目主要研究目標是設計新壹代風力直流發電系統來實現寬風速範圍的風能轉換。清潔無污染的風能在可再生能源領域占有重要位置。但是風場一般在偏遠的地區，長距離的電力輸送無疑會帶來能量的浪費和建設成本的增加。如何更加有效的利用風能，在寬的風速範圍內增大風能利用率成為研究關鍵。直流風力發電系統可以去除直流交流轉換的能量損失，提高能源利用率，減少能源損耗。然而，風速是受氣候條件及季節因素的制約，從而風速有很寬的變化範圍，為何提高風能的利用率，有效的風能利用區間需要增長。本研究項目就是要提出新型的直流風力轉換系統在寬的風速範圍內都可以有效的轉換成直流的電能輸出。尤其是，這種風機有開關繞組結構連接，結構緊湊，重量相對比較輕，可以允許低的切入速度和本結構具有增強的磁場調制能力，混合激勵的電磁設計，從而可以允許高的切出風速。 基於繞組切換的混合勵磁直流發電機是一個創新性的研究，此項技術可以克服逆變器容量不足的限制，還可以解決勵磁繞組跟電樞繞組空間占用的矛盾。此項技術具有以下優點1）在低速，所有的線圈切換成電樞繞組，風機可以感生出高的反電勢。2）在中速跟高速， 壹部分或者整個內定子繞組切換成勵磁繞組，可以提供並聯的緩和勵磁激勵，從而實現勵磁的調節。3）這個新的直流發電機具有無電刷，結構緊湊等優點。整個系統用在直流發電系統中具有高的可靠性和增強的風能利用率。

15214318.label: Realisation of objectives
15214318.value: The main objective of this project is to develop the next generation wind power DC generators capable to realize an extra-wide-speed-range wind power conversion for DC energy supply. Design guidelines of parallel-hybrid-excitation machine has been investigated. Based on bidirectional-flux modulation and parallel hybrid excitation technology, different innovative machine topologies have been developed and compared. Hybrid excited (HE) machines are a potential solution for wind power generation for their high efficiency from permanent magnet (PM) and good flux regulation ability from flexible field current. However, the principle and machine performance of different structures are diverse, which brings challenges in selection of machine topologies and in the dimensional parameter design. Hence, in this study, different machines with different topologies are presented and analyzed to show their merits and demerits. Both machines have relieving-DC-saturation PMs located in the slot openings, while only one of them has consequent rotor PMs to provide an auxiliary flux and to enhance torque production. In this study, the machine structure and working principle are presented, including the relieving-DC-saturation-relieving effect and air-gap field harmonic analysis. For a fair comparison, under the same outer diameter, rated current density, the dimensional parameters of two machines are optimized with genetic algorithm (GA). Further, the machine performance of the optimal models is compared in terms of torque production, back EMF, voltage regulation ability and speed range. The merits and demerits of both machines are summarized. Novel parallel-excited dual-PM reluctance machines with enhanced torque and efficiency performance have been investigated. The key is to build an integrated magnetic field with two sets of PM excitation sources in both stator yoke and slot openings. Two excitation sources produce a parallel magnetic field, which contributes to a superimposed magnetic flux in the airgap, thus leading to strengthened flux variation, improved back-EMF and torque. Additionally, with a special slot/pole combination, biased component and even order harmonics in the phase magnetic flux are eliminated to make the phase flux linkage more sinusoidal. In the meantime, self-inductance variation is greatly suppressed with odd order harmonics of selfinductance removed, resulting in suppressed torque ripple. The prototype is manufactured, and experiments are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the machine design. Novel slot-permanent-magnet (PM)-assisted hybrid reluctance generators (SPMa-HRG) with self-excited dc source for stand-alone wind power generation system have been investigated in this study. By introducing PM excitation in stator slot openings, enhanced torque density due to flux modulation effect can be achieved compared with the original reluctance topology. Moreover, the introduced PMs make it feasible to build a self-excited dc source to fed dc field winding without using extra power supply. In particular, a simple design of ac supply winding is proposed, by splitting a small portion of ac armature winding to provide electrical power to dc field winding through a diode rectifier and small-capacity H-bridge converter. Compared with using separate dc source, the device cost is reduced, and the system reliability is improved. In this study, the generator structure and operation principle are introduced. PM usage is optimized to obtain the optimal torque. The feasibility of the optimal design with self-excited dc source is verified by field-circuit coupled finite element analysis. Winding switching technology has be studied in depth to satisfy the high-efficiency wind energy conversion over an extra-wide speed range. A novel winding switching strategy has been investigated to improve the flux-weakening capability of a hybrid-excited reluctance machine (HERM). The key is that in low-speed operation, the primary and the secondary windings are connected in series and serve as armature winding to maximize output voltage while in high-speed operation, the secondary winding is switched to dc excitation winding to realize variable speed constant voltage output. The machine configuration, operation principle with dual excitation sources, winding switching concept, and manipulation circuit are illustrated in detail. Then the electromagnetic characteristics of HERM in different operation status are investigated. Finally, the variable speed constant voltage output of wind power generation system resorting to winding switching as well as dc excitation regulation is verified with Maxwell/Simplorer cosimulation. A novel winding switching control strategy has been investigated to extend the speed range of a consequent-pole ferrite-permanent magnet hybrid-excited machine (CPFPM-HEM). The key is that in low-speed range, the ac armature winding and dc field winding are connected in series to achieve large starting torque, while in high-speed range, dc field winding is injected with adjustable dc currents to realize variable speed constant voltage of ac armature winding. Furthermore, consequent-pole rotor is used to reduce the usage of the permanent magnet (PM). In the meantime, ferrite PMs are used to replace rare-earth PMs to reduce the cost with the shortage of rare-earth resources. In this study, the machine configuration, operation principle with dual excitation sources, flux modulation principle, and winding switching strategy are illustrated in detail. Then, the electromagnetic performance of the CPFPM-HEM in different speed ranges is investigated. Finally, the speed range extension with winding switching strategy is verified by the Maxwell/Simplorer co-simulation.

15214318.label: Major findings and research outcome
15214318.value: In order to realize an extra-wide-speed-range wind power conversion for DC energy supply, different parallel-hybrid-excitation machine has been investigated for the wind power generation application. In [1-4],different hybrid excited Vernier machine designs for wind power generation have been investigated and compared. Hybrid excited (HE) machines are a potential solution for wind power generation for their high efficiency from permanent magnet (PM) and good flux regulation ability from flexible field current. However, the principle and machine performance of different structures are diverse, which brings challenges in selection of machine topologies and in the dimensional parameter design. In [5] doubly fed doubly‐salient machines with DC‐saturation‐relieving structure for wind power generation has been investigated. PMs are introduced into the stator slot openings to mitigate the saturation effect in stator core caused by DC field excitation, and relatively large excitation current can be fed into stator field windings, which contributes to improved power density of machine. In addition, with the armature winding artificially connected, the reluctance of all magnetic paths is kept the same, and the variation of self-inductance is compensated, and the torque ripple is greatly suppressed. Winding switching technology has be studied in depth to satisfy the high-efficiency wind energy conversion over an extra-wide speed range. In [6]and [7],winding switching strategy has been investigated to improve the flux-weakening capability of a hybrid-excited reluctance machines and consequent-pole ferrite-permanent magnet hybrid-excited machines. The key is that in low-speed operation, the primary and the secondary windings are connected in series and serve as armature winding to maximize output voltage while in high-speed operation, the secondary winding is switched to dc excitation winding to realize variable speed constant voltage output. The variable speed constant voltage output of wind power generation system resorting to winding switching as well as dc excitation regulation is verified with Maxwell/Simplorer cosimulation.

15214318.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15214318.value: Fistly, the wind power can be efficiently used to produce not only DC power but also AC power.The special designed generator based on bidirectional flux modulation effect can be further inestigated to produce DC/AC power supply system. This is the one of the further development of the research. Secondly, winding switching strategy could be further combined with contra-rotating wind power generation system to realize high-efficiency wind energy conversion. Contra-rotating wind turbine has the high potential for the furture high performance wind energy harvesting. If further combined with winding swithching technology, the whole power density and energy conversion efficiency can be further improved.

15214318.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15214318.value: The design of this proposed parallel-hybrid-excitation wind power generator which can supply wide-speed-range DC power energy to DC micro-grids in residential or commercial buildings would be a breakthrough in the development of DC wind power generation system. It will reduce the AC/DC conversion cost and also improve the reliability of DC distribution system. At lower wind speeds, with the winding switching technology, wind conversion system can effectively enhance the wind power extraction in lower wind speed region. At medium and higher wind speeds, the proposed machine can regulate the magnetic flux with parallel magnetic circuit, avoiding the restriction from the inverter limitation and the irreversible demagnetization risk of PMs in conventional series-hybrid-excitation machines. Traditional large-capacity AC/DC/AC frequency converter is eliminated from the wind power generation system, which can significantly reduce the power conversion losses and system cost. This advanced wind energy generation technology will significantly improve the energy harvesting efficiency as well as reduce environmental hazards in residential and commercial buildings in urban area

15214418.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15214418.value: Cancer is the second leading cause of death worldwide, accounting for 8.8 million deaths in 2015, and nearly 1 in 6 deaths is due to cancer. Surgery, radiation therapy and chemotherapy are three basic treatments of cancer. Unfortunately, most cancer cases, in particular those of lung cancer and liver cancer, are not diagnosed until the later stages of development, by which time surgery is no longer possible. Chemotherapy and radiation therapy destroy both cancer cells and normal cells, with many undesired side effects including anemia, hair loss, oral ulcer, nausea and vomiting. In recent years, hyperthermia, or thermotherapy, has been introduced for cancer treatment in which body tissue is heated to a temperature above the physiological level to damage and kill cancer cells or to make cancer more susceptible to radiation or chemotherapy. Typical temperature ranges for hyperthermia are between 39°C and 45°C. Among various heating techniques, the magnetic hyperthermia utilizes magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs), which are dispersed in tumor tissues and exposed to an alternating magnetic field, to generate the required heat for temperature enhancement. Although having been demonstrated to be effective, magnetic hyperthermia is still facing a great challenge, i.e., how to impose fatal thermal damage to cancerous tissues, while minimizing the damage to surrounding healthy tissues? To tackle this challenge, the best MNP concentrations, spatial distributions and magnetic excitation parameters must be identified. It is, however, not an easy task, because magnetic hyperthermia involves multiple areas of thermofluids including nanofluid, magnetics, heat transfer, fluid-structure interaction, porous media, flow pulsation, turbulence and rheology, not to mention the biological and medical areas. Furthermore, the factors in these areas are generally coupled. As such, the determination of optimal hyperthermia conditions requires an analysis tool that takes all the mentioned factors into account. In view of this, we propose to develop a holistic simulation framework which is based on a new set of governing equations and realized using the lattice Boltzmann method, and use it to explore the coupled effects of various parameters in magnetic hyperthermia. Through this research, we will demonstrate the important role of mechanics in magnetic hyperthermia and how modifications to the influential parameters can improve the efficiency and accuracy of the heating process. The findings from this research will help improve existing magnetic hyperthermia as a promising alternative treatment of cancer. 癌症被列為全球第二大死因，有數據顯示2015年有大約八千八百萬人死於癌症，每六個死亡個案里就有一例是因為癌症。目前手術、放療和化療是癌症治療的三種主要療法。大部分的癌症個案在被確診時已經發展到晚期，尤其是肺癌和肝癌，進行手術治療通常已來不及。化療和放療在殺死癌變組織的同時也會殺死正常組織，并產生很多副作用，如貧血、掉頭髮、口腔潰瘍、惡心和嘔吐。熱療法作為一種新發展起來的技術，近年來也被用在癌症輔助甚至獨立治療上。此療法通過將癌變組織加熱到超過生理水平的溫度（通常在39°C至45°C之間）以達到殺死或殺傷癌細胞的目的。在各種加熱技術中，磁熱療技術以其生物相容性好、靶向性強等優勢逐漸成為熱療的關注熱點。該療法通過將納米級磁流體注射到癌變組織里并施加交變磁場來產生熱量從而提高組織溫度。儘管已被證明有效，磁熱療法仍然面臨著一大挑戰：如何在對癌變組織進行熱疗的同時避免或盡可能減少對其周圍健康組織的破壞？為了解決這個問題，我們需要對磁流體中納米顆粒的濃度和空間分佈以及交變磁場的激勵參數進行優化。但該優化工作並不簡單，因為磁熱療涉及多學科領域，包括生物學、醫學和熱流學，而僅熱流學里就包括了納流體、磁學、熱傳導、流固耦合、多孔介質、脈動流、湍流和流變學等多種複雜物理現象，這些現象還通常耦合在一起。因此，我們需要使用一套能夠同時考察以上所有熱流學現象的分析工具來確定最優熱療條件。在本項目中，我們致力於建立這樣一套基於格子玻爾茲曼方法的整體模擬分析工具，并用它探索耦合在磁熱療法里的各種參數的影響，確定最優熱療條件。通過本研究項目，我們將展示力學在磁熱療法里所起的重要作用，并揭示如何通過改變各重要參數來提高熱療的效率和精度。本項目的成功將會進一步改善已有的磁熱療法，使其逐漸成為傳統癌症療法之外的另一可行選擇。

15214418.label: Realisation of objectives
15214418.value: 1. To develop and validate a holistic simulation framework for magnetic hyperthermia by considering nanofluid, magnetics, heat transfer, fluid-structure interaction, porous media, flow pulsation, turbulence and rheology (100% achieved) We have successfully developed the proposed holistic simulation framework for magnetic hyperthermia. A new set of equations were adopted to simulate thermal and magnetic nanoparticle (MNP) transport in two neighboring flow regimes: a blood flow in a vessel, and a perfusion flow in porous media that includes both tumor/healthy tissues. The MNPs are treated as a separate phase instead of discrete particles, and hence are described using volume fraction. In the momentum equation, we included the drag due to porous media, the buoyancy force caused by temperature and MNP concentration gradients, and the Lorentz force induced by the external alternative magnetic field. Considering the huge difference between the time scales of temperature field and magnetic field, which may result in a significant increase of the computational cost, the time-varying Lorentz force has been replaced by its time-averaged value. If the blood vessel deforms, the flow-structure interaction force should also be taken into account. In the energy equation, the heat removal caused by the blood prefusion and the heat addition due to the MNPs were considered. If turbulence is considered in the blood flow, the quantities in the equations were large-eddy-simulation (LES) filtered with the Smagorinsky sub-grid scale model. In case the non-Newtonian effect of the blood and magnetic nanofluids was evaluated, we adopted the Carreau-Yasuda model. To evaluate the thermal dose received by both the tumor/healthy tissues, the cumulative-equivalent-minutes-at-43°C model (CEM43) was adopted. This set of equations were then solved using the multiple-relaxation-time lattice Boltzmann method (MRT-LBM), with the D2Q9 (i.e., two-dimensional nine-discrete-velocity) scheme applied on the flow field and the D2Q5 scheme applied on the temperature and concentration fields. The coupling of the fluid and the structure is realized using the immersed boundary method (IBM). To speed up the simulations, the developed models were further parallelized on Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) platforms. Compared to simulations run on a single CPU, the current GPU parallelization can achieve a speed-up ratio of up to O(10^2). This simulation framework was then well validated in a step-by-step manner through various studies presented in the listed publications. 2. To conduct a systematic parametric study using the developed framework, so as to improve our understanding, from the mechanics point of view, in the effects of key parameters in magnetic hyperthermia-based cancer treatment (100% achieved) Using the developed simulation framework, we conducted a series of studies on magnetic hyperthermia-based cancer treatment. First, by coupling this simulation framework with the particle-swarm-optimization (PSO) algorithm, we searched optimal strategies of MNP injection for hyperthermia-based cancer treatment. Two simplified tumor models were considered: a circular model representing geometrically regular tumors and an elliptic model representing geometrically irregular tumors, both sharing the same area. Both single- and multi-site injection strategies were explored. The results suggest that the multi-site injection strategies generally work well, while the single-site injection strategy fails even on the simplest circular tumor model. The more the injection sites, the better the performance. This study was then extended from two-dimensional tumor models to more complex three-dimensional tumor models. In addition to confirming the findings obtained in the two-dimensional study, it was further found that the increase of MNP injection sites reduces the required MNP volume at each site, makes the injection sites closer to the tumor centroid, and decreases the waiting time after the injection. We then studied the effects of several key parameters, including the Lewis number (i.e., the ratio of thermal diffusivity to mass diffusivity), the heat source number (describes the capability of MNP heat generation), and the Darcy ratio (i.e., the ratio of tumor permeability to healthy tissue permeability). It was found that the larger the Lewis number, the longer the required treatment time. A larger heat source number leads to a higher temperature rise, reducing the required treatment time. It was also found that the buoyancy significantly affects the treatment efficacy. Increasing the buoyancy can substantially slow down the tumor ablation and noticeably cause injury of the healthy tissue. Last, we studied the effect of a nearby blood vessel on the efficacy of magnetic hyperthermia treatment. The distance of the blood vessel from the tumor, the vessel size, the vessel orientation and the blood rheology were the major parameters. It was found that, if too close, the nearby blood flow is able to bring away the magnetic heat generated for hyperthemia treatment, leading to a much longer treatment time. However, this cooling effect can be mitigated by the buoyancy if the vessel is located right underneath the tumor. It was also found that this cooling effect almost vanishes as the distance is greater than just about one tumor diameter. With the same blood flow rate, the size of blood vessel affects the velocity gradient on the vessel wall. Therefore, smaller vessel size causes greater heat loss and longer treatment time. The non-Newtonian blood flow also leads to a slightly large velocity gradient on the vessel wall, resulting in a slightly longer treatment time. Last, it is also found that the movement of the vessel wall exerts little impact on the treatment efficacy.

15214418.value: The tumor models studied in the present project are relatively simple, mainly for the purpose of feasibility demonstration. 15215518.label: Major findings and research outcome
15215518.value: In this project, inspired by the strong underwater adhesion properties of mussels based on cation–π interaction, a new series of functional chemicals were synthesized and developed, which present strong cohesion and adhesion property on poly(ethylene terephthalate) (PET) fabric. First, a novel cation-π hydrophilic agent (CPHA) was synthesized via a two-step reaction (transesterification and polycondensation) using dimethyl terephthalate (DMT), ethylene glycol (EG), and bis(2-hydroxyethyl) dimethylammonium chloride (BDAC) as monomers while polyethylene glycol (PEG) as copolymerization blocks. The structure of CPHA was characterized and its weight-average molecular weight was ~11 kDa. The CPHA can efficiently transform the hydrophobic PET fabric into a superhydrophilic one, and its superhydrophilicity can withstand 150 home laundry cycles, which is much superior to commercial hydrophilic agent for PET. Additionally, the CPHA finished PET fabric present better softness, antistatic, and antibacterial property. Due to its strong adhesion, we applied it to one side of the PET fabric via spray coating and curing to form a Janus hydrophobic/superhydrophilic one-way sweat transportation fabric with excellent moisture/thermal management performance. The results were published in Advanced Materials as listed in Part C. In addition, a new cationic waterborne polyurethane hydrophilic finishing agent (including bis(2-hydroxyethyl) terephthalate, BDAC, PEG components, and pentaerythritol as the chain extender) was also synthesized, which is easier to make, providing polyester with more durable hydrophilic property and more conducive to mass production, a China patent is submitted for this new synthesis method. In this project, we also developed 2 kinds of anti-insect finishing agents by reversible addition-fragmentation chain transfer polymerization, which includes styrene as the aromatic moieties, the methacrylatoethyl trimethyl ammonium chloride as the positively charged moieties, permethrin and picaridin as the anti-insect component. The as-prepared anti-insect finishing agents present very high mosquito repellent efficiency(76.19% and 76.59%) and high adhesion on PET fibers. After 75 washes, there was still a rich polymer coating of anti-insect agents on the fiber surface. Moreover, inspired by the mussel's ability for underwater adhesion to rocks, we also developed charge-controllable magnetic nanocomposites (Fe3O4@PDA) for the application of selective dye adsorption and separation. To sum up, the synthesized polymers in this project achieved the planned functions and at the same time possess excellent affinity to PET fiber, which is a normally considered difficult-to-treat material, with cation-π interaction playing a vital role.

15215518.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15215518.value: The mechanisms of cation-π interaction will be further investigated via theoretical calculation and experimental exploration. With the information and results already obtained from this project, the potential development of other functional finishing agents, such as antimicrobial agents, fire retardants, and dyestuffs, will be explored for the modification of PET fabric. A National Natural Science Foundation of China project on new dyestuffs with cation-π interaction for PET fiber was successfully obtained and will start in 2023 to further extend the research started in this project.

15215518.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15215518.value: In the past, functional surface finishing treatments of widely used but chemically stable polyester (PET) fabrics are very difficult. The use of plasma treatment, harsh chemicals, and also binders are needed, which is complicated and expensive to operate and in most cases, only result in poor durability as well as pollutions. In this study, we designed and synthesized functional finishing agents for PET fabric based on the concept of cation-π interaction, inspired by the adhesive power of marine mussels. The hydrophilic surface functionalized PET fiber showed much improved hydrophilicity comparable to cotton, which provides much better water/sweat and thermal management properties compared to that of the untreated PET. The functionalized PET fiber is therefore much more comfortable to wear. The other function of mosquito repellency is also successfully achieved in this project for better wears' protection. More importantly, the agents designed and synthesized showed excellent adhesion to PET fiber with outstanding washing durability. The functional materials can be easily scale up and the application is also easily done. The methodologies acquired in this project are very significant to guide the future development of functionalizing polyester fibers, a most widely used fiber in textile industry, in a long term.

15215718.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15215718.value: High-strength steel materials are constructional steel materials with yield strengths ranging from 690 to 960 N/mm2, and they are readily produced in many countries at affordable prices recently. Many engineers believe adoption of these steel materials will lead to a major advancement in structural engineering as there will be fundamental changes to the ways super high-rise buildings and long span bridges are being constructed. Despite deflection control is critical in many high-rise buildings, the use of high-strength steel materials is able to reduce member sizes, and thus increase usable floor areas. New structural forms will then become not only technically feasible, but also financially viable. Despite high structural advantages offered by high-strength steel materials, there are challenges to promote wide adoption of these steel materials in construction. One of the key concerns is significant reduction in various mechanical properties, in particular, resistances and ductility, of welded-sections of these steel materials after exposure of heating/cooling cycles due to welding if welding is not properly controlled. As modern seismic resistant design always assumes that all structural steel members and systems possess a high degree of resistances and ductility, it is essential to provide experimental evidence to demonstrate adequacy of resistances and ductility in these welded-sections, especially with steel plates at least 8 mm thick when multi-pass welding is adopted in practice. In this project, it is proposed to examine adequacy of resistances and ductility of welded-sections and connections of high strength S690-QT thick steel plates with multi-pass welding for qualifying their applications in seismic resistant structures. It is important to establish that multi-pass welding is beneficial to both resistances and ductility of welded-sections under monotonic and cyclic deformations owing to reduced heat-input-energy per weld-run, and thus, reduced amount of recrystallization in heat-affected-zones accordingly. A number of coordinated experimental and numerical investigations into i) heat transfer during multi-pass welding, and ii) mechanical properties of welded-sections and connections of S690-QT thick steel plates will be carried out. Key findings of the project will be highly relevant to structural engineers in Hong Kong as they are often required to perform seismic resistant design on high-rise buildings in major cities in the Region. Structural adequacy in these S690-QT welded-sections and connections is extremely important in ensuring that these members and sections with practical thicknesses are able to behave satisfactorily according to their structural design. 高強度鋼材是建築用鋼材料，屈服強度在690至960 N/mm2 之間，目前在世界許多地方以合理的價格生產。目前，最常用的結構鋼材料的屈服強度範圍為235至355 N/mm2。雖然不同強度的鋼材的楊氏模量保持大致相同，但高強度鋼材料在強度與自重比增加一倍或甚至三倍方面具有顯著的結構優勢。許多工程師認為，這些高強度鋼材的廣泛採用將導致結構工程的重大進步，因為有效使用這些鋼材將使超高層建築和大跨度橋樑的建造方式發生根本性變化。儘管偏轉控制在這些建築物和橋樑中是至關重要的，但是使用高強度鋼材料能夠減小結構構件的尺寸和自重。此外，它將增加建築物中的可用樓面面積，特別是在較低樓層中，並減少橋樑中的基礎負荷。新的結構形式將不僅在技術上可行，而且在經濟上也是可行的。 值得注意的是，在19世紀鋼鐵工業的早期，普通鋼材的屈服強度通常在 220 到 250 N/mm2 之間。由於當時難以去除熔煉過程中的不希望的化學物質如硫和磷，這些鋼材的延展性和焊接是有問題的。隨著煉鋼技術的進步，20世紀50年代碳錳鋼材料的屈服強度增加到 300 至 350 N/mm2，並且由於碳含量的顯著降低，還發現可焊性大大提高。從20世紀60年代到90年代，屈服強度分別為 460, 550, 690 和 960 N/mm2的鋼材在世界許多地方都可以買到。最近，據報導，16 至 63 mm 厚的鋼板的屈服強度在 1000 至 1500 N/mm 2的範圍內，並且它們還具有良好的機械性能，例如延展性，韌性和耐腐蝕性。 在香港建築行業，自2010年以來，超過70％的建築鋼材來自中國。據世界鋼鐵協會（www.worldsteel.org）稱，中國是世界上最大的鋼鐵生產國，自2000年代以來。 2015年，中國鋼鐵年產量達到 803.8 百萬噸，佔世界總產量的49.6％。應該注意的是，在生產高強度 S690 鋼材料的三種不同工藝中，即i）淬火和回火工藝（QT），ii）熱機械控制工藝（TMCP），和iii）直接淬火工藝（ DQ），QT過程在中國被廣泛採用。根據中國鋼鐵工業協會（www.chinaisa.org.cn）的數據，過去5年中國生產的 S690 鋼材料超過75％為S690-QT，S690-QT約為500萬噸。 2016年前五大鋼廠生產。應該注意的是，許多這些高強度鋼材料被用於製造各種行業的起重機械和設備，如採礦，造船，集裝箱物流和其他港口服務。 儘管S690-QT鋼材具有很高的結構優勢，但是在建築中廣泛採用這些鋼材仍然存在挑戰。結構工程師的關鍵問題之一是，當焊接未得到適當控制時，由於焊接而暴露於加熱/冷卻循環之後，這些鋼材的焊接部分的各種機械性能，特別是阻力和延展性顯著降低。由於現代抗震設計總是假設所有結構鋼構件和系統都具有高度的阻力和延展性，因此必須提供實驗證據來證明這些焊接部分的耐受性和延展性，特別是鋼板至少 8 mm在實踐中採用多道焊接時厚。 在該項目中，建議檢查高強度S690-QT厚鋼板的焊接截面和連接的耐受性和延展性，並採用多道焊接，以確定它們在抗震結構中的應用。重要的是要確定多道次焊接有利於焊接部分在單調和循環變形下的阻力和延展性，這是由於每次焊接運行的熱輸入能量減少，因此減少了受熱影響的再結晶量。 - 相應的區域。 該項目的主要發現將與香港的結構工程師高度相關，因為他們經常被要求在本地區主要城市的高層建築上進行抗震設計。

15215718.label: Realisation of objectives
15215718.value: 1. To examine heat transfer and temperature changes in welded-sections during welding A total of six number of 16 mm thick steel plates with a dimensions of 250 x 500 mm were cut from a large S690 steel plate. Each of these six steel plates were carefully machined along one of its longitudinal edges, and robotic welding was conducted at specific heat input energy, q, namely 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0 mm. Hence, various welding procedures and parameters were practiced and tried out so that quality welding was readily achieved: a. electrode materials with specific diameters b. voltage, current and welding speed c. wire feeding speed and supply rate of inert gas (carbon dioxide and argon) It should be noted that both thermal couples and an infra-red camera were employed to measure the surface temperature distributions of these welded sections during welding, and these temperature data were used to calibrate advanced finite element models of thermomechanical analyses developed. 2. To establish deformation characteristics of welded sections under monotonic and cyclic deformations a) A total of 36 funnel-shaped coupons were cut from these S690 steel plates, and they were tested under cyclic actions with varying strain amplitudes according to specific target strains, εm , and of different loading frequencies, f as follows: Target strain, εm = ±2.5 %, ±5.0 %, ±7.5% and ±10.0 5% Loading frequency, f = 0.1, 0.5, 1.0 and 2.0 Hz All of these tests were conducted successfully. Hysteretic curves of all these coupons over the entire deformation ranges were plotted to assess their cyclic deformation characteristics, and effectiveness in absorbing strain energy under cyclic actions. These test results may be considered as reference data for deformation characteristics of welded sections. b) A total of 18 funnel-shaped coupons were cut from these welded sections of the S690 steel plates which were prepared with robotic welding as described in Item 1 above. They were also tested under cyclic actions with varying strain amplitudes according to specific target strains, εm, and of different loading frequencies, f as described above. All of these tests were conducted successfully. Hysteretic curves of all these coupons over the entire deformation ranges were plotted. For each of these coupons, both the total energy dissipation before fracture and the energy dissipation per cycle were quantified. Hence, these data allow direct comparison on the cyclic deformation characteristics of both the S690 steel plates and the S690 welded sections with different heat input energy. c) Comparison on cyclic deformation characteristics of both steel plates and welded sections have also been carried out: • engineering stress-strain curves • true stress-engineering strain curves • back-bone curves for hysteretic behaviour Moreover, microstructures of both original and deformed coupons of the steel plates and the welded sections have been established for direct comparison through SEM images. Comparison on their relative energy dissipation characteristics have also been made systematically. 3. To establish load-deflection characteristics of welded column-base connections under monotonic and cyclic lateral loads A total of 12 column base connections were designed according to EN 1993-1-1, and based on preliminary test data obtained from Item 2, the maximum applied loads for these test specimens were evaluated to ensure smooth execution of these tests. Welding joint details with various heat input energy were devised according to various technical guides of the American Welding Society, and expert opinions from experienced welders had also been sought. Key ﬁndings from the experimental investigation are summarized as follows: 1) S355 and S690 steels a) Deformation characteristics of the S355 and the S690 steels have been examined under monotonic tensile tests. They are found to be very diﬀerent when expressed in terms of engineering stress–strain (σe-εe) curves, and they exhibit diﬀerent levels of strain hardening immediately after yielding as well as in the post yielding ranges. b) Cyclic deformation characteristics of the S355 and the S690 steels have been examined under the two Loading Protocols. In general, the stress–strain curves of both the S355 and the S690 steels are found to exhibit various degrees of softening under repeated cyclic actions. The number of cycles completed prior to fracture under the two Loading Protocols with diﬀerent target strains and loading frequencies are summarized in Table 4 for direct comparison. Moreover, the energy dissipation characteristics of both the S355 and the S690 steels are presented in Table 5 according to the two Loading Protocols with various target strains and loading frequencies. c) It is important to compare cyclic deformation characteristics of the S355 and the S690 steels under speciﬁc loading protocols as well as speciﬁc target strains and loading frequencies. Based on the test results, it is found that: i. Contrary to the general understandings on the ductility of both the S355 and the S690 steels, the cyclic deformation characteristics of both steels are demonstrated to be the same under Loading Protocol V with all the four target strains and the two loading frequencies! ii. The cyclic deformation characteristics of the S690 steels are demonstrated to be inferior to that of the S355 steels under Loading Protocol C with a target strain εm at±2.5% and f = 0.1 and 1.0 Hz. This agrees with the general understandings. iii. Interestingly, the cyclic deformation characteristics of the S690 steels are demonstrated to be superior to that of the S355 steels under Loading Protocol C with target strains εm at ±5.0, ±7.5 and ±10%, and f = 0.1 and 1.0 Hz. This is contrary once again to the general understandings ! 2) S690 and their welded sections A number of important conclusions can be drawn: a) In general, Cyclic Protocol CT, in which constant strain ampli-tude cycles are applied up to fracture, is signiﬁcantly more demanding when compared with the more gradual Cyclic Protocol NL. Whilst the former is considered an overly severe representation of seismic loading, it can be used as an effective approach for assessing the inelastic cyclic response of the S690 welded sections in comparison with that of the S690 steel plates. b) Cyclic softening in the hysteretic loops of the coupons of the S690 welded sections under Cyclic Protocol CT were evident. The corresponding numbers of cycles completed before fracture, nc, for the S690 welded sections were found to be typically only half or even one third of those for the S690 steels. Hence, the structural response of the S690 steel plates was shown to deteriorate more signiﬁcantly after welding under various cyclic actions. c) Deteriorations in both the strength and the energy dissipation performance of the S690 welded sections under accumulated cyclic de-formations according to Cyclic Protocol CT were more severe than those of the S690 steel plates. These deteriorations were readily quantified in terms of the numbers of effective cycles completed be-fore fracture, the strength adjustment factors and the hysteretic energy dissipation densities. d) The coupons of the S690 welded sections under Cyclic Protocol NL were able to complete 20 cycles at a target strain εT of ±5.0%. When the target strain εT was increased to ±7.5%, the coupons of the welded sections failed prematurely. Hence, a ±5.0% strain might be considered as the strain limit of the S690 steel plates and their welded sections in seismic resistant design.

15215718.label: Major findings and research outcome
15215718.value: Journal Paper 1 Contrary to the general understandings, it is demonstrated that the high strength S690 steels do have a good ductility under both monotonic and cyclic actions. Moreover, depending on speciﬁc loading protocols and target strains, the cyclic deformation characteristics of the S690 steels are demonstrated to be superior to those of the S355 steels in terms of the number of cycles completed prior to failure and their corresponding energy dissipation characteristic under various target strains up to ±10.0%. The ﬁndings of this experimental investigation highlight the importance of establishing ductility requirements and cyclic deformation characteristics for the high strength S690 steels in accordance with speciﬁcally designed cyclic tests rather than relying solely on conventional monotonic tensile tests. Journal Paper 2 It is shown that a signiﬁcant deterioration in strength similarly occurs in both the unwelded and welded S690 sections with the increase in number of cycles, particularly under large target strains. However, in terms of ductility, the number of effective cycles to fracture of the S690 welded sections is found to be considerably lower than for the S690 steel plates, typically by a factor of 2 to 3. Moreover, the energy dissipation densities of the S690 welded sections are shown to be only 41% to 47% of those for the counterparts. Overall, in addition to highlighting the importance of conducting realistic cyclic tests for assessing ductility, the ﬁndings provide detailed insights into the structural response of the S690 welded sections in steel structures under earthquake attacks, including the inﬂuence of target strains and loading frequencies. The results also enable detailed quantiﬁcation of the cyclic response for the purpose of numerical modelling as well as for determining reliable ductility criteria.

15215718.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15215718.value: It is highly useful to carry out further developments on the research as follows: a) Different steel To carry out similar experimental investigations into other high strength steel, such as S690-TM and S960-QT b) Other loading protocols commonly encountered in practice : • To carry out tension-only cyclic tests on coupons of welded sections under a different sets of target strains, such as 0 to +2.5%, +5.0%, +7.5% and +10.0%. • To carry out compression-only cyclic tests on coupons of welded sections under a different sets of target strains, such as -2.5%, -5.0%, -7.5% and -10.0% to 0. c) Other loading protocols with reduced target strains : • To carry out cyclic tests on coupons of welded sections under a different sets of target strains, such as ±0.25%, ±0.50%, ±0.75% and ±1.0% These tests will provide practical test data for possible engineering applications in seismic resistant construction.

15215718.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15215718.value: High-strength S690 steel are constructional materials with yield strengths at 690 N/mm2, and they are readily produced in many countries at affordable prices in the recent years. Many engineers believe adoption of these steel will lead to a major advancement in structural engineering. However, a major concern on their adoption in construction is a possible reduction in various mechanical properties of these welded-sections after exposure of heating/cooling cycles due to welding if welding is not properly controlled. As modern seismic resistant design always assumes that all structural steel members and systems possess a high degree of resistances and ductility, it is essential to provide experimental evidence to demonstrate adequacy of resistances and ductility in these welded-sections. In this project, a number of coordinated experimental and numerical investigations into heat transfer during multi-pass welding, and mechanical properties of these S690 welded-sections under monotonic and cyclic actions have been examined. It has been successfully shown that these welded-sections and connections possess certain amount of ductility because of their high strengths, typically 50 to 70% of those of S355 steel in terms of energy dissipation densities. These data provide a favourable reference for further development on these S690 steel in seismic resistant structures.

15216318.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15216318.value: 空氣源熱泵室外機組沿氣流方向的均勻結霜,以提高運行效率和使用者的熱舒適

15216318.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15216318.value: 因為獨特的高能效特性，空氣源熱泵 (ASHPs) 在全球範圍內已有越來越廣泛的應用。對於采暖用空氣源熱泵, 霜层可以在它的室外机组上積累，因而週期性除霜變得必要。結霜可以对空氣源熱泵的運行效率和室內熱環境產生負面影響。然而, 以往的研究表明, 在室外机组上的結霜 沿氣流方向有着顯著的不均勻。由於在結霜时較低的效率，更短的结霜時間或更頻繁的除霜操作, 和較差的除霜效率，不均勻的結霜加剧了上述的負面影響。因此, 不均勻的結霜進一步影響室內使用者熱舒適性，和空氣源熱泵在結霜和除霜时的運行能效。 在本项目中，為了提高运行效率和使用者的热舒适，以达到空气源热泵室外机组沿气流方向的均匀结霜，将對兩種緩解不均勻的結霜的措施進行研究。第一種, 可用於改造現有和新的空气源热泵, 通过交替反轉空氣通過室外机组的方向，因而把迎風面和背風面互換。第二种, 用于新的空气源热泵。会開發一個新的室外机组， 它具有疏水性表面塗層, 最小的翅片寬度或迎風和背風兩側之間的距離，和一個足夠大的翅片間距。以前的相關研究仅考虑结霜, 但在本项目中，会系統性的考虑結霜和除霜，上述兩項措施的成效，將根據空气源熱泵在整個结霜和除霜期間運行效率和熱舒適度，通過實驗和建模方法進行評估。 成功地完成本项目有助於實現空气源热泵室外机组沿气流方向的均匀结霜, 以減輕不均勻结霜所带来的進一步負面影響。本项目的長期意義在于： (a) 通過減少达到20%空气源熱泵的能耗并提高室內使用者的熱舒適性，从而促进可持續性发展； (b) 促进空气源熱泵技術的進步。

15216418.value: 滑坡監測和預警是世界範圍內的挑戰。 首先，很難從大量的天然和人造斜坡中識別出不穩定的斜坡。 例如，政府在香港註冊的人造斜坡超過6萬個，尚有很多自然斜坡。 像中國這樣的國家的斜坡數量可能達到數億。 其次，預測滑坡的時間非常具有挑戰性。 最近的毀滅性山體滑坡，例如舟曲滑坡（2010年在中國，1,287人死亡），Oso滑坡（2014年在美國，43人死亡），危地馬拉滑坡（2015年在危地馬拉，500多人死亡），Mocoa滑坡（2017年在哥倫比亞，329） 塞拉利昂山體滑坡（2017年在塞拉利昂，大約500人死亡）已明確表明目前管理山體滑坡的技術和策略嚴重不足，因為在任何山體滑坡之前沒有給出適當的警告。 大多數斜坡在最終滑坡之前會經歷變形過程。 如果可以定期監測所有斜坡的變形，則可以及時識別不穩定的斜坡，並且可以確定斜坡的時空變形模式。 這些信息對於確定對每個斜坡採取的行動至關重要。 例如，如果斜坡穩定，則此時不需要任何行動。 然而，如果斜坡在移動，則可能需要更密切地監測（例如，使用實時監測系統）和/或穩定工程。 然而，由於涉及非常高的成本，用傳統技術監測大量斜坡的變形是非常困難的。 因此，幾乎沒有國家/地區能夠定期監測所有斜坡。 這部分地解釋了為什麼會有這麼多“非預見的”致命山體滑坡。 干涉合成孔徑雷達（InSAR），尤其是星載InSAR，是最強大的地球觀測技術之一。 InSAR測量的高空間分辨率（通常約1米到幾十米），連續的空間覆蓋和高精度的測量使該技術變得非常適合監測諸如山體滑坡等地質災害。 然而，使用星載InSAR監測滑坡，地表植被和由崎嶇地形特徵引起的雷達圖像的幾何變形是兩個主要障礙。 第一個障礙已經在一定程度上被多時相InSAR技術所克服。 第二個問題很少受到關注，儘管這是一個瓶頸問題，對InSAR在山區的應用有重大影響。 例如，由於幾何變形，香港20％以上的土地面積不能使用InSAR進行適當的觀測。 此項目將通過發展先進方法，包括集成層析成像SAR和多時相InSAR技術的創新概念，以及利用交匯SAR觀測，來克服第二個障礙。 眾所周知，香港的地形非常崎嶇，山體滑坡是一個突出問題。 定期監測斜坡的變形有助於檢測不穩定的斜坡並更好地了解其穩定性狀態。 此項目將為SAR / InSAR技術的進步做出重要貢獻。 研究結果將可能在香港和世界許多其他地區如中國大陸廣泛使用，以更好地管理滑坡災害。 因此，該項目具有很好的學術和應用價值。

15216418.label: Realisation of objectives
15216418.value: The objectives of the project were revised at the very beginning of the project, from three as per the original application into the current two. The revision was approved by the RGC. All the two current objectives have been fully addressed in the project. SAR/InSAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar/Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar) represent the most important spaceborne Earth observation technologies that are especially useful for applications such as geohazard study and earthquake research. Although the technologies have been applied widely all over the world, there are still some critical shortcomings in the technologies. For example, in hilly regions and urban areas, the so-called geometric distortions can significantly affect the quality of SAR/InSAR observations. This project has been focusing on these problems, hoping to provide some effective solutions to the problems. We have successfully integrated, as proposed in the research proposal, the tomographic SAR and multi-temporal InSAR techniques into one set of technologies to overcome the problems in the traditional InSAR techniques. We have selected some typical sites in Hong Kong to test the developed technologies and to study the ground deformation at the sites. The test results have demonstrated the effectiveness of the newly developed technologies. In the same time, the deformation patterns of the selected sites over the recent years have been better understood based on the new results obtained.

15216418.label: Major findings and research outcome
15216418.value: (1) The research has further studied the effects of troposphere and ionosphere on spaceborne InSAR measurements and provided some new solutions (e.g., J8 (journal paper No. 8 on the list, similar for the other journal papers), J11, and C1 (conference No. 1 on the list, similar for the other conference papers). (2) It has been found that the distortion problems of InSAR in mountainous areas can be overcome to certain extent by further extending the capability of multi-temporal InSAR (e.g., J1, J4, C2 and C3). Some further publications on this part of the research are under preparation. (3) The developed technologies have been applied to study the ground/structural deformation of various sites in Hong Kong and other parts of the world (e.g., J2, J3, J4, J5, J6, J7, J9, J10, J12 and J13).

15216418.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15216418.value: In studying geohazards such as landslides, monitoring ground deformation in critically important to understand the stability of the ground. However, there is an important gap in making the full use of the monitoring data in analyzing the potential of geohaards such as the timing of a landslide. We plan to apply for a new project carry out some further research in this direction to bridge the knowledge gaps.

15216518.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15216518.value: 误差界及其稳定性分析和应用

15216518.label: Project Objectives
15216518.value: We will establish upper estimates of the local error bound modulus for proper and lower semicontinuous functions in terms of subderivatives and end sets and apply them to study the corresponding modulus of positively homogeneous functions and sublinear-type functions. We will explore lower and upper estimates of the uniform local error bound modulus and the restricted uniform local error bound modulus respectively and investigate stability analysis of these local error bound properties. We will apply the established local error bounds properties to the convergence analysis of a DC optimization algorithm and the supremum function of a linear portfolio selection optimization problem with a sparsity constraint.
rows: We will establish upper estimates of the local error bound modulus for proper and lower semicontinuous functions in terms of subderivatives and end sets and apply them to study the corresponding modulus of positively homogeneous functions and sublinear-type functions.

We will explore lower and upper estimates of the uniform local error bound modulus and the restricted uniform local error bound modulus respectively and investigate stability analysis of these local error bound properties.

We will apply the established local error bounds properties to the convergence analysis of a DC optimization algorithm and the supremum function of a linear portfolio selection optimization problem with a sparsity constraint.

15216518.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15216518.value: Error bounds and related topics, such as metric subregularity, weak sharp minima, calmness and exact penalization, have been extensively studied in last three decades. Error bounds have important applications in the design of optimal algorithms and the study of their convergence analysis in solving nonlinear optimization problems, as convergence rates of some iterative algorithms rely on the error bound property and the accuracy of the approximate solution obtained by the algorithms depends on the magnitude of the local error bound modulus. As in the practical optimization applications, data in the models are often not estimated accurately, stability analysis can guarantee that the solutions or properties of the original system can be reserved under certain kinds of perturbations. However the study on the computable local error bound moduli and their stability analysis is relatively new and immature. Therefore there is a need to carry out an in-depth study for local error bound moduli and their stability analysis and applications. In this project we will establish computable lower and upper estimates of the local error bound modulus for a proper and lower semicontinuous function without regularity assumptions and obtain a computable global error bound modulus for a positively homogeneous function by virtue of variational analysis tools. We will provide formulae for the uniform local error bound modulus and the restricted uniform local error bound modulus respectively for a proper and lower semicontinuous function. We will exam sufficient conditions for uniform local error bound and the restricted uniform local error bound properties that allow us to explore stability analysis of the relevant error bound. We will apply the obtained results to the study of the convergence analysis of the sequence produced by approximate problems of a difference-of-convex optimization problem to a Bouligand-stationary point and investigate the local error bound property of the supremum function of a linear portfolio selection optimization problem with a sparsity constraint. 在过去的三十年中，人们对误差界和与其相关一些主题进行了广泛的研究，其中包括：度量次正则性，弱尖锐极小解，镇定性和精确罚函数。由于一些优化迭代算法的收敛速度依赖于误差界性质以及由算法得到的近似解的精确度取决于局部误差界模的大小，误差界在优化算法的设计和其用于求解非线性优化问题时的收敛性分析上有着重要的应用。在实际优化应用中，模型中的数据往往不能准确估计，稳定性分析能够保证原系统的解或及其性质在某些扰动下仍然能够保留。然而，可计算的局部误差界模及其稳定性分析的研究目前较少而且尚未成熟。因此，很有必要深入研究局部误差界模及其稳定性分析和应用。 在本项目中，我们将在正则性假设缺失的情况下，针对真下半连续函数建立起可计算局部误差界模的上限及下限估计，并通过应用变分分析工具获取正齐次函数的可计算全局误差界模。同时，我们将为真下半连续函数提供计算一致局部误差界模和限制一致局部误差界模的公式。除此之外，我们将检验能够用于研究一致局部误差界和限制一致局部误差界稳定性分析的充分条件。我们将把这些理论结果应用于由差凸优化问题的近似问题产生的序列到Bouligand稳定点的收敛性分析，并研究带有稀疏约束的线性投资组合选择优化问题的上确界函数的局部误差界性质。

15216518.label: Realisation of objectives
15216518.value: For objective 1, we studied strong subregularity and isolated calmness and their moduli. These notions are closely related to local error bounds. Let q>0. We introduced q-order positively homogeneous multifunctions in Banach spaces and one sup-norm-like quantity and one inf-norm-like quantity. The sup-norm-like quantity is a generalization of the well-known outer norm of a multifunction. We studied properties of two norm-like quantities. We introduced a q-order graphical derivative of a multifunction. We obtained a sum rule that the q-order graphical derivative of a multifunction plus a q-order Hadamard directional differentiable mapping is equal to the sum of q-order graphical derivatives of the multifunction and the mapping. We introduced a q-order Hadamard directional differentiability of a mpping and studied its properties. We introduced a q-order strong subregularity for a mapping and a q-order isolated calmness for a multifunction together with their moduli. We showed that a mapping is q-order strong subregular if and only if its inverse posseses q-order isolated calmness property. We obtained a upper bound of q-order strong subregular modulus by the inf-norm-like quantity of its q-order graphical derivative. We represented some characterizations of q-order isolated calmness property for a multifunction in terms of its q-order graphical derivative. We showed that q-order strong subregularity enjoys stability under perturbations by functions with small q-order Hadamard directional derivatives. For an extended real-valued function, we defined a q-order sharp minimizer. We showed that if a point is q+1 order sharp minimizer then the graphical derivative of its subdifferential is q-order positively definite and that the modulus of the former can be represented by that of the latter. As applications, we characterized Holder isolated calmness for the solution multifunction of a linear semi-infinite optimization problem and a Holder sharp minimizer of some penalty functions for a constrained optimization problem. When q = 1, the notions introduced reduce to the standard ones in the literature and our results can recover the relevant ones. For objective 2, we proposed an inexact linearized proximal algorithm with an adaptive stepsize, together with its globalized version based on the backtracking line-search, to solve a convex composite optimization problem. Under the assumptions of local weak sharp minima of order q (q ≥ 1) for the outer convex function and a quasi-regularity condition for the inclusion problem associated to the inner function, we established superlinear/quadratic convergence results for the proposed algorithms. Compared to the linearized proximal algorithms with a constant stepsize proposed in Hu et al. (SIAM J Optim 26(2):1207–1235, 2016), our algorithms own broader applications and higher convergence rates as the idea of analysis used in the present project deviates significantly from that of Hu et al. (2016). We reformulated a convex inclusion problem as a convex composite optimization problem and proposed the corresponding inexact linearized proximal algorithm and its global version. We obtained the corresponding convergence results. We applied the algorithms of the convex inclucion problem to solve the nonnegative inverse eigenvalue problem and the wireless sensor network localization problem. We observed that the proposed algorithms are more efficient and robust, and outperform the algorithms in Hu et al. (2016). For the wireless sensor network localization problem we compared with some popular algorithms, such as multidimensional scaling algorithm and semidefinite relaxation algorithm, for relevant problems and concluded that the global strategy seems a good tool for achieving precise solutions and better convergence rate, that inexact linearized proximal algorithm with adaptive stepsize and global strategy outperforms the semidefinite relaxation algorithm and that inexact linearized proximal algorithm combined with multidimensional scaling algorithm is suitable for large-scale wireless sensor network localization problems. We considered a linear constraint system with a set constraint. We investigated the Lipschitz-like property of such systems with an explicit set constraint under full perturbations (including the matrix perturbation) and derived some sufficient and necessary conditions for this property. We made use of some other approaches like outer-subdifferentials and error bounds to characterize such a property. We applied the obtained results to linear portfolio selection problems with different settings and obtained some sufficient conditions for the parametric feasible set mapping to enjoy the Lipschitz-like property with various stock selection constraints. For objective 3, we revisited the bi-criteria portfolio optimization model where the short selling is permitted, and a trade-off is sought between the expected return rate of a portfolio and the maximum of the uncertainty measured by a general deviation measure for all the investments comprising a portfolio.We solved this bi-criteria model by first converting it into a collection of weighted sum piecewise linear convex programs, and then analysing their optimality conditions. We not only provided explicit analytical formulas for all the efficient portfolios, but also explored as a whole the set of all the efficient portfolios and its structure such as dimensionality and distribution. We generalized the classical Two-fund Theorem by providing some collections of finitely many efficient portfolios to generate or estimate the set of all the efficient portfolios. We also noticed that our efficient portfolios are almost the risk parity ones in the sense that the risks are allocated equally across the investments. We illustrated the reliability of our model by carrying out Monte Carlo simulations to test the performance of some efficient portfolios versus inefficient ones. We studied a rearrangement optimization problem, which is associated with a nonlinear parametric boundary value problem. When the parameter is positive and less than the principal eigenvalue of the p-Laplacian type operator, we obtained that the nonlinear parametric boundary value problem has a unique solution. We then established the solvability of the rearrangement minimization problem. Finally, based on Stampacchia truncation method, we established the regularity property of the solution to the nonlinear boundary value problem, and then we investigated the symmetric property of the solution to the rearrangement minimization problem when the domain is a ball at the origin. We studied maximization and minimization problems related to a boundary value problem involving a p-Laplacian type operator. These optimization problems were formulated relative to the rearrangement of a fixed function. Firstly, by introducing a truncated function, we established the existence and uniqueness of the solution of the boundary value problem involving a p-Laplacian type operator, and then, we showed that both optimization problems are solvable under some suitable assumptions. Furthermore, we showed that the solution of the minimization problem is unique and has some symmetric property if the domain considered is a ball.

We revisited a bi-criteria portfolio optimization model where the short selling is permitted, and a trade-off was sought between the expected return rate of a portfolio and the maximum of the uncertainty measured by a general deviation measure for all the investments comprising a portfolio. We not only provided explicit analytical formulas for all the efficient portfolios, but also explored as a whole the set of all the efficient portfolios and its structure such as dimensionality and distribution. We generalized the classical Two-fund Theorem by providing some collections of finitely many efficient portfolios to generate the set of all the efficient portfolios. We studied optimization problems related to boundary value problems involving a p-Laplacian type operator. We established the existence, uniqueness and regularity of the solution of the boundary value problems involving a p-Laplacian type operator. See [4], [5] and [6].

We will seek applications of relative error bound property and relative weak sharp minimum property in the convergence analysis of optimal algorithms.

15217018.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15217018.value: 由于社会媒体被广泛使用，大量的源信息，特别是图像和视频，正以不断增长的速度被创造。随着即将到来的物联网（IOT）时代和新兴的车辆（V2X）通信，大量的源信息将进一步在机器与机器通信中产生。为了以双向方式发送或存储源信息，信息一般首先被压缩以消除冗余（即源编码），然后通过添加冗余（即信道编码）来保护压缩数据。由于两种编码方案是分别设计的，总体设计并不是最优的。为了达到更接近理论极限的性能，我们应该把源编码和信道编码一起研究和设计。 最近，高性能纠错码（FEC）不仅能在不同类型的信道上有效地和高效率地校正错误，而且在联合信源信道码（JSCCs）时也能产生良好的校错性能。在所有的FEC码中，低密度奇偶校验码（LDPC）受到了广泛的关注，原因是LDPC的阈值非常接近香农极限。此外，使用原型构建的LDPC码允许快速编码和高效解码，我们分析它们的性能也很容易。 我们团队在分析、设计、仿真和实现LDPC码和原型LDPC码方面丰富经验，并对利用原型进行JSCCS的研究进行了初步探讨。理论和仿真结果都表明，基于原型的JSCCs比其他现有的FEC码对有显著的改进——在解码阈值方面有0.65 dB到1.5 dB的改进和在1e-7的误码率（BER）有0.6 dB到1.1 dB的改进。此外，我们的JSCC对的解码阈值仅和Shannon极限相差1.4dB。然而，我们希望改进基于原型的JSCCS在解码阈值和BER方面性能。我们还打算研究（a）基于速率兼容的基于原型的JSCC设计，以及（b）编码器和解码器的硬件实现。因此，我们提出深入研究从原型构建的JSCC。 我们的联合信源信道编码技术将可更有效和更高效地存储、传输和保护信源信息。这些技术对设计未来需要超可靠性和超高效率的通信及存储系统具有重大价值。

15217018.label: Realisation of objectives
15217018.value: We realized the revised (two) objectives by theoretical analysis, computer simulations and hardware implementations. We also verified the theoretical analysis with simulation results, and verified the hardware implementation results with software (floating-point) simulations. We developed an efficient linear programming (LP) decoding algorithm for low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes. The LP relaxation was formulated based on a check-node decomposition approach. First, we proposed an algorithm based on the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) technique to solve this LP relaxation. By exploiting the orthogonality structure of the LP model, each ADMM update step can be implemented in parallel. Second, the proposed decoding algorithm under this LP formulation eliminates the Euclidean projection on the check polytope compared with the existing ADMM-based LP decoding algorithms. Third, the feasibility analysis of the proposed algorithm was presented. We also proposed a joint shuffled scheduling decoding algorithm for double-protograph low-density parity-check (DP-LDPC) codes-based joint source-channel coding (JSCC) schemes. We further investigated the joint protograph that forms the basis of a DP-LDPC code, and focused on the complete-source-variable-linking (CSVL) protomatrix of the joint protograph. We proposed a generalized source protograph extrinsic information transfer (GSP-EXIT) algorithm for evaluating the source decoding thresholds of the CSVL protomatrix. Based on the proposed algorithm, we analyzed CSVL protomatrices with regular or irregular source protographs. We present design criteria for connections between VNs of the source protograph and CNs of the channel protograph. We also proposed a differential evolution algorithm for optimizing the source protographs. We implemented our JSCC encoder and decoder on a Xilinx Virtex UltraScale+ FPGA VCU118 Evaluation Kit. A 6-bit quantization scheme was adopted to realize this JSCC system. The error performance of the hardware design was then compared with the software-simulated JSCC system using floating-point computations. We also extended the above techniques and applied to the study of protograph-based low-density parity-check Hadamard codes. Overall, 5 journal papers and 2 conference papers were published.
