16200918.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16200918.value: The increasing concentration of emerging pollutants (EPs), such as pharmaceutical and personal care products, industrial chemicals and pesticides in wastewater could pose a serious threat to human health and ecosystems if not treated properly. Conventional methods adopted in sewage treatment works (STWs) cannot degrade chemically stable EPs. Moreover, the chlorination process used in STWs for disinfecting bacteria can generate harmful and carcinogenic disinfection by-products (DBPs) in the presence of EPs and natural organic matter, raising further concerns about the discharge of effluents to water bodies. Many previous studies only focused on individual photocatalysis and photoelectrochemical process to treat EPs and bacteria separately, but there is a lack of studies for treating both entities. In addition, there is a research gap for applying coupled photocatalytic-electrochemical technology for simultaneous EP photodegradation and bacteria photodisinfection with hydrogen (H2) evolution. The evolved H2 gas can be used as renewable energy for electricity. Therefore, this study proposes to develop and evaluate an advanced 3-in-1 technology that couples visible-light-driven photocatalysis with the photoelectrochemical process. The proposed novel photocatalyst with these multiple functions requires a base material, semiconductor, and enhancement agent. The base material is graphitic carbon nitride (g-C3N4), which is non-metallic, abundant, inexpensive, stable, non-toxic, and versatile in surface activity modification. The base material will combine with a semiconductor to increase the overall visible light absorption range and reduce the recombination rate of electron-hole (e-/h+) pairs. Bismuth vanadate (BiVO4) is the proposed semiconductor for this study as it is non-toxic, inexpensive, highly responsive to visible light, and has energy levels well-matched with g-C3N4. Hybrid g-C3N4/BiVO4 composite photocatalysts have efficient photocatalytic structures allowing for good performance in organic pollutant photodegradation. The enhancement agent such as silver (Ag) will be added subsequently to the hybrid composite photocatalysts to enhance the photodisinfection, as it has exceptional bacterial photodisinfection properties. This hybrid composite photocatalyst will be synthesized and then tested for its photoactive performance. Afterwards, an integrated photocatalytic-electrochemical two-compartment reactor will be developed with a photoanode in one compartment for EP photodegradation and bacteria photodisinfection, with a cathode in another compartment for H2 evolution. The 3-in-1 technology will be evaluated using both synthetic and real wastewater, and the mechanisms for EP photodegradation, bacteria photodisinfection, and H2 evolution will be investigated. This advanced wastewater treatment technology, through the development of the proposed photocatalytic material, provides a highly innovative solution to major water problems of the 21st century. 新兴污染物（如制药和个人护理产品，工业化学品和杀虫剂）在污水中的浓度越来越高，如果处理不当，这类新兴污染物可对人类健康和生态系统构成严重威胁。现阶段污水处理厂采用的常规水处理方法对这类化学稳定的新兴污染物不能有效降解。此外，在污水厂的氯化消毒过程中，这类新兴污染物和天然有机物质的存在会进一步产生有害和致癌的消毒副产物，如果直接将这类处理过的污水排放到水体，将进一步引起问题。尽管许多先前的研究已经采用光催化或者光电催化技术单独地降解新兴污染物或者细菌消毒，但是现阶段仍然缺乏同时处理这两类污染物的光电化学技术。再者，在现有的研究中，将光催化和电催化耦合，同时降解新兴污染物、光消毒及产氢气仍然处于空白阶段。光电催化产生的氢气可作为可再生能源用于发电。基于以上考虑，本研究课题拟开发和测试一个耦合了可见光催化和光电催化的“三合一”技术，并将其用于二级污水处理。此研究中提出的多功能的新型催化剂需要基本材料、半导体和增强剂。氮化碳（g-C3N4）将作为基本材料，因为它是一类非金属、普遍存在、廉价、稳定、无毒及表面活性可多功能调控的光催化剂。这一基本材料将再和半导体材料结合，以此提高催化剂在可见光区域的吸收以及减少催化光反应过程中“电子-空穴对”的复合。此研究中，我们将使用钒酸铋（BiVO4）作为该半导体材料，因为它无毒、廉价、在可见光区间有良好的响应、以及具有和g-C3N4 相匹配的能带位置。复合的g-C3N4/BiVO4催化剂具有有效的光催化结构，因此其可以有效地降解有机污染物。由于银（Ag）具有优越的消毒活性，将银和该复合催化剂结合，可进一步提高催化剂的光消毒性能。在此项目中，我们将首先合成该复合材料并测定其光催化性能。之后，我们将设计一个耦合光催化和电催化且包含2个组分的一体化反应器。在该反应器中，阳极将作为有机污染物降解和细菌消毒的组分，而阴极将用于产生氢气。 此“三合一”技术的性能将在合成的污水及实际污水中进行测试。此外，我们也将探索在此过程中新兴污染物的降解、细菌消毒以及产生氢气的机理。通过开发这一催化剂材料，此先进的污水处理技术将为解决21世纪重要的水问题提供极具创新性的解决方案。

16200918.label: Realisation of objectives
16200918.value: The project was conducted smoothly, and the three research objectives were achieved on schedule. In the study, the g-C3N4/Ag/BiVO4 and MoS2/N-rGO were successfully fabricated through the hydrothermal method. The as-prepared materials were comprehensively characterized through different techniques to fully understand the morphology, electrochemical properties, and photocatalytic properties of the materials. The SEM images revealed the morphology of g-C3N4/Ag/BiVO4, which has a flower-shaped microstructure with sizes ranging from 3 to 5 μm. Moreover, the g-C3N4/Ag/BiVO4 exhibited improved electrochemical properties compared with g-C3N4 and BiVO4 due to the introduction of Ag significantly enhancing the charge transfer ability of the material. The investigation of the photocatalytic properties also revealed that the g-C3N4/Ag/BiVO4 composite possessed improved reactivity than the pristine materials because the construction of heterojunction improved the light absorption ability and reduced the charge recombination. The g-C3N4/Ag/BiVO4 and MoS2/N-rGO were coated on the conductive glass substrates as photoanode and cathode for the multifunctional photoelectrochemical application to remove emerging pollutants and disinfect bacteria. The photoelectrochemical reactions were conducted in actual sewage samples collected after secondary treatment or tertiary treatment from three wastewater treatment plants. More than 80% of emerging pollutants (using carbamazepine, ibuprofen, and benzophenone-3 as target pollutants) can be degraded within 2 hours of the treatment, and the treated sewage can meet the discharge standard of E. coli, indicating that the photoelectrochemical system achieved excellent performance in degrading emerging pollutants coupled with bacteria disinfection. The outstanding performance was mainly attributed to the g-C3N4/Ag/BiVO4 composite promoting the interfacial electron transfer and effectively suppressing the recombination of e−–h+ pairs, thus boosting the reactive species generation during the photoelectrochemical process. Moreover, the excellent electrochemical properties of the MoS2/N-rGO cathode also promoted the separation of e− for reactive species generation. On the other hand, the reactive species scavenging tests revealed that h+, ˙O2−, ˙OH, and ˙Cl were generated in the multifunctional photoelectrochemical system and engaged in the sewage treatment process. To make full use of the photogenerated electrons in the photoelectrochemical system and produce value-added product during sewage treatment, an air-tightness reactor was designed and fabricated for the multifunctional photoelectrochemical. The g-C3N4/Ag/BiVO4 photoanode and MoS2/N-rGO cathode were integrated into the reactor to treat sewage for the simultaneous emerging degradation, bacteria photodisinfection, and H2 evolution. The results demonstrated that the multifunctional photoelectrochemical system maintained a high performance for emerging degradation and bacteria disinfection in the developed reactor, coupled with the significant generation of H2 as a high-value product. Mechanistic investigation revealed that the H2 evolution was driven by the photogenerated electrons. The three objectives of this study have been achieved through the above-mentioned investigation. The experimental tests were conducted by a postdoctoral fellow, and promising results were obtained. The main findings of this study have been published in a top-tier journal Water Research. Based on the concept of the multifunctional photoelectrochemical system for sustainable sewage treatment coupled with green H2 generation, the research group further deeply dipped into this area in these two years, and more promising results were obtained. The multifunctional photoelectrochemical system was first optimized by integrating the sulfite activation with the photoelectrochemical reaction using a BL-BiVO4 photoanode. The developed sulfite addition PEC system achieved the complete removal of emerging pollutants and E. coli from sewage in 1 hour, and a significant amount of H2 was generated along with the sewage treatment. Control experiments revealed the performance of photoelectrochemical reactions in sewage treatment and H2 evolution were simultaneously promoted by adding a low concentration of Na2SO3 into the sewage. The mechanistic study found that the sulfite can be activated by the photogenerated holes to produce sulfate radicals, promoting the emerging pollutants degradation and E. coli disinfection. Meanwhile, as the sulfite ions worked as a quench of holes in the PEC system, more electrons could be separated, thus increasing the generation amount of H2. The system was also feasible to degrade various emerging pollutants and showed excellent reusability and stability, proving its great potential in sewage treatment. Another innovative technology developed an optimized MoS2@BL-BiVO2 photoanode and applied it in the photoelectrochemical system to in-situ activate the chloride ions in sewage for simultaneous pharmaceuticals and personal care products (PPCPs) degradation, E. coli disinfection, and H2 production. The MoS2@BL-BiVO4 photoanode exhibited reduced bulk and surface charge recombination compared with pristine BiVO4 photoanode, achieving a photocurrent density of 2.21 mA/cm2 at 1.0 V vs. Ag/AgCl in actual sewage, 8.1 times that of pristine BiVO4 photoanode. The enhanced photoelectrochemical properties were mainly contributed by the morphology engineering of BiVO4 and the construction of heterojunction between MoS2 and BL-BiVO4, through which the charge transfer ability was greatly improved. In terms of performance study, the MoS2@BL-BiVO4 photoanode achieved complete degradation of 2 ppm benzophenone-3 and entire inactivation of E. coli in sewage with 89.32 μmol H2 evolution at 1.0 V vs. Ag/AgCl in 30 min. Further mechanism study suggested that chloride ions in the sewage played a critical role in the PEC system: they were in-situ activated by the PEC system to become chloride-based radicals (˙Cl, ˙ClO) for sewage treatment and worked as hole scavengers to increase H2 evolution. The effects of sewage components on the PEC system were also studied. The results showed that natural organic matters negatively impacted the PEC reactions as they were adsorbed onto the material's surface to block charge separation and can scavenge the reactive species. On the other hand, the inorganic ions promoted the PEC reactions due to they can increase the conductivity of sewage for better charge transfer. Overall, the PEC system showed good efficiency when degrading various PPCPs, and excellent reusability and stability, giving it great practicality. The above-mentioned studies only considered the removal of emerging pollutants and bacteria from sewage, which could not cover the majority of contaminants in sewage. Therefore, the research group developed a low operational carbon emissions multifunctional photoelectrochemical system for saline sewage treatment, covering the removal of major contaminants in sewage (including organic pollutants, ammonia, and bacteria) coupled with H2 evolution. The reduced BiVO4 (r-BiVO4) photoanode with outstanding PEC properties, owing to the introduction of oxygen vacancies in the materials and the increased V4+ species, was developed for the application. The photoelectrochemical system using BiVO4 as the photoanode achieved excellent performance, which was capable of treating saline sewage to meet the local wastewater discharge standard for COD, ammonia, and E. coli, along with 633 μmol of H2 evolution. A 93.29% reduction in total carbon emissions and a 77.82% decrease in direct emissions were obtained by the PEC/r-BiVO4 process compared with large-scale wastewater treatment plants, attributed to the reduced generation of greenhouse gases. The PEC system exhibited high performance in conditions of different pH and varying concentrations of total suspended solids. The r-BiVO4 also has outstanding reusability and stability, ensuring its promising practical potential. Overall, the three objectives of this project were successfully achieved by our research group. Moreover, we also extended our research in multifunctional photoelectrochemical systems to different aspects. Three novel multifunctional photoelectrochemical systems, as mentioned above, were developed after the main missions of the project were done.

16200918.label: Major findings and research outcome
16200918.value: The project developed a multifunctional photoelectrochemical system for the treatment of authentic sewage in Hong Kong to simultaneously degrade emerging pollutants, produce H2, and disinfect E. coli. The g-C3N4/Ag/BiVO4 photoanode and MoS2/N-rGO cathode were integrated into a three-electrode configuration photoelectrochemical reactor for the multifunctional application. Electrochemical characterization showed the near reversible, diffusion-controlled, and high electron transfer reaction was achieved in the electrode-electrolyte system. The photocurrent density of g-C3N4/Ag/BiVO4 photoanode was 0.1-0.2 mA cm2 at 1.23 V vs. RHE, much higher than g-C3N4/BiVO4 and Ag/BiVO4. As a result, g-C3N4/Ag/BiVO4 photoanode achieved the highest benzophenone degradation efficiency of 11.15% h-1 cm2. During the same reaction, 118 μmol of H2 gas was generated, and the treated sewage was disinfected to less than 1000 CFU/mL E. coli, which can meet the acceptable discharge standard (1500 CFU/mL) in Hong Kong. The multifunctional photoelectrochemical system also had wide feasibility, which could maintain the high performance in sewage samples collected from different wastewater treatment plants. Furthermore, the multifunctional PEC system was optimized by adding a low concentration of sulfite into sewage using a BL-BiVO4 electrode as the photoanode. It was found that the addition of sulfite could simultaneously promote contaminant removal efficiency and H2 evolution because sulfite can be activated to produce sulfate radicals for sewage treatment and function as the hole scavenger to separate additional electrons for H2 evolution. As sulfite addition increased the sewage treatment cost, another study developed a MoS2@BL-BiVO4 photoanode to in-situ activate chloride ions in sewage for removal of emerging pollutants and E.coli coupled with H2 evolution. It was found that chloride ions in sewage could be activated by the photogenerated holes to produce reactive chlorine species to boost pollutant removal, while the photogenerated electrons evolved H2. Moreover, the newest study developed a low carbon emissions photoelectrochemical system for removing organic compounds, ammonia, and bacteria, along with H2 generation, using a reduced BiVO4 photoanode. The system could treat the sewage to meet the sewage discharge standard of COD, ammonia, and E. coli. Moreover, the system reduced 93% of carbon emissions compared with wastewater treatment plants due to the reduced greenhouse gases generation and significant H2 evolution. All the above-mentioned studies were successfully completed, and promising results were obtained. The findings were published in the top journals of the environmental engineering field, including Environmental Science & Technology, Water Research, Applied Catalysis B: Environmental, and Chemical Engineering Journal.

16200918.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16200918.value: The BiVO4-based photoanode showed great potential for multifunctional sewage treatment, which is of great significance to extending the research for practical application. All the above-mentioned studies were conducted on a lab scale using a batch reactor, which is unsuitable for applying in realistic sewage treatment with a large amount of influent. Therefore, the continuous flow reactor is proposed to be designed and fabricated for the scaling up of the multifunctional PEC system for real sewage treatment. Moreover, the lab-scale experiments were conducted using the solar light simulator as the light source. In future studies, real sunlight will be adopted to drive the multifunctional photoelectrochemical reactions. Apart from the reactor design, the scale-up fabrication of the materials is also a crucial challenge for the practical application of the system. Hence, the approach of fabricating photoanode with a large surface area should be developed. Based on the experience we obtained from this project, a novel photoelectrochemical/chlorine system using BiVO4-based photoanode has been proposed for the pilot-scale drinking water treatment to remove persistent organic pollutants and bacteria simultaneously. The photoelectrochemical/chlorine system will be integrated into the water treatment plant in Hong Kong for the scaling-up operation. Water Supplies Department and China Road & Bridge Corporation are likely to provide financial support to the proposed project.

16200918.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16200918.value: Organic compounds, bacteria, and ammonia are major contaminants in sewage, which adversely impact human beings and wildlife. Conventional wastewater treatment plants have drawbacks, such as being powerless to remove emerging organic pollutants, generating highly toxic by-products, high carbon emissions, and being non-sustainable. The photoelectrochemical system is a green and effective technique, which can simultaneously remove multiple contaminants from sewage and produce a significant amount of H2 as renewable energy (a high-value product). Moreover, integrating the removal of multiple contaminants and H2 evolution in a single photoelectrochemical system can achieve space-saving and cost-effectiveness. This study developed several kinds of multifunctional photoelectrochemical systems for sewage treatment coupled with H2 evolution using BiVO4-based photoanodes. The photoanodes are activated under irradiation of simulated solar light and produce sufficient electrons and holes for the multifunctional application with the assistance of external voltages. The developed systems achieved excellent performance in the removal of target contaminants and H2 generation. Moreover, the photoanodes can be easily used without producing secondary pollution because they have outstanding stability and reusability. From this study, the multifunctional photoelectrochemical systems using BiVO4-based photoanodes are promising techniques due to their high sewage treatment efficiency and significant generation of H2. WSD of HKSAR and industry already express their interest in developing a large-scale reactor for further testing.

16201118.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16201118.value: First-order phase transformation between crystalline solids underlies the key functionalities for many emerging applications such as smart actuators, microelectronic sensors and solid-state refrigeration devices. The properties of the phase-changing materials are closely related to the formation of microstructure, which is a consequence of the deformation caused by the change of crystal structures during the transformation. Quantifying the deformation and microstructures, and revealing their dynamic correlations in situ during the phase transformation play very important role in modern experimental mechanics and materials science. By far, the most common approaches for determination of the surface displacements (deformations) are Moiré interferometry, holographic interferometry, and digital image correlation. These methods can be very fast using the high-speed camera for in situ characterization. However, these methods all need the distinguishable surface patterns being tracked during the whole measurement, which makes it difficult observe the microstructures simultaneously. Non-contact surface probes, particularly the atomic force probe enable the simultaneous surface profile determination and microstructure imaging. However, these scanning-based approaches are slow for in situ topography measurement. Differential Interference Contrast (DIC) light microscopy is widely used to observe transparent biological samples such as unstained living cells. The specimen thickness gradient generates the phase difference between the interfering transmitted light rays, which gives rise to the contrast of transparent samples. In this project, we propose to utilize the principle of DIC to study the phase-changing materials by quantitatively measuring the full-field deformation gradients and synchronizing it with the evolution of microstructure in situ during the phase transformation. To obtain the full-field deformation gradients, a dual beam-shear DIC optical system will be designed and built based on the principle of DIC and the mechanics theories of crystalline solids. We will use a coherent and linearly polarized light to formulate the mathematical relations between the surface height gradient and the optical parameters. Integrating the ferroelectric liquid crystal phase retarders and Nomarski prisms with fast imaging module (at least 50fps), the proposed system will be able to resolve the deformation gradients corresponding to the evolution of microstructures at speed of 0.3mm/s with sub-micron resolution. Finally, we will demonstrate this system in a typical phase-changing material: the single crystal CuAlNi alloy. 固体晶体的一阶相变是许多新兴应用器件关键功能的基础，如智能执行器，微电子传感器和固态制冷设备。相变材料的性质与微观结构的形成密切相关，而微观结构的形成是由于晶体结构在相变过程中变化引起的材料变形的结果。量化材料形变和微观结构，并在相变过程中揭示它们的动态相关性在现代力学实验和材料科学实验中起着非常重要的作用。 到目前为止，确定表面位移（形变）的最常用方法是莫尔干涉测量法，全息干涉测量法和数字图像相关法。这些测量方法可以在高速摄像机的帮助下进行非常快速的材料原位表征。然而，这些方法都需要在整个测量期间跟踪可区分的表面图案，这使得上述方法在测量时，难以同时观察材料的微结构。非接触式表面探针，特别是原子力探针能够同时进行材料表面轮廓测定和微结构成像。然而，这个基于扫描的方法，在应用于材料原位表面形貌测量时速度太慢。 微分干涉差（DIC）光学显微镜被广泛使用在观察透明的生物样品中，例如观察未染色的活细胞。细胞样品厚度梯度所导致的相干透射光线之间的相位差，使得透明样品产生对比度。在该项目中，我们提议利用DIC原理，通过定量测量全场变形梯度，并使其与相变过程中材料原位微观结构的演化同步，来研究相变材料。为了获得全场变形梯度，我们将结合DIC原理和固体晶体力学理论，设计并建造双分离光束DIC光学系统。我们将使用相干线性偏振光来得到材料表面高度梯度和光学参数之间的数学关系。该光学系统将铁电液晶相位延迟器，Nomarski棱镜与快速成像模块（至少每秒50帧）结合在一起，并能以亚微米级的分辨率，观测以0.3mm/s的速度进行微结构演变的材料，同时该系统能测量材料表面的微结构形态以及材料变形梯度。最后，我们将用典型的相变材料（CuAlNi单晶合金）验证该系统。

16201118.label: Realisation of objectives
16201118.value: 1. We analytically formulated the out-of-plane deformation gradient component in terms of the optical path gradient, which was published on the Journal of the Mechanics and Physics of Solids in 2019 and 2020 respectively. 2. The design of the dual beam-shear and the calibration of the small shear angle beyond the diffraction limit were done and published on Optics Communications in 2019. 3. We implemented the dual beam-shear DIC optical microscope with the initialization module, shutter/phase control module and data acquisition module. We used the developed system to quantitatively characterize the surface deformation gradients of the NiTi under stress-induced transformations. 4. We also used the system to characterize the brittle Si thin film buckled on the stretchable elastomer substrate. Moreover, we quantitatively resolve the 3-dimensional twin structure from the surface deformation captured by our system in the single crystal CuAlNi. These works directly result in a series of publications on the top-tier journals in mechanics and material science fields.

16201118.label: Major findings and research outcome
16201118.value: 1. We theorized the analytical relation between the out-of-surface deformation components and the optical path difference, from which the differential interference microscope can be used to quantitatively characterize the surface deformation. 2. We advanced the existing DIC microscope to an optical system for mechanics and microstructure characterization. 3. We successfully applied the dual beam-shear differential interference microscope to characterize the deformation gradients of phase-transforming alloys, the grain morphology/orientation contrast of phase-transforming pyroelectric energy materials and the thin film buckling on elastomer substrate. The research outcome from the project is reflected by a series of top-tier journal publications and invited talks in seminars by overseas universities and research institutes.

16201118.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16201118.value: We will further develop the differential interference microscope for higher lateral and axial resolutions. To explore the theoretical limit of the axial resolution is an important direction in this field. We will design an innovative optical system to finely tune the beam shear distances despite the restriction of the Nomarski prisms.

16201118.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16201118.value: The significance of the development of a quantitative optical differential interference system is beyond an invention of a microscope. It actually opens a new direction of experimental mechanics in micro to mesoscale. Many real engineering problems are in indeed in this scale. To understand the structure – property relationships at macroscopic level, and to quantify the deformation and its evolution in time are of great interests in many aspects. The dual beam-shear DIC provides a combo characterization for this purpose. More importantly, the deformation gradient is the direct measurable quantity from the analytical calculations. We believe that this is the field to which one can dedicate long-term career. In future, more uncovered mechanical properties of various material systems can be studied.

16201218.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16201218.value: Hydrometeorological extremes constitute a major trigger for a spectrum of natural hazards, such as floods and landslides, that collectively cause significant socio-economic losses. Floods dominate other natural hazards, claiming lives, inflicting financial losses and straining the authorities providing response and relief. 2016 is the costliest year for global natural catastrophe losses in the last four years, due to a number of devastating flood-triggering storms. The extreme summer flood in the central and lower Yangtze river region last year was triggered by a series of successive moderate-to-heavy rainfall events over different areas in the basin, resulting in 232 fatalities and a conservative estimate of US$ 20 billion losses. Such extreme events pose challenges for public safety and sustainable development. The design, construction, operation and maintenance of critical infrastructures and systems of the future “Smart Cities” need to consider the frequency, intensity and predictability of these events. Flood can be triggered by a single rainfall event with high intensity, but also by a sequence of rainfall with moderate intensity over an extended period. Given the long duration and large spatial area covered, the latter might be more disastrous. Well-organized atmospheric moisture transport, convergence and release patterns may determine the probability of occurrence of such events. The proposed research focuses on the Southeast China coastal region including Hong Kong, the economic gravity centre of the Asia-Pacific region, for a pilot to improve the predictability of flood-triggering precipitation. This will be achieved by a comprehensive understanding of the associated atmospheric moisture transport mechanism, using a Bayesian hierarchical model to formally consider climate predictors describing the source-to-destination moisture transport network. The results will inform managerial and operational decision-making for flood risk mitigation and adaptation considering climate change and variability, and will contribute to the integration of hydrology, atmospheric science and climate research in an interdisciplinary manner. 極端的水文氣象現象是一系列自然災害（例如洪水和山體滑坡）的主要誘因。以洪水作為主導的自然災害，包括泥石流、山體滑坡，將給社會帶來重大的生命財產損失，也給災害救濟的組織和實施帶來重大的壓力。 由於誘發破壞性洪水的風暴的頻繁發生，2016年成為近四年來全球自然災害損失最嚴重的一年。 去年長江中下游地區的特大洪水是由長江流域內不同地區的一系列中、強降雨事件引發的，總計造成232人死亡，保守估計經濟損失達200億美元。此類極端天氣對公共安全和社會可持續發展都帶來了重大挑戰。在未來“智慧型城市”的發展中，尤其是基礎設施以及城市系統的設計、建造、運行和維護都必須考慮到此類極端天氣發生的頻率、強度以及可預測性。洪水可由一次高強度降雨觸發，也可能由一系列較長時間的中等強度的降雨觸發。相較於持續較長時間的洪水，大範圍的洪水或將帶來更為嚴重的損失。而大氣中大規模的水汽傳輸可能誘發相關的大範圍降雨。所以，對大氣中水汽的傳輸，會聚以及釋放模式的深入理解，將有助於建立極端天氣發生的概率模型。此研究提案作為一項試驗性研究，其目的在於提高對中國東南沿海地區（包括作為亞太地區經濟重心的香港），發生可能觸發洪水的極端降雨事件的可預測性。首先，我們將基於對大氣中水汽傳輸機制的全面理解，再通過貝葉斯分層模型，結合大氣及氣候預測變量，來建立從水汽發源地到目的地的水汽傳輸概率網絡模型。 我們期望本課題的研究結果可為洪水抗災減災的管理運營決策，提供氣候變化及其可變性因素的信息。此項研究也將有助於水文，大氣科學和氣候研究的跨學科合作。

16201318.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16201318.value: 最坏情况下最优数据流连接算法

16201318.label: Project Objectives
16201318.value: Establish a solid theoretical foundation for stream joins and give characterizations for the tractable and intractable cases. For queries that are tractable, design worst-case optimal stream join algorithms in traditional computational models like the RAM. Design worst-case optimal stream join algorithms for distributed streaming systems, where the goal will be to minimize the number of computation rounds and communication cost. rows: Establish a solid theoretical foundation for stream joins and give characterizations for the tractable and intractable cases. For queries that are tractable, design worst-case optimal stream join algorithms in traditional computational models like the RAM.
Design worst-case optimal stream join algorithms for distributed streaming systems, where the goal will be to minimize the number of computation rounds and communication cost.
Implement and test the developed stream join algorithms in some streaming systems such as Spark Streaming, Storm, and Flink.

16201318.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16201318.value: Join is a fundamental operator in the relational model, and has played a central role in the wide adoption of relational databases. A key idea in the relational model is to organize data into multiple relations (tables) to make data management easy and clean. However, data from different relations needs to be linked back together in order to answer complex analytical queries, which is accomplished by the join operator. Despite of extensive research and engineering efforts, join remains one of the most expensive operations in database systems. Existing algorithms are mostly heuristics based with no guarantee on their worst-case performance. This problem is particularly severe in large-scale distributed big data systems such as Hadoop, Spark, and Flink, where a lot of data shuffling is required for computing joins, especially on highly skewed data sets. Starting in 2013, a series of works in the database theory community have started to unravel the inherent complexity of the join problem. Worst-case optimal join algorithms have subsequently been developed, implemented, and tested on single-server databases as well as large-scale distributed systems. These new join algorithms, backed up by solid theoretical foundation, exhibit predictable performances regardless of the underlying data characteristics. This is especially valuable on highly skewed data, on which the existing algorithms may perform very badly or even fail completely. Motivated by the success of these worst-case optimal join algorithms, in this project, we plan to take the next natural step: coping with dynamic, streaming data. Indeed, one of the three V's of big data is "velocity", referring to the high speed at which data arrives as a stream. In the recent years, many large-scale distributed streaming systems, such as Storm, Spark Streaming, and Flink, have been developed and widely used in real deployment, but their support for joins is still quite primitive. The proposed study will first establish a solid theoretical foundation for stream joins, develop worst-case optimal algorithms, and then try to carry the theoretical findings to practice. We expect that similar to the static case, worst-case optimal stream join algorithms can make a valuable contribution to how joins are processed in real-world streaming systems, especially on highly skewed data. 连接计算是关系型数据库中最为重要的操作之一，这是因为在关系型数据库中，基于易于管理的原因，数据被分散存储在多个表中，所以需要连接操作将不同表中的信息连接以回答查询。然而，尽管经过多年的研究工作，连接操作的开销仍然十分庞大。而现有算法大多是启发式的，在运算时间和资源开销方面没有任何保证。这一问题在一些诸如 Hadoop, Spark, Flink的大型分布式系统中尤为关键，特别是当数据呈现出某些非正常化的特征时。 自2013年以来，数据库理论界的一系列工作发现了最坏情况下最优的连接算法，这些算法不但具有理论最优性，同时在实际中的表现也十分优异。这一结果在单机数据库系统以及分布式数据库系统中均得到证实。这一结论在非正常化数据中尤为具有价值，因为在这些数据上已有算法的表现可能非常糟糕。 在本研究项目中，我们将研究如何将这些最坏情况下最优的连接算法拓展到流数据上。大数据的三个最重要的特性之一就是“速度”，指的就是当数据以流的形式快速到达时，如何有效和高效的对之进行处理。近几年，若干个大型的分布式数据流系统被开发出来，比如Storm, Spark Streaming, and Flink等。这些系统目前在连接操作上的开销十分巨大。这样，在我们把流数据上的最优连接算法研究出来之后，就可以在这些系统中实现，以将理论结果付诸实践，大大提高这些数据流系统在连接运算上的执行效率。

16201318.label: Major findings and research outcome
16201318.value: In this project, we have studied how to answer queries over streaming data. A key problem is how to support joins efficiently, as join is a fundamental operator in the relational model, and has played a central role in the wide adoption of relational databases. To solve this problem, we take a worst-case optimal approach, which enjoys a solid theoretical foundation and exhibits predictable performances regardless of the underlying data characteristics. We have obtained the following major results: First, we have laid down the theoretical foundation for stream joins, and have identified the class of queries for which optimal algorithms can be designed. In particular, we have studied two key types of optimality for these queries: instance-optimality and output-optimality. Instance-optimality refers to the ability of an algorithm to achieve optimal performance for any given input, while output-optimality means that the algorithm's performance depends on the actual output size. By focusing on these two types of optimality, we have been able to identify the types of join queries that can be processed optimally, as well as the specific algorithms and techniques that can be used to achieve this optimal performance. These results have been published in (C1) and (J2). Second, we have studied the problem in a distributed setting, which refers to a scenario where the streams of data are processed across multiple computers or nodes in a network. This is a common scenario in modern data processing systems, as it allows for parallel processing and can improve the overall performance and scalability of the system. To address the challenges of distributed stream join operations, we used data summarization and sketching techniques. These techniques involve reducing the amount of data that needs to be processed and transmitted between nodes, in order to minimize the computation rounds and communication costs. The results have been been published in a journal paper in (J1) and (C3). Finally, we have built a system on top of Flink, which is an open-source stream processing framework. Flink provides a scalable and fault-tolerant platform for distributed stream processing, and it has been widely used in both industry and academia. Our system integrates worst-case optimal stream join algorithms into Flink, while incorporating data summarization and sketching techniques, as well as other optimizations to improve performance and scalability. The paper has been published in (C2).

16201318.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16201318.value: The Flink community has grown rapidly in the recent years, but the native support on joins in Flink is not satisfactory. Our demo system already exhibits significant improvement, but the integration with Flink still needs further work. In the future, we plan to engage with the open source community and further develop the system.

16201318.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16201318.value: A stream refers to a continuous flow of data that is being generated and needs to be processed in real-time. For example, a stream of social media posts, financial transactions, or sensor data from a factory. Joining streams means combining data from two or more streams based on a common attribute or key. This is a fundamental operation in many real-world applications, such as data analytics, financial trading, and online advertising. This project is specifically focused on developing algorithms that are "worst-case optimal," meaning that they will always work efficiently and reliably, even in the worst possible scenarios. This is important because real-world data can be unpredictable, and algorithms that work well in most cases may fail when faced with extreme or unexpected data. The significance and value of this research project lie in its potential to improve the efficiency and accuracy of stream processing, which has become increasingly important in today's data-driven world. Thus, worst-case optimal algorithms enable faster and more reliable processing of large-scale data streams, which could have significant impacts on industries such as finance, healthcare, and transportation.

16201718.value: Monitoring sensor data streams. 16201718.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16201718.value: Recent advances in measurement and sensing technology have generated data-rich environments in many industrial and service applications, which has led to an increasing need to handle datasets generated from multiple sources. Conventional statistical process control (SPC) methods cannot monitor and use such data effectively due to the great variety and variability of such datasets. This brings new challenges and opportunities for improving conventional SPC methods to make better use of data from different domains. To tackle the complexity of the data, we propose to combine the control charts of conventional SPC with statistical transfer learning, which is designed to connect information from various scenarios via statistical methodologies and models. Statistical transfer learning enables the transfer of previously-acquired knowledge from some data sources to tackle related tasks in new domains. The proposed study will focus on developing new SPC methods based on statistical transfer learning to allow monitoring and control using complex data from multiple sources. In the proposed research, we will investigate statistical transfer learning approaches for three growing areas of SPC: (1) monitoring high-dimensional auto-correlated sensor data streams; (2) network monitoring within transportation applications; and (3) quality improvement and monitoring in advanced manufacturing processes. The central idea of the proposed research will be to develop statistical methodologies and practical tools in a transfer learning framework which will facilitate effective monitoring and quality improvement by handling complex datasets of great variety and variability. The study will be carried out with reference to real applications involving sensor systems, transportation and 3D printing. 測量和傳感技術的最新進展產生了豐富數據. 許多工業和服務應用中的環境導致了這種環境的增加, 需要處理從多個源生成的數據集。傳統的統計過程控制（SPC）方法無法有效地監視和使用這些數據。這些數據集的多樣性和可變性, 給我們帶來了新的挑戰和機遇。改進傳統的SPC方法，以更好地利用來自不同領域的數據。為了解決數據的複雜性，我們建議結合使用的傳統的SPC控製圖與統計傳遞學習，旨在連接通過統計方法和模型從各種情景中獲取信息。統計轉移學習使得能夠從一些數據轉移先前獲得的知識, 解決新領域的相關任務。擬議的研究將側重於基於統計轉移學習開發新的SPC方法以允許監控並控制使用來自多個來源的複雜數據。在擬議的研究中，我們將研究統計轉移學習方法在SPC的三個增長領域：（1）監測高維自相關傳感器數據流; （2）運輸應用中的網絡監控; （3）先進製造工藝的質量改進和監控。擬議研究的中心思想是在轉移學習框架下開發統計方法和實用工具，通過處理各種變異性的複雜數據集來促進有效的監測和質量改進。

16201818.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16201818.value: Surveillance video cameras are ubiquitous and instrumental in monitoring behaviors and activities for directing or protecting the general public. Such cameras may also be deployed in domains other than security applications such as in smart homes and autonomous vehicles. The fundamental technologies that enable these video-related applications are video object detection and video object tracking. For example, in video surveillance applications, when the automatic system detects a possible intruder, the system should be able to track him/her across video frames. These applications should have such video tracking ability despite changes in the shape and appearance (e.g. front and back views) of the possible intruder, who may be under partial or total occlusion as the video sequence progresses. The accuracy and robustness of state-of-the-art algorithms have considerable room for improvement. In this project, we propose new approaches and cutting-edge technologies for video object detection and tracking. Specifically, we propose online video object detection and one-shot video object tracking. Both approaches are based on current state-of-the-art deep learning frameworks. In particular, the use of Neural Turing Machine (NTM) is quite unique in video object tracking. Despite technical challenges observed by other researchers, namely, numerical instability in optimization, hard-to-use memory, and difficulty of use in practice, our preliminary results demonstrate that the proposed NTM video object tracker shows excellent promise. Moreover, it can handle difficult cases where competitive online video object trackers may fail. In the proposal, we will describe the three phases of the project by providing mathematical formulation and technical details. The three phases are as follows: online video object detection using our new association LSTM, one-shot video object tracking with our NTM tracker, and validation using benchmark datasets and experiments on our deep learning methods and algorithms. We will present preliminary results (e.g. ICCV'17 results on video object detection) to show the great potential of the proposed methods. 監控攝像機無處不在，有助於監控指導或保護公眾的行為和活動。這些攝像機還可以在安全應用之外的領域使用，例如智能家居和自動駕駛車輛。支持這些視頻相關應用的基礎技術是視頻對象檢測和視頻對象跟踪。 例如，在視頻監控應用中，當自動系統檢測到可能的入侵者時，系統應該能夠跨視頻幀跟踪他。這些應用程序應該具有這樣的視頻跟踪能力，儘管入侵者的形狀和外觀（例如，前視圖和後視圖）可能發生變化，因為當視頻序列進展時，入侵者可能處於部分或完全遮擋之下。最先進算法的準確性和穩健性具有相當大的改進空間。 在這個項目中，我們提出用於視頻對象檢測和跟踪的新方法和尖端技術。具體來說，我們提出在線視頻對象檢測和一次性視頻對象跟踪。這兩種方法都基於當前最先進的深度學習框架。特別是，神經圖靈機（NTM）的使用在視頻對象跟踪中是非常獨特的。儘管其他研究人員觀察到技術挑戰，即優化中的數值不穩定性，難以使用的內存以及實際使用中的難度，我們的初步結果表明，所提出的NTM視頻對象跟踪器顯示出極好的前景。此外，它可以處理競爭性在線視頻對象跟踪器可能失敗的困難情況。在提案中，我們將通過提供數學公式和技術細節來描述項目的三個階段。這三個階段如下：使用我們的新關聯LSTM進行在線視頻對象檢測，使用我們的NTM跟踪器進行一次性視頻對象跟踪，以及使用基準數據集和我們深度學習方法和算法的實驗進行驗證。我們將展示初步結果（例如ICCV17對視頻對象檢測的結果），以顯示所提出方法的巨大潛力。

16201818.label: Major findings and research outcome
16201818.value: 1. Fundamental research on video object detection (Papers 1, 5) Psychological studies have found that human visual tracking system involves learning, memory, and planning. Our Dual Augmented Memory Network (DAWN) is unique in remembering both target and background, and using an improved attention LSTM memory to guide the focus on memorized features. DAWN is effective in unsupervised tracking in handling total occlusion, severe motion blur, abrupt changes in target appearance, multiple object instances, and similar foreground and background features. We present extensive quantitative and qualitative experimental comparison with state-of-the-art methods including top contenders in recent VOT challenges. Our DAWN-RPN, where we simply augment our memory and attention LSTM modules to the state-of-the-art SiamRPN, can report immediate performance gain. Despite success of this LSTM approach, conventional methods for object detection typically require a substantial amount of training data and preparing such high-quality training data is very labor-intensive. We propose a novel few-shot object detection network that aims at detecting objects of unseen categories with only a few annotated examples. Central to our method are our Attention-RPN, Multi-Relation Detector and Contrastive Training strategy, which exploit the similarity between the few shot support set and query set to detect novel objects while suppressing false detection in the background. To train our network, we contribute a new dataset that contains 1000 categories of various objects with high-quality annotations. 2. Fundamental research on video object tracking and image/video object segmentation (Papers 4, 7, 6, 9, 3, 8, 11) Significant progress has been made in Video Object Segmentation (VOS), the video object tracking task in its finest level. We introduce "tracking-by-detection" into VOS which can coherently integrates segmentation into tracking, by proposing a new temporal aggregation network and a novel dynamic time evolving template matching mechanism to achieve significantly improved performance. Further, we present a simple yet effective approach to modeling space-time correspondences in the context of video object segmentation. Unlike most existing approaches, we establish correspondences directly between frames without reencoding the mask features for every object, leading to a highly efficient and robust framework. With the correspondences, every node in the current query frame is inferred by aggregating features from the past in an associative fashion. We cast the aggregation process as a voting problem and find that the existing inner-product affinity leads to poor use of memory with a small (fixed) subset of memory nodes dominating the votes, regardless of the query. In light of this phenomenon, we propose using the negative squared Euclidean distance instead to compute the affinities. We validate that every memory node now has a chance to contribute, and experimentally show that such diversified voting is beneficial to both memory efficiency and inference accuracy. 3. Implementation and experimentation (all the papers above; including papers 2 and 10) Thorough experimentation and validation have been conducted, as evidenced by the acceptance of our papers exclusively in top, peer-reviewed computer vision and machine learning conferences.

16201818.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16201818.value: Based on the research findings on video object segmentation and tracking, we have further developed a disentangling network (ICCV'19) and geometrical and scene-aware network (ECCV'20), respectively for face and natural scene understanding, to make impact related and beyond to video understanding. Specifically, 1) we propose a local adversarial disentangling network (LADN) for facial makeup and de-makeup. Central to our method are multiple and overlapping local adversarial discriminators in a content-style disentangling network for achieving local detail transfer between facial images, with the use of asymmetric loss functions for dramatic makeup styles with high-frequency details; 2) we present a novel end-to-end framework named as GSNet (Geometric and Scene-aware Network), which jointly estimates 6DoF poses and reconstructs detailed 3D car shapes from single urban street view. GSNet utilizes a unique four-way feature extraction and fusion scheme and directly regresses 6DoF poses and shapes in a single forward pass. Extensive experiments show that our diverse feature extraction and fusion scheme can greatly improve model performance. Based on a divide-and-conquer 3D shape representation strategy, GSNet reconstructs 3D vehicle shape with great detail (1352 vertices and 2700 faces). This dense mesh representation further leads us to consider geometrical consistency and scene context, and inspires a new multi-objective loss function to regularize network training, which in turn improves the accuracy of 6D pose estimation and validates the merit of jointly performing both tasks. We evaluate GSNet on the largest multi-task ApolloCar3D benchmark and achieve state-of-the-art performance both quantitatively and qualitatively.

16201818.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16201818.value: Psychological studies have found that human visual tracking system involves learning, memory, and planning. We are thus interested in memory augmented network, where an external memory remembers the evolving appearance of the target foreground object. On the other hand, conventional methods for video object detection typically require a substantial amount of training data and preparing such high-quality training data is very labor-intensive. In this project, a novel few-shot object detection network is proposed that aims at detecting objects of unseen categories with only a few annotated examples. Moreover, we introduce ?tracking-by-detection? into video object segmentation which can coherently integrates segmentation into tracking, by proposing a new temporal aggregation network and a novel dynamic time-evolving template matching mechanism to achieve significantly improved performance. Notably, our method is entirely online and thus suitable for one-shot learning, and our end-to-end trainable model allows multiple object segmentation in one forward pass. Finally, unlike most existing approaches, we establish correspondences directly between video frames without reencoding the mask features for every object, leading to a highly efficient and robust framework. With the correspondences, every node in the current query frame is inferred by aggregating features from the past in an associative fashion. We cast the aggregation process as a voting problem and validate that every memory node now has a chance to contribute, and experimentally show that such diversified voting is beneficial to both memory efficiency and inference accuracy. The synergy of correspondence networks and diversified voting works exceedingly well, achieves new state-of-the-art results on both DAVIS and YouTubeVOS datasets while running significantly faster at 20+ FPS for multiple objects without bells and whistles.

16202118.value: 层次隐树分析与单类协调过滤

16202118.label: Project Objectives
16202118.value: Investigate a novel approach for dealing with the lack of negative examples in one-class collaborative filtering by using hierarchical latent tree analysis. Investigate various issues such as scalability and side information in the context of the new approach.
rows: Investigate a novel approach for dealing with the lack of negative examples in one-class collaborative filtering by using hierarchical latent tree analysis.
Investigate various issues such as scalability and side information in the context of the new approach.

16202118.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16202118.value: 现在在线消费很常见，消费对象可以是书籍、网页、歌曲、电影、新闻文等等。 用户面对的选择几乎是无限的，有必要自动过滤无数选项，找出用户感兴趣的选项， 协同过滤（collaborative filtering, CF）应运而生。协同过滤假设在过去的有共同兴趣的人将来也往往会有类似的偏好，从而确定一个用户可能感兴趣的选项。 过去，协同过滤的研究工作大多集中在显式反馈 (explicit feedback) 数据上, 这种数据包含用户对选项的评分，评分高的选项是正面例子，评分低的为负面例子，没有评分的选项为缺失数据。然而，在实际应用中更多见的是隐式反馈 (implicit feedback) 数据, 即只知道用户消费了哪些选项，而不知道用户喜欢哪些选项，不喜欢哪些选项。换句话说，只有正面例子，没有负面的例子，因此这类问题被称为单类协同过滤（one-class collaborative filtering, OCCF）问题。 在以前的工作中，解决OCCF缺乏负面例子这个问题的方法有：（1）假设用户对她未消费的选项不感兴趣; （2）在低信度下假设用户对她未消费的选项不感兴趣; （3）随机抽取一些用户未被消费的选项，假设她对它们不感兴趣; （4）假设用户喜欢消费过的项目超过未消费的选项。其中第一个假设称为单用户UAN (unconsumed-as-negative, 未消费等于无兴趣) 假设。 上面的所有假设都经不起推敲。用户未消费一个选项不代表不喜欢，更多是因为不知道和其它原因。本项目使用分层隐树分析（HLTA）来处理OCCF中缺乏负面例子的问题。HLTA 通过分析过往消费数据找出各种消费口味以及具有不同口味的人群。我们假设：如果具有某一口味的所有用户都未曾消费过某选项，那么该选项就是该口味的负面例子。这个假设称为用户群UAN 假设，它显然比单用户UAN 假设更合理。我们将基于这个思想，开发新的OCCF算法，并通过实验确定它相对以前其它方法的优劣。

16202118.label: Realisation of objectives
16202118.value: This project is concerned with one-class collaborative filtering (CF), i.e., collaborative filtering with implicit feedback. The idea is to identify various tastes from past user behaviors, where a taste is the tendency to consume a certain collection of items. We also identify, for each taste, a group of users who have demonstrated the taste in the past. We handle the lack of negative examples by assuming that an item is not of interest to a taste group if none of the group members have consumed it before. The tastes are identified by analyzing co-occurrence of items in the consumption histories of users. In Khawar and Zhang (RecSys 2018 , SIGIR 2019), we first showed that efficient co-occurrence estimation and representation can benefit some previous CF algorithms. In Khawar and Zhang (ECIR 2019), we used hierarchical latent tree model (HLTM) (see Fig 1) to model item co-occurrence and achieved better recommendation results than previous methods such as BPRMF, WRMF etc (see Table 3). The scalability of the method described in the ECIR paper was improved in Khawar and Zhang (ICDE 2019), where we cluster items in a latent space defined by top eigenvalues of the item-item matrix, and learn a latent class model, a special case of HLTM, for each cluster of items to identify taste user groups. The method of item clustering was further used to learn sparse structures for auto-encoders-based recommendations in Khawar et al. (WWW 2020). Both of the two objectives stated in the proposal are fully achieved.

16202118.label: Major findings and research outcome
16202118.value: Khawar and Zhang (RecSys 2018): We show that matrix factorization can actually be seen as simultaneously calculating the eigenvectors of the user-user and item-item sample co-occurrence matrices. We then use insights from random matrix theory (RMT) to show that picking the top eigenvectors corresponds to removing sampling noise from the matrices, and it increases the diversity of recommendations. Khawar and Zhang (SIGIR 2019): Memory-based collaborative filtering methods need to estimate the empirical similarity between users/items. We show that previous methods lead to overestimation of the largest eigenvalues of the similarity matrix. We quantify this overestimation and present a simple re-scaling and noise cleaning scheme. This results in better performance of the memory-based methods compared to their vanilla counterparts. Khawar and Zhang (ECIR 2019): We perform multidimensional clustering on implicit feedback data using hierarchical latent tree analysis (HLTA) to identify user “taste” groups and make recommendations for a user based on (1) her memberships in the groups and (2) the past behavior of the groups. Experiments on two real-world datasets from different domains show that our method has superior performance compared to several common baselines. Khawar and Zhang (ICDE 2019): In this paper, we improve the scalability of the method proposed in the ECIR 2019 paper. The idea is to cluster items in a latent space defined by top eigenvalues of the item-item matrix, and to build a latent class model, a special case of HLTM, for each cluster of items to identify taste user groups. In comparison with previous algorithms, the new algorithm leads to more meaningful latent factors and hence its recommendations are easier to explain. It is also scalable and in empirical evaluations, it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, particularly in the cold-start setting. Khawar, Poon and Zhang (WWW 2020): Autoencoder recommenders have recently shown state-of-the-art performance in the recommendation task due to their ability to model non-linear item relationships effectively. However, existing autoencoder recommenders use fully-connected neural network layers and do not employ structure learning. In this paper, we introduce structure learning for autoencoder recommenders by taking advantage of the inherent item groups present in the collaborative filtering domain. The resultant sparse network considerably outperforms the state-of-the-art methods like MULT-VAE/ MULT-DAE.

16202118.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16202118.value: It would be interesting to incorporate the concept of taste groups into more recent deep learning-based recommendation methods. Deep learning models are black boxes to users and the reasons for predictions are opaque. If taste groups can be considered in architecture design, as in Khawar et al. (WWW 2020), the interpretability of the resulting models would be improved.

16202118.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16202118.value: Recommender systems serve as bridges between users and items. Collaborative filtering (CF) is a technique commonly used in recommender systems. It predicts a user?s preference for an item based on past user-item interactions. These user-item interactions, called feedback, are of two types: explicit and implicit. In explicit feedback, a user is asked to explicitly indicate their preference for the items they have consumed. However, this requires additional effort and cooperation from the users. An alternative is to use implicit feedback in which we record the user consumption behavior when they interact with items. Implicit feedback is easy to collect and is domain independent. However, it leads to the sparseness of the signal. Unlike explicit feedback, it does not possess any negative signal to show users dislike. With such data, a valuable piece of information that can be used for making recommendations is the co-occurrence of items or users. In this project, we have investigated the use of co-occurrence in implicit feedback recommendation. We have developed algorithms that outperform previous methods, and are especially strong in the cold-start scenario. They also lead to models that are more interpretable.

16202218.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16202218.value: Knowledge bases (KBs) play significant roles in semantic search and QA systems. Therefore many studies have focused on the construction and enhancement of KBs by attempting to complete the set of knowledge facts, add new knowledge, or remove inconsistency. However, the existing approaches for KB construction (e.g., path-based approaches) suffer from high computation cost, ignore important data structures, and/or cannot easily be interpolated (e.g., embedding-based approaches). Most importantly, only a few researchers have attempted to populate KBs with knowledge facts extracted from short text messages such as data from social media, add subjective knowledge to existing KBs and track the freshness of the content. In this study we propose to investigate a novel framework to complete and enhance KBs automatically. It will involve a novel and efficient approach to populating KBs with new facts as knowledge evolves. We will also investigate effective mechanisms for adding subjective knowledge to KBs. And we will attempt to design effective methods for checking the freshness of the knowledge in a KB and conducting updates if necessary. The results of this work will provide a stronger theoretical foundation for completing, enhancing and updating KBs, and also practical guidance for applying such a framework in industry. 知识库（KB）在语义搜索和问答系统中发挥着重要作用。许多研究都集中在通过尝试充实知识事实，添加新知识或消除不一致来构建和增强知识库。然而，用于知识库构造的现有方法（例如，基于路径的方法）遭受高计算成本，忽略重要数据结构，和/或不能容易地内插（例如，基于嵌入的方法）。只有少数研究人员尝试使用从短文本消息中提取的知识事实来填充知识库，例如来自社交媒体的数据，向现有知识库添加主观知识并追踪内容的新鲜度。在本研究中，我们建议研究一种新的框架来自动完成和增强知识库。随着知识的发展，它将应用一种新颖有效的方法，用新的事实来填充知识库。我们还将研究向知识库添加主观知识的有效机制。我们将尝试设计有效的方法来检查知识库中知识的新鲜度，并在必要时进行更新。这项工作的结果将为完成、增强和更新KB提供更强大的理论基础，并为在工业中应用此类框架提供实用指导。

16202218.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16202218.value: In this project, we have proposed effective techniques for comprehensive knowledge bases (KBs) enhancement and updating. The proposed techniques addressed three critical issues. First, we have studied how to identify emerging factual knowledge in which typed entities are initially extracted and relationships are inferred by utilizing the information of these entities. Second, we propose crowdsourcing enhanced solution to collect subjective knowledge while considering optimizations for reducing the noise and latency during the collection. Third, we devise different strategies (joint linking and knowledge embedding) to predict the freshness of factual knowledge and hence keep the KBs updated. Finally, an enhanced KB system is built to integrate these techniques and serve the downstream task.

16202718.label: Realisation of objectives
16202718.value: All the four research objectives were achieved in this project. For the objective 1, an accurate and flexible measurement method of paraxial focal length with a simple apparatus has been successfully developed, which can realize the state-of-the-art measurement accuracy. The proposed method utilizes the established measurement principle based on the differentiation of the Gaussian optical formula and geometrical relationship of the thin-lens model to obtain the focal length of a lens. The measurement accuracy is guaranteed by employing sub-pixel image processing methods, image sharpness evaluation function and system calibration technology. In addition, aberration is considered to obtain a paraxial focal length of a lens. For the objective 2, the calibration methodology for the stereo vision system based on the thin-lens model has been successfully proposed. It includes two aspects: the calibration method for each single thin-lens camera and the stereo calibration scheme for external relationship between two thin-lens cameras. Two calibration methods were developed for two types of thin-lens cameras, which are respectively based on movable imaging sensor and electrically tunable lens. A unified thin-lens camera model of these thin-lens camera systems for machine vision applications is established based on detailed analyses of their optical and mechanical properties. The proposed thin-lens calibration methods include initial estimation of camera parameters and bundle adjustment strategy. Real-time temperature compensation is also conducted in the thin-lens camera system based on electrically tunable lens. The proposed stereo calibration scheme describes how to calibrate the whole stereo vision system effectively and accurately before measurement. Its optimization strategy and Jacobian matrix are also provided. For the objective 3, a stereo vision system with structured-light based on the thin-lens model has been developed. It can accurately measure small objects with extended depth of field. The system model, stereo calibration strategy, bundle adjustment strategy, correspondence matches and measurement principle are presented. This unleashes the potential of fully automating the inspection process in the advanced manufacturing and 3C industries. For the objective 4, measurement experiments were conducted with the developed stereo vision system based on the thin-lens model. Its measurement results were compared with the results of two commercial products: optical profiler based on interferometry and 3D scanner based on the pin-hole model. Complete measurement experiments have verified the effectiveness and accuracy of proposed calibration strategy and stereo vision system based on the thin-lens model.

16202718.label: Major findings and research outcome
16202718.value: The thin-lens model improves the measurement accuracy and extends the depth of field at high magnification of vision systems based on the pin-hole model. The thin-lens model solves two limitations of the pin-hole model, which are low calibration accuracy and small depth of field at high magnification. The thin-lens model can be regarded as a set of numerous pin-hole models with different camera settings (different focal lengths or principal distances). Since a single pin-hole model at high magnification cannot provide enough information to precisely determine camera parameters, the pin-hole models at different magnifications are combined, which then forms the thin-lens model. Once the relationship among camera parameters at different camera settings can be established, calibration information at low magnification can be utilized for the calibration at high magnification. Therefore, extra information at low magnification makes the calibration at high magnification stable and with low calibration errors. Meanwhile, the focal length or principal distance of a vision system is varied in the thin-lens model to ensure captured images in focus, which extends the depth of field (DOF) of the vision system. To preliminarily demonstrate the superiority of fully utilizing the resolution of the imaging sensor, a differential measurement method based on the thin-lens model is proposed to accurately measure the paraxial focal length of a lens with a simple apparatus. Details can refer to Journal paper No. 1. To facilitate the development of the thin-lens model in machine vision applications, a unified thin-lens camera model for two types of thin-lens camera systems is established. The corresponding calibration methods, including initial estimation of camera parameters and bundle adjustment (BA) strategy, are respectively developed. A real-time temperature compensation method is also developed for the thin-lens camera system with electrically tunable lens. With the proposed calibration methods for the thin-lens camera systems, the calibration workload is significantly reduced and accurate calibration at high magnification is achieved. Details can refer to Journal paperNo.2 and No. 3. To fulfill the high-accuracy requirement from the industries, a stereo vision system with structured-light based on the thin-lens model (BVSSTM) is developed. The system model, stereo calibration strategy, bundle adjustment strategy, correspondence matches and measurement principle are presented in the research. With BVSSTM, accurate measurement with extended DOF for small objects can be achieved. Details can refer to Journal paper No. 2 and No. 3. Overall, the thin-lens model unleashes the potential of fully automating the inspection process in the advanced manufacturing and 3C industries. All these significances are benefited from the theories of the thin-lens model. Once the thin-lens model is utilized, it can spark further impact in other vision-based applications.

16202718.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16202718.value: The proposed course of action has two aspects. First, we studied two thin-lens camera systems with movable imaging sensor and electrically tunable lens. Both do not change their optical centers as analyzed. It means that the rotation and translation matrices in the camera model keep constant. However, the optical centers in zoom lenses or movable lenses are varied, which adds more freedom to the thin-lens camera systems. The possibility of applying the thin-lens model to other thin-lens camera systems such as zoom lenses maybe examined. Second, the relative pose of two thin-lens cameras in developed stereo vision system is fixed in current designs. It constrains the measurement range of stereo vision system. To further improve its measurement range, the thin-lens cameras can be designed with rotational function. However, the calibration of rotation angle should be further studied. This calibration process can possibly be realized with a calibration board. Since the thin-lens cameras have been calibrated, the pose of the calibration board relative to each thin-lens camera can be solved by computing its homograph. Therefore, the relationship between pose's change and rotation of thin-lens cameras can be established. With these improvements accomplished, a 3D measurement system based on the thin-lens model can be more flexible.

16202718.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16202718.value: High resolution images can be provided by image acquisition devices at higher magnification. Objects can be measured with higher accuracy due to images with higher resolution. However, current visual measurement systems based on the pin-hole model have two limitations at high magnification, which are small depth of field and low calibration accuracy. It limits measurement accuracy at high magnification. This research proposes to use the thin-lens model instead of the pin-hole model. The thin-lens model extends the depth of field with autofocusing capability and realize accurate calibration by combining the information at both low and high magnifications. In this research, a visual measurement system based on the thin-lens model is developed. It includes the system model, calibration strategy and measurement principle. This measurement system can measure small object more accurately and more flexibly than conventional systems. With the proposed theories of the thin-lens model, the potential of further improving the accuracy and flexibility of visual measurement systems is unleashed. Being a general measurement principle, the proposed theories of the thin-lens model can be easily integrated into visual applications other than the developed stereo vision system, and thereby bringing along significant impact to the field of machine vision.

16202918.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16202918.value: 协相关系数矩阵 (简称``协相关矩阵”) 在统计信号处理中有重要的作用。它们在很多基本操作中是核心部件，举例来说包括：自适应滤波，假性检验，信号检测，聚类和主成分分析。在实际中，这些矩阵必须从样本数据中估计得到。在样本量足够大并且数据的维度（也就是变量的数量）不高的条件下，经典的估计方法，比如广泛使用的样本协相关矩阵，适合解决这个问题。但是在很多现代信号处理应用中，我们通常会需要处理复杂并且高维的数据集。这些应用往往不满足大样本量和低维度的条件。 在这样的情况下，我们熟知的经典估计方法，包括样本协相关矩阵，会有很差的效果。 这是高维下的统计噪声造成的。这种估计的不准确性会减弱基于协相关矩阵的信号处理算法的效能。 为了解决这个重要的问题，提议的这个项目将旨在推演出第一套严密的高维协相关矩阵估计的统计理论，并且利用这套理论提出针对现代高维应用的新型信号处理算法。这个项目将会建立在主要研究员，协作研究员以及其他相关人员最近的研究成果上。这些研究成果是运用高维随机矩阵理论来设计新型具有鲁棒性的高维协方差矩阵估计方法。设计这些方法的关键在于利用趋于极限情况下的高维协方差矩阵的频谱特性（也就是特征值和特征向量的特性）。但是，在很多信号处理的应用中，使用的是协相关矩阵，而不是协方差矩阵。这主要是因为为人熟知的协相关矩阵缩放不变性。 对于协相关系数矩阵，尽管它们的重要性巨大，但是有关它们在高维情境下的统计特性知之甚少。基于我们在随机矩阵理论上的专业知识，我们将致力于填补这个重大的空缺。我们将发展出一套基本的分析机制来描述高维样本协相关矩阵的频谱特征。这个在技术上非常具有挑战性。这是因为这些矩阵构建在标准化的数据样本上。标准化后的数据样本在统计上具有不独立性，运用现有的随机矩阵方法很难处理这个问题。我们通过解决这个问题，将会搭建一个基础平台。利用这个平台可以设计出新型基于协相关矩阵的信号处理算法。这一点将具体体现在设计新型，具有鲁棒性的协相关矩阵估计方法。这些方法的优化将适用于高维数据集。同时也体现在提出一类新型的已优化并且数学理论严谨的无监督式频谱聚类算法。我们将会用模拟产生和现实得到的数据集，并且在选定的高维信号处理的具体应用中，来评估和展现我们提出的方法的性能。

16202918.label: Realisation of objectives
16202918.value: All key objectives have been successfully met. The project has produced numerous key contributions, leading to 4 publications in top journals. It has partially supported one post-doc and supported one PhD student who successfully defended his PhD and found an excellent job. OBJECTIVE 1 aimed at developing a fundamental framework for characterizing the statistical properties of high-dimensional correlation matrices. This key objective has been thoroughly addressed. Technical contributions, presented in [Journal Paper 1], led to the development of a novel framework to characterize the asymptotic statistical properties of the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of spiked correlation-coefficient matrices, under the “random matrix theory (RMT) regime” in which the number of variables and the number samples are large and comparable. This presents, for the first time, precise analytical results in the form of central limit theorems for the spectral properties of high dimensional correlation matrices. The work was done jointly with Co-Investigators Morales-Jimenez and Johnstone. Joint work with Co-Investigator Morales-Jimenez was also developed in [Journal Paper 2], where random matrix methods were presented to describe the asymptotic spectral properties of more advanced random matrix models, relevant for canonical correlation analysis, of the so-called “double Wishart” type. Here, new exact and asymptotic theory were presented for the extreme (largest and smallest) eigenvalue distributions. These results provide a fundamental advance in random matrix theory, establishing, among other results, connections between double Wishart ensembles and Legendre polynomials, familiar in classical orthogonal polynomial theory. Further theoretical developments were presented in [Journal Paper 4], which produced theoretical analysis for describing noise in the spectral properties of robust high-dimensional sample covariance matrices. This work was also performed jointly with Co-Investigator Morales-Jimenez. OBJECTIVE 2, which sought to develop robust high-dimensional correlation matrix estimation algorithms, was thoroughly met. A key contribution was presented in [Journal Paper 4], which applied theoretical asymptotic random matrix results to deliver improved robust correlation matrix estimators. More specifically, we proposed new and improved estimators for high-dimensional settings by developing optimized versions of robust Maronna-type estimators with regularization. By deriving and employing the limiting spectral properties of regularized Maronna estimators under “clean” data settings and data settings with outliers, asymptotically optimal data-driven regularization approaches were proposed. This led to new data-driven correlation matrix estimation solutions that minimized the probability of classification error when employed in the context of Linear Discriminant Analysis. The solutions were found to be highly robust to the presence of outliers in the data. We also synthesized RMT-based robust spectral analysis results into a flexible, easy-to-use software package. This package was published in Bioinformatics in [Journal Paper 3]. In accordance with OBJECTIVE 3, the methods developed in this project were benchmarked against existing/conventional techniques. Hence, this objective was comprehensively met. Important connections were made in [Journal Paper 1] between the derived spectral properties of spiked correlation matrices and those of spiked covariance matrices that had been studied previously. Remarkably, the results that we derived admitted simple decompositions that clearly showed the differences in the stochastic fluctuations of the eigenvalues and eigenvectors in the correlation case. We showed that the fluctuations are typically less in the correlation case, due to variance normalization. This contributes new fundamental understanding of correlation matrix estimators under high-dimensional settings and complements existing work on covariance estimation. In [Journal Paper 2], our results were also contrasted against prior studies of double Wishart random matrices. One of the key contributions of our proposed method, compared with related literature, is that it allowed for a high-dimensional characterization of the extreme eigenvalue distributions of double Wishart matrices, which turned out to be remarkably simple and interpretable. In [Journal Paper 3], a distinguishing feature of the developed software package compared with previous related contributions was that it was flexible and broadly applicable to diverse data sets. This was demonstrated in the paper by showing examples with multiple real data sets for different proteins of HIV and hepatitis C virus. In [Journal Paper 4], we presented using both theory and simulations illustrating that our proposed robust correlation matrix estimators outperformed the most relevant conventional estimation strategy (the regularized sample covariance matrix estimator), when the training samples are corrupted by outliers, while achieving equivalent performance under outlier-free settings. OBJECTIVE 4 was also comprehensively achieved. Random matrix methods and theory were applied in [Journal Paper 4] to investigate a class of high-dimensional classification methods often used in signal processing—robust linear discriminant analysis (LDA). This work, performed with Co-Investigator Morales-Jimenez and reported in the IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing, provided a first rigorous theoretical basis for analyzing robust LDA performance under high dimensions, using random matrix theory. The analysis informed the optimal choice of regularization and quantified the effect of different robust kernel functions (namely, of the Huber and Tyler type). The results were demonstrated on the MNIST image data set, which is a commonly used data set for benchmarking in image classification. The robust estimation methods implemented in the software package reported in [Journal Paper 4] were also demonstrated on multiple data sets, demonstrating the wide applicability of the proposed platform in practice.
