17103618.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17103618.value: 具有抗高血壓特性的功能性食品越來越受歡迎，因為用於治療或減輕高血壓症狀的藥物 也會引起副作用。γ-氨基丁酸(GABA),一種非蛋白氨基酸,是哺乳動物中樞神經系統的主要抑制性神經遞質。天然動植物產品中的 GABA 含量通常過低，無法提供任何健康益處，許多國 家禁止使用化學合成的 GABA 作為食品添加劑。因此，乳酸菌自然產生的氨基丁酸對生產富含氨基丁酸的食品具有重要意義。 我們的初步工作表明，高 GABA 生產的短鏈乳桿菌（Lactobacillus brevis）NPS-QW-145 由於缺乏蛋白水解活性而不能發酵牛奶。該菌在谷氨酸鈉(MSG)存在的情況下，與特定的乳 製品發酵菌株，嗜熱鏈球菌（Streptococcus thermophilus）共同培養，顯著提高了其產生 GABA 的能力，但是只有極少量的谷氨酸鈉被代謝，這些結果表明 GABA 的產生不一定是與之 前報導的一樣是由谷氨酸代謝造成的。谷氨酸鈉作為一種較強的調味劑，其殘留量可能會影 響最終產品的風味。關於什麼原因導致嗜熱嗜酸桿菌在含有谷氨酸鈉的情況下提高了短鏈乳桿菌的 GABA 產量還需要進一步的研究。另外，在富含 GABA 的發酵牛奶中降低谷氨酸鈉的含 量(達到不會引起口味問題的程度)也是一大挑戰。GABA 是否能穿過血腦屏障到達腦組織， 以及 GABA 含量豐富的牛奶是否能在體內顯示抗高血壓活性，這些都是需要研究的基本問題。 因此，這項研究的主要目的是研究富含 GABA 的牛奶是否會增加腦組織中 GABA 的濃度，以及 是否具有抗高血壓活性。我們的研究目的還包括在分子水準上通過元轉錄分析 GABA 產生者， 短鏈乳桿菌和嗜熱鏈球菌，在谷氨酸鈉的存在下共同生長時的相互作用行為和微生物生理 學。以上這些資訊對於生產富含 GABA 的牛奶有著至關重要的作用。 利用元轉錄分析瞭解 GABA 產生菌，短鏈乳桿菌和嗜熱鏈球菌，在谷氨酸鈉的存在下共 同生長時的相互行為，將對生產富含 GABA 的乳製品有很大的促進作用，尤其是在谷氨酸鈉 含量低的情況下。同樣，確定富含 GABA 的乳製品或高含 GABA 的短鏈乳桿菌是否能增加動物 腦組織中 GABA 的濃度的研究將引起廣泛和極大的興趣，因為這將增強數百萬潛在消費者對 這類產品的信心。

17103618.label: Major findings and research outcome
17103618.value: Levilactobacillus brevis (L. brevis) harboring intact gad operon was regarded as a promising cell factory for GABA production, but the organism was not able to survive in milk because of absence of cell envelope proteinase. Co-culturing non-proteolytic Lb. brevis with Streptococcus thermophilus was proved to improve the viability of Lb. brevis and GABA production in milk. However, there were several research questions to be answered: 1) the interaction mechanism between Lb. brevis and S. thermophilus to produce GABA during milk fermentation; 2) the application of co-culture system in GABA-rich soymilk production; 3) the method to improve GABA content and reduce residual MSG in fermented milk; 4) the mechanism behind cysteine for improving GABA production. Comparative peptidomic and metatranscriptomic analyses were performed to unravel the casein and lactose utilization patterns during milk fermentation with the co-culture (Lb. brevis 145 and S. thermophilus 1275). We found particular peptides hydrolyzed by S. thermophilus were transported and biodegraded with peptidase in Lb. brevis to meet the growth needs of the latter. In addition, amino acid synthesis and metabolism in Lb. brevis were also activated to further support its growth. Glucose, as a product of lactose hydrolysis by S. thermophilus, was outcompeted by Lb. brevis as a main carbon source to produce ATP. In the stationary phase, pH of fermented milk dropped to 4.5 due to accumulation of lactic acid produced by S. thermophilus, genes expression involved in pyridoxal phosphate (coenzyme of glutamic acid decarboxylase) metabolism and glutamic acid decarboxylase (Gad) in Lb. brevis were induced for GABA production under acidic environment. Soymilk rich in peptides was found more suitable than milk casein for GABA production by the co-culture. Importantly, there was a weak correlation between GABA production and sugar utilization. Instead, S. thermophilus produced lactic acid from carbohydrate catabolism to create acidic environment, which influenced GadA activity in Lb. brevis to regulate GABA production during soymilk fermentation. Supplementation with cysteine was found to significantly improve GABA production with a minimum level of residual MSG by the co-culture during milk fermentation. Meanwhile, viable cell counts of Lb. brevis and lactic acid production were increased, and casein hydrolysis pattern was not influenced. Moreover, -SH containing chemicals including cystine, reduced glutathione and oxidized glutathione showed similar effects as cysteine in improving GABA production. Subsequently, the specific mechanism behind cysteine on improving GABA production in Lb. brevis was investigated. Lb. brevis was capable of producing H2O2, cysteine protected Lb. brevis against H2O2-induced oxidative damage to increase cell viability for the enhancement of GABA production. Besides, cysteine promoted glucose consumption to produce acetyl-CoA for synthesizing long-chain fatty acids to significantly up-regulate GABA biosynthesis. Overall, this study systematically explained enhancement of GABA production in milk fermented by Lb. brevis together with S. thermophilus.

17103618.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17103618.value: Based on the widely reported contribution of LAB and GABA to human health, the elucidation of interactions between the two groups of bacterial communities in the production of GABA-rich milk is important for promoting the development of functional dairy food and may provide new insight into the development of industrial GABA production. Dietary approaches to regulate hypertension attracted more attention considering its much less undesirable side effects. GABA-rich fermented milk is recommended as a non-pharmacological treatment for hypertension. To confirm the blood pressure (bp)-lowering effect of the components in fermented milk, the effects of pure GABA, GABA-rich fermented milk, and bacterial mixture of Lb. brevis 145 and S. thermophilus 1275 on preventing elevation of blood pressure in humans could be investigated in future study.

17103618.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17103618.value: Functional foods having anti-hypertensive property is becoming popular as the drugs used to treat or alleviate these conditions also cause side effects. γ-Aminobutyric acid (GABA) is the major inhibitory neurotransmitter in the mammalian central nervous system. Although GABA is widely found in natural animal- and plant-based products, its level is very low to provide any health benefits. GABA producing Lactobacillus brevis NPS-QW-145 is unable to ferment milk due to lack of proteolytic activity. This research work showed that co-culturing of this organism in the presence of monosodium glutamate (MSG) with Streptococcus thermophilus, one of the two starter cultures to make yogurt, GABA-producing ability was significantly improved. However, very little glutamate was metabolized. Being a strong flavoring agent, the residual glutamate may affect the flavor of the final product. This research work reported that high levels of GABA was produced in milk with the help of S. thermophilus, which produced peptides required for the growth of L. brevis and reduced the level of glutamate in GABA-rich fermented milk. Supplementation with cysteine was found to significantly improve GABA production with a minimum level of residual MSG by the co-culture during milk fermentation. Consumption of milk and fermented dairy foods as the best source of protein and other nutrients is on the rise in Hong Kong and the mainland China, and dairy foods containing high level of GABA will provide additional health benefits.

17103718.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17103718.value: 研究背景：口腔健康和肥胖已成為全球關心的健康問題。健康整齊的牙列和形態功能正常的頜面部組織，能顯著提升個體的身心健康。早期肥胖不僅會增加成年肥胖的風險和其它相關疾病的發生，而且早期肥胖與口腔健康成負相關關係，會影響口腔頜面部的正常生長和發育。因此，在口腔頜面部生長發育的相關研究中，應當重視肥胖因素對其的影響。 研究重點：充分了解在不同年齡階段牙弓的生長大小和發育形態，對於一名口腔醫生在進行病情的診斷和製定相應的治療計劃，並進一步對病人及家屬解釋和討論其治療方案時尤為重要。儘管目前存在大量有關牙弓生長大小的研究數據，但是對於牙弓發育形態的相關研究卻十分有限。在這些有限的研究當中，大多數發表的研究數據僅僅只提供了有健康問題的病人是否患有口腔疾病的截面分析數據。同時這些橫向研究設計的樣本量較小，導致其研究結果的可信度不足。目前，由於缺少成熟的3D電腦模型技術和先進的分析數據工具，所以至今還沒有相關研究，對牙弓生長形態進行全面的分析。 研究目的：本項研究以香港青少年為研究對象，旨在建立一個有關肥胖狀況對恆牙列上下牙弓發育形態的研究模式，並且提出牙弓形態與其假設的影響因子（例如肥胖）之間關係的動態學分析。 研究方案：根據標準的測量規定，本研究團隊前瞻性收集香港青少年早期（12歲：基線研究）和中期（15歲：後續跟蹤調查）的牙弓形態，肥胖狀況，與健康有關的其它信息的縱向研究數據。為了完善整個動態學評價數據，我們擬計劃在青少年末期（18歲）進行第二次後續跟蹤調查。記錄牙弓形態的數據將採用3D技術和幾何形態學分析數據軟件。通過對收集的數據進行全面統計學分析，可直觀的比較分析在青少年人群中，隨著年齡增長而變化的牙弓形態，與肥胖狀況的動態學關係。 研究意義：在青少年階段，恆牙列完成構建，頜面部生長旺盛。所以，在矯正治療過程，青少年時期是一個相對關鍵的治療時期。根據本項研究所提供的有關牙弓發育的參考數據庫，可以優化青少年時期的矯正治療方案，從而減少就診次數，避免不必要的治療程序，最終達到滿意的矯正治療效果。本項研究首次建立了一個有關牙弓形態與肥胖狀況之間的動態學關係的參考數據庫。通過收集縱向數據，全面的統計學分析，並結合先進的畫圖技術，為本項研究提供了堅實的基礎。

17103718.label: Realisation of objectives
17103718.value: # How the project objectives have been achieved: 1. Preparation for realization of the objective Invitation letters have been sent to 883 18 years old students in the 54 secondary schools in the 18 districts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Written consent has been obtained from 440 (235 females and 205 males) participants. 2. Data collection The participant’s oral cavity was cleaned with gauze and dental floss. All types of malocclusion, the presence of dental anomalies, and oral health status were evaluated using the same criteria. One trained and calibrated examiner performed the clinical examination using a disposable plane intra-oral mirror with a built-in LED light source. Participants’ body height was measured using a portable height measure (Seca 213, Hamburg, Germany) and body weight measured using a calibrated weighing scale (WB-8000RW, Tanita, Japan). Their BMI was then calculated. One trained and calibrated examiner (intra-class correlation coefficient (ICC) = 0.96 - 0.99 for intra-examiner reliabilities of assessing body height and body weight) performed all of the anthropometric measurements following standardised assessment procedures. 3D dental arch scanning was conducted using a high-precision portable intra-oral 3D scanner (iTero® ElementTM, Align Technology, San Jose, CA, USA). The same operator who served in the previous surveys in 2013 and 2016 performed the assessment in 2019. The participants’ 3D models were reconstructed and stored in the ‘.ply’ format in MeshLab_64bit v1.3.4BETA (Visual Computing Lab - ISTI - CNR). Data from anthropometric measurements, clinical examinations, and 3D electronic models of dental arches collected in previous surveys when participants were 12 years old in 2013 and 15 years old in 2016 were extracted from the extant database. 3. Data processing Geometric morphometric analyses were based on 3D facial images of 440 (235 females and 205 males) participants from whom growth records at age 12, 15, and 18 years were all available. 1320 sets of digital models were obtained during adolescence (at age, 12, 15 and 18) and 272 landmarks were identified on each model. The reliability and validity of assessments were confirmed. Variance of shape at each age level and pairwise differences among age levels were estimated using the DisparityBox8 module nested in the PCAGen8 software. When the interaction between In(CS) and group was not significant, the vectors of regression coefficients estimated from regression of age by gender groups’ shape variables on the corresponding In(CS) were parallel in size-shape space. To remove the effect of static allometry when comparing growth changes in facial shape, size standardization was performed using the following procedures: (1) a multivariate regression of shape variables on In(CS) was performed using data from all groups; (2) the predicted shape variables at the grand mean In(CS) (mean In(CS) for all groups) were estimated from the multivariate regression model; and (3) the residual component of the regression model, which captured shape variation independent of size, was then added back to the predicted shape variables. The resultant size-corrected Procrustes shape coordinates were therefore independent of size and were used for statistical analyses. 4. Statistical analysis Landmark coordinates obtained from the 3D facial images and dental arch models provided raw data for geometric morphometric analyses. Analyses were performed separately for facial shape and dental arch data on age 12, 15, and 18 years. The level of statistical significance was set at 0.05. Analyses were performed in SPSS version 20.0. Landmarks digitized from the 3D dental arch models were then submitted to Generalized Procrustes Analysis (GPA), which served to remove nonshape information including location, orientation, and centroid size of the configurations. Since the present study aimed to investigate changes in form, the Procrustes shape coordinates obtained after GAP was then augmented by centroid size through multiplication of Procrustes shape coordinates by centroid size. GPA was performed combining landmark data for all participants at all three age periods so that the resultant coordinates are in the same shape space where valid comparisons of age-related form changes were made possible. Changes in centroid size throughout the three age periods were determined by Friedman ANOVA. Post-hoc pairwise comparisons between age 12 and 15 years, age 15 and 18 years, and between age 12 and 18 years were performed using paired t-test. The changes from age 12 through 15 to 18 years were determined by Procrustes ANOVA, followed by pairwise comparisons among the three age periods under investigation. GPA and further statistical analyses were performed in MATLAB. # To what extent the project objectives have been achieved: The project objectives have been completely achieved. # Give reason for under-achievements and outline attempts to overcome problems, if any: Nil.

17103718.label: Major findings and research outcome
17103718.value: The direction of growth changes of shape differed between genders (θ = 44.4152, p value = 0.0048). Besides, females and males differed significantly in shapes of the phenotypic growth trajectories (D_shape = 0.2629, p value = 0.0194). In contrast, the total amount of shape change was similar between genders (MD = 0.0015, p value = 0.6681). In addition, results of analyses on phenotypic growth trajectories of facial/dental arch configurations were very similar before and after size standardization. Multivariate regression showed that the association between In(CS) and shape was significant for all age by gender groups (p < 0.05) except for male shape at age 18 years (p = 0.0751). The percentage of shape variation attributable to size ranged from 1.50% to 6.14%. Pairwise comparisons revealed that the direction of static allometric trajectory for females at age 12 years differed from the trajectory direction for both females and males at age 15 and 18 years (p < 0.05). The trajectory direction for males at 12 years differed from the direction of trajectory for females at both age 15 and 18 years (p < 0.05). In spite of the perpendicular static allometric trajectories for females at age 12 and 15 years (90.18 degrees), the two trajectories appeared parallel in the PC plot. Bearing in mind that the PC plot is a two-dimensional representation of the multidimensional shape variables, the perpendicular relationship between the two trajectories may be visible in dimensions other than the first two PCs. (Paper 2 and Conference Abstracts 1 and 2) Three types of dental arch form were identified through clustering. Significant changes (p < 0.001) in types of dental arch form were noted during age 12 to 18 years. Procrustes ANOVA identified significant changes in upper arch form (p<0.001). There was a significant change in upper arch form between age 12 to 15, p<0.001. There was no significant change in upper arch form between age 15 to 18, p>0.05. Overall, there was a significant change in upper arch form between age 12 to 18, p<0.001. Furthermore, Procrustes ANOVA identified significant changes in lower arch form (p<0.001). There was a significant change in lower arch form between age 12 to 15, p<0.001. There was no significant change in lower arch form between age 15 to 18, p>0.05. Overall, there was a significant change in lower arch form between age 12 to 18, p<0.001. (Paper 1 and Conference Abstract 2)

17103718.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17103718.value: Age of the participants in this study was restricted to 12 to18 years, a period that possibly excluded the onset of pubertal facial skeletal growth for girls. Increasing the investigative period to age 10 years will allow for a more complete understanding of developmental changes of facial shape during adolescence. Pubertal facial skeletal growth peaks at age 14 and 12.5–13 years for boys and girls, respectively, which were included within the investigative period of this study; hence, we were able to capture the most important pubertal changes in facial shape for both sexes. The final sample size was adequate for evaluation of developmental changes in facial shape and dental arch form, which is substantiated by the statistically significant form changes observed in this study. However, due to sparsity of anatomical landmarks defining the upper third of the face, analyses in the present study were limited to lower two thirds of the face. Algorithms for automatic digitization of spatially-dense three-dimensional semilandmarks covering the entire human face have been developed. Future geometric morphometric studies based on three-dimensional facial photographs and advanced algorithms for landmark digitization would allow for increased accuracy and complete coverage of the human face.

17103718.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17103718.value: Our findings suggested significant age-related changes in facial shape and provided a dynamic view of developmental changes in sexual dimorphism of facial shape. Allometry contributed minimally to developmental changes in frontal facial shape. The allometric trajectories for lateral facial configurations were similar in rate of shape change but differed in their directions in shape space. In addition, adolescent changes of dental arch form occur primarily during age 12 to15 years, whereas dental arch form was relatively stable during age 15 to 18 years. The present study is of clinical implications. Of note, most changes in the dentoalveolar complex occurred during ages 12 to 15 years as opposed to 15 to 18 years. Age 12 to 15 years corresponds to a period when most orthodontic treatment is conducted. Thus, the effect of developmental form changes of dental arch during adolescence must be taken into orthodontic treatment planning. Between ages 15 to 18, less frequently were changes in the dentoalveolar complex observed. This would suggest that if treatment is completed at around age 15, the dentoalveolar complex will be relatively stable post orthodontic treatment and chances of relapse due to growth and development is minimal.

17103818.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17103818.value: 痴肥和非酒精性脂肪肝是兩種不斷增長的流行病，並成為迫切的公共衛生問題。高強度間歇訓練（HIIT）是一種省時的運動方式，可有效地管理痴肥和非酒精性脂肪肝。然而，痴肥和非酒精性脂肪肝患者大多是沒有運動習慣，他們可能會因恆常的HIIT（通常每週三次）訓練頻率而感到恐懼。根據已往的HIIT研究，參與者可以在2-4個月後完成這種鍛煉頻率，但大多數研究只在受控的實驗室環境下進行。但對於長期堅持和可持續性，特別是在真實户外環境中，仍然不確定。再者，對於人們不願意參與HIIT的原因研究人員也是不確定，如他們對HIIT的認知或對完成訓練計劃的信心。從邏輯上來說，較低訓練頻率的HIIT令完成運動計劃的難度降低，會更適合少做運動的肥胖和非酒精性脂肪肝患者。但對於改善健康所需的最低運動頻率仍然是未知的。所以，這項研究目的是研究長期低頻HIIT對改善中央肥胖成年人的身體肥胖和肝臟脂肪的有效性。這項研究計劃的假設是基於早期的HIIT研究成果，早期的研究結果指出HIIT每5-7天進行一次可以改善心肺健康，血壓，心臟形態，代謝能力，肌肉力量和肌肉重量。我們的初步數據也顯示，在超重/肥胖成人中進行每週一次，持續8週的HIIT可以改善帶氧表現，腰圍，脂肪量和肌肉量。是次研究將採用隨機對照試驗，並採用前後測試設計。中央肥胖的成年人將被隨機分配到低頻HIIT組或常規治療組。 HIIT組將接受12個月的每週一次HIIT訓練，而常規護理組將會接受與痴肥相關的健康教育。我們將會在實驗前、第12個月和第24個月會對受試者進行檢測，測試項目包括︰身體成份（通過雙能量X光吸收測量儀測量）、肝臟脂肪（通過磁力共振成像測量）、內臟脂肪（通過磁力共振成像測量），人體測量學（身高體重指數和腰圍），心血管疾病風險因素，血液化驗，對訓練計劃的依從性，心理測量，心理健康，藥物使用，日常身體活動和飲食。本研究將為長期低頻HIIT的有效性提供相關的研究證據，並在後續階段評估其有效性，安全性，依從性和可持續性。我們預計這種訓練模式將增強HIIT在沒有運動習慣的肥胖成人中的實際適用性，並將為低頻HIIT作為管理肥胖和肝臟脂肪的新運動選擇提供研究證據。

17103818.label: Realisation of objectives
17103818.value: The objective of this project is to examine the effectiveness of 12 months of low-frequency high-intensity interval training (HIIT) on improving 1) liver fat and 2) body adiposity in adults with central obesity. This project has successfully and fully achieved its objective. The method and how the project’s objective was accomplished is provided in the breakdown below. The principal investigator and the supervised research postgraduate students were responsible for overseeing and coordinating the project. Adults with central obesity were recruited from the local community via leaflet distributions, poster campaigns, and promotional health talks. Interested individuals were invited to come to the laboratory at HKU medical campus and were screened against the eligibility criteria to determine if they were suitable to be included in the current project. Individuals were deemed eligible if they met the following inclusion criteria: 1) aged 18 to 60 years, 2) body mass index (BMI) ≥25 (obesity classification adopted by the Department of Health, Hong Kong SAR Government), and 3) waist circumference ≥90cm/80cm for men/women, respectively (central obesity classification adopted by the International Diabetes Federation [IDF] for Chinese ethnic group). The estimated sample size of 120 participants stated in the original application was recruited and included in the project. Baseline assessments were performed after eligible individuals provided their informed consent to participate in the project. In the baseline assessment, participants were assessed on different health parameters, such as blood pressure, cholesterol profile, body composition, cardiorespiratory fitness, and more. Nonetheless, in line with the objective of the project, the main outcomes assessed were liver fat and total body adiposity. Liver fat was assessed using proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy (H-MRS). H-MRS detects the chemical composition of the scanned tissue and was used to generate a raw data file containing the water and methylene peak amplitudes observed in the liver of the scanned participant. Liver fat was defined as the content of intrahepatic triglycerides (IHTG) and was calculated as IHTG = methylene peak amplitude ÷ (methylene peak amplitude + water peak amplitude) and expressed as a percentage value. Body adiposity was assessed using whole-body dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) scan. Participants were positioned on the DXA scanner by trained research personnel according to the recommended positioning and alignment of the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) method. Scans were analyzed using Hologic APEX Software according to the manufacturer’s recommendations for body composition analysis. Body adiposity was defined as total body fat mass in grams. Following baseline assessments, participants were randomized into one of two groups, the HIIT group and the usual care control (CON) group. Participants were randomized in batches resulting in a total of 9 batches in this project. The HIIT group performed HIIT once a week for 12 months, whereas the CON group received health education classes once every 2 weeks for 12 months. Contents delivered in the CON group are based on information provided by the Department of Health of the Hong Kong SAR Government and were also distributed to the HIIT group in the form of handouts. Participants in the HIIT group performed the 4×4 HIIT training protocol. This protocol consists of four 4-min high-intensity intervals at 85-95% heart rate peak (HRpeak) interspersed with 3-min active recovery intervals at 50-70% HRpeak. After 12 months, participants in both groups performed post-assessments to assess the differences in liver fat and total body adiposity. Overall, the project had a very good intervention completion rate of 84% with no serious adverse events noted. Moreover, the findings of the project enabled the research team to elucidate the effectiveness of low-frequency high-intensity interval training on liver fat and body adiposity (details in Section 6). Despite the successful and full achievement of the objective, the project had to overcome multiple problems and difficulties. The first batch of participants commenced their intervention in September 2019. However, shortly after, in January 2020 the first positive case of COVID-19 was confirmed to have spread to Hong Kong. This initial spread induced significant concern among the participants in the first batch, eventually resulting in all of them withdrawing from the study. The second and third batch of participants began intervention in May 2020, however, COVID-19 cases experienced a substantial uptick in July and August 2020. Despite complying with the social distancing measures implemented in Hong Kong, many of the participants still got infected. The project resolved this challenge by implementing a standardized training protocol for COVID-19 recovered participants. The COVID-19 training protocol for recovered participants in the HIIT group consisted of the following steps: 1) provide proof of two consecutive days of negative rapid antigen test results, and 2) initiate 4 weeks of gradual resumption of HIIT beginning at 50% of the initial volume with an intensity of ~70% HRpeak for the high-intensity intervals and progressing to 100% of the prescribed intensity and volume by the 4th week. Moreover, beginning in February 2022, Hong Kong experienced another severe COVID-19 outbreak. The research team adapted the delivery of its interventions to comply with the tightened social distancing measures implemented by the Hong Kong SAR Government. The HIIT intervention for batch 6, 7 and 8 participants were modified from group training to 1-on-1 training (1 participant with 1 trainer) per training time slot. Nevertheless, in March 2022 when COVID-19 cases exponentially increased the intervention was further adjusted to HIIT conducted at home via bodyweight exercises and supervised via Zoom. Similarly, participants in the CON group switched from group-based face-to-face lessons to group-based online sessions via Zoom. Participants in the HIIT group resumed 1-on-1 face-to-face training in May while complying with stringent COVID-19 prevention measures. In addition to the difficulties arising from COVID-19, the project was also negatively impacted by the reduction in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) availability. MRI availability was reduced to approximately 10 scans per month from August to October 2022 due to a reduction in personnel at the MRI unit due to the impact of COVID-19. This delayed batch 7 and 8 post-assessments and batch 4 follow-up assessments. MRI availability remained limited from March 2023 to September 2023 due to the replacement of the 1.5T MRI scanner with a 3T MRI scanner. This problem was resolved by having a member of the coordinating team receive training under the guidance of a senior radiographer of the MRI unit to become a trained MRI operator. This enabled the project to conduct MRI scans during non-office hours, which allowed the project to catch up the progress and to achieve major progress. Moreover, the change in the MRI scanner from 1.5T to 3T meant that the liver fat outcome could differ marginally due to an increase in MRI magnet strength. This issue was addressed by conducting a side study having 16 participants undergo consecutive scans on both the 1.5T and 3T MRI scanners to enable the research team to be able to perform correlation analysis and develop a regression equation between the measurements obtained from the 1.5T and 3T MRI scanners.

17103818.label: Major findings and research outcome
17103818.value: This project demonstrates that 25 minutes of HIIT performed once weekly for 12 months induces a 3.8% within-group reduction in intrahepatic triglycerides (IHTG). In contrast, the CON group had a 0.1% within-group reduction. The IHTG decline in the HIIT and CON groups corresponds to a 29% and 0.8% relative reduction from their respective baseline values, with the reduction in the HIIT group being statistically significant when compared to the CON group (p<0.01). The 29% relative decline in the HIIT group is critical as literature has proposed that a ≥30% relative decline in IHTG is associated with fibrosis regression. Among the individuals living with metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD), 10-30% of them are likely to develop metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH). MASH is a progressive and severe form of MAFLD and promotes liver fibrosis via inflammation, eventually leading to cirrhosis and potentially hepatocellular carcinoma. Consequently, liver fibrosis regression is one of the most important factors associated with a favorable prognosis and reduced liver-related complications in MAFLD. Encouragingly, Tamaki and colleagues illustrated that a ≥30% relative decline in IHTG is significantly associated with six times higher odds of ≥1 stage improvement in liver fibrosis. Individuals with obesity and MAFLD also have a higher risk of morbidity and mortality. Indeed, treatment guidelines for fatty liver and obesity unequivocally recommend that a weight loss goal of 5% be achieved by employing first-line therapies, such as exercise. In this project, the HIIT group achieved a statistically significant reduction in total body fat mass compared to the CON group (p<0.02). The within-group reduction in the HIIT and CON group was -1.5kg and -0.04kg, respectively. This 1.5kg decrease in fat mass in the HIIT group translates to a relative reduction of 4.7% from baseline and aligns closely with the weight loss goal of 5%. Encouragingly, modest weight loss of 5-10% results in numerous health benefits. These benefits range from improvements in comorbid conditions to cardiovascular disease risk factors to mental health issues. Exercise is a first-line therapy for managing obesity and fatty liver disease due to its effectiveness, low cost, and ease of implementation. Accordingly, this project demonstrates that 25 minutes of HIIT performed once a week can induce clinically meaningful improvements in liver fat and total body adiposity. Moreover, this exercise modality is highly feasible and adherable in centrally obese adults as evidenced by the high completion rate, and may enhance long-term exercise compliance.

17103818.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17103818.value: This project elucidated the effectiveness of low-frequency (i.e., once-weekly) and low-volume (i.e., 25 minutes a week) HIIT on reducing liver fat and total body adiposity in centrally obese adults. Undoubtedly, these informative and impactful findings beckon further questions regarding the application of this exercise protocol in more severe versions of MAFLD and other health issues. Indeed, the effectiveness of a low-frequency and low-volume HIIT protocol on alleviating liver fibrosis among individuals with MASH, an advanced and severe stage of MAFLD characterized by the scarring of liver tissues, is unknown. Similarly, whether the efficacy of low-frequency and low-volume HIIT is upheld in other critical public health issues with a distinct disease etiology, such as mild cognitive impairment and depression remains to be investigated. Moreover, the substantial improvements derived from this low-volume HIIT protocol raise the question of whether the exercise volume can be further reduced and still maintain its efficacy. Further reduction of exercise volume will decrease time commitment and may lower the perceived barriers to engaging in regular exercise. Future projects will continue to explore and demonstrate the application and suitability of this HIIT exercise protocol in different critical public health issues.

17103818.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17103818.value: This research project investigated the effectiveness of long-term low-frequency high-intensity interval training (HIIT) on liver fat and total body fat in centrally obese adults. Participants were allocated into the HIIT intervention group or to a usual care group. Their liver fat and total body fat were assessed prior to the beginning of the intervention and after 12 months. The findings demonstrate that 25 minutes of HIIT performed once a week can greatly reduce liver fat by approximately 30% and confer significant health benefits by reversing the development of more severe metabolic-associated fatty liver diseases. In addition, a modest but clinically meaningful reduction of 4.7% in total body fat was observed. This relative reduction in total body fat has been shown to lead to a host of health benefits, including improvements in cholesterol profile, blood pressure, mental health problems, comorbid conditions, and more. This long-term project also recorded no adverse events coupled with a high adherence and intervention completion rate among the participants in the HIIT group. To conclude, 25 minutes of HIIT performed once a week is an effective, safe, and sustainable exercise modality to manage central obesity and liver fat.

17104318.label: Realisation of objectives
17104318.value: Objective 1. To improve our understanding on the internalisation process of T. marneffei by bronchial epithelial cells and to study the fates of the fungus and infected cells after internalisation Scope of investigation undertaken A green fluorescent protein (GFP)-tagged T. marneffei strain (PM1-GFP) was constructed for imaging analysis. Confocal microscopy and live cell imaging were performed to visualise the internalisation process of T. marneffei by bronchial epithelial cells. Survival assay was performed to determine the fate of the internalised T. marneffei conidia in the infected cells. Results achieved: Growth of PM1-GFP at both 25°C and 37°C showed similar morphologies and growth rates to its parental strain (PM1), respectively; and this fluorescent strain was then used for subsequent confocal microscopy analyses. Typical stacking of optical sections (z-series) showed that GFP signals of cell surface-attached conidia and internalised conidia were detected from different sections. Visualisation of the GFP signals revealed that most of the signals were detected from inside of the cells, which was in line with the expected subcellular localisation, indicating that fungal conidia were not only attached to the surface of hBECs, but also present inside the host cells. The results suggested that hBECs might play a role in fungal recognition and engulfment. To acquire a more in-depth physiological understanding on the interactions between hBECs and T. marneffei, live cell imaging for a continuous 24-hour period was performed. It was observed that internalised conidia were localised inside membrane-bound vacuoles within the host cell. Moreover, the process of cell division was widely observed in the infected hBECs, which was confirmed by confocal microscopy. Survival assay found that the lysates from hBEC–T. marneffei co-culture yielded a higher fungal recovery rate than those of human peripheral blood monocyte-derived macrophage–T. marneffei co-culture (p < 0.01). Objective 2. To characterize the immune response of bronchial epithelial cells induced by T. marneffei Scope of investigation undertaken Reverse-transcription−quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qRT−PCR) was performed to characterise the immune response of hBECs induced by T. marneffei. Results achieved: It was demonstrated that unlike the situation observed for Aspergillus fumigatus infection in hBECs where the mRNA expressions of CXCL8, CXCL10 and TNF during the early infection stage (within the first 24 h post-infection) in the host cells were markedly up-regulated, no significant change in the mRNA expressions of these cytokines was detected in hBECs upon encountering T. marneffei live conidia (Fig. 6 of the manuscript). Moreover, the induction of interleukin 1 beta (IL1B) and interleukin 6 (IL6) were also not observed while the mRNA expression of interferon alpha 2 (IFNA2), interferon beta 1 (IFNB1), interferon lambda 1 (IFNL1) and interferon lambda 2 (IFNL2) could not be detected by qRT–PCR in infected hBECs. Objective 3. To examine the change in gene expression profiles of both T. marneffei and bronchial epithelial cells after infection and to elucidate the candidate gene(s) important for evasion of host immunity and virulence in T. marneffei, so as to identify potential vaccine and drug targets Scope of investigation undertaken RNA-seq was performed and differentially expressed genes were identified to evaluate the global gene expressional changes of human bronchial epithelial cells and T. marneffei upon infection Results achieved: hBECs were cultured using an air-liquid interface model. Upon T. marneffei infection, 78, 138 and 413 genes were up-regulated at 8, 24 and 48 h post-infection, respectively and 189, 398 and 462 genes were down-regulated at 8, 24 and 48 h post-infection, respectively. Cytokines that are previous identified to be associated with T. marneffei infection such as CXCL8/IL8, TNF, IL1B and IL6 were found to be downregulated while CXCL10/IP10 was found to be not expressed. Shortlisted cytokine genes that are differentially expressed (listed in the manuscript).

17104318.label: Major findings and research outcome
17104318.value: Talaromyces marneffei is a thermally dimorphic fungal pathogen endemic in Southeast Asia. As inhalation of airborne conidia is believed as the major infection route, airway epithelial cells followed by pulmonary macrophages are the first cell types which the fungus encounters inside the host. However, due to the lack of an optimised infection model, the host-pathogen interaction of talaromycosis is not well-understood. In this study, we established an in vitro infection model based on human peripheral blood-derived macrophages (hPBDMs) cultured with the supplementation of autologous plasma. Using this model, we determined the transcriptomic changes of hPBDMs in response to T. marneffei infection by qRT–PCR as well as high-throughput RNA–sequencing. Results showed that T. marneffei infection could activate hPBDMs to the M1-like phenotype and trigger a potent induction of chemokine (CXCL8, CXCL10, CCL5 and CCL20) and pro-inflammatory cytokine (TNF) production as well as the expression of other immunoregulatory genes (SOD2, CCL3, STAT1, CLEC4E, IL1B, IER3, PIK3R2 and C3). In contrast to hPBDMs, there was no detectable innate cytokine response (CXCL8, CXCL10, IFNA2, IFNB1, IFNL1, IFNL2, IL1B, IL6, and TNF mRNA expression) against T. marneffei in human bronchial epithelial cells (hBECs). Using a GFP-tagged T. marneffei mutant strain (GFP-PM1) and confocal microscopy, internalisation of the fungus by hBECs was confirmed. Live cell imaging further demonstrated that the infected cells exhibited normal cellular physiology, especially that the process of cell division could be observed. Moreover, T. marneffei also survived better inside hBECs than hPBDMs. Our results illustrated a potential role of hBECs to serve as reservoir cells for T. marneffei to evade immunosurveillance by phagocytes, from which the fungus reactivates when the host immunity is weakened and causes infection. Such immunoevasion and reactivation may also help explain the long incubation period observed for talaromycosis, in particular the travel-related cases.

17104318.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17104318.value: In this study we have demonstrated that T. marneffei could down-regulate the immune response by hBECs and therefore, hBECs may potentially serve as reservoir cells for T. marneffei to evade immunosurveillance. Immune pathways which T. marneffei supresses were identified. Genes of T. marnffei which were up-regulated upon hBEC infection were also recognised and they may represent potential virulence factors. These have laid down an important foundation for studying the host-pathogen interaction during T. marneffei infection. In future studies, these supressed immune pathways in infected hBECs can be reactivated and any clearance of intracellular T. marneffei can be determined. The potential T. marneffei virulence factors can also be verified by mutagenesis studies. This will help reconstruct a clearer picture on the pathogenesis of T. marneffei and provide clues on potential vaccine candidates.

17104318.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17104318.value: Talaromyces marneffei is an important fungal pathogen especially in Southeast Asia. To understand the innate immune response to talaromycosis, a suitable infection model is needed. However, previous host-T. marneffei interaction studies usually employed murine macrophages for characterisation only. Moreover, very often pre-treatment of the macrophages with stimulants were performed, which was non-physiological and did not represent the situation in human infection. Here, we established an in vitro T. marneffei infection model using human peripheral blood-derived macrophages (hPBDMs) cultured with the supplementation of autologous plasma. We then examined the change in transcriptomic profiles of hPBDMs in response to T. marneffei infection with this model. We found that contact with T. marneffei could activate hPBDMs to the M1-like phenotype and induced the mRNA expression of five cytokines and eight immunoregulatory genes. Contrary to hPBDMs, such immunoresponse was not elicited in human bronchial epithelial cells (hBECs), despite normal cellular physiology, especially cell division, was observed in infected cells. We also found that infected hBECs did not eliminate T. marneffei as efficiently as hPBDMs. Our observation suggested that hBECs may potentially serve as reservoir cells for T. marneffei to evade immunosurveillance. When the host immunity deteriorates later then the fungus reactivates and causes infection.

17104418.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17104418.value: Liver transplantation (LT) is a life-saving procedure for patients with end-stage liver disease. Despite continuous advancement in technology, it remains a high-risk operation. The goal of LT is not only to ensure survival of the patients but also to restore them to their pre-morbid state with good quality of life. Neurological sequelae can have a major impact on postoperative outcomes after LT and yet relevant reports are scarce. Studies from Western countries showed evidence on the use of cerebral oximtery in cardiac surgery to prevent neurological mishaps. This system is the ONLY cerebral/somatic oximetry system with FDA cleared improved outcome claims. Drop of more than 15% of regional cerebral perfusion during operation can be harmful to the brain leading to poor postoperative stroke or confusion and thus intra-operative manipulation of the anesthesia could rectify this problem promptly with the help of this device. Nonetheless, LT shares similar intra-operative fluctuation of the haemodynamices as in cardiac surgery, causing disturbances in regional cerebral oxygenation and theorectically cerebral oximetry should be of great value as well in LT surgery. Data from a large randomised controlled trial is lacking from the current literatures. We therefore propose a randomized controlled trial on the use of this device in adult Chinese LT and see whether its use could reduce neurological mishaps. 肝移植的目的不單單是挽救生命；希望通過它，病人回復病前狀態，擁有良好的生活品質。但肝移植是一項高風險手術，病人術後可能出現後遺症。神經性的後遺症或會嚴重影響移植成果，然而目前相關的報告甚少。 在西方，有證據顯示術中「腦血氧飽和度分析」能夠防止心臟手術後神經性後遺症的出現。INVOS系統是目前唯一獲得【美國食品藥品監督管理局】認可能夠改善手術成果的「腦血氧飽和度分析」系統。手術中，若然局部腦灌注下降多於15%，就會對腦部造成傷害，導致術後中風或神智不清。術中以這系統來調控麻醉，可以防止這種不幸。 在肝移植中，血動力的波動與在心臟手術中的差不多，可以擾亂局部腦氧合。理論上，「腦血氧飽和度分析」在肝移植中可以派上用場，只是目前來自大型隨機對照試驗的數據不足。有見及此，我們建議在華裔成年肝移植病人中進行一個隨機對照試驗，以確認INVOS系統能否減少或阻止神經性後遺症的發生。

17104418.label: Realisation of objectives
17104418.value: We were able to recruit a total of 121 patients out of the planned 158 patients before the funding was exhausted. We were not able to recruit the planned number of patients due to historically low rates of transplant numbers during the study period. From the analysis of the available data, we were not able to demonstrate any difference to the neurological outcomes from the use of cerebral oximetry monitoring. As the rates of complications was relatively low in this population, a much larger than anticipated sample size would be required to definitively answer the question. However, the available data would indicate there is no likely incremental cerebral benefits from the use of intraoperative cerebral oximetry in this group of patients. Further there were indications that extremely high bilirubin readings interfered with cerebral oximetry reading, producing unphysiologically low readings but these were relatively rare in our study population

17104418.label: Major findings and research outcome
17104418.value: The findings below are presented as control group versus intervention group Patients in the two groups had similar ICU and hospital length of stays in days (4.16 +/- 2.73 vs 4.6 +/- 4.89) The median hospital length of stay in days was 20 versus 19 The median number of hours required for Glasgow Coma Scale to return to 15 were 15 in both the control and intervention groups. The median scores of Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) done on postoperative day 10 were 27 for both groups. The incidence of postoperative delirium was similar between the 2 groups (7/66 ; 10.6%) versus (4/55 7.3%) (p=0.403). The overall incidence of neurological complications within the patients recruited in the study was 18.7% (n=24). The incidence of neurological complications in the control 22.9% (n=13) and intervention group 14.0% (n=11) but these were not significant Other complications reported in the control group of patients in decreasing order of frequencies were seizure (n=2), ischemic stroke (n=3) and mutism (n=1). While the most common neurological complication in the intervention group was ischemic stroke (n=4) seizure with an incidence of 7.0% (n=3), followed by delirium (n=4) and encephalopathy (n=1). Among the 55 intervention patients, preoperative desaturation (rScO2 <40%) occurred in 45% patients (n=25).

17104418.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17104418.value: The incidence of delirium in our local population was surprisingly low compared to those reported in the literature. As such a very large sample size is required to demonstrate any true benefit from the use of the device in the local population. There were also no trends of any benefits from the use of cerebral oximetry in other cerebral outcomes. Therefore it is the view of the investigators that there is little potential for further research in this area.

17104418.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17104418.value: This clinical trial evaluated the utility of monitoring the brain tissue oxygen level using a non-invasive commercially available cerebral oximetry device. The results showed that such form of monitoring was not significantly helpful in preventing adverse cerebral events in liver transplant recipient patients. This may be due to the considerable interference from the yellow pigments in the blood of patients with liver disease or that there are multiple factors that contribute the poor brain outcomes in these high-risk patients. This will guide anaesthesiologists in their choice of monitoring and resource allocation when looking after these patients.

17104618.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17104618.value: DNA損傷可誘導細胞增殖停滯、轉錄沉默，啟動DNA修復等一系列複雜的細胞過程。然而，這些DNA損傷應答的時空調控機制並未被完全闡述。其中，阻斷DNA損傷功能應答連貫性的基因突變與基因組不穩定性和包括癌症、神經發育缺陷的人類疾病存在因果關聯。 我們旨在研究哺乳動物DNA損傷應答機制及其在保護基因組穩定性和腫瘤抑制中的作用。為此，我們鑑定出MIRK是促進DNA損傷後細胞存活的一個十分重要的蛋白因子。此外，為了研究MIRK在DNA損傷應答中的潛在功能，我們純化出MIRK蛋白複合物，並且鑑定出促進DNA高保真修復的RNF169蛋白可募集MIRK至DNA損傷位點。 MIRK和RNF169蛋白複合物的功能域結合研究表明，MIRK與RNF169以二價模式結合，有意思的是，我們發現MIRK的表達沉默可顯著減少電離輻射所致的DNA雙鏈斷裂處的RNF169蛋白募集。基於以上的初步研究，我們認為MIRK參與哺乳動物DNA損傷應答調控，其中一個可能性是透過調節RNF169在DNA損傷位點上的作用。 為了闡述MIRK-RNF169促進DNA損傷應答的機制，我們將詳細地研究MIRK-RNF169的相互作用及MIRK如何促進依賴RNF169的DNA損傷應答包括恢復DNA損傷檢查點和修復DNA雙鏈斷裂。此外，我們還會深入研究MIRK及其激酶活性如何在DNA雙鏈斷裂處精細調控染色體應答，例如DNA損傷誘導的轉錄沉默等機制，並且描述MIRK-RNF169如何影響細胞對會引起DNA損傷的抗癌治療產生抗性。最後，我們會有系統地研究癌症引起的MIRK突變對細胞應答DNA損傷的影響，並透過篩選來鑑定出有異常MIRK活性的細胞中是否存在聯合致死作用。 MIRK活動失調與人類惡性腫瘤和家族性代謝綜合症有密切關係。雖然MIRK與一系列人類疾病相關，但是現時MIRK對促進細胞增殖和動物存活的機制並不清楚。我們的研究工作將確定MIRK可作為DNA損傷應答調控的靶向藥物，深入揭示MIRK功能異常導致人類疾病的機制，為MIRK相關疾病治療藥物的設計和研究提供有力理論支持。

17105318.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17105318.value: White adipose tissue (WAT) browning/beiging, the process in which conversion of white to brown adipocytes in response to thermogenic stimulations such as cold or beta3-adrenergic receptor agonist resulting in increased energy expenditure, is suggested to be an effective strategy to combat obesity and its-related cardiometabolic diseases. Increasing studies focus on identifying factors that promote WAT browning while those inhibitory factors are rarely discovered. Obesity is associated with neutrophil infiltration and activation in different fat depots. Rapid neutrophil infiltration is observed at 3 days and maintained constant up to 90 days after high fat feeding suggesting that neutrophil not only participates in initiating adipose tissue inflammation but also involves in the progression of obesity. Neutrophil elastase (NE) and proteinase 3 (PR3) are the two major neutrophil-derived serine proteases. NE and PR3 deficiency has been shown to protect mice against diet-induced obesity but the mechanism remains unclear. Our preliminary data showed that treatment of beta3-adrenergic receptor agonist CL-316,243 in C57BL/6N mice markedly induced neutrophil infiltration into epididymal WAT (eWAT) but no browning was observed. On the contrary, increased brown-like adipocytes and expression of uncoupling protein-1 (UCP-1) were evidenced in subcutaneous WAT (sWAT) with no neutrophil infiltration. Mice with neutrophil depletion mediated by treatment with anti-Ly6G antibody exhibited significantly higher cold-induced energy expenditure and improved thermoregulation which was accompanied by enhanced browning also in eWAT comparing to IgG-treated control mice. Furthermore, cold-induced NE and PR3 expression in eWAT of IgG-treated control mice was abolished in neutrophil-depleted mice. These data implicate that neutrophil infiltration and expression of its-derived factors contribute to the impairment of physiologically- and pharmacologically-induced WAT browning. In obese mice and patients, WAT browning is compromised and increased neutrophil infiltration in various fat depots is evidenced. Here, we propose that neutrophil is the key immune cell that negatively regulates browning of WAT in obesity by releasing NE and PR3. NE and PR3 may inhibit the proliferation and/or differentiation of beige adipocyte progenitors and their commitment to beige adipocytes. On the other hand, NE and PR3 possess proinflammatory properties and may suppress alternatively activated M2 macrophage polarization thus impair browning. We will examine these hypotheses using genetic ablation and pharmacological inhibition of NE and/or PR3 in mice. The results allow the discovery of the novel role of neutrophil in energy metabolism and identify the endogenous suppressors of beige adipogenesis and adaptive thermogenesis which can be the therapeutic targets for obesity. 白色脂肪組織棕色化，來源於寒冷或β3-腎上腺受體激動劑誘導白色脂肪細胞轉變為棕色脂肪細胞，進而促進能量代謝，成為防治肥胖及其相關心血管疾病的有效手段。當今研究主要集中於尋找白色脂肪組織棕色化的激活因子，但鮮有抑制因子的報導。肥胖與脂肪組織中性粒細胞浸潤和活化緊密相關。高脂飲食顯著性誘導脂肪組織中性粒細胞浸潤，最早3天出現並維持至90天。這些研究表明，中性粒細胞不僅介導脂肪細胞炎症反應，並參與肥胖的病理過程。中性粒細胞彈性蛋白（NE）和水解酶3（PR3）是2種主要的中性粒細胞絲氨酸蛋白酶。缺失NE和PR3基因緩解高脂飲食誘導的小鼠肥胖，但分子機制仍不清楚。我們前期數據發現，β3-腎上腺受體激動劑CL-316243顯著性誘導中性粒細胞在腹腔脂肪組織的聚集，但其未出現脂肪組織棕色化。相反，皮下脂肪組織出現明顯棕色化，但未聚集中性粒細胞。利用中性粒細胞中和性抗體Ly6G消除中性粒細胞後，寒冷誘導的能量消耗和脂肪組織棕色化顯著性增強。同時，消除中性粒細胞能夠阻斷寒冷誘導的腹腔脂肪組織NE和PR3生成。這些數據證明，中性粒細胞浸潤及其細胞因子能夠抑制生理性或藥理性誘導的脂肪組織棕色化。在肥胖小鼠和人群中，大量數據闡述了脂肪組織棕色化減弱和中性粒細胞數量增加緊密相關。因此，我們提出假設：中性粒細胞通過釋放NE和PR3抑制脂肪組織棕色化。其中，NE和PR3可能抑制棕色化前體脂肪細胞的增殖或分化為棕色化脂肪細胞。另一方面，NE和PR3具有促炎活性，可能抑制M2巨噬細胞來抑制脂肪組織棕色化。本項目將利用NE/PR3基因敲除小鼠模型和藥理抑製劑探討本實驗假設。本項目將發掘中性粒細胞在能量代謝中的新型意義，並證明脂肪組織棕色化及適應性產熱是肥胖的有效治療手段。

17106018.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17106018.value: Neurons convey information in the brain through chemical messengers released at the specialized cellular junction called synapse. Each synapse contains numerous diverse proteins being organized into distinct signaling networks, and their alteration due to gene mutations underlies many inherited neurodevelopmental disorders. Understanding the function of various synaptic proteins is therefore fundamental to the identification of therapeutic targets and represents one major area in current neuroscience research. Synapse in the brain is classified as either excitatory or inhibitory, and the development of these two types of synapses has to be tightly balanced for normal brain function. It is generally believed that the two types of synapses are differentially regulated by different sets of signaling molecules. While many components of excitatory synapse have been well-characterized, the constituents of inhibitory synapse and the mechanism underlying its development are not well-defined. Genetic studies have identified numerous mutations on the tbc1d24 gene in patients with syndromic intellectual disability and DOORS syndrome that are associated with epilepsy, yet the cellular function of the TBC1D24 protein remains poorly understood. We have found that TBC1D24 is essential for the formation of dendritic spines, the cellular compartments where excitatory synapses are located. Surprisingly, TBC1D24 is also located at inhibitory synapses on the postsynaptic neuron, and electrophysiological recording of dissociated hippocampal neurons indicates that depletion of TBC1D24 results in greater attenuation of neurotransmission at inhibitory synapses than that of excitatory synapses. We therefore hypothesize that TBC1D24 is a novel key player that controls the development of both excitatory and inhibitory synapses. However, TBC1D24 might play a more important role in inhibitory synaptogenesis, and loss of TBC1D24 function will shift the excitatory/inhibitory balance towards over-excitation that might underlie epilepsy. To test this hypothesis, we will knock down TBC1D24 expression by RNA-interference in both primary hippocampal neurons in vitro and the hippocampus of young and adult animals in vivo. The relative impact on the development and properties of excitatory and inhibitory synapses will be examined by imaging and electrophysiology. We will further explore whether disrupting TBC1D24 expression or function in vivo will lead to aberrant animal behaviors that are associated with altered excitatory and inhibitory balance, and elucidate the molecular mechanism underlying the synaptic role of TBC1D24. The proposed study should provide new insights into neurobiology of synapse by demonstrating the differential regulation of excitatory and inhibitory synapse development through a novel signaling protein whose disruption is associated with neurodevelopmental disorder. 神經元通過突觸釋放的化學遞質傳輸信息。每個神經突觸包含許多處於不同信號通路以及功能各異的蛋白分子。基因突變引起的蛋白功能改變與許多遺傳性神經發育疾病相關。因此，對不同突觸蛋白的功能研究有助於發現此類疾病的治療靶點，而且蛋白功能的研究也是神經科學領域的一個主要熱點。在大腦內，突觸被分為興奮性與抑制性兩種。它們的發育需要嚴格的平衡調節從而維持大腦的正常功能。目前的研究表明，這兩種突觸受到不同的信號分子的調控。雖然許多興奮性突觸相關蛋白的功能已經相對明確，但是抑制性突觸的構成以及發育機制研究尚缺乏。基因遺傳學研究表明數十種的tbc1d24的基因突變與癲癇相關的智力缺陷和DOORs綜合症有關。然而，TBC1D24在細胞體內的功能仍然不明。 我們在前期的實驗證實TBC1D24對神經樹突棘的形成有著重要作用。興奮性突觸大部分形成於神經樹突棘。同時，我們意外發現TBC124存在於抑制性突觸後神經元。電生理實驗結果顯示減弱TBC1D24的表達會影響神經元的興奮性與抑制性的傳輸，以影響抑制性更為顯著。據此，我們推測TBC1D24對控制興奮性與抑制性突觸都扮演著重要角色，並且TBC1D24可能在抑制性突觸的形成有著更重要作用，所以TBC1D24的功能缺失會改變腦內興奮與抑制的平衡，從而導致癲癇的產生。為驗證這個設想，我們將通過RNA干擾技術減弱TBC1D24基因在體內外的海馬神經元的表達水平。運用電生理與激光共聚焦拍照技術，我們將檢查TBC1D24的基因減弱對興奮性和抑制性突觸發育以及功能的影響。我們將進一步研究體內TBC1D24的表達水平下調是否會改變與興奮抑制失衡相關的動物行為，同時研究TBC1D24調控突觸功能的分子機制。該項研究將展示與神經發育疾病相關的一種新的信號蛋白對興奮性和抑制性突觸的不同調節機，從而為突觸神經生物學的研究提供新思路。

17106018.label: Realisation of objectives
17106018.value: Objective 1: We first determined the subcellular localization of Tbc1d24 mRNA and its protein product in cultured hippocampal neurons. Using fluorescence in situ hybridization, the Tbc1d24 mRNAs were detected as distinct puncta in soma and dendrites, while immunocytochemistry with TBC1D24 antibody showed the dendritic localization of the protein, including their presence in dendritic spines. To address the role in synapse development, a shRNA plasmid was constructed that effectively knocked down the expression of TBC1D24. After co-transfection with GFP to visualize the dendritic arbors and spines, we performed immunostaining with the excitatory synaptic markers vGLUT1 and PSD-95. Compared to control shRNA, introduction of TBC1D24-shRNA significantly reduced the number of excitatory synapses and mushroom spines. Co-expressing the RNAi-resistant TBC1D24 construct rescued the loss of PSD-95-positive mushroom spines, thereby ruling out off-target effect of the shRNA. Whole-cell patch recording further revealed a reduction of miniature excitatory postsynaptic current (mEPSC) frequency after TBC1D24 knockdown. To validate our findings with another cellular model, we generated a knock-in (KI) mouse line that carries an epilepsy-associated missense mutation, causing the substitution from Phe to Leu (F251L). Comparing the half-lives of wild-type and mutated TBC1D24 revealed lower stability of the mutated protein. Accordingly, the expression of TBC1D24 protein was reduced by ~50% in the brains of heterozygous mice, and almost no TBC1D24 protein was detected in the homozygous brains. Primary hippocampal neurons were then isolated from the KI mice, followed by transfection with GFP. Compared to wild-type neurons, the homozygous KI neurons display larger dendritic spine heads and increase in mEPSC amplitude without changing the number of excitatory synapses and dendritic spines. Both the knockdown and KI neurons therefore showed altered excitatory synapses and disruption in synaptic transmission upon TBC1D24 deficiency, but the two cellular models display distinct abnormalities. By examining the endogenous TBC1D24 or exogenous FLAG-tagged TBC1D24 in cultured hippocampal neurons, we observed their co-localization with the inhibitory postsynaptic scaffold protein gephyrin in dendrites. To ask how TBC1D24 deficiency affects inhibitory synapses, electrophysiological recording was performed to show that TBC1D24-shRNA significantly reduced the frequency of miniature inhibitory postsynaptic current (mIPSC) in cultured hippocampal neurons. This finding was corroborated by immunostaining with the inhibitory synaptic markers vGAT and Gephyrin, which revealed significant reduction of inhibitory synapse density in both the soma and dendrites. Intriguingly, when we compared the number of inhibitory synapses in hippocampal neurons cultured from KI mice, we observed significantly more inhibitory synapses in both the heterozygous and homozygous Tbc1d24-F251L neurons than that of wild-type littermates. Whole-cell patch recording confirmed significant increase in the amplitude of mIPSC. Our findings suggest that short-term (3-day) depletion of TBC1D24 by shRNA and long-term deficiency due to the disease-mutation have opposite consequences on inhibitory synapses in cultured hippocampal neurons. While TBC1D24 is required for inhibitory synapse formation (as indicated by the shRNA experiments), after prolonged TBC1D24 deficiency due to the point mutation, the elevated excitatory synaptic transmission might cause a compensatory increase in the number and strength of inhibitory synapses, which can serve as a protective response to the neurons. Objective 2 We investigate how disrupting TBC1D24 in vivo affects excitatory and inhibitory synapses as well as animal behaviors. We demonstrated an increase in TBC1D24 expression in the mouse hippocampus along development from postnatal day 7 and maintained in adulthood. Adeno-associated virus (AAV) carrying control- or TBC1D24-shRNA was stereotaxically injected into adult mouse hippocampus. This adult-onset knockdown of TBC1D24 significantly reduced the number of dendritic spines and excitatory synapses in hippocampal CA1 neurons. In contrast, the number of inhibitory synapses were increased after TBC1D24 knockdown in the hippocampus. The control and knockdown mice were also subjected to behavioral tasks testing anxiety (open field and elevated plus maze), memory (contextual fear conditioning) and seizure. Hippocampal knockdown of TBC1D24 leads to hyperactivity of the mice in open field and is associated with increased time spent in the peripheral area, suggesting increased anxiety. Compared with control-shRNA, mice injected with TBC1D24-shRNA exhibit impaired fear learning and memory, as well as increased (albeit not statistically significant) susceptibility to pentylentetrazole-induced seizure. Next, we examined the synaptic phenotypes in the CA1 area of hippocampus and behaviors of the F251L KI mice. Almost all the homozygous mutant mice exhibit spontaneous seizure that led to pre-mature death around postnatal day 21. By measuring the action potentials of neurons in hippocampal slices, we confirmed the neuronal hyperactivity in homozygous mice. In contrast, the heterozygous mice survive normally but showed fewer dendritic spines and smaller Homer1 puncta in the hippocampal CA1 neurons. Compared to wild-type littermates, the fear memory of heterozygous KI mice was also significantly impaired, without showing abnormality in the open field and elevated plus maze. To ask whether defects in inhibitory synapse development might underlie the epilepsy of Tbc1d24 KI mice, we performed electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings in the awake wild-type and homozygous KI mice around postnatal day 21, while at the same time video-recording the animals and hence able to align the EEG with any seizure behaviors. We observed strong epileptiform activities only in the KI mice. Importantly, these electrical activities correlated well with the spontaneous seizures and were detected prior to their death. These findings strongly support our conclusion that spontaneous seizure underlies the pre-mature death of the homozygous KI mice. By performing immunohistochemistry of hippocampal sections at P21, we found that the densities of vGAT and gephyrin puncta were significantly reduced in the Tbc1d24 KI mice, as compared to their wild-type littermates. The defects in inhibitory synapse development of the hippocampus might therefore underlie the spontaneous seizure and death of the homozygous KI mice. This raises the possibility of using allosteric modulator that facilitates inhibitory synaptic transmission as a potential therapeutic strategy. Objective 3 This objective examined if the small GTPase ARF6 acts downstream of TBC1D24 in synapse development of primary neurons. We showed by co-immunoprecipitation in 293T cells that TBC1D24 interacted specifically with ARF6 but not the related small GTPase Rab35. Moreover, the wild-type, dominant-negative (DN) or constitutively-active (CA) ARF6 was transfected with GFP into dissociated hippocampal neurons. Only the CA-ARF6 significantly reduced the number of excitatory synapses, indicating that hyperactive ARF6 inhibits excitatory synapses. Notably, co-expression of DN-ARF6 but not the wild-type counterpart partially reversed the loss of dendritic spines induced by TBC1D24-shRNA, suggesting that TBC1D24 maintains dendritic spines partly through the suppression of ARF6 activity. To further test this notion, neurons were treated with secin-H3, a cytohesin inhibitor that blocks the activity of ARF-family of small GTPases including ARF6. SecinH3 significantly reduced the number of excitatory synapses, yet it partially reversed the reduction of excitatory synapses upon TBC1D24 knockdown. SecinH3 also partially rescued the loss of dendritic spines induced by TBC1D24-shRNA. We further performed pull-down assay of GTP-bound ARF6 to examine whether brain lysate or primary cortical neurons isolated from the Tbc1d24 KI mice show aberrant ARF6 activity. No consistent change in ARF6 activity was observed in the homozygous KI mouse brains or neurons, suggesting that that synaptic defects observed in the KI neurons might not be caused by altered ARF6 activity. Together our findings indicate that the balanced activity of ARF6 is crucial for the development of excitatory synapses in primary hippocampal neurons, and its dysregulation partly contributes to the altered synaptic phenotypes of acute TBC1D24 depletion.

17106018.label: Major findings and research outcome
17106018.value: Perturbation of synapse development underlies many inherited neurodevelopmental disorders. Mutations on the TBC1D24 gene are strongly associated with epilepsy and intellectual disability, but the neuronal function of TBC1D24 is unclear, and very few genetic mouse models are available. Here we uncover the significant function of TBC1D24 in the development of both excitatory and inhibitory synapses. TBC1D24 is present at dendritic spines and is required for the maintenance of dendritic spines and excitatory synapses partly through inhibition of the small GTPase ARF6. Mice subjected to viral-mediated knockdown of TBC1D24 in the adult hippocampus display dendritic spine loss, deficits in contextual fear memory, and abnormal behaviors including hyperactivity and increased anxiety. We further found that the protein stability of TBC1D24 is diminished by the disease-associated missense mutation that leads to F251L amino acid substitution. We generate the F251L knock-in (KI) mice which show much lower TBC1D24 protein expression in the brain than wild-type control. The homozygous KI mice show increased neuronal excitability and spontaneous seizure coupled with pre-mature death, while the heterozygous mutant mice display dendritic spine defects and impaired memory. These findings, which were published in PLoS Genetics (Lin et al. 2020), reveals that impaired excitatory synapse development as a plausible pathophysiological mechanism of the cognitive deficits underlying TBC1D24 gene mutations. The severe epileptic activities of the homozygous KI mice led us to examine possible defects in inhibitory synapses. Indeed, either knockdown of TBC1D24 in cultured hippocampal neurons or depletion of the protein in the KI hippocampus in vivo significantly reduced the number of vGAT/gephyrin puncta. Failure to develop GABAergic synapses due to TBC1D24 depletion might therefore underlie the epileptic activities and seizure of the animals. Through EEG recording of awake animals, we are currently investigating whether chronic low-dose treatment of diazepam, an allosteric modulator of GABAergic synapses, will reduce the occurrence of epileptic activities in the homozygous mice. Manuscript describing how inhibitory synapses are affected by the TBC1D24 knockdown or the F251L mutation is now under preparation (Wang et al.). We expected to submit the manuscript this year after the diazepam treatment and EEG data is available. Tbc1d24 mRNA is present in dendrites, suggesting that it may undergo local translation. Related to this project, we studied another dendritic mRNA that encodes a novel synaptic signaling proteins PRMT8, which we found is able to regulate protein synthesis through methylation of the RNA-binding protein G3BP1. We also elucidate the role of the kinesin motor protein KIF5B in dendritic transport of mRNAs and dendritic spine plasticity. These studies were published in Cell Reports (Lo et al. 2020), under revision for J. Biol. Chem. (Dong et al.), as well as published in eLife (Zhao et al. 2020). Several review articles were also published, including one that discusses the use of human induced pluripotent stem cells to study brain disorders (Lo and Lai, 2020).

17106018.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17106018.value: Up to 30% of patients’ seizures cannot be controlled by existing anti-epileptic drugs (AED) and there is a great need for specific AED for different inherited epileptic patients. Despite intense genetic studies of TBC1D24 in human patients from different countries, there are very few genetic mouse models. More importantly, there is no study so far using any TBC1D24 mutant mouse model to test the effect of AED. The F251L knock-in homozygous mice in our study show pre-mature death around postnatal day 21 which is accompanied with severe spontaneous seizure. We are collaborating with Dr. Geoffrey Lau at City U to perform EEG and video-recording on awake animals and confirm the strong epileptic activities in neurons of the cerebral cortex in homozygous mice right before their death. The F251L KI mouse line therefore represents a valuable animal model for testing the effects of various AED. Since the knock-in mice show decreased number of GABA-mediated inhibitory synapses in the hippocampus, we reason that facilitation of GABAergic transmission by allosteric modulator might reduce the epileptic seizure and improve the survival of the homozygous mutant mice. We will test whether chronic, low-dose treatment of diazepam, an allosteric modulator that enhances GABA-mediated inhibitory synaptic transmission, will have beneficial effects on the survival and seizure behaviors (as indicated by EEG recording of awake animals) of the KI mice. This represents the first study to elucidate the therapeutic strategy for epilepsy associated with Tbc1d24 gene mutations.

17106018.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17106018.value: Disrupted neuronal connections (the synapses) underlie many inherited neurodevelopmental disorders. Numerous mutations on the TBC1D24 gene are observed in patients with epilepsy and intellectual disability, yet the gene function remains unresolved. Here we found that the TBC1D24 protein is present near neuronal synapses in the hippocampus, a brain region critical to memory formation. After preventing the synthesis of TBC1D24 specifically in the hippocampus, the mice performed worse in a memory task that associated fear with an environmental context. We further found that a particular disease-causing mutation that results in only one amino acid change on the TBC1D24 protein can diminish its stability. Mice carrying this mutation on both chromosomes had hyper-excitable hippocampal neurons and died pre-maturely due to spontaneous seizure. Their hippocampi also show reduced number of inhibitory synapses which may underlie the elevated neuronal activities. Mice carrying one copy of the mutated gene survive into adulthood but exhibited poor fear memory with fewer dendritic spines in neurons. Our findings reveal that impaired synapse development may underlie the abnormal brain functions caused by TBC1D24 gene mutations. As many of the patients have drug-resistant epilepsy, our transgenic mice represent a promising animal model to test potential therapeutic targets.

17106318.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17106318.value: 幼兒齲齒是全世界學齡前兒童的一個重要，可以預防的的公共衛生問題。未經治療的齲齒導致牙齒逐漸破壞，伴隨著嚴重的疼痛和不適，影響兒童健康和口腔健康相關的生活質量。在時間和金錢方面，修復蛀牙是非常昂貴的。由於學齡前兒童行為問題，通常必須在全身麻醉下提供治療，從而造成重大的醫療保健負擔。 氟化物是預防齲齒的主要干預劑。對於齲齒風險增加的學齡前兒童，建議定期使用氟化物清漆以防止兒童早期齲齒。氟化物通過吸收唾液中的鈣和磷酸鹽，阻止牙釉質礦質損失，並促進 再礦化。然而唾液的淨再礦化是受到鈣和磷酸鹽離子的可用性限制，導致主要表面再礦化，但 這可能不會改善更深結構特性的齲齒病變。要解決這些問題，最近已開發新型氟化鈉（NaF）清漆。清漆含有生物可利用的鈣和磷酸，通過提供額外的口內鈣和磷酸鹽離子，增強牙釉質亞表面，在齲齒挑戰期間再礦化。然而，沒有臨床試驗評估這些新清漆在預防齲齒方面的臨床效果。 在這項為期24個月的雙盲，隨機，平行組試驗中，我們旨在比較兩種不同類型的含鈣和磷酸鹽的NaF清漆與傳統NaF清漆在預防齲齒方面的臨床效果。測試的兩種含鈣和磷酸鹽的氟化物清漆是（i）5％NaF和磷酸三鈣（ClinproTM White Varnish）和（ii）5％NaF和酪蛋白磷酸肽穩定的無定形磷酸鈣（CPP-ACP）（MI Varnish TM） 。常規的5％NaF清漆（Duraphat®清漆）將用作陽性對照。研究地點是香港的幼稚園。研究人群是3-4歲，具有高齲牙風險的學齡前兒童。根據美國兒科牙科學會的指引，齲齒風險較高的學齡前兒童，應每3個月使用氟化物清漆。主要結果將是24個月研究期間兒童的新齲齒發展。次要結果將是變異鏈球菌生長和基線後2年的唾液緩衝能力。 在學齡前兒童中預防兒童早期齲齒是全世界公共衛生的優先事項。這項跨學科研究的結果將為兒童早期齲齒預防提供基於證據的最佳實踐，並顯著改善我們兒童患者的口腔健康和福祉。

17106318.label: Realisation of objectives
17106318.value: The objective of the project had been completely achieved. However, Covid 19- pandemic had some impact on the research project. The pandemic affected my research project in four major areas: (i) a higher dropout rate, (ii) change in fluoride varnish application frequency, (iii) delay in research completion date and (iv) inability to present at conferences. The 36-month research project has been extended for 6 months from 31-10-2021 to 30-4-2022 to allow more time for completion of the study due to limited access to kindergartens during the pandemic. A total of 381 children completed the 24-month study with an overall retention rate of 66%. The reason for this higher loss to follow-up was the refusal of parents to continue with the trial due to COVID-19 pandemic, closure of the kindergartens and the inability to contact the children. Our study intended to follow the regimen of fluoride varnish application 4 times a year to prevent caries in high-risk group children as recommended by current clinical guidelines and previous clinical trials. However, none of the recruited children could receive their programmed fluoride varnish applications every three months due to kindergarten closures. The total number of applications received varied from 3 to 6. Hence, addition statistical analysis was performed. Pearson’s correlation coefficient was used to assess the correlation between the number of fluoride applications and the cavitated and non-cavitated lesions increments. In terms of research presentations, the pandemic hit the worst possible time; only 4 abstracts were presented at annual meeting/session of International Association for Dental Research, International Association of Paediatric Dentistry and American Academy of Paediatric Dentistry in 2020-2023, respectively.

17106318.label: Major findings and research outcome
17106318.value: Early childhood caries (ECC) is a worldwide health issue. Topical fluoride is the most recommended preventive strategy for ECC and among the varnishes, 5% sodium fluoride (NaF) is the gold standard. The aim of the clinical trial was to compare the effectiveness of two 5% NaF commercial varnishes containing casein phosphopeptide amorphous calcium phosphate (CPP-ACP) (ClinproTM White) or tricalcium phosphate (TCP) (MI Varnish TM), to the conventional 5% NaF varnish (Duraphat®) in preventing ECC in high caries-risk preschool children. A double-blinded, randomized controlled trial recruited healthy 3-4 years old children having at least one carious lesion (pre-cavitated or cavitated). Children were randomly assigned to one of the 3 groups, and allocation was concealed: Control group (n=196): 5% NaF varnish (Duraphat®) or the two test groups: 5% NaF with TCP (ClinproTM White) (n=193) and 5% NaF varnish with CPP-ACP (MI Varnish TM) (n=193) to receive a quarterly application of the varnish over a 24-month follow-up. The incidence and the increment of both cavitated and non-cavitated carious lesions were measured using Independent-Samples Kruskal-Wallis Test. Zero-inflated negative binomial (ZINB) model was used to analyse the association between caries increment and selected independent variables at an alpha of 0.05. A total of 582 children with at least one carious lesion were recruited at baseline (T1) and randomly allocated into one of the three intervention groups: Group 1 (Control, n=196)- 5% NaF, Group 2 (Test, n=193)- 5% NaF with TCP, Group 3 (Test, n=193)- 5% NaF with CPP-ACP. A total of 381 children remained at 24 months (T2), and no significant difference was found among the three intervention groups for the incidence and increment of cavitated and non-cavitated carious lesions. A subgroup of 135 children were randomly selected and grouped (n=45) according to their caries status: caries-free, with only non-cavitated lesions and with cavitated lesions. They were further subdivided into three fluoride varnish intervention groups (n=15) and the effect of the varnishes on S. mutans and L. fermentum count in saliva and biofilm samples of children collected at T1 and T2 were investigated. No significant difference in salivary and biofilm bacterial levels was observed among the groups according to children’s caries status. In conclusion, the two calcium- and phosphate-containing NaF varnishes were equally effective in preventing ECC in high-risk preschool children and demonstrated a similar antibacterial effect on S. mutans and L. fermentum counts in both saliva and biofilm as the conventional NaF varnish.

17106318.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17106318.value: Further studies can be conducted in other high caries risk group e.g. orthodontic patients to compare the effectiveness of two 5% NaF commercial varnishes containing casein phosphopeptide amorphous calcium phosphate (CPP-ACP) (ClinproTM White) or tricalcium phosphate (TCP) (MI Varnish TM), to the conventional 5% NaF varnish (Duraphat®) in the prevention and remineralization of white spot lesions (WSLs) around orthodontic brackets during and after debonding. Conversely, we can also compare the 3 varnishes in the arrest and reversal of root caries in xerostomic patients or in the elderlies. Furthermore, the multifactorial nature of ECC cannot be neglected when planning for a preventive program. Therefore, comprehensive planning is needed in future studies considering oral hygiene, dietary and microbiological factors to achieve maximum benefit from the public health program.

17106718.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17106718.value: 鼻咽癌是一種具有局部侵略性的頭頸癌，它起源於鼻咽上皮細胞並經常轉移至頸部淋巴結和遠端器官如骨骼，肺和肝，以中國南方包括香港發病率和流行率最高的地區。大多數鼻咽癌患者被診斷已為晚期III至IV期，鼻咽癌在早期階段大多是沒有症狀。放射治療或配合同步放化療是這種癌症的主要治療依據。儘管所有這些積極的根治性治療，這些患者中30-50％仍然局部或遠端復發。但是到目前為止仍然沒有對這種疾病的有效靶向治療或免疫療法，雖然這些靶向治療或免疫療法的臨床試驗正在進行中。 直到最近鼻咽癌的遺傳變異包括細胞突變，染色體異常和基因易位和重排的發現令我們，變清楚認識這個病。有趣的是，很多眾所周知的致癌基因很少在鼻咽癌中發現突變。我們的團隊一直都在研究鼻咽癌基因鑑定以及最近通過下一代測序發現參與調節NF-kB途徑的機制。然而，(1)這些基因變異如何在鼻咽癌癌細胞內部共存和(2)不同亞克隆族群的組合於放化療復發和轉移時的演變模式仍然存在疑問。這些問題對於研究治療初發及復發鼻咽癌極為重要。 在我們的提議中，我們計劃(1)研究鼻咽癌腫瘤異質性和克隆進化過程(2)鑑定有關這些基因改變和進化軌跡與臨床病理學數據和生存結果的關係。我們的研究結果將有助於遺傳異質性不同鼻咽癌亞群的進化軌跡對治療方向的啟發，並提供個性化的指導治療策略，以加強腫瘤根治和減少盲目使用化療所帶來的好處。
