17304018.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17304018.value: The planetary nebula (PN) luminosity function (PNLF) is a powerful standard candle. The PNLF, constructed from how bright a population of PNe appears in the doubly-ionised oxygen emission line ([OIII]), has the major advantage of working across all Galaxy types whether spiral, elliptical or irregular. It has provided reliable distances to > 60 galaxies from local systems out to members of the Coma Cluster at > 100 Mega parsecs (Mpc). How and why it works so well has been an on-going conundrum. However, recent advances by our group are shedding important light on this issue via adoption of accelerated evolution models and the possibility of a reduced mass range that populates the sharp, bright end cut-off. This is invariant to galaxy type, age and effectively metallicity. Until recently the [OIII] bright PNe that define the PNLF cut-off were supposed to derive from higher mass progenitor stars that have much shorter lifetimes on the main sequence and go through the PN phase within 1-2 Giga-years (Gyrs) post birth. PNe from such stars should not exist in elliptical galaxies dominated by old stellar populations of ~10 Gyrs and yet they are detected. A solution has been proposed where the brightest PNe are created by progenitors 1.1M⊙ < Mi < 2M⊙, which have nearly the same post-AGB stellar luminosity, log(LpAGB/L⊙) = 3.75 ± 0.13, and have total ages from 1 to 7 Gyr. The masses are much lower than was required in older models. The presence of such PNe near the cut-off over a wide age range of stellar populations would solve the long standing mystery of the observed PNLF cut-off invariance. Identifying more clearly the PN at the PNLF cut-off is fundamental to verifying this new model. We will undertake an investigation of the PNLF to address this problem by study of PNe in the Galactic Bulge and Large Magellanic Cloud. They represent co-located populations at known distances of ~8 and 51 kiloparsecs, (kpc), sufficiently close for detailed investigation. We will determine the nature and origin of the PNe at the PNLF tip. The PNLFs in each system will be examined to also study the so-called “Jacoby dips” found in PNLFs ~3 magnitudes below the bright-end cut-off. We have shown that we can also reproduce this feature in our models for a constant SFH or a SFH truncated at 4 Gyr but further study and confirmation is required. 行星状星云（PN）光度函数（PNLF）是一种强大的标准蜡烛。 PNLF是由PNe的人群在双重化中出现的 氧气排放线（[OIII]），具有跨所有工作的主要优点 星系类型是螺旋形，椭圆形还是不规则形。它提供了可靠的距离> 从当地系统的60个星系到> 100兆的昏迷群集成员 parsecs（Mpc）。它如何以及为何如此有效地运作一直是一个持续的难题。 然而，我们小组最近的进展正在通过这个问题重新阐明 采用加速演化模型和质量范围缩小的可能性 它填充了尖锐，明亮的截止点。这对于星系类型，年龄和星系都是不变的 有效的金属性。直到最近，[OIII]明亮的PNe定义了PNLF截止 应该来自更高质量的祖先星，它们更短 主序列的生命周期，并在1-2千兆年内经历PN阶段 （Gyrs）出生后。来自这些恒星的PNe不应该存在于椭圆星系中占主导地位 通过~10 Gyrs的老恒星种群，但它们被检测到。已经有了解决方案 提出最明亮的PNe是由祖先创建的1.1M⊙

17304018.label: Major findings and research outcome
17304018.value: There have been several scientific results worthy of note that have come out of the research efforts supported by this grant. 1. We were able to add an important point to the initial to final mass relation for low to intermediate mass stars from our investigation of the central star of the PN in the old Galactic open cluster AL1 that is independent of cluster white dwarfs. 2. We were able to provide fresh insights into the Age of stars in the Galactic Bulge as this has direct bearing on the bright end of the PNLF and objectives 1 and 2 3. An improved radio technique was developed that provides reliable and accurate angular size estimates for PN in obscured regions that is relevant to objective 4 4. We collaborated on obtaining H-alpha fluxes and extinction distances for significant numbers of PN in the Northern Galactic Plane which will provide data to various of our objectives 5. In some remarkable related work on astro-quantum chemistry we have shown that C60 fullerene can remain stable even when highly ionized (as is sometimes possible from the extremely hot central stars of some PNe) 6. We undertook a preliminary study of Central Stars in Planetary nebulae (CSPN) and compared our HASH determinations with those reported based on studies from the Gaia satellite data. Our work showed that there are some serious problems with the Gaia identified CSPN with 10-15% contamination as Gaia identified the incorrect CSPN. Gaia simply does not go deep enough to see the true CSPN in such cases but we have data that does. 7. I produced an important review of PNe and how to find them in 2022 that is being well cited and helps identify and remove contaminants that effect the properties of the PNLF and so is relevant to all the objectives. 8. 17304018.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17304018.value: Planetary nebulae (PNe), the ejected ionised envelopes of dying stars, are amongst the most beautiful and complex of astrophysical sources but also amongst the most important to understand. This is because their short lifetimes (perhaps only 10,000-30,000 years) provide unique insights into the late-stage evolution of low- to intermediate-mass stars (~1-8Msun). They are important probes of nucleosynthesis processes, mass-loss physics and Galactic abundance gradients. Their progenitor stars dominate all stars above one solar mass, so PNe, via their ejecta, are responsible for a large fraction of the chemical enrichment of the interstellar medium. Furthermore, their rich, strong emission-line spectra enable detection to large distances. PNe are in fact the main observable tracer of low-mass stars at larger distances. The emission lines allow the determination and analysis of chemical abundances and permit the estimation of shell expansion velocities and ages, so probing the physics and timescales of stellar mass loss. The measured radial velocities can trace the kinematic properties of observed PN, enabling us to determine if they belong to a younger or older stellar population. They directly probe Galactic stellar and chemical evolution. Their complex morphologies provide clues to their formation, evolution, mass-loss processes, and possible shaping role by magnetic fields and binary central stars.

17304318.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17304318.value: Layered phosphorus thin films are of great current research interests for their appealing physical properties and application promises. Phosphorene, a single layer phosphorus, exhibits high carrier mobility, strong optical absorption and anisotropic mechanical and electronic characteristics. Black phosphorene has been successfully isolated by exfoliation from bulk crystals, from which some interesting properties have been unveiled by transport and optical studies. For application purposes, however, exfoliated samples are not adequate. It is highly desirable to develop direct epitaxial methods for wafer size sample growth. Blue phosphorene, an allotrope of phosphorus, shares a similar layered structure and appealing electronic properties with black phosphorene, which has attracted some recent theoretical studies. Besides black and blue phosphorene, there are also other types of phosphorus having layered structures. Experimental verification of these are yet to be documented. In this proposal, we plan to carry out a systematic study of epitaxial phosphorus by molecular-beam epitaxy (MBE). By employing reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED), scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy (STM/S), photoemission spectroscopy and other techniques, we aim to firstly achieve epitaxial phosphorene and unlock the growth mechanisms. Secondly, we shall investigate the fundamental properties of substrate-supported phosphorene and examine the effect of defect, doping and strain. We shall supplement the experiments by density functional theory (DFT) calculations in the project. It is hoped that this research will lead to important findings that can contribute to the advancement of phosphorene research and provide valuable references for future device explorations of the material. 層狀磷薄膜，因其吸引人的物理特性及應用前景而為人們所廣泛研究。磷烯，一個磷單原子層，其具有高的載流子遷移率，強的光學吸收和各向異性機械與電子特性。黑磷磷烯已成功從塊狀晶體剝離出來，並用此通過運輸和光學研究方法揭示出了一些有趣的性質。然而，出於應用的目的，靠剝離獲得磷烯的樣品不能滿足要求。開發用於晶片尺寸樣品的外延生長從而是十分必要的。藍磷磷烯是黑磷的同素異形體，其具有類似於黑磷烯的層狀結構和吸引人的電子特性，故其吸引了近期的一些理論研究。除了黑鱗和藍磷磷烯外，磷元素還存在其他的層狀結構而等待實驗上的實現與驗証。 於該項目中， 我們計劃通過分子束外延（MBE）手段對磷烯的外延制備進行系統的探討。通過採用反射高能電子衍射（RHEED），掃描隧道顯微鏡和隧穿譜（STM / S），光電子能譜及其他手段，我們將首先實現磷烯的外延生長並闡明其生長機制，其次，我們將對襯底上磷烯薄膜的基本物性，以及缺陷、摻雜和應變對物性的影響等進行研究。我們將進行密度泛函理論（DFT）計算來支持實驗。通過該項目的研究，我們希望發現一些重要結果並促進磷烯研究的進一步發展，也為未來該材料用於器件應用提供有價值參考。

17304318.label: Realisation of objectives
17304318.value: The project is on a study of epitaxial phosphorene by the method of molecular-beam epitaxy (MBE), aiming to achieve epitaxial phosphorene, to understand the growth mechanism and the effect of substrate, to probe the atomic and electronic characteristics and doping and strain effects. To achieve these goal, we have firstly modified the experimental setup for substrate sputtering and better control of phosphorus flux. We then carried out experiments of P deposition by MBE on Au, Pt and some other substrates (GaN, MoSe2), probed the atomic and electronic properties by low-temperature scanning tunneling microcopy/spectroscopy (STM/S) and supplemented by density functional theory (DFT) studies in collaboration with Prof. H. Xu at SUSTech, China. Objective 1 is considered fully achieved. We successfully made phosphorus deposition on Au, Pt and MoSe2 substrates. On Au, the deposit resembled that of blue phosphorene - a single-layer blue phosphorus according to previous literature reports. On Pt, a rich family of structures were discovered, while on MoSe2, an unknown new phase of the material was observed. Aided by DFT calculations, we established the atomic details of the 'blue phosphorene' epilayer, which was consisted of patches of blue-phosphorene linked by Au atoms, forming a two-dimensional (2D) gold-phosphorus network (AuPhoN), thereby resolved an outstanding issue about the origin of the hexapetalous-flower-like superstructure. On Pt, a rich family of surface structures were unveiled, some of which were found to share the same building block - the Pt4P nanoblock. They showed similar formation energies and thus experimentally accessible. Our work corrected a previous model of one such structures. The mechanisms of AuPhoN formation and growth were established by following the initial stage deposition and by DFT investigation, and a comparison of the deposit on different substrate suggested strong interaction between the deposit and metal substrates. Objective 2 is almost fully achieved. As described above, we unlocked the atomic structures of epitaxial P on Au and Pt substrates. Besides, their electronic characteristics was characterized by low-temperature STS as well as by the DFT calculations. We examined the effect of different metal dopants, the linking atoms in MPhoN and noted metallic, semiconducting and even a topological insulating phase upon doping different metal elements. We also experimentally observed a novel structure upon P deposition on MoSe2, which supposedly involved Se atoms, despite its precise atomic identity remains unresolved and requires further microscopic and theoretical studies. For the strain effect, we attempted to use patterned substrates and unfortunately, no reliable result was obtained. Effort could continuously be made along the direction.

17304318.label: Major findings and research outcome
17304318.value: 1. Blue-phosphorene like structures consistent with the literature was grown on Au. A family of P induced structures were obtained by deposition on Pt. 2. By combinations of STM and DFT, we unlocked the atomic identity of the blue-phosphorene like structure on Au, proposed a new model of two dimensional gold-phosphorous network (AuPhoN). By following the initial stage deposition and by the DFT calculations, we further established the mechanism of AuPhoN formation and growth. The work was published in 'Matter' (publication 1), which was highlighted for a preview (Matter 2, 13, 2020). Our proposed model correctly resolved an outstanding issue about the hexapetalous-flower-like superstructure in the epifilm, and has subsequently been confirmed by other works through different approaches. 3. A family of structures was unveiled by P deposition on Pt. Aided by DFT calculations, we unlocked their atomic origin, particularly corrected a previous interpretation of one of the structures. We identified the basic building block, the Pt4P nano-block, which are arranged differently to give rise to the variations of structures seen in experiments. The mechanism and energetics of these various structures are established (publication 2). 3. We revealed other new structures by P deposition on Pt as well as on MoSe2. In particular, the new phase of P grown on MoSe2 likely involved Se dopant and weakly coupled to MoSe2 substrate. The atomic identities of these however remain elusive, inviting further studies.

17304318.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17304318.value: As noted above, there remain unresolved issues and unanswered questions requiring further attention and investigations. One is the identities some new structures found, in particular that on MoSe2 substrates, as it coupled weakly with the substrate and might be isolated for nano-device applications. Another issue is how to effectively introduce sizable strain to tune the electronic properties. Indeed, introducing strain in 2D materials can be important topics in future research, as some recent studies of strained transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers exhibited superior electronic properties (e.g., high electrical carrier mobility).

17304318.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17304318.value: Single atomic-layer phosphorus (P), called phosphorene, has attracted a lot of research attentions recently. It has been successfully obtained by exfoliation from bulk crystals. However, for application purposes, direct growth of phosphorene will be highly desirable. Attempts were thus made and blue-phosphorene epilayers were reported obtained lately. However, there are discrepancies between theory and experiments, and more studies are invited. In this project, we set out to deposit P on different substrates by the technique of molecular-beam epitaxy and to probe the atomic details and growth mechanisms by scanning tunneling microscopy and density functional theory. We found that while Au and Pt substrates would support P deposition, the epilayers were more complicated than a simple phosphorene layer. For example, on Au, it consisted of blue-P patches stitched by Au atoms, forming a metal-phosphorus network (MPhoN). On Pt, an even richer structural variation was revealed, some of which shared a common building unit, the Pt4P nanoblocks. These findings not only resolved some outstanding issues or discrepancies in the literature, but also uncovered new phases. By changing the metal atoms, we showed that MPhoN may exhibit different electronic behaviors, so there can be a rich physics and application promises.

17304518.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17304518.value: Many-body effect is one of the most focused themes in condensed matter physics. The emerging two dimensional atomic crystals featuring an enhanced Coulomb interaction and a truly spatial confined two dimension system provide a new platform to explore many-body physics in low dimensions. Exciton, a quasiparticle of the bounded electron-hole pair, in 2D semiconductors is expected to robust against small energy perturbation owing to reduced Coulomb screening. As a composite boson, exciton behaves differently from individual electrons and triggers persistent interests in condensed matter physics. This proposal aims to experimentally study many-body effects on excitons in 2D atomic crystals. The interactions between excitons will be probed in 2D transitional mental dichalcogenide (TMD) and monochalcogenides with optical spectroscopic techniques. The goal is to experimentally reveal the exciton-exciton interactions and explore the potential phase transitions in 2D system. 凝聚態物理中多體問題是一個重要的研究方向。在二維原子晶體中由於隨著維度減低帶來的空間束縛效應和增強的庫倫作用，多體問題尤為突出。 作為准粒子的束縛電子空穴對，通常稱為激子，經常主導了二維體系的光學響應。隨著激子密度的增大，多體作用必然明顯的影響這激子的行為。這在二維體系中尤為明顯。本研究計劃規劃利用半導體光學手段研究在二維過渡金屬硫屬化物中的激子行為。研究關注於激子-激子相互作用， 探索可能的在二維體系中的相變行為。

17304518.label: Major findings and research outcome
17304518.value: 1. We successfully explored the exciton dynamics in monolayer WS2 with pump-probe spectroscopy. We probed the excited states of band-edge excitons and consequently mapped the exciton relaxation process in momentum space. We concluded that the strong Coulomb interaction thermalizes hot excitons within sub-picosecond. The work was published in 2D Materials 6 (2), 025035 • 2. We study the photoluminescence spectra of monolayer MoSe2 with photoluminescence excitation spectroscopy. We observed the PL linewidth increases with the increased excitation energy even at low excitation intensity (diluted exciton density) and a high energy tail rises at high excitation energy. We concluded the acoustic phonon scattering contributes to the high energy tail in PL spectra and hot exciton effect is significant even in linear regime. The effective exciton temperature could be tuned by excitation energy. This nontrivial behaviour results from 2D nature and strong exciton-phonon scattering. The work was published in Natural Science doi.org/10.1002/ntls.20220035. 3. We study the exciton-exciton interaction with probing the energy difference between the ground and excited states of band-edge exciton of monolayer MoSe2. The energy difference between 1s and 2s states is immune to the bandgap normalization and reflects the exciton-exciton interaction. We observed the decreased exciton binding energy with the lifted exciton density. We attribute the exciton-exciton interactions leads to the polarization of excitons and we obtained the polarizability of excitons. With the 2D exciton model with modified Keldysh potential, we extract the effect of exciton-exciton interactions on bandgap renormalization and exciton binding energy. The work demonstrates many-body effect in exciton-exciton interactions. The work is under review.

17304518.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17304518.value: We identified the hot exciton effect and exciton-exciton interaction induced polarizability in monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) in this project. These findings lead to more understanding how to realize "cooled" excitons and how to modulated exciton resonance energy with exciton density. With the finding above, we are going to explore potential exciton phase transition with resonance optical pumping and the coupling of exciton-surface plasmon polariton. The high density ground state exciton is to be sought with resonant pumping and TMD heterostructures. The potential exciton phase such as exciton plasmon, exciton droplet, exciton liquid are to be explored. Our present research revealed the exciton-exciton interactions at low exciton density where the inter-exciton spacing is significantly larger than its Bohr radius. The exciton-exciton interaction and electron-electron of adjacent excitons were not involved. In the following up research plan, the exciton-exciton interaction at high exciton density is to be studied to address the exchange interactions of exciton-exciton and electron-electron.

17304518.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17304518.value: The exciton is a quasiparticle of the Coulomb bounded electron-hole pairs and could be treated as a composite particle. The exciton in 2D semiconductors dominates its optical properties in many aspects. The interplay of exciton-exciton in 2D system carries the curiosity in condensed matter physics and has the potential interests in optoelectronics and quantum optics. The project is to address the fundamental questions related to the exciton-exciton interactions in the most prominent 2D semiconductors- monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides. In this project, we revealed the exciton cooling process and exciton-exciton induced polarizability which induces the exciton resonant energy change. The findings are both valuable for fundamental research in 2D semiconductors and potential optoelectronic applications.

17304618.value: 最近, 越來越多的研究旨在使用低成本納米加工方式構建生物醫學可用的納米機器，各種以類比運動藻類/細菌自推進人工微/納米粒子被合成出來。在化學家、物理學家和電氣工程師的共同努力下, 在過去數十年中, 這一領域取得了很多重大進展。許多納米機器原型已經在從分子尺度到微米尺度上被證明可行。同時由於潛在的對生物醫藥產業和傳統制造業進行革命性的應用, 在細胞和亞細胞尺度的納米機器人研究尤其值得關注。 然而, 目前的微米/納米機器系統面臨著一些嚴重的難題挑戰, 並阻礙了它們潛在的廣泛應用。其中, 提高微米/納米機器的生物相容性最關鍵。由於微米/納米機器系統需要在體內環境中工作，有毒燃料不能應用，同時微米/納米機器需要在高鹽度和有其他生物溶質 (如蛋白質和酶) 的體液中工作。而這本質上是由於基本物理定律所定義。 在這項研究中, 我們的目標是通過探索高Dukhin數條件下的電泳理論來解決這一具有挑戰性的問題，從而實現納米機器與生物相關的介質相容。通過對具有高電導率的聚合物電解質或金屬-有機框架對納米機器系統進行塗敷, 我們期望提高納米器件對電解質的耐受能力。 近年來, 我們已經成功開發世界上第一個可編程的納米樹結構納米機器人；可多通道同時控制的光控制納米機器人。在這項研究中我們希望進一步開發生物相容的可以在類比體液中工作的microswimmers。此外, 我們還將通過開發新仿真工具, 以瞭解基本的物資傳輸以及納米馬達的表面的化學和物理性質, 以促進下一代 microswimmer 系統的設計。 我們還將把這一最先進的研究與我們正在進行的教育、培訓結合起來, 給予本科生參與開創性研究的機會, 並通過科學日等活動積極增進對公眾對科學的興趣。

17304618.label: Realisation of objectives
17304618.value: This research is trying to address 5 objectives, where most of them has been fully or exceedingly realized as detailed bellow: 1. Develop high-efficiency light powered micro/nanomotor based on dye sensitized TiO2 which response to visible illumination 2. Develop technique to independent control multiple micro/nanomotors Objectives 1 and 2 are realized by proving that dye-sensitized TiO2 nanomotor demonstrated in aqueous solution, which can be independently addressed with different colors of light. In this work, three different dyes of different absorption spectral is selectively loaded onto the nanotree microswimmer. This is the world-first multicolor controllable nanorobot system. The work is published on Nature Communications (Nat. Commun. 8, (1), 1438). Furthermore, we developed a full spectrum tunable nanomotor system based on the alloyed nanowire, which enables the response spectrum from blue to infrared sensitivity. The work is published on Advanced Functional Materials ( Adv. Funct. Mater. 29, 1901768 (2019)) Additionally, the independent control is also realized with the polarization control mechanism. In this work, a Sb2Se3 nanowire is used, which can strongly respond to linear polarized light. By incorporating two polarizing sensitivity nanomotor, we developed the world's first polarization navigated nanorobot. This work is published on Advanced Materials (Adv. Mater. 1903329) 3. Develop silicon-based micro/nanomotor powered by ultra-low intensity visible and infrared illumination This objective is fully realized with publication on Advanced Materials (Adv. Mater.29, (30), 1701451), where infrared light can be used to power the nanomotor. However, as our research found the energy transfer process is not efficient, we switched our research to the mechanism study and tried to enhance the propulsion efficiency, as the research target 5. 4. Develop optical and fluid dynamic simulation protocol to evaluate light-powered micro/nanomotor This objective is partially realized, where the numerical simulation is used to simulate the propulsion of nanomotor. However, due to limited funding support, no software development is realized. Only a commercial software package is used. 5. Develop bio-compatible redox shuttle for light-powered micro/nanomotor This objective is partially realized, where we studied the energy conversion mechanism in nanomotor propulsion and find a high conversion efficiency, low toxicity redox for biocompatible propulsion. The work is published on ACS Nano (ACS Nano 14, 3, 3272-3280 (2020)). However, this research only addressed the fundamental mechanism due to insufficient funding, which gives a guideline of how to design bio-compatible redox without optimizing the chemical structures. The discovered redox couple is currently commercially available chemicals, while the designed targeted compound is not synthesized.

17304618.label: Major findings and research outcome
17304618.value: In this research, we successfully developed a theory for light-propelled nanomotor and developed a series of controlling mechanisms to navigate the nanomotor inside a complex environment. With this development, we have demonstrated high degree of freedom controlling nanorobot and enhanced the propulsion efficiency of previous light-controlled nanomotor by over 100 times. These findings prepared well for the next level of research for biological compatible nanorobot and application for medical research and beyond. Based on our theory, multiple international groups has developed in-vivo nanorobot system which shows efficacy for biomedical treatment. Due to the limited time and funding, this research is mainly focused on fundamental mechanism study and proof-of-concept prototype, where we find it is possible to design nanorobot working in biocompatible environments and control them for designed functions. Additional indepth development for medical research maybe continues in the future with new funding support.

17304618.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17304618.value: In this research, we developed nanorobot and nanomotor on single-particle level, where the detailed control can be realized. In principle, the biocompatible microswimmer and nanorobotic system can be designed and tested. The next stage of research can be extended into more applied research in two directions: 1. The application of single nanomotor. Although in this research, we demonstrated the nanomotor in a biocompatible environment, it is still a challenge to incorporate all demonstrated functions into single nanorobot. Further research is needed to further integrate our findings and optimize the material system for applicable nanorobot. It is also likely to find novel functions for nanorobot system beyond single nanorobot. 2. The development of nanoswarm. This research developed the nanomotors and robot on single-particle level, it is interesting and important to study how to establish an effective collaboration mechanism between nanorobots and create nanoswarm. As a complex system, many nanorobot can work together for more complex functions, while this mechanism is not available in the current system.

17304618.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17304618.value: This research brings dreamed nanorobot a step closer to reality, where we demonstrated micrometer-scale robot could be controlled/navigated and assembled in a complexed environment which is compatible with cells. Particularly, we demonstrated that the light can be used as a perfect tools for controlling nanorobot with complex maneuvers as well as high-efficiency power sources to propel nanorobot swim at high speed.

17304918.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17304918.value: 原子核的基石概念正如榮獲諾貝爾獎的相關工作中所描述的那樣,獨立核子是由核平均場勢加上核子-核子之間相互作用產生的自旋軌道效應保持在壹起。由此，誕生了描述原子核的最重要的基礎模型-原子核的殼模型。該模型成功地描述了核結構的系統和特定特征。然而, 最近的研究發現了壹些核的特征類似於分子,其內部形成了質子和中子會形成的小型集團結構。例如，核內核子傾向於形成玻色子α集團結構（兩個質子和兩個中子組成）;以及部分核內中子傾向於形成多中子集團結構。這些有趣的現象挑戰了我們對原子核的基本相互作用的理解,並揭示了在原子核中起主導作用的核力的新方面。 本項目側重於兩個相互關聯的科學目標： •奇異核中新的α集團結構特性研究 •尋找多中子集團結構態（“中性核”） 本項目的首要目標是通過(p,pα)準彈性散射的方法研究豐中子的鈹同位素10,12,14Be 中 α 集團結構的特性。之所以選擇這些特殊的鈹同位素的原因是因為8Be（N = 4，Z = 4）原子核有著名的α-α結構,而這個α-α核心在超越經典模型中被預測仍然存在於10,12,14Be中, 剩余的中子占據了周圍分子軌道。第二個物理目標是通過同樣的(p,pα)反應在14Be上第壹次探究六中子系統“六中子”存在。這個物理目標是受到在較少豐中子的Be中發現四中子系統的研究的啟發。 本提案中的實驗數據可以對在核內集團結構以及多體系統方面提供重要的理解,開啟原子核力研究的新窗口。實驗采用的方法可以對目標進行直接測量並定量物理結果。實驗所關註的反應由奇異核Be束打到純固態氫靶上產生。實驗將在能夠提供世界上最強的豐中子Be同位素的RIBF, RIKEN進行。相關實驗已經獲得批準,並且擁有A級的優先級。大直徑厚固體氫靶可以和RIKEN提供的束流相適配,滿足實驗對統計方面的要求。此外，在實驗中應用的SAMURAI光譜儀具有大接受度和高分辨的特性。這些裝置和靶周圍帶電粒子探測系統相結合可以對我們的物理目標進行針對性測量。

17304918.label: Realisation of objectives
17304918.value: The cluster structure of the neutron-rich isotope 10,12,14Be has been probed via the (p,pα) reaction at 150 MeV/u in inverse kinematics and in quasifree conditions at RIKEN. The populated states of 6,8,10He were investigated through missing mass spectroscopy. The triple differential cross-section for the ground- state transition was extracted for quasifree angle pairs (θp, θα) and compared to distorted-wave impulse approximation reaction calculations performed in a microscopic framework using successively the Tohsaki-Horiuchi-Schuck-Ro ̈pke product wave-function and the wave-function deduced from Antisymmetrized Molecular Dynamics calculations. For 10Be case, the remarkable agreement between DWIA calculated and measured cross-sections in both shape and magnitude validates the description of the 10Be ground-state as a rather compact nuclear molecule. More theoretical investigations are being carried out to understand the underlying physics of 12,14Be systems. On the other hand, 6-neutron data was analysed and relevant calculations are being discussed for firm conclusions.

17304918.label: Major findings and research outcome
17304918.value: The alpha-cluster structure of an unstable neutron-rich nuclei, 10,12,14Be, has been investigated by measuring for the first time the TDX of the (p,pα) re- action in inverse kinematics with a setup allowing inclusion of the recoilless condition. For 10Be case, double differential cross-sections to the ground and 2+ states of the 6He residue have also been extracted. Obtained data have been compared with cross-section calculations performed within a microscopic DWIA framework involving up-to- date alpha-cluster wave functions, describing the ground- state in terms of a dumbbell-shaped two-alpha core (with moderate extension) surrounded by two neutrons occupying π orbit. A remarkable agreement in both shape and magnitude between the experimental and calculated TDX for the 10 Be(p, pα)6 He(g.s.). Due to the previously established sensitivity of the TDX to the extension of the alpha wave-function in the ground-state of 10Be, our results provide direct experimental evidence of the above molecular structure of 10Be implemented in the THSR approach, and validated by the general AMD framework. In the latter, this cluster structure emerges from the details of the nuclear mean field. Concerning the double differential cross-sections to the g.s. and 2+ states of the residue, a good agreement between calculations and experimental results is found. A consistent picture is then obtained.

17304918.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17304918.value: We successfully obtained direct evidence for the molecular structure of the neutron-rich nucleus 10Be ground-state using (p,p-alpha) for the first time. The experimental technique and physics interpretation serve as a benchmark and solid foundation to extend the alpha-clustering study to other exotic nuclei. Proposal on heavier isotopes is planned at RIKEN for future.

17304918.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17304918.value: The cornerstone concept for the description of a nucleus, as in Nobel Prize work, is the independent nucleons being held together by the nuclear mean-field potential plus strong spin-orbit effect generated by nucleon-nucleon interactions. However, recent studies have discovered some nuclei behave like molecules composed of clusters of protons and neutrons which challenge our understanding.We investigated the alpha (α) clustering structure of neutron-rich Beryllium isotopes 10,12,14Be using (p,pα) cluster quasi-free scattering reactions at RIKEN for the first time. We successfully obtained direct evidence for the molecular structure of the neutron-rich nucleus 10Be ground-state. Similar physics conclusion is being finalised for 12,14Be. This work demonstrates a new approach to probe alpha-clustering of exotic nuclei which serves as solid foundation for studies of heavier nuclei.

17305018.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305018.value: Nowadays, many insurance companies and financial institutions are involved in trading variable annuities and equity-indexed insurance contracts. The contractual structures of these products are more sophisticated than traditional insurance products. In particular, these products contain various exotic derivatives features. So, advanced quantitative tools and methods are required for valuation and risk management of these products. This represents a practically relevant and challenging research problem. Our previous work considers valuation of guaranteed minimum death benefits (GMDBs). A substantial series of closed-form formulas is obtained for various kind options. In order to obtain closed form valuation formulas, a key assumption made in our previous work is that the payment time and the linked underlying asset are independent. This assumption is reasonable for GMDBs. However, there are many insurance and financial products with payment at a random time, the payment time and the linked underlying asset are correlated. The methodologies used in our previous papers cannot be used to deal with this situation. This project will investigate the models where the payment time and the linked underlying asset are correlated. In some special cases, we expect to obtain closed form or analytical solutions. For more general models, we propose numerical methods to tackle the problem. In our previous work, we use the linear combination of exponential distributions to approximate the random payment time. To obtain a better fitting, we study Phase-type stopping of jump diffusion. If the underlying asset is not a stock or index, the models used in our previous work may not be proper. We shall investigate other models. Variable annuities and other equity linked life insurance products contain both market risk and mortality risk. Risk management of portfolios containing equity linked life insurance products is a challenging problem. It is of great importance for the insurance companies to adopt appropriate hedging and risk management methodologies to deal with the risk from selling equity linked products. This is another theme of this project. We believe that our work paves a way to stimulate the development of some new and appropriate theories and methodologies to value life insurance liabilities and related insurance and financial products. This project will help us understanding and managing the risk of portfolios containing equity linked life insurance products, and generate plenty of opportunities for further research. Our research will make significant impact on both insurance and financial industries. 現在很多保險公司和金融機構都銷售變額年金和股票指數年金。這些產品的結構比傳統保險產品複雜得多。這些產品往往帶有奇異期權，這類產品的定價及風險管理需要高深的數理方法。對這些產品的研究既是實際的需要並且充滿挑戰。我們以前的工作考慮的是保低死亡付給的定價。對不同種類的期權，我們得到了一系列顯式解。 為了得到顯式解，一個關鍵的假設是支付時間和相聯的股票價格是獨立的。對保低死亡付給產品，這一假設是合理的。但很多保險和金融產品的支付時間和相聯的股票價格是相關的。我們以前的方法無法直接用到這類產品。本項目將研究支付時間和相聯股價相關的模型。對一些特殊的情形，我們有望得到解析解。對一般的模型，我們會給出數值方法。 在我們以前的工作，我們用指數分佈的綫性組合去逼近支付時間分佈。一個可能更好的辦法是用相型分佈去逼近支付時間分佈。當相連的資產不是股票時，以前用的股價模型可能不合理。我們也會考慮別的模型。 當資產組合中帶有與股票相連的壽險產品時，風險管理變得具有挑戰性。採取適當的對沖和風險管理對保險公司是非常重要的，如果保險公司在賣這類產品。這也是我們要研究的課題。我們相信我們的研究會提供新的適合的定價方法。本課題對我們理解和管理這類產品的風險將會是有幫助的。我們的研究也會對以後進一步研究提供很多題材。

17305018.label: Realisation of objectives
17305018.value: We have addressed all the objectives of this project and obtained very satisfactory results. 5 papers have been published on the themes of this project. In Asmussen et al. (2019) study the fitting of PH distributions to human lifetimes. The class of generalized Coxian distributions is given special attention. In part, some new software is developed. In the second part, pricing of life insurance products such as guaranteed minimum death benefit and high-water benefit is treated for the case where the lifetime distribution is approximated by a PH distribution, and the underlying asset price process is described by a jump-diffusion with PH jumps. The expressions are typically explicit in terms of matrix-exponentials involving two matrices closely related to the Wiener-Hopf factorization, for which recently, a Lévy process version has been developed for a PH horizon. The computational power of the method of the approach is illustrated via a number of numerical examples. In Siu et al. (2019), risk management of portfolios with derivative security is studied in a hidden, Markovian regimes witching economy. The approach can be applied to manage the insurance portfolio with variable annuities as the payoff of the embedded options in variable annuities is the same as a derivative. A generalized delta-hedged ratio and a generalized elasticity of an option are introduced to accommodate the presence of the information state process and the derivative security. Li et al. (2021) provide the first systematic numerical study on, via the popular Fourier-cosine (COS) method, finite-time Gerber--Shiu functions with the risk process being driven by a generic Levy subordinator. These functions play a major role in modern actuarial science, and there are still many open problems left behind such as the one here of looking for a universal an effective numerical scheme for them. By extending the celebrated Ballot Theorem to the continuous setting, we first derive an explicit integral expression for these functions, with an arbitrary penalty, in terms of their infinite-time counterpart. As is common in actuarial or financial practice, advanced knowledge of the characteristic function of the driving Levy process facilitates the applicants of the Fourier-cosine method to this integral expression. Under some mild and practically feasible assumptions, a comprehensive and rigorous (yet demanding) error analysis is provided; indeed, up to an arbitrarily chosen error tolerance level, the numerical scheme is linear in computational complexity, which can even reach the theoretically fastest possible rate of 3; all of these are the most effective records of the contemporary state of the art in actuarial science. Finally, the effectiveness of our approximation method is illustrated through different representative numerical experiments, some of which, such as those driven by Gamma and Generalized Stable Processes, are even achieved for the first time in the literature. Yong and Yang (2022) consider the problem of valuing an equity-linked insurance product with a cliquet-style pay-off. The premium is invested in a reference asset whose dynamic is modeled by a geometric Brownian motion. The policy delivers payment to the benefit ciliary at either a fixed maturity or the time upon the insured's death, whichever comes first. The residual lifetime of a policyholder is described by a random variable, assumed to be independent of the asset price process, and its distribution is approximated by a linear sum of exponential distributions. Under such characterization, closed- form valuation formulae are derived for the contract considered. Moreover, a discrete-time setting is briefly discussed. Finally, numerical examples are provided to illustrate our proposed approach. Yong and Yang (2021) investigate valuing the cliquet-style equity-linked insurance product with death benefits. Whether the insured dies before the contract maturity or not, a benefit payment to the beneficiary is due. The premium is invested in a financial asset, whose dynamics are assumed to follow an exponential jump diffusion. In addition, the remaining lifetime of an insured is modeled by an independent random variable whose distribution can be approximated by a linear combination of exponential distributions. We found that the valuation problem was reduced to calculating certain discounted expectations. The Laplace inverse transform and techniques from existing literature were implemented to obtain analytical valuation formulae.

17305018.label: Major findings and research outcome
17305018.value: In this project, we investigated the valuation and risk management of equity-linked insurance products. we obtain closed-form results for the valuation of Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefits (GMDB) with a cliquet-style pay-off under both the Geometric Brownian motion model and the jump-diffusion model using lear exponential distributions to approximate the lifetime distribution. In the Phase-type stopping of Brownian motion and Phase-type stopping of jump-diffusion, we develop some powerful numerical methods to tackle the problem and obtain very satisfactory results. The numerical method also helps us to manage the risks of insurance portfolios with equity-linked products. We also investigated some classical actuarial science problems using both theoretical approaches and numerical methods. We have published 5 papers that are directly from this project in refereed international journals and the PI has presented a number of papers at international conferences. 3 Ph.D. students worked on the topics of this project and have graduated now.

17305018.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17305018.value: Our work from this project paves a way to stimulate the development of some new and appropriate theories and methodologies to value life insurance liabilities and related insurance and financial products. This project will provide us with plenty of opportunities for further research. In the future, I shall continue doing research in this direction with help of AI techniques and data science.

17305018.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17305018.value: In this project, we have investigated the problems of valuation and risk management of variable annuities and equity-indexed insurance contracts. The contractual structures of these products are more sophisticated than traditional insurance products. In particular, these products contain various exotic derivatives features. So, advanced quantitative tools and methods are required for the valuation and risk management of these products. We have obtained very satisfactory results, 5 research papers on the themes of this project have been published in refereed international journals. This project has investigated the equity-linked insurance models where the payment time and the linked underlying asset are correlated. In some special cases, we have obtained closed-form or analytical solutions. We have also used some numerical methods to tackle the problem when the model is more general. The insurance products investigated in this project are sold in the insurance market and are very popular. It is of great importance for insurance companies to adopt appropriate hedging and risk management methodologies to deal with the risk of selling equity-linked products. Our work paves the way to stimulate the development of some new and appropriate theories and methodologies to value life insurance liabilities and related insurance products.

17305218.label: Project Objectives
17305218.value: We will construct the Landau Fermi liquid theory as applied to spinless Fermi gas interacting via p-wave scattering and investigate its quasi-particle properties, including the ground state energy, quasi-particle effective mass, residue and lifetime. Comparison with the s-wave case will be made wherever appropriate. Particular attention will be paid to the effective range dependences in those quantities. We will investigate and verify the p-wave universal relations in the weak interacting limit. We will setup the transport equation for p-wave Fermi gas and investigate the collision integral that arises in the p-wave Fermi gas. We will pay close attention to the possible angular dependences of transport arising due to p-wave scattering.

17305218.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305218.value: The exact study of model systems has deepened our understanding of interaction effects in quantum many-body systems and constitutes one of the most fruitful directions in many-body physics. One can cite as a prime example the Bogolyubov theory of a weakly interacting Bose gas which elucidates much of the phenomenology of Landau’s theory of superfluid Helium four. On the other hand, the dilute two-component Fermi gas has also been very instrumental in our understanding of the Landau Fermi liquid theory. Cold atom experiments offer a unique opportunity for these model systems to be realised and their properties have been investigated in great detail and in general found to be in very good agreement with theory. Recently, systems with p-wave Feshbach resonance has been discovered and some of their properties have been investigated in detail, such as the binding energy of the p-wave dimers and universal relations. Instead of focusing on the strongly interacting regime, in this proposal, we shall address the problem of a weakly interacting p-wave Fermi gas and investigate its Fermi liquid properties. We note that in comparison with the s-wave Fermi gas, the p-wave system offers not only more interesting orbital degrees of freedom, but also requires the effective range for its proper description. In addition, the momentum dependent p-wave scattering is likely to introduce a significant change in the transport properties of the system. The following aspects will be investigated: (1) The explicit computation of the ground state energy, quasi-particle effective mass and lifetime, and the Landau functions and (2) the construction of transport equations and in particular the analysis of collision integral for the p-wave Fermi gas. While the general theory of a Fermi liquid is well-known, the proposed calculations should give exact parameters in the Fermi liquid description of p-wave Fermi gas and will be important in later investigations of its transport properties and interpretation of future experiments. In both parts, we will try to highlight the differences as compared with the classic calculation of Galistkii for a weakly interacting two-component Fermi gas. 在多体物理中，一些弱相互作用问题的严格解大大加深了我们对于多体体系的理解。一个很常见的例子是Bogoliubov的弱相互作用玻色子理论，它加深了我们对于朗道超流理论的理解。另外一个例子是Galistkii对于弱相互作用两份量费米子的研究加深了我们对于费米液体的理解。这类理想体系在冷原子中可以被实现，而且他们的性质可以被系统的研究。最近的实验上对于p-波费米子进展让我们理解了其在强相互作用下的普适性质。在我们这个项目中，我们将研究弱相互作用p-波费米子的费米液体理论的性质。相比较于Galistkii的计算而言，p-波费米子有更多的相互作用轨道自由度，而且需要两个参数来描述其行为。我们将研究其基态能量，准粒子的性质以及朗道函数。另外我们将研究p-波费米子的输运方程。我们的目的是利用微扰论来计算费米液体理论的参数。

17305218.label: Major findings and research outcome
17305218.value: 1. The Fermi liquid properties of a single component Fermi gas has been investigated and the resulting result is published in Physics Review Letters 123 070404 (2019). In that work, we have essentially calculated all Landau Fermi liquid characterisations of the system, apart from the quasi-particle residue, which cannot be obtained from our simple formulation, and requires the inclusion of three-body and higher order terms in the effective range expansion. The problem is still worth investigating, but would require a lot more efforts. 2. The transport based on Landau-Boltzmann equation has been investigated especially for the two experimentally relevant quantities, namely bulk and shear viscosity. It is shown that within the formulation, the results obtained from the kinetic calculation differ from that based on Kubo formula. The structure of the collision integral is analysed. The relevant work was summarised in a paper to be published (but delayed as my student and then postdoc, Dr. Liu Ruibin has since decided to quit physics for reasons unrelated to the project). It is included in his thesis and also in the manuscript attached to this final report.

17305218.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17305218.value: Recently there has been some experimental interest in p-wave Fermi gas, especially the recent progress in creating higher density p-wave gases in the weak coupling limit. This system is relatively long lived and collision could lead to thermal equilibrium within a reasonable time scale. As such, some of our prediction, for example, the existence of zero sound might be tested in experiments. Theoretically, I am still interested in the calculation of quasi-particle residue, a quantity that is obviously very important in the general framework of Fermi liquid theory. However, so far, attempts have been unsuccessful due to the complication of dealing with nested divergences. I would still like to see if we can find a way to deal with it.

17305218.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17305218.value: The study of many-body system with inter-particle interaction is always a fascinating field of investigation because many collective phenomena can occur which cannot be reduced to the properties of a single particle (as a result, a naive reductionist view is invalid). In this field, exact results are usually very hard to find and controlled calculations are thus very appealing theoretically. In this regard, we have studies a model system that is very close to experiment, namely, the properties of a single component Fermi gas that is undergone p-wave interaction. The results are quite nice and fits very well (apart from quasi-particle residue, see above) with the general framework of Landau Fermi liquid theory. Within Landau Fermi liquid theory, one can investigate the transport of quasi-particle (not the original particles) and thus calculate the viscosities of the system. This is what we did with p-wave Fermi gas.

17305518.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305518.value: Many biological tissues such as the cornea consist of organized layers of cells that enable the functions and activities essential for organs. Damage to a layer can lead to tissue dysfunction, triggering the need for treatment or even transplantation. However, a lack of reliable sources of tissues and organs, as well as potential organ failure due to graft rejection, significantly jeopardizes patients’ chances of recovery. Despite immense advances in tissue engineering, synthetic tissues have not fulfilled their promise for transplantation, in part because we lack understanding of the cell organization in biological systems and approaches to assembling controlled cell sheets. Although techniques such as bioprinting have been demonstrated to control clusters of cells geometrically, organizing individual cells into a compact cell sheet remains elusive. One way to achieve the desired cell organization is by incorporating a solid scaffold that provides a framework for cells to attach to. However, growing cell-dense tissues often involves degradation of the scaffold, and the degradation process can elicit undesired effects such as inflammatory responses in the tissues assembled, even for biodegradable scaffolds. Emulsion droplets and interfaces have also served as platforms for the directed assembly of colloidal particles into monolayers. The use of liquid-liquid interfaces as substrates offers the advantage of not requiring solid scaffolds while facilitating the self-organization of the particles and cells. However the typical inclusion of oil as one of the emulsion phases can compromise component biocompatibility and bioactivity. Hence, the use of all-aqueous emulsions, i.e., mixtures of two immiscible aqueous phases containing high concentrations of multiple water-soluble additives, offers an exciting alternative. To assemble compact cell sheets from suspensions of cells in all-aqueous droplets, the interactions among the cells and with the aqueous-aqueous interfaces need to be better understood. The aims of the proposed project are to (1) understand the organized spreading of all-aqueous droplets (OSAD) on aqueous-aqueous interfaces, (2) develop an approach to organizing the particles and cells inside those droplets into compact cell sheets, and (3) engineer sheets of particles and/or cells with controlled compositions using the OSAD approach. In the short term, the study will provide a fundamental understanding of the dynamics between the adsorption and assembly of particles and cells at all-aqueous interfaces, and suggest a physicochemical strategy for forming cell sheets. In the long term, it will contribute to the development of artificial transplants that rely on thin cell sheets, such as corneal transplants. 角膜等生物組織具有多層細胞結構，用以維持其必需的功能及活性。若一層細胞被破壞，將導致整個組織的功能紊亂。因此，細胞層被破壞時，需要進行適當的治療，嚴重的情況甚至需要進行細胞移植。然而，由於移植排斥及缺少可靠來源的細胞、器官，這種細胞移植極大降低了病患康復的機率。儘管目前組織工程學飛速發展，但其產生出來的生物組織仍然很難用於細胞移植。其中一部分原因是由於我們對生物系統中的細胞組織及其形成細胞層片的機理仍然缺乏了解。儘管現在的生物技術例如生物打印，可以用於控制細胞集群的幾何形狀，但無法將單個細胞組裝成一個高密度的細胞層片。要製備這樣的細胞層片，需要使用一個固體支架用以固定細胞。然而，高密度的細胞通常會使得固體支架降解，從而引發一系列問題例如生物組織組裝時引起的免疫反應。值得注意的是，即使使用生物可降解的固體支架，也無法避免此類問題。 液滴及液-液界面可以用作膠體顆粒組裝成單層結構的平台。由於此平台不需要固體基底，因此使用液-液界面作為基底進行微粒及細胞的自組裝具有極大的優勢。然而，製備液-液界面通常需要以油作為乳化相的乳液，而其中油的使用會大大降低製備產物的生物相容性及生物活性。因此，我們創新性地提出使用水-水乳液（由兩種互不相容的高濃度水溶液組成）來代替現有的油-水乳液。如要利用水-水液滴來製作高密度的細胞層片，我們需要深入理解細胞在水-水界面上的相互作用。 此研究的目標為：（1）理解水-水界面上的水-水液滴擴張行為（OSAD）；（2）提出一種將液滴中的細胞和顆粒組裝成高密度細胞層片的方法；（3）利用OSAD形成可以精確控製成分的顆粒與（或）細胞層片。 短期內，我們會著重研究水-水界面上顆粒和細胞的吸收及自組裝的動態過程。並且基於此研究提出一種製備細胞層片的機制。之後，我們將會用此細胞薄層片應用於人工移植，例如角膜移植。

17305518.label: Realisation of objectives
17305518.value: 1. We have investigated the organized spreading of all-aqueous droplets (OSAD) on aqueous-aqueous interfaces under different conditions, such different concentrations, types, shapes and solvents. We have characterized the behaviors of all-aqueous droplets with different stabilizing structures, including liposomes, and during the emergence of new interfaces driven by changes, such as osmotic flows. 2. To develop an approach to organizing the particles and cells inside all-aqueous droplets into compact cell sheets, we have studied and devised strategies that may induce changing shapes, including budding, of otherwise spherical or almost spherical droplets, by varying the types of stabilizers. The studies allow us to identify approaches to control the stability of all-aqueous droplets formed under different conditions and from different stabilizing materials. 3. We have engineered sheets of particles and/or cells with controlled compositions using the OSAD approach. In addition, we have also looked into the intricate and intertwining effects between stabilization and aqueous phase separation, which is a pre-requisite for the emergence of aqueous-aqueous interfaces. By freezing the structures at different stage of phase separation, we demonstrate the possibility to have different structures, not limited to core-shell and porous structures. We have also outlined the potential to incorporate this concept into printing and robotic applications, and believe these can inspire new functional cyto-mimetic materials.

17305518.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17305518.value: In this project, we have built upon our preliminary works in the successful demonstration of compact cell sheet formation by encapsulating microparticles and cells in all-aqueous droplets to propose an approach to design and fabricate cell sheets with tunable properties. The finished study showed that these systems still have great potential. On the one hand, we can keep using our knowledge of creating and modifying all-aqueous droplets to unearth wider applications, for instance, for cell patterning and delivery of bioactive compounds. On the other hand, these systems can further contribute to developing artificial tissue graft for transplantation that rely on thin cell sheets, such as transplantable corneal tissue graft. Our proposed work has great potential to generate new artificial tissue graft for transplantation, especially for eyes, as confirmed by the support of the clinician and a biomedical company that have extensive experience in eye surgeries and biomedical innovations respectively. To further support these efforts, we will submit funding requests to organizations, such as the Research Grants Council (RGC) of Hong Kong. We also suggest investigating these through industry partnerships, made possible by research grants, such as the RGC and Innovation and Technology Fund (ITF). When the findings are ready for generating new tissue transplants, we will collaborate with hospital, biomedical companies, and academia in Hong Kong, Shenzhen, and Guangdong.

17305518.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17305518.value: Transplantation of human cells, tissues or organs restores fundamental organ functions and therefore can save numerous lives. Cell-based therapies and tissue engineering are showing increasing promise as an alternative approach to organ transplantation of human donor organs that are always in shortage. To aid rapid tissue development, liquid-liquid interfaces have demonstrated promise to collect cells and allow their assembly into planar cell-based constructs. What is important is that the biphasic aqueous interfaces used in this project boast the advantage of not including any oils or organic solvents that could harm the bioactivities of the cells. Although the biphasic aqueous approach addresses the limitations associated with scaffolds and biocompatibility, cells are only passively collected on the interfaces, offering no control over cell sheet properties, such as cell arrangements and compactness. Therefore, the use of all-aqueous emulsions, which are mixtures of two immiscible aqueous phases containing high concentrations of multiple water-soluble additives, is an exciting alternative. To assemble compact monolayered cell sheets, which has huge potential to generate cell sheets as tissue graft for transplantation, from suspensions of cells in all-aqueous droplets, the interactions among the cells and with the aqueous-aqueous interfaces need to be understood. In this project, we start by studying the dynamics between adsorption and assembly of mammalian cells and microparticles at all-aqueous interfaces. We then also devised physico-chemical strategies to form monolayered cell sheets. We also engineered sheets of mammalian cell and/or microparticles with controlled compositions using the approach of OSAD. Our findings will not only inspire the relevant study of the fundamental questions that are relevant to aqueous-aqueous interfaces, but will further contribute to developing artificial transplantable tissue that rely on thin cell sheets, for example corneal epithelial or endothelial layers to restore the functions of cornea of human eye.

17305618.label: Project Objectives
17305618.value: We will investigate the radial velocity data collected by the CARMENES survey of low-mass stars to discover and characterize new multiple planet systems. We will combine new CARMENES data with existing data to improve our understanding of the 4-planet system around GJ~876. We will examine whether the 1:2:4 Laplace resonance of the outer three planets is chaotic, which places constraints on planetary migration during formation, and whether the orbit of the innermost planet is eccentric, which places constraints on the efficiency of planetary tides. We will use new radial velocity data to determine whether some systems previously identified as having a single planet on eccentric orbit in fact harbor two planets in 2:1 mean-motion resonance. We propose to investigate three aspects of the extraordinary TRAPPIST-1 system, which has 7 Earth-mass planets in a chain of resonances. We will examine the stability of the best fits, constraints on the orbital eccentricities if the system has 2-body resonances, and constraints on disk-induced migration leading to the resonant chain.

17305618.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305618.value: The search for planets around low-mass stars and multiple planet systems are both frontiers in extrasolar planet research. The overall statistics and the orbital properties of individual systems provide important constraints on the formation and dynamical evolution of planetary systems. (1) We will investigate the radial velocity data collected by the CARMENES survey of low-mass stars to discover and characterize new multiple planet systems. (2) We will combine new CARMENES data with existing data to improve our understanding of the 4-planet system around GJ~876. We will examine whether the 1:2:4 Laplace resonance of the outer three planets is chaotic, which places constraints on planetary migration during formation, and whether the orbit of the innermost planet is eccentric, which places constraints on the efficiency of planetary tides. (3) We will use new radial velocity data to determine whether some systems previously identified as having a single planet on eccentric orbit in fact harbor two planets in 2:1 mean motion resonance. (4) We propose to investigate three aspects of the extraordinary TRAPPIST-1 system, which has 7 Earth-mass planets in a chain of resonances. We will examine the stability of the best fits, constraints on the orbital eccentricities if the system has 2-body resonances, and constraints on disk-induced migration leading to the resonant chain. 尋找圍繞低質量恆星的行星和具有多個行星的系統都是系外行星研究的前沿。系外行星系統的總體統計數據和個別系統的軌道特性為行星系統的形成和演化提供重要的約束。（1）我們將考察由一項名為CARMENES的調查對低質量恆星所收集的視向速度數據，以發現和表徵新的多行星系統。（2）我們將把新的CARMENES數據與現有數據結合起來，以改進我們對GJ876的四行星系統的理解。我們會研究外三個行星的1：2：4拉普拉斯共振是否是混沌的，從而約束行星形成期間的遷移。我們也會研究最內行星的軌道是否偏心，從而約束行星潮汐的效率。（3）我們將使用新的視向速度數據來確定一些先前被確定為只有單個在偏心軌道上的行星的系統實際上是否存在兩個在2：1共振軌道的行星。（4）TRAPPIST-1是一個擁有7個在共振鏈中的類地行星的特殊系統。我們建議調查這個系統的三個方面，包括最擬合數據的模型的穩定性，如果系統具有二體軌道共振，對軌道偏心率的約束，以及共振鏈對原行星盤引起的遷移的約束。

17305618.label: Realisation of objectives
17305618.value: (1) We have analyzed the planetary system around the 0.14 solar-mass M dwarf star YZ Ceti, using an additional 229 radial velocity (RV) measurements from the CARMENES and HARPS spectrographs. We used photometry to determine that the stellar rotation period is close to 68 days. We were able to resolve aliases in the RV data to determine that there are three planets with orbital periods of 2.02, 3.06 and 4.66 days. By modeling stellar activity with a Gaussian process regression model, we determined that the amplitudes due to the three Earth-mass planets are 1.3, 1.8 and 1.5 m/s, respectively. Keplerian fits and stability analysis show that 17% of the fits are stable and 22% of the stable fits show libration of the three-body resonance angle. We have re-analyzed the planetary system around the star GJ 1148, using new and archival CARMENES and HIRES RV measurements. We confirmed that this is a rare planetary system with two massive planets around a low-mass M dwarf star. The Saturn-mass planets are on eccentric orbits with periods of 41 and 532 days. We studied the orbital dynamics of this system using both direct N-body integrations and secular theory and found that the planetary orbits are likely in apsidal alignment having the largest possible libration amplitude. The inner planet GJ 1148 b is in the so-called optimistic habitable zone, and we examined the prospects of a potentially habitable moon around GJ 1148 b. We found only a narrow dynamically stable region around the planet where an exomoon can exist, but the exomoon orbits in this region decay rapidly due to tides. (2) The number of observations of GJ 876 by the CARMENES spectrograph during the grant period has been smaller than expected due to other priorities in the observing program. Since we cannot yet significantly improve on the existing fits for GJ 876, we decided to turn our attention to two systems discovered by the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), which was launched at the beginning of the grant period. TESS has detected transits of the K-dwarf star TOI-2202 by a Jupiter-mass planet with an orbital period of 11.9 days. The transits show significant timing variations. We have obtained RV measurements with FEROS, HARPS, and PFS. A joint dynamical analysis of the transit and RV data showed that there is a second giant planets in a 24.7-day orbit. The planets are just outside the 2:1 mean-motion resonance. Similarly, TESS has detected transits of the K-dwarf star TOI-2525 by two planets with significant timing variations. We have obtained RV data with FEROS and PFS. A joint analysis showed that there are 2 warm giant planets in 23.3 and 49.3 day orbits, just outside the 2:1 mean-motion resonance. (3) We have performed an analysis of the RV observations of the giant star 7 Canis Majoris, combining data obtained by our collaboration using the Lick, HARPS and SONG spectrographs with published UCLES data. The data reveal two planets with minimum masses of 1.9 and 0.9 Jupiter masses and orbital periods of 740 and 990 days, respectively. We performed dynamical fits and stability analysis in a Bayesian framework and found that 13% of the Markov chain Monte Carlo samples are stable. The stable fits have the two planets in a low-eccentricity 4:3 mean-motion resonance. Using the HARPS and CARMENES data obtained by our group, we have performed an independent and detailed analysis of the two-planet system HD 10718. We confirmed that it has a Saturn-mass planet with a period of 77 days and a Neptune-mass planet on an eccentric 18-day orbit. The planet HD 10718 b falls into an area in the mass vs orbital separation space that is sparsely populated with planets. We have discovered a third planet around the 1.5 solar-mass giant star HD 33142, using new and archival HARPS, FEROS, and HIRES RV data. We confirmed two Jupiter-mass planets with orbital periods of 330 and 810 days and discovered a Saturn-mass planet in a closer-in 90-day orbit. We have performed dynamical analysis, which show that the system is long-term stable but that the planets will likely be engulfed near the tip of the red giant branch phase of the parent star due to tidal migration. Two undergraduate students under the PI's supervision have worked on the remaining systems in our observing program using HARPS and FEROS to collect data on a sample of stars previously thought to contain a single planet on an eccentric orbit. At least two stars show long term trends in the RV data that are likely due to an additional long period companion. (4) A PhD student under the PI's supervision has worked on three-body resonances and resonant chains. By carefully removing the other planets in the TRAPPIST-1 system, we have constructed three-planet systems based on planets d, e, and f of TRAPPIST-1, which are in the 3:2 and 3:2 resonance chain. We were able to construct systems with pure three-body resonance (i.e., without libration of the two-body resonance angles) and double two-body resonance at different proximity to exact commensurabilities. We found that pure three-body resonance can be generated if the forced eccentricity is small enough that there is no separatrix and the free eccentricity is larger than the forced eccentricity. We have also studied the multiple equilibrium solutions of 3-body resonances. We showed that the multiple equilibrium solutions originates from the combination of different geometric phases in 2-body resonance between the inner and the outer planet pairs. We performed N-body simulations, which show that the probability of capture into different libration centers is highly skewed if the resonance is assembled by non-adiabatic migration. We also examined the conditions necessary to maintain the known resonant chains such as Kepler-60, Kepler-80, Kepler-223 and TRAPPIST-1, if they were assembled by migration in protoplanetary disk. For type-I migration in an adiabatic disk model, the conditions can be stated analytically, and we found that rather extreme disk parameters (very different from those of the Minimum Mass Solar Nebula, viscously heated disk, weak or strongly opaque disk) are needed to maintain the resonant chains.

17305618.value: (1) We have used radial velocity (RV) data collected by CARMENES to discover and characterize new multiple planet systems. We have determined that there are 3 Earth-mass planets in an ultra-compact configuration around the star YZ Ceti, with orbital period ratios near 3:2 and 3:2, suggesting a three-body resonance. We have also confirmed that GJ 1148 is a rare planetary system with two giant planets around a low-mass M dwarf star. (2) We have combined transit data obtained by the TESS mission with RV data to discover two planetary systems around the K-dwarf stars TOI-2202 and TOI-2525. In both cases, there is a pair of warm giant planets just outside the 2:1 mean-motion resonance. Two journal papers have been published. (3) We have analyzed the HAPRS and FEROS RV data collected by our observing program of stars previously thought to contain a single planet on an eccentric orbit. We have discovered a second planet orbiting 7 Canis Majoris. The two Jupiter-like planets are in a 4:3 mean-motion resonance, making it only the third discovered system in this resonance. We have confirmed the existence of a second Neptune-mass planet around the solar-type star HD 107148. We have also discovered a third Saturn-mass planet around the giant star HD 33142 and showed that all three planets will likely be engulfed near the tip of the red giant branch phase of the parent star due to tidal migration. Three journal papers have been published. (4) We have improved several aspects of our understanding of three-body resonance and resonant chains. We were able to construct pure three-body resonance and double two-body resonance under different conditions. We were able to provide a simple geometric explanation for the multiple equilibrium solutions of 3-body resonances. We also showed that the disk conditions needed to maintain the observed resonant chains during disk-induced migration are rather extreme and that a planetary migration halting mechanism near the inner edge of the disk may be needed. At least two journal papers will be submitted soon.

17305618.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17305618.value: CARMENES has continued to observe the GJ 876 system. With the extended time line and the increased number of RV observations, it will be possible to determine whether the Laplace resonance of the outer three planets is chaotic and whether the orbit of the innermost planet is eccentric. An excess of planet pairs just outside first-order resonances like 2:1 was first found in the sample of multiple-planet systems discovered by the Kepler mission. Unlike many Kepler systems, the properties of systems discovered by TESS can be well constrained by RV data, as shown in our papers on TOI-2202 and TOI-2525. With the TESS systems, it will be interesting to revisit which of the previously proposed mechanisms is responsible for the excess just outside first-order resonances. Further work is needed to analyze and publish the entire RV data set that we collected on the sample of stars previously identified as having a single planet on eccentric orbit. Some systems show long term RV trends likely due to an additional long period companion, while the orbital parameters of the systems still consistent with a single planet can be improved.

17305618.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17305618.value: We have investigated the dynamics and origins of extrasolar multi-planet systems. We have used radial velocity data to discover or characterize (1) 3 Earth-mass planets in a three-body resonance around the star YZ Ceti, (2) a rare system with two giant planets around the low-mass star GJ 1148, (3) two Jupiter-like planets in 4:3 resonance around the star 7 Canis Majoris, (4) a second Neptune-mass planet around the solar-type star HD 107148, and (5) a third Saturn-mass planet around the giant star HD 33142. We have also combined transit data obtained by the TESS mission with radial velocity data to discover two planetary systems around the stars TOI-2202 and TOI-2525, both of which have a pair of warm giant planet just outside the 2:1 resonance. We have investigated several aspects of the extraordinary systems (such as TRAPPIST-1) with three or more planets in a chain of resonances. In particular, we have found that it is difficult to maintain the resonant chains during migration induced by the protoplanetary disk and that a migration halting mechanism near the inner edge of the disk may be needed.

17305718.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305718.value: Earth’s earliest period, including its transition from magma ocean to plate tectonics, remains poorly understood. Hypotheses vary dramatically: from a rapid onset of plate tectonics, assuming that Earth’s oldest endogenic materials, zircons up to 4.4 billion years old, record plate tectonic subduction; to scenarios in which the first third of Earth history was dominated by vertical tectonic processes, such as volcanism and sub-/intra-lithospheric diapirism, which created a single-plate lithosphere. At the heart of this debate is the 4.0 to 3.2 billion year old geological record, which comprises terranes termed granitoid-greenstone belts. These terranes contain consistent, restricted metamorphosed rock types, dominated by mafic volcanic rocks, melt-products of those rocks, and sparse sediments derived from these rocks and from early oceans. Notwithstanding this simplicity, they are interpreted in diverse ways. Geology from some of these terranes forms the evidentiary basis for vertical tectonic models, though most can be interpreted via either plate or vertical tectonics. One ancient terrane stands apart: all detailed studies of the 3.8 - 3.6 billion year old Isua supracrustal belt of SW Greenland conclude that plate tectonic processes are responsible for its development. These interpretations, however, have tremendous variability, such that key features like proposed subduction directions are disagreed upon. Isua exhibits the same rock types as other granitoid-greenstone belts, which prompts the question: might vertical tectonic models be similarly viable for the Isua supracrustal belt? If not, the hypothesis that Earth had vertical tectonics for the first third of its history can be ruled out. The Isua supracrustal belt thus offers an opportunity to test contrasting tectonic models for early Earth. Despite long recognition of this value, the remote setting and expense of Isua field work mean that some useful techniques have yet to be applied. We will use samples from our recently completed field work at Isua to conduct [1] the first microstructural analysis spanning the belt, including determination of crystallographic preferred orientations, to constrain the distributions, mechanisms, and temperatures of deformation. This will be combined with [2] phase equilibria determinations to illuminate relationships between metamorphism and deformation, and supplemented by [3] dating of key igneous and metamorphic crystallization events to test specific tectonic model predictions. Synthesis of our findings will permit reconstruction of the tectono-metamorphic evolution here, thereby enabling tests of plate and vertical tectonic models at Isua, and tests of the general viability of vertical tectonic concepts for early Earth. 我們仍然缺乏對地球的最早期過程，包括從岩漿海到板塊運動的轉變的瞭解。現存的假説之間有很大的區別：從假定地球最古老的内生物質：大至44億年年齡的鋯石為板塊運動產物的板塊運動快速啓動假説；到占到地球前三分之一歷史的垂直構造運動假説，其構造過程為製造單一板塊的火山運動和岩石圈底部/内部的底譬作用。處在辯論中心的是40億至32億年前的地質編錄，其組成為一系列被稱之爲花崗-綠岩帶的地體。這些地體由一致及有限的已變質岩石所組成：主要為鎂鉄質火山岩，鎂鐵質火山岩的重熔產物以及由上述岩石和早期海洋所形成的少量沉積岩。部分地體的地質樣式組成了垂直構造運動的證據基礎，但絕大部分地體可以同時被板塊運動或垂直構造運動所解釋。 有一個古老的地體與衆不同：所有對格陵蘭西南部的38-36億年年齡的Isua表殼岩帶的研究都認爲這個地體是由板塊運動所發展而來。但是這些構造解釋有著很大的可變性，譬如如同解釋所提出的板塊俯衝方向這樣關鍵的構造樣式都沒有取得一致。Isua展現出和其他花崗-綠岩帶一樣的岩石類型，因此迫使了這個問題的提出：垂直構造運動在Isua表殼岩帶也同樣可行嗎？如果答案是否定的話，那麽那些認爲地球前三分之一歷史擁有垂直構造運動的假説可以被排除了。 因此，Isua表殼岩帶提供了一個機會來檢驗不同的早地球構造模型。雖然人們早已認識到其價值，Isua的偏遠和在此從事野外工作的巨大開銷意味著一些實用的技術仍然未被運用。我們將會使用我們最近在Isua的野外工作中取得的樣品來開展：【1】首例以整個岩帶為範圍的微構造分析，包括對晶體優選定向的確定，從而約束構造變形的分佈，機制以及溫度。這項研究將會結合【2】相平衡研究從而闡明變質作用和變形作用的關係，輔以【3】對關鍵的火成和變質事件的定年從而檢驗特定的模型預測。對我們發現的綜合將允許對Isua的構造-變質過程進行重建，從而能夠使我們檢驗板塊運動假説和垂直構造運動假説在Isua的可行性，以及檢驗垂直構造運動這個概念在早地球的總體可行性。
